hotel.name: Mountain Shadow Hostel
hotel.desc: Mountain Shadow Hostel is a well-established hostel in downtown Rossland, BC, operating for over two decades and serving travellers drawn to Red Mountain Resort and the surrounding mountain terrain. It offers both private rooms and co-op dorm options, with a full kitchen, laundry, and a snowboard/ski maintenance area catering to outdoor adventurers. Its central location puts guests within walking distance of grocery stores and local amenities.

notes.Laundry: Guest review on site: 'The hostel has everything you need including WiFi, laundry, full kitchen, and snowboard/ski maintenance area.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Guest review on site: '1min walking distance to liquor and grocery stores.'

hotel.name: Lá:lem te Baker (UFV Guest Accommodation)
hotel.desc: Baker House is a University of the Fraser Valley residence building on the Abbotsford campus that opens to guest and group accommodation during the summer months. As a university dorm repurposed for travellers, it offers an affordable base in the Fraser Valley for cyclists passing through the region. Its seasonal availability and institutional setting make it a distinctive option compared to conventional hotels or B&Bs.

hotel.name: Sunstone
hotel.desc: Sunstone is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island—a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Warm pine-clad interiors and a nature-immersive setting distinguish the retreat, and every stay includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. Bowen Island itself offers mountain biking and hiking, making this a tranquil base for cyclists exploring the island.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

hotel.name: The Rodfathers
hotel.desc: An eco retreat glamping cabin in the Fraser Valley near Chilliwack, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin #3 The Rodfathers.' The property appears to be a standalone cabin-style accommodation rather than a traditional guesthouse or hotel.

hotel.name: St Clair Hotel-Hostel
hotel.desc: Built in 1911 by Captain Henry Pybus, St Clair Hotel-Hostel is one of Vancouver's oldest heritage buildings and the city's first concrete structure, originally designed to welcome travelers arriving by train and ship. It operates today as a nautical-themed hostel in downtown Vancouver, offering private rooms across several configurations — single, double, twin, triple, and family quad — with shared washrooms and a kitchenette. Located steps from SkyTrain, beaches, parks, and city attractions, it caters to budget-conscious travelers seeking private accommodation in the urban core.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry facilities on the first floor for guest use, confirmed on rooms/rates page and amenities list
notes.Luggage storage: Same-day luggage storage available for guests only; explicitly not overnight

hotel.name: Queens Hotel
hotel.desc: Queens Hotel bills itself as the only hotel in Queensborough, a historic neighborhood of New Westminster, and occupies a quiet residential setting that buffers highway noise. The boutique property offers multiple room types from twin beds to family suites, all with premium Serta pillowtop mattresses and strong Wi-Fi throughout, and is notably pet-friendly with selected pet-friendly rooms. It sits close to the Q to Q Ferry to downtown New Westminster, the Queensborough Landing Outlet Mall, and a cluster of restaurants within walking distance, with a covered patio and BBQ available on-site.

detail.address: 130-1110 Ewen Avenue, New Westminster, BC V3M 5E4

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple restaurants within 15-minute walk including Boston Pizza, Pho Express, Naan Bites, Opa Souvlaki, Nando's Flame Grilled Chicken, Tora Sushi, Tim Hortons, Subway, and A&W

hotel.name: O Canada House Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: O Canada House is a meticulously restored 1897 Queen Anne-style Victorian home in Vancouver's West End, awarded the City of Vancouver Heritage Award of Honour in 1997 for its interior and exterior restoration. The house has notable historical significance as the site where Ewing Buchan penned one of the first English versions of Canada's National Anthem in 1908. Guests stay in individually decorated suites filled with Victorian antiques, steps from downtown attractions, restaurants, and the seawall.

notes.Nearby evening food: Area page lists multiple nearby restaurants including Guu Original Thurlow Izakaya, CinCin Ristorante & Bar, Coast Seafood Restaurant, and Breka Bakery and Cafe
notes.Luggage storage: Rooms page states: 'Take advantage of our luggage storage for early check-ins and late check-outs with proper notice.'

hotel.name: Anchors Inn
hotel.desc: Anchors Inn is a small waterfront property in Ucluelet offering two cozy cabins and a one-bedroom suite, all pet-friendly and self-catering, operating since 2003. The suite features a full kitchen, propane fireplace, private deck with barbecue, and access to a hot tub. The property sits near the beach in a historically notable neighbourhood associated with pioneering botanist George Fraser.

hotel.name: Tyrol Lodge
hotel.desc: Tyrol Lodge is a chalet-style accommodation on Alta Lake Road in Whistler, BC, situated near the shores of Alta Lake in one of Canada's premier mountain resort communities. The Alta Lake corridor is popular with cyclists using the Valley Trail and the Sea-to-Sky corridor. No current website content is available to characterize the property further.

hotel.name: West Coast Suites at UBC
hotel.desc: West Coast Suites at UBC are the campus's most premium offering—modern Signature Studio and One-Bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, available year-round on the University of British Columbia's forested Point Grey campus. The property is sustainably heated by biomass generation and hydro electricity, and sits about 20–25 minutes from downtown Vancouver by car or transit. For touring cyclists, the location provides a quiet, scenic base with direct access to Pacific Spirit Regional Park trails and the broader Metro Vancouver cycling network.

detail.address: 5961 Student Union Boulevard, Vancouver, BC V6T 2C9

notes.Laundry: "Laundry facilities available" listed in features for both West Coast Suites and Gage Suites pages

hotel.name: A Snug Harbour Inn
hotel.desc: A Snug Harbour Inn is a six-room luxury oceanfront bed and breakfast perched on an 85-foot cliff in Ucluelet, surrounded by old-growth forest and dramatic Pacific coastline on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The inn sits directly on the Wild Pacific Trail with access from the end of the driveway and is a short drive from Pacific Rim National Park and Long Beach. It caters exclusively to adult guests, with a private beach, communal hot tub, and a Great Room featuring a wall of ocean-facing windows.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'many great restaurants in Ucluelet, all of which you can walk to' and lists named establishments including Norwoods (open for dinner only) on the /ucluelet-restaurants.html page

hotel.name: Vanhorne Guest House
hotel.desc: Van Horne Guesthouse is a single self-contained 400 sq ft apartment suite in Field, BC, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park in the Canadian Rockies. The property is run by francophone hosts with over 30 years of Rocky Mountain guiding experience, offering a private entrance, full kitchen, and satellite TV. Field sits at the gateway to Takakkaw Falls, Emerald Lake, and Lake O'Hara, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the Icefields Parkway corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Restaurants, cafes, arts, souvenirs shops' are in Field village, described as a short distance from the suite
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'a convenience store' is available in Field village to facilitate guests' stay

hotel.name: Birds of a Feather B&B
hotel.desc: A purpose-built, fully licensed luxury waterfront B&B situated on the shores of the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, on the western beaches of greater Victoria. The property offers three self-contained private-entrance studio suites on the second floor, each with individual climate control, and sits on an ocean lagoon with a private dock, kayaks, and canoes available to guests. The website features dedicated pages for arriving by bicycle and an on-site EV charging station, signaling a cyclist- and adventure-traveller-aware operation.

hotel.name: Princess and the Pea Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: Princess and the Pea Bed & Breakfast is a small, owner-operated B&B in Langley, BC, run by Sharon & Wally Martin. Its storybook name hints at a cozy, attentive hosting style typical of independent B&Bs in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists riding through Langley on routes connecting the Lower Mainland to the Interior would find it a locally rooted alternative to chain accommodation.

hotel.name: Alfred House
hotel.desc: Alfred House is a grand 4-bedroom Queen Anne style heritage home built in 1905, set within Ruckle Heritage Farm — the oldest operating family farm in BC's Gulf Islands and now part of a Class A provincial park. Guests rent the entire house via Airbnb and enjoy sweeping pastoral views, handcrafted period woodwork, and access to on-site farm-to-table meals and picnic baskets. Accredited by the BC Accommodations Association, it offers a genuinely immersive heritage experience for cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island.

detail.address: 1801 Beaver Point Road, Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 1W3

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website states 'Farm-to-table breakfast and dinner, as well as picnic basket options available' — picnic baskets serve as a packed meal option
notes.Nearby evening food: Farm-to-table dinner available on-site at Ruckle Heritage Farm

hotel.name: At The Beach Retreat
hotel.desc: At the Beach Retreat is a single-suite luxury waterfront bed and breakfast perched directly on the shores of Burrard Inlet in Port Moody, featuring a private hot tub, cedar sauna, gas fireplace, and gourmet breakfast delivered to the suite each morning. The property sits on a sandy beach with dock access and is steps from the TransLink 181 bus route, which connects to the SkyTrain and West Coast Express at Moody Centre Station. Newport Village's restaurants and the Port Moody Ale Trail are close by, with hiking trails also accessible from the area.

detail.address: 872 Alderside Road, Port Moody, BC V3H 3A6

notes.Nearby evening food: Located near Newport Village with fine restaurants and shops, and the Murray Street Ale Trail is accessible via the 181 bus

hotel.name: Up the Creek
hotel.desc: Up the Creek Backpacker's Lodge is a family-run cedar house hostel on BC's Sunshine Coast, operating since 2004 and situated 14 km from the Langdale ferry terminal — making it a natural stopover for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries from Vancouver. It explicitly caters to cyclists with loaner bikes and a dedicated cyclist camping area, and sits a short 10-minute walk from the heart of Roberts Creek village. The lodge has a warm, nature-focused character and is well-reviewed for cleanliness and hospitality.

detail.address: 1261 Roberts Creek Road, Roberts Creek, V0N 2W2

hotel.name: Kicking Horse Hostel
hotel.desc: Kicking Horse Hostel is a budget hostel situated in Golden, BC, a mountain town that serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park, Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, and a network of world-class cycling trails. Golden sits at the confluence of several major touring routes through the Canadian Rockies, making it a natural overnight stop for long-distance cyclists. The hostel's location on Station Avenue places it within the small downtown core.

hotel.name: The Old Dorm B&B
hotel.desc: The Lodge at the Old Dorm is a guest house / bed-and-breakfast located on Bowen Island, BC, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a B&B at 460 Melmore Road. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay and is a popular destination for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast corridor. No verified web presence was found to describe the property in detail.

hotel.name: 99 Trials Association Upper Cabin
hotel.desc: A free, unlocked wilderness hut at 870 m elevation in the Sea to Sky corridor near Squamish, operated by the 99 Trials Association — a non-profit motorcycle trials club active since 2016. The one-storey wooden cabin offers a basic fireplace shelter for trail users but has no drinking water, toilets, shower, or mattresses. Touring cyclists passing through the area may use it as an emergency or overnight stop on backcountry routes, though facilities are extremely minimal.

hotel.name: 99 Trials Association Lower Cabin
hotel.desc: An unlocked, open-access wilderness shelter near Squamish operated by the 99 Trials Association, a non-profit motorcycle trials club advocating for trails throughout the Sea to Sky corridor. The one-storey wood cabin sits at 467m elevation and offers basic refuge with a fireplace, but no running water, toilets, mattresses, or shower facilities. No reservation is required and the door is never locked, making it available on demand to anyone who reaches it.

hotel.name: The Chick Inn
hotel.desc: A glamping cabin located at Tamihi Meadows in the Chilliwack area, listed exclusively on Airbnb. The property sits near the Chilliwack River valley, a popular area for outdoor recreation east of Chilliwack.

hotel.name: Saturna Lodge
hotel.desc: Saturna Lodge is a guest house situated on Saturna Island, one of the more remote Southern Gulf Islands of British Columbia, located on the traditional W̱SÁNEĆ homelands of the SENĆOŦEN speaking people. The island is accessible only by BC Ferries or small aircraft, making it a distinctive destination for cyclists touring the Gulf Islands by ferry. The lodge's website sections for rates, reservations, and reviews suggest it operates as a small, full-service lodging.

hotel.name: Forest Haven Hideaway
hotel.desc: Forest Heaven Hideaway is a guest house in Roberts Creek on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, situated on Joe Road. The property is notable for accepting Bitcoin, Lightning Network, and on-chain cryptocurrency payments — an unusual option for small accommodation in the region. Beyond OSM tags, no further detail about the property or its facilities is currently verifiable.

hotel.name: Highland House Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: A converted former guest house for Highland Valley Copper Mines, this 4,700-square-foot bungalow sits on 25 acres just outside Logan Lake in BC's Highland Valley. With four en-suite bedrooms and a hot tub, it caters to outdoor enthusiasts drawn to the area's fishing, ATV trails, and horseback riding — they even offer equine experiences on-site. Logan Lake is located south of Kamloops via Hwy 97C, making it a potential stop for cyclists traversing the Interior.

detail.address: 8615 Tunkwa Lake Road, Logan Lake, V0K 1W0

hotel.name: Miller Retreats
hotel.desc: Miller Retreats is a chalet-style accommodation on Bowen Island, a small island community accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver. Its location on Miller Road places it within the quiet rural interior of the island, which is popular with cyclists seeking an escape from the Lower Mainland.

hotel.name: Jasper
hotel.desc: Jasper is a modernized 1960s-style A-frame cottage on the forested 20-acre grounds of Nectar Yoga Retreat on Bowen Island, a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The retreat blends Scandinavian-inspired simplicity with wellness programming; every stay includes daily breakfast and yoga and meditation lessons. In 2025 the property added the Mist Thermal Sanctuary offering sauna and cold plunge experiences in the heart of the forest.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2

hotel.name: HI Victoria
hotel.desc: HI Victoria is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Victoria's downtown core on Yates Street, offering budget shared accommodation within walking distance of the Inner Harbour and the BC Ferries terminal at Swartz Bay via transit. As part of the global HI network it historically attracted backpackers and cycle tourers passing through southern Vancouver Island. Its central location would give cyclists convenient access to provisioning, the waterfront Galloping Goose trailhead, and onward island connections.

hotel.name: Hostelling International
hotel.desc: HI Vancouver Downtown is a Hostelling International hostel located in Vancouver's West End, a flat, bike-friendly neighbourhood close to Stanley Park and the downtown core. As part of the HI Canada network, it caters to budget-conscious travellers and is well-positioned along popular urban cycling routes. The hostel occupies a dedicated building on a quiet residential street just blocks from the seawall.

hotel.name: ThistleDown House
hotel.desc: ThistleDown House is a heritage-listed 1920 Craftsman-style home converted into a licensed six-room bed and breakfast in 1997, set on a half-acre of lawns and gardens in North Vancouver. Each ensuite room is filled with antiques and hand-crafted furnishings, and stays include a multi-course gourmet breakfast drawing on world culinary traditions. Its location near Grouse Mountain and the Capilano Suspension Bridge puts it within reach of popular North Shore trails and the Lions Gate Bridge corridor into Vancouver.

detail.address: 3910 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4J2

hotel.name: The Francis Boutique Inn
hotel.desc: The Francis Boutique Inn is an adult-only luxury boutique hotel perched on a private half-acre treed hillside in the heart of Ucluelet, with individual private outdoor entrances for each suite and harbour views. Named after Captain Peter Francis, an original pioneer of the Ucluth Peninsula, it was voted #1 Small Hotel in Canada in 2019. Its central location puts guests within a one-minute walk of restaurants, a grocery store, cafes, a bakery, and the harbour-front — a convenient base for rides along the Wild Pacific Trail and into Pacific Rim National Park.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states guests are 'just a minutes walk to the best restaurants, cafes, bakery... and craft brewery.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states guests are 'just a minutes walk to the... grocery store.'

hotel.name: Wisteria Guest House
hotel.desc: A family-owned guest house on Salt Spring Island run by the Brown family since 2003, offering six main guest house rooms plus cottage and studio suites set amidst gardens with cascading wisteria. Located a 10-minute walk from Ganges Village, it is well-positioned for cyclists arriving by ferry or exploring the island. The property is all on one level and provides covered, lockable bicycle storage.

detail.address: 224 Park Drive, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2R6

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states Ganges Village & Marina is a 10-minute walk with 'lots of restaurant options and shops to explore.'
notes.Nearby grocery: FAQ states '2 grocery stores within walking distance.'

hotel.name: Whistler Lodge Hostel
hotel.desc: Whistler Lodge Hostel is a historic 19+ adventure hostel originally built in 1965 by UBC's Varsity Outdoor Club, now independently operated near the base of Whistler Mountain in the Nordic neighbourhood. After a major restoration in 2015 it blends authentic ski-lodge character with modern amenities, offering mixed dorms, two-bed nook dorms, and a lockable private room. Touring cyclists are well placed here: Creekside Gondola is a five-minute walk, Whistler Village is a short bus ride away, and the lodge features a large shared kitchen, outdoor deck with fire pit, and secure storage for bikes.

notes.Laundry: 'Onsite laundry' listed under PROPERTY FEATURES
notes.Vending machines: 'Vending machine' listed under PROPERTY FEATURES
notes.Device charging: Each bunk has 'an individual privacy curtain, light and plug' per room descriptions
notes.Luggage storage: 'Locker room with large lockers for luggage storage' listed under PROPERTY FEATURES

hotel.name: Eagle's Nest Guest Suite
hotel.desc: Eagle's Nest Guest Suite is a private vacation rental suite perched atop a bluff on the Paragon Estate between Peachland and Summerland, offering sweeping views of Okanagan Lake and access to a shared 300-foot private lakefront. The suite sleeps up to four guests across King and Queen bedrooms plus a pull-out sofa, and is booked exclusively through Airbnb. The Okanagan Rail Trail and Peachland Rotary Trail are accessible in the area, making this a scenic base for cycle touring.

hotel.name: Southside Lodge
hotel.desc: Southside Lodge is a small hostel-style accommodation operated by Whistler Snowboard Tours, situated in Whistler Creekside approximately 400m from the Creekside Gondola. Running since 1993 under the ownership of Maxwell, it positions itself as an affordable, no-frills base for accessing Whistler Blackcomb. Touring cyclists passing through Whistler would find it a conveniently located and budget-conscious overnight option near the Creekside village.

hotel.name: Powell River Harbour Guesthouse
hotel.desc: A waterfront international hostel right across from the Westview Ferry Terminal in Powell River, explicitly welcoming cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast. Guests enjoy a sun deck with views across Georgia Strait to Vancouver Island's glaciers, a full common kitchen, and large common room. The location beside the Sunshine Coast Connector ferry stop makes it a natural hub for multi-day cycle touring itineraries.

notes.Laundry: Rates page lists 'Laundry facility' as a named amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Map page states the hostel is 'in the building behind the ThaidalZone Restaurant,' placing a restaurant immediately adjacent

hotel.name: Turtle Hostel
hotel.desc: Turtle Hostel occupies a historic Victorian character house in downtown Victoria, BC, offering budget dorm beds and private rooms a short walk from the Inner Harbour, Chinatown, and multiple transit connections. As a multicultural, independently run hostel it draws long-term travellers and those island-hopping by ferry. The central location means most of Victoria's attractions are reachable on foot or by bus within minutes.

notes.Luggage storage: Free baggage storage provided on day of check-in and/or check-out only; website explicitly states no overnight storage

hotel.name: Vancouver Traveller B&B
hotel.desc: Vancouver Traveller Bed & Breakfast is a family-run, low-carbon-footprint B&B custom-built in 2016 and operated by sisters Linda and Jenny in Vancouver's West Side. The house uses geothermal in-floor heating and cooling, and every guest room features an en-suite bathroom, sofa bed for a third guest, and cross-ventilation windows. Hosts pride themselves on deep local knowledge and a warm, personal atmosphere in a pet-free and smoke-free home.

notes.Device charging: Type B 120V Electrical Sockets listed as a room amenity on both the King-Sized Room and Queen-Sized Room pages
notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states guests may leave luggage in the living room on arrival if the room is not yet ready, and again after check-out until a later flight

hotel.name: Angela's Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Angela's B&B is self-described as Rossland's original bed and breakfast, a long-standing establishment in this mountain town well known for cycling. Rossland sits at the confluence of popular Kootenay touring routes and is home to extensive trail networks, making it a natural overnight stop for touring and mountain cyclists alike. The property is centrally located on Spokane Street within the compact town core.

hotel.name: Kelowna Okanagan Lake Hostel
hotel.desc: A budget hostel in the heart of downtown Kelowna offering five room styles from mixed-gender dorms to private queen rooms, all with bedding included. Located on Bernard Avenue, it is a 6-minute walk to the Okanagan Lake waterfront and steps from Safeway and the Towne Centre Mall. Guests share a fully equipped self-catering kitchen, a lounge with games, and free on-site parking.

notes.Laundry: FAQ page lists 'washer and dryer' among available facilities
notes.Nearby evening food: About page states '3 minutes walk to premium coffee shops and various restaurants.'
notes.Nearby grocery: About page states '1 minutes walk to Safeway.'

hotel.name: Alert Bay Lodge
hotel.desc: A converted church turned spacious log lodge on the south shore of Cormorant Island, overlooking Johnstone Strait with views of passing orcas and the Vancouver Island mountains. Reached by a 35-minute ferry from Port McNeill, the island offers self-guided biking, cultural attractions like the U'Mista Cultural Centre, and whale-watching tours. The lodge lists biking among its recommended self-guided activities and provides guests with a free colour map of the island.

detail.address: 549 Fir Street, Alert Bay, BC, Canada V0N 1A0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Breakfast sittings begin at 7:00 AM; hot breakfast included for up to two guests per room
notes.Nearby evening food: Sample itinerary says 'have dinner out at one of several restaurants'; lodge also serves dinners (roast chicken, pot roast, fish, Buddha bowl)
notes.Nearby grocery: About page states 'Also located on the island is a grocery store'

hotel.name: Cirrhosis of the River
hotel.desc: Cirrhosis of the River is a self-catering glamping cabin near Chilliwack, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin 1.' It appears to be part of a small eco-retreat property with at least one bookable cabin unit. As an Airbnb-only listing with no traditional front desk or staff, the experience would be independently managed by the host.

hotel.name: Art and Sould Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: Art and Sould Bed & Breakfast is a guest house situated in Nanoose Bay on Vancouver Island, a scenic stretch of BC's cycling coast between Parksville and Nanaimo. As a B&B it would typically offer overnight accommodation with breakfast included, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists touring the Island. Website content was unavailable at time of review, so specific offerings could not be confirmed.

hotel.name: Bralorne Adventure Lodge
hotel.desc: Bralorne Adventure Lodge is a guest house situated in Bralorne, a small historic gold-mining community in BC's Bridge River Valley, deep in the mountains northwest of Lillooet. The area is a gateway to backcountry adventure and is extremely remote, making accommodation options scarce for touring cyclists passing through. The lodge's name suggests an adventure-oriented clientele, but no further detail about its offerings could be confirmed.

hotel.name: Cambie Lodge
hotel.desc: Cambie Lodge is a bed-and-breakfast guest house located in the Cambie corridor neighbourhood of Vancouver, steps from the main street grid and transit connections. As a small, owner-operated B&B it offers a more personal stay than a hotel for cyclists arriving in or departing the city. Its proximity to the central Vancouver cycling network makes it a potential base for multi-day touring.

hotel.name: Ucluelet Ocean Mist Guesthouse
hotel.desc: Ocean Mist Guesthouse is a craftsman-style owner-operated property near the tip of the Ucluelet peninsula offering two self-contained private suites — the ground-floor Blue Heron Room and the second-storey Uncle John Room. Each suite features a kitchenette, private ensuite, covered cedar deck, and dedicated exterior entrance, making it well suited for a quiet, self-sufficient coastal stay. The property sits a five-minute walk from the Wild Pacific Trail Lighthouse Loop and roughly fifteen minutes from Pacific Rim National Park's Long Beach unit.

notes.Nearby evening food: Front page notes 'fine coastal dining, all within a short drive to the town centre.'
notes.Device charging: Room features list 'USB/AC Charging Outlets' in both suites

hotel.name: Painted Turtle Guesthouse
hotel.desc: Painted Turtle Guesthouse, also known as HI Nanaimo, is a Hostelling International hostel situated on Bastion Street in downtown Nanaimo on Vancouver Island. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Nanaimo waterfront, ferry terminals, and the Trans Canada Trail network. As an HI-affiliated property, it is part of a global network of budget traveller hostels with a long tradition of welcoming bicycle tourists.

hotel.name: Evergreen Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: The Evergreen Bed & Breakfast is a family-run, top-rated inn in Hope, BC, owned by Christian and Miyuki since 2016 and in continuous operation since 1997. It offers three individually styled rooms featuring soaker tubs and 4K smart TVs, and sits within easy walking distance of Hope's town centre shops and restaurants. The property operates exclusively on a self check-in model, giving guests code-based keyless entry and flexible arrival — a practical feature for cyclists finishing a long day on the road.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'a quick walk to the city centre's shops and restaurants.'

hotel.name: Woodlands Guesthouse
hotel.desc: Woodlands Guesthouse is a guest house listed in OpenStreetMap at 1237 Adams Road in the Vancouver area of British Columbia. Its Squarespace website has expired, leaving no current public information about the property's offerings or character. A touring cyclist considering this stop would need to contact the property directly via phone or email to verify it remains in operation.

hotel.name: Pacific Spirit Hostel
hotel.desc: Pacific Spirit Hostel is a budget-friendly hostel on the University of British Columbia campus, offering private single and double rooms with shared washrooms and a shared lounge. Situated at the western edge of Vancouver near Pacific Spirit Regional Park, multiple beaches, and the famous Stanley Park seawall loop, it is a natural stop for cyclists touring the city's coastal routes. The 24-hour front desk and direct access to the UBC bus exchange make it a practical and scenic base for cycle touring.

notes.Laundry: Laundry facilities available at each property; refillable laundry cards purchasable at the front desk
notes.Nearby evening food: Website notes 'a variety of food outlets around on the UBC Campus'; front desk can advise on locations

hotel.name: The Modern Cabin
hotel.desc: The Modern Cabin is a standalone 1,000 sq.ft. vacation rental cabin at Hummingbird Oceanside Suites on Bowen Island, reachable via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay with a 15-minute bike ride from Snug Cove terminal. The cabin sleeps up to six guests in two bedrooms plus a sofa bed, with sweeping views of Howe Sound and the North Shore Mountains from huge windows. Shared property amenities include a wood barrel sauna, a wooden staircase to the ocean, a communal fire pit, and a lawn games field with BBQ.

hotel.name: The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm
hotel.desc: The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm is a 1,400 sq ft, three-bedroom vacation cabin on a functioning 7-acre permaculture homestead near Mount Currie, sleeping up to six guests. The property features a private hydrotherapy suite with hot tub, cold plunge, and cedar barrel sauna, plus unobstructed views of Mount Currie (t'szil). Owners Gus and Jocelyn live 150 metres from the cabin and offer guided farm tours so guests can meet resident donkeys, Highland cattle, and milk cows.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'Full laundry with dryer facilities' in the cabin description; overview amenities also list 'Iron & Board'

hotel.name: C&N Backpackers - Ucluelet
hotel.desc: C&N Backpackers is a budget hostel on the wild west coast of Vancouver Island, offering dorm and private rooms steps from the Wild Pacific Trail and Ucluelet's surf beaches. It sits within easy reach of whale-watching tours, the Ucluelet Aquarium, and a lively local music scene, making it a natural base for adventurers exploring the Pacific Rim area. The hostel has negotiated discounts with local surf and tour operators, which may appeal to cyclists combining a ride with ocean activities.

detail.address: 2081 Peninsula Road, Ucluelet, BC Canada V0R 3A0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple nearby options: The Eagles Nest pub, FloatHouse Patio and Grill, Howlers Family Restaurant, Hanks BBQ, The Blueroom (all-day breakfast), Jiggers fish and chips, and others

hotel.name: The Balfour Inn
hotel.desc: The Balfour is a heritage bed and breakfast housed in a 1902 mansion in Vancouver's historic Shaughnessy neighbourhood, featuring handpainted ceilings and faux-finished walls that preserve the character of the original building. Guests can explore surrounding landscaped gardens or walk to the Van Dusen Botanical Garden and Queen Elizabeth Park. The property offers a mix of rooms with full ensuite and semi-private bathrooms, and is well-positioned for transit access to downtown Vancouver.

notes.Wi-Fi: FAQ states: 'Wireless hi-speed internet is provided free throughout the home'; front page adds 'Wireless Internet hook-up upon request'

hotel.name: Tantalus View Retreat
hotel.desc: Tantalus View Retreat is a hand-crafted, off-grid chalet built entirely by log artisan Warren Brubacher, perched alone on a rock bluff above Swift Creek with a panorama of the Tantalus Mountain Range and glaciers. Sitting between Vancouver and Whistler, it runs on renewable energy and offers a private hot tub, creekside sauna, and cold plunge tub in a single-unit rental designed as a secluded nature sanctuary. Mountain biking is cited among the many adventure options within half an hour, though the chalet is reached via a luggage cable tram up the bluff from a Forest Service Road.

detail.address: 451 Swift Creek Forest Service Road, Squamish

hotel.name: Alders Beach Resort
hotel.desc: A beachfront cottage resort on Vancouver Island's east coast between Courtenay and Campbell River, set against old-growth coastal forest. The resort has about 20 individual 2- and 3-bedroom cottages with full kitchens, bathrooms, and gas or wood-burning fireplaces. Originally a 1920s Comox Logging camp turned family resort, it sits on a sandy beach with tidal pools, forest trails, and a resident harbour seal colony.

detail.address: 179 Williams Beach Road, Merville, BC V0R 2M0

notes.Nearby grocery: Policies page states 'an excellent selection of groceries and other supplies are available in nearby Courtenay or Campbell River'
notes.Wi-Fi: Not explicitly mentioned on website

hotel.name: C&N Backpackers Central Station
hotel.desc: C&N Backpackers Central Station is an OSM-tagged hostel near Vancouver's Main Street, operated under the C&N Backpackers brand. The operator also runs a hostel in Ucluelet on Vancouver Island. No current web presence for the Vancouver location could be confirmed.

hotel.name: Inn Field Guest House
hotel.desc: Inn Field Guesthouse is a self-contained lower-level suite in the small mountain village of Field, British Columbia, situated within Yoho National Park. The suite sleeps up to four guests with a full kitchen, queen bed, and pull-out couch — offering independent travellers a home-base feel rather than a hotel stay. It is a 3–5 minute walk from downtown Field and a 20-minute drive from Lake Louise, making it a practical staging point for cyclists exploring the Kicking Horse corridor.

hotel.name: Adela's Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Adela's is an award-winning bed and breakfast in West Kelowna, opened in 2017 by on-site hosts Jessie and Jay, who serve a hot breakfast daily from their own home. The property offers three guest rooms with private bathrooms and views of the surrounding mountains and valley, situated minutes from Okanagan wineries, hiking trails, and beaches. Cyclists will find it a welcoming and well-equipped base, with the hosts explicitly advertising secure storage for bikes alongside ski and luggage storage.

notes.Device charging: Website front page and /our-services page both confirm 'Bedside USB charging ports & 110V outlets' available in all guest rooms

hotel.name: Wolverine Chalet
hotel.desc: Wolverine Chalet is a recently renovated luxury 9-bedroom private chalet on Tyaughton Lake, part of the Tyax Lodge & Heliskiing property near Gold Bridge in the Southern Chilcotin Range. The chalet accommodates up to 18 guests and is rented as a whole unit, with access to Tyax Lodge amenities including spa, dining, and lake activities when the lodge is open. The remote location at the end of an 8-kilometre lakeside road offers a genuine wilderness setting, though the property is oriented toward group retreats, heliskiing, and mountain biking rather than cycle touring.

detail.address: 1 Tyaughton Lake Road, Gold bridge, V0K 1P0

notes.Laundry: Laundry facilities listed as a chalet feature
notes.Nearby evening food: Tyax Lodge dining room is 70 metres walking distance from the chalet; access subject to lodge being open to the public

hotel.name: Himwitsa Lodge
hotel.desc: Himwitsa Lodge is an accommodation property in downtown Tofino operating under the House of Himwitsa complex, which also includes a First Nations art gallery and a smoked fish store. Located on Main Street, it sits at the heart of one of BC's most popular coastal destinations on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The lodge's affiliation with the Indigenous-owned House of Himwitsa gives it a culturally distinctive character compared to typical Tofino hotels.

hotel.name: Prior Castle Inn
hotel.desc: Prior Castle Inn is a guest house situated in Victoria, BC, occupying a three-storey building on St. Charles Street. Its castle-inspired name suggests a heritage or character property, which may appeal to cyclists looking for a distinctive stay in the city. No further details could be confirmed as the website is currently unreachable.

hotel.name: Across the Creek Cabins
hotel.desc: Across the Creek Cabins is a family-operated property consisting of four self-contained cabins on 10 acres of private land at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park, roughly 25 km from downtown Clearwater. Each open-concept studio cabin is fully equipped with a kitchen, queen bed, sofa-bed, three-piece bathroom, and a private outdoor patio overlooking forested surroundings. The property has deep roots in the Smith family going back to the 1970s and sits just off the main road to Helmcken Falls, making it a convenient base for exploring one of BC's premier wilderness parks.

detail.address: 5164 Clearwater Valley Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N1

hotel.name: Greenwood Country Inn
hotel.desc: Greenwood Country Inn is a chalet-style bed and breakfast in Pemberton, BC, operated by Margit de Haan, who brings over 20 years of international hospitality experience and speaks both English and German. The inn offers four individually themed guest rooms — Dove Tail, Humming Bird, Love Bird, and Dream Suite — featuring mountain and valley views from multiple decks. It sits about 25 minutes from the Whistler/Blackcomb area, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists travelling through the Pemberton Valley.

hotel.name: The Riding Fool Hostel
hotel.desc: The Riding Fool is a cyclist-focused hostel in historic downtown Cumberland on Vancouver Island, a community internationally recognized for its world-class mountain bike trail network in the Comox Valley. It offers 8 private rooms with shared bathrooms, a full common kitchen with BBQ, and a social lounge with woodstove — purpose-built for adventure travellers arriving by bike. All of Cumberland's restaurants and shops are walkable from the front door, and Strathcona Provincial Park is a short drive away.

notes.Drying area: About page lists 'Commercial boot dryer' as an amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Homepage states 'All of the Village of Cumberland's culinary and cultural delights can be accessed by foot'; Links page lists multiple restaurants including Cumberland Brewing, Cook's Restaurant, Riders Pizza, and others
notes.Nearby grocery: Links page lists seedsfoodmarket.ca under Food; homepage confirms walkable access to Cumberland's amenities
notes.Bike wash / hose: About page lists 'Bike wash station' as a named amenity

hotel.name: Birchwood Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Birchwood Bed and Breakfast is a guest house situated along Clearwater Valley Road in Clearwater, BC, a community that serves as the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park — a destination popular with touring cyclists exploring the Thompson-Okanagan region. As a B&B, it would offer overnight accommodation with breakfast in a residential-style setting. The property's location near the Wells Gray corridor makes it a plausible staging point for multi-day cycling routes through the area.

hotel.name: The Float House
hotel.desc: The Float House is a houseboat-style guest accommodation operated by Union SteamShip Marine Resort at Snug Cove on Bowen Island, a short ferry ride from Vancouver. The property sits within a historic boutique marina resort that has served visitors since the steamship era, surrounded by the 600-acre Crippen Regional Park — popular for walking and cycling. Guests are a short distance from the village of Snug Cove and the resort's own chandlery, company store, and boaters lounge.

detail.address: 431 Bowen Island Trunk Rd, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0

notes.Laundry: Marina Boaters Lounge (on-site) described as featuring 'washrooms, showers and laundry facilities' — availability to Float House guests specifically is not confirmed

hotel.name: Hostelling International
hotel.desc: Whaler's Guesthouse & Tofino Hostel is a boutique waterfront hostel and guesthouse perched on the edge of Clayoquot Sound with views of Meares Island and Lone Cone Mountain. Operating under the Hostelling International brand, it offers both private ocean-view rooms and shared hostel rooms steps from downtown Tofino's restaurants and amenities. The property rents bikes and surfboards on-site, making it a natural base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'within steps of Tofino's best restaurants, coffee shops and amenities.'

hotel.name: Quarrystone House
hotel.desc: Quarrystone House is a bed and breakfast on five rural acres atop a Salt Spring Island ridgeline, with four private guest rooms in a building separate from the main farmhouse, each offering 180-degree ocean and sunset views from a private balcony or patio. Rooms include a private entrance, ensuite bathroom, two-person jacuzzi tub, gas fireplace, fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, with a three-course country breakfast served each morning at the main house. The property's pastoral setting — bordered by rolling sheep fields to the east and ocean views to the west — makes it a distinctive rural retreat on an island known for outdoor recreation.

detail.address: 1340 Sunset Drive, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1E2

hotel.name: Birds of a Feather Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Birds of a Feather is a purpose-built, licensed-since-1997 luxury waterfront B&B situated on the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, just west of Victoria. Three self-contained studio suites on the upper floor each feature private entrances, ocean lagoon views, gas fireplaces, and radiant heated floors. The property explicitly caters to guests arriving by bicycle and kayak, and offers hosted day trips and boat tours of the Gulf Islands.

hotel.name: Crystal's View Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: Crystal's View Bed & Breakfast is a boutique B&B in North Vancouver founded in 1998, offering ocean-view suites (Queen, Deluxe, and Luxury tiers) described as having a European flair. It is centrally located on a quiet residential crescent minutes from Grouse Mountain, Capilano Suspension Bridge, Lonsdale Quay, and Lynn Canyon. A member of the BC Innkeepers Guild and Canada Select, it holds a 4.9-star rating from over 631 verified customer reviews.

detail.address: 420 Tempe Crescent, North Vancouver, BC V7N 1E6

hotel.name: Skyline House Vacation Rental
hotel.desc: Skyline House Vacation Rental is a family-operated luxury vacation suite in the mountain village of Valemount, 35 km from Mount Robson and 120 km from Jasper National Park. The self-contained suite occupies a locked, separate entrance at the side of the host's home and features two king-bedded rooms with private ensuites, a chef's kitchen, and a private landscaped yard with a fire table. Guests and reviewers consistently describe it as an excellent base for cycling, hiking, and mountain adventures in the region.

notes.Device charging: USB Wall Outlets explicitly listed as a room amenity on the property page

hotel.name: English Bay Inn
hotel.desc: English Bay Inn is a small detached guest house on Comox Street in Vancouver's West End neighbourhood, close to English Bay beach and Stanley Park. The West End location puts cyclists within easy reach of the seawall cycling path, one of the most scenic urban cycling routes in BC. No further detail about the property's character or cyclist facilities could be confirmed due to the website being inaccessible.

hotel.name: Waterview Home D2
hotel.desc: Waterview Home D2 is a single-storey cabin unit within Karen's Village, a small accommodation complex in North Vancouver that has been operating since 2002. It is individually named and listed as a guest house, suggesting it is one of several self-contained units on the property. Touring cyclists staying here would be based near the eastern edge of the North Shore, with access to regional cycling routes.

hotel.name: Barclay House
hotel.desc: Built in 1904 and reopened as a premier bed and breakfast in 2006, Barclay House is a restored Victorian home in Vancouver's West End offering six individually themed suites, several featuring clawfoot tubs and custom international furnishings. The property sits within walking distance of Stanley Park, the Seawall, and English Bay — some of the finest urban cycling in Canada. A full hot breakfast is included each morning, and free reserved parking in the lane behind the building is available for each room.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the property is close to 'Vancouver's finest restaurants and shopping on Robson Street and in Yaletown' and within reach of Gastown and Chinatown dining areas
notes.Luggage storage: Policies page states: 'If you require early luggage drop-off, please provide prior notice,' confirming luggage can be held before official check-in with advance notice

hotel.name: Seymour Hostel
hotel.desc: The Cambie Seymour Hostel is a century-old building in the heart of downtown Vancouver, one block from the Granville Entertainment Strip and within walking distance of major SkyTrain connections. With 74 beds in small dorms and private rooms, it draws budget backpackers and international travelers. Three on-site or attached bars and 24-hour staffing give it a social, urban character.

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry on site listed in the Facilities section of the website
notes.Nearby evening food: Malone's Taphouse and The 515 Bar are attached to the property along Seymour Street; The Cambie Bar is also part of the operator's premises. Guests receive a 20% discount voucher for food and drinks at these venues
notes.Luggage storage: Luggage Storage listed in the Facilities section; FAQ also references a luggage storage area for valuables

hotel.name: Maple Beach Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Maple Beach Bed and Breakfast is a guest house located in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on Maple Street, a short distance from the waterfront. As a bed and breakfast, it offers a more personal hosting experience than a hotel. Its location near the Seaside Greenway and Point Grey cycling routes makes it a convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the city.

hotel.name: Red Barn Lodge B&B and Guesthouse
hotel.desc: Red Barn Lodge B&B and Guesthouse is a small bed and breakfast and guesthouse in Rossland, BC, a mountain community in the Kootenay region well known for cycling and outdoor recreation. The lodge maintains an active local presence and appears to serve as a comfortable base for visitors exploring the area. Rossland's trail network and proximity to Red Resort make this a practical stop for cyclists touring the southern interior of British Columbia.

detail.address: 1107 Black Bear Drive, Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0

hotel.name: The Trailer Trash Tacky Shack
hotel.desc: The Trailer Trash Tacky Shack is a quirky, self-described cabin-style Airbnb rental in Chilliwack, British Columbia. Its deliberately irreverent name suggests a characterful, rustic aesthetic that may appeal to cyclists looking for something offbeat. As an Airbnb property, it operates without traditional front-desk staff, and host-specific amenity details were not recoverable from the fetched content.

hotel.name: Hiellen Village Longhouses
hotel.desc: Hiellen Village Longhouses is an Indigenous-owned campground on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, operated by the Old Massett Village Council on traditional Haida lands, steps from North Beach. The site offers six small cedar longhouses (each sleeping up to 4 with indoor bathroom, gas stovetop, and wood-burning fireplace), a group longhouse sleeping 20+, and tent and RV sites. Built using wood milled locally by community apprentices, all profits are reinvested into the Old Massett Village Council to support local employment and cultural preservation.

detail.address: 29997 Tow Hill Road, Masset, BC V0T 1R0

hotel.name: Salish Sea Beach House
hotel.desc: Salish Sea Beach House is a B&B situated on Lochside Drive in Sidney, BC, directly alongside the Lochside Regional Trail — a primary cycling corridor on the Saanich Peninsula. The property overlooks Bazan Bay toward James Island and San Juan Island, with 10,000 sq ft of exclusive beachfront access for guests. Host Shelley offers a single 'Solaris Suite,' set within half an acre of English gardens with walking paths and mature Arbutus trees.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple nearby restaurants including Seaglass Waterfront Grill, Deep Cove Chalet, Sabhai Thai, Woodshed Pizza, Fish on Fifth, and Mary Bleue Moon Cafe under 'Nearby Attractions.'

hotel.name: Gastown Hostel
hotel.desc: The Gastown Hostel, part of The Cambie Hostels group, occupies a century-old building in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood and has been welcoming international travelers for decades. Guests share access to full kitchens, communal lounges, and multiple on-site bars including The Cambie Bar & Grill and Malone's Taphouse. A fob-secured single entrance and 24-hour front desk give the property a notably secure feel for a social hostel.

notes.Laundry: Listed under Guest services as 'Laundry facilities'
notes.Nearby evening food: Three on-site venues: The Cambie Bar & Grill, Malone's Taphouse, and The 515 Bar
notes.Luggage storage: Listed under Guest services as 'Luggage storage'; FAQ also references a 'luggage storage area' for valuables
notes.Wi-Fi: Free high-speed Wi-Fi available in all rooms and select public areas; confirmed on both main page and FAQ

hotel.name: Horseshoe Bay Motel
hotel.desc: Horseshoe Bay Motel is a small oceanside motel in the picturesque village of Horseshoe Bay, a 1-minute walk from the BC Ferries terminal and positioned on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Touring cyclists will find it a natural staging point for ferry crossings or the Sea to Sky route, with express bus connections to downtown Vancouver steps away. The motel offers queen and double rooms with village, ocean, or mountain views, free WiFi, and free self-parking.

detail.address: 6588 Royal Ave, West Vancouver, BC V7W 2B6

notes.Nearby evening food: Olive & Anchor, Troll's (Fish n Chips), and The Lookout Café all listed as 2-minute walk from the motel

hotel.name: Dreamcatcher Hostel
hotel.desc: Dreamcatcher Hostel is a well-kept hostel in Golden, BC — a hub for cycling, hiking, and mountain adventure — offering private en-suite rooms, family rooms, and six-bed dorms with privacy curtains and personal lockers. The hostel prides itself on cleanliness, enforcing a strict no-shoe policy, and has a communal kitchen, garden with BBQ, and a boot drying room to handle the inevitable wet-gear days. Touring cyclists will appreciate the explicit secure bike and gear storage, laundry facilities, and the welcoming community atmosphere.

notes.Laundry: Listed as 'Laundry' in both summer and winter amenities sections on the website
notes.Drying area: Website lists 'Boot drying room for those rainy day hikes' in summer amenities and 'Boot drying room' in winter amenities
notes.Device charging: Dorm beds described as featuring 'bedside lights & outlets' providing in-room device charging for dorm guests

hotel.name: Eastman Waterfront Cottage
hotel.desc: Eastman Waterfront Cottage is a chalet-style rental on Bowen Island, BC, set along the waterfront on Mount Gardner Road and managed by Bowen Island Accommodations. Bowen Island is a compact, relatively quiet island reached by a short ferry crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver, making it an appealing detour for touring cyclists exploring Howe Sound. The island's limited road network and scenic terrain offer a distinctive riding experience close to Greater Vancouver.

hotel.name: Oyster Bay Resorts
hotel.desc: A 20-chalet oceanfront resort on Vancouver Island's Highway 19A between Campbell River and Courtenay/Comox, with views across the Georgia Strait. Each standalone chalet has a full kitchen, private deck with gas BBQ, and spa tub. The resort sits directly on the Island Highway cycling corridor, with restaurants and a grocery store nearby.

detail.address: 4357 South Island Highway, Campbell River, V9H 1B7

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'we also have excellent restaurants ... nearby'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'a grocery store ... nearby'

hotel.name: Lodge at Xenia
hotel.desc: Xenia Centre is a 38-acre nature sanctuary on Bowen Island celebrating over 30 years of land stewardship, offering unique wooden cottages surrounded by old-growth forest and protected government lands. The centre specialises in healing, creativity, and personal transformation retreats, reachable by BC Ferry from Horseshoe Bay or by seaplane. It is a quiet, contemplative destination well off the beaten tourist track.

detail.address: 782 Smith Road, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

hotel.name: Jade
hotel.desc: Jade is one of three modern Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat centre spread across 20 forested acres on Bowen Island. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and features a covered cedar porch, reading nook, and an indoor/outdoor ensuite shower. Reaching the retreat requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay, placing guests in a quiet island setting where mountain biking and hiking are among the local activities.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2

hotel.name: Sasquatch Crossing Eco Lodge
hotel.desc: Sasquatch Crossing Eco Lodge is an Indigenous-owned and operated historic property on 87 acres in Sts'ailes territory near Harrison Mills, BC. Originally constructed in 1903 as Fenn Lodge and acquired by the Sts'ailes First Nation in 2009, the lodge runs largely on creek-powered hydro-electric energy and offers seven uniquely themed guest rooms. Touring cyclists will find it a scenic base for the Harrison Valley with mountain biking, birding, and Harrison Hot Springs all within easy range.

detail.address: 15500 Morris Valley Road, Harrison Mills, BC V0M 1A1

notes.Nearby grocery: Chehalis Store & Gas station described as a 3-minute drive up Morris Valley Road with 'a great selection of delicious fresh food.'

hotel.name: Sahhali on the Bluffs
hotel.desc: Sahhali on the Bluffs is a vacation rental property perched on a bluff on Pender Island, offering a cottage and several suites with 180-degree views of the Salish Sea toward Vancouver Island and the San Juan Islands. The property is accessible by BC Ferries and sits on one of the island's highest vantage points, in a peaceful setting where guests commonly spot orcas, humpback whales, and bald eagles. Pender Island is a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination, and the cottage listing specifically mentions hiking and cycling as local activities.

hotel.name: Ocean Breeze Executive Bed and Breakfast
hotel.desc: Ocean Breeze is a boutique European-style bed and breakfast on the North Shore of Vancouver, operating since 1992 with waterfront views of Vancouver Harbour. The property is 11 minutes from downtown Vancouver via the scenic SeaBus and sits within walking distance of craft breweries, restaurants, and the Shipyards Night Market. All rooms include private bathrooms and the B&B serves a full hot breakfast with specialty items like smoked salmon omelettes, eggs benedict, and blueberry pancakes.

detail.address: 462 East 1st Street, North Vancouver, BC V7L 1B7

notes.Laundry: Laundry service listed on amenities page; note charges apply
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states walking distance to 'waterfront marina and restaurants, craft breweries, shops and privately owned boutiques, the Shipyards Night Market.'

hotel.name: Cranberry Arms Pub & Hotel
hotel.desc: The Cranberry Arms is a historic neighbourhood pub and hotel in Cedar, south of Nanaimo, with roots going back to 1878 when the property was won in a card game by Irish immigrants. Newly renovated rooms sit above a lively community pub that hosts regular events including karaoke, sports nights, and charity fundraisers. The hotel offers five rooms ranging from a full suite with kitchen to standard queen rooms, and a shared non-smoking balcony for guests.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and pub serves food and drinks daily; testimonials mention brunch, wing nights, and curries

hotel.name: Seaview Cottage
hotel.desc: Seaview Cottage is an Airbnb-listed guest house situated at Cates Hill on Bowen Island, a small island community in Howe Sound reached by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Bowen Island's relatively quiet roads and scenic coastal terrain make it a popular cycling destination, with the compact Snug Cove village—including a grocery store and pub—near the ferry terminal. The property is tagged in OpenStreetMap as a guest house, though no details about its layout, capacity, or cyclist-specific facilities could be verified from the available sources.

hotel.name: Twin Peaks Resort
hotel.desc: Twin Peaks Resort is a guest house located in Valemount, British Columbia, a small mountain community in the Robson Valley region. Valemount sits at the junction of several major cycling routes and serves as a gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists. The resort's location on Jack Adams Road places it within the town, convenient to local services.

hotel.name: Beaconsfield Inn
hotel.desc: An award-winning Edwardian mansion from 1905, fully restored and operating as a luxury B&B with nine individually appointed guest suites featuring antiques, fireplaces, and Jacuzzi tubs. Located in a quiet residential neighbourhood just four blocks from downtown Victoria's Inner Harbour. Registered Heritage Property with a Canada Select 5 Star Rating.

notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states check-in allows 'earlier for luggage drop-off' before the standard check-in window

hotel.name: Marina House B&B
hotel.desc: Marina House B&B is a guest house situated on Marine Drive in Gibsons, a scenic coastal community on the Sunshine Coast of British Columbia. The property's name and waterfront address suggest a setting near Gibsons Harbour, a natural stopping point for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast. No additional details about the property's offerings could be verified due to website inaccessibility.

hotel.name: Aauuknuk Lodge
hotel.desc: Aauuknuk Lodge is a guest house located near Tofino, British Columbia, a renowned destination for outdoor adventure on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The lodge's name suggests possible Indigenous cultural ties, which would make it a distinctive lodging choice in a region celebrated for its wild coastline and old-growth forests. Touring cyclists approaching or departing Tofino would find it a potential base for exploring the area.

detail.address: 135 Ahousaht Blvd, Ahousat, BC V0R 0B3, Canada

hotel.name: Bearspaw Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Bearspaw Inn Bed & Breakfast is a guest house listed in OpenStreetMap on Goold Road in Houston, BC, a small community in the Bulkley-Nechako region along Highway 16. No verified website or contact information is available to confirm current operations or amenities. Touring cyclists passing through the Houston area would need to verify the property directly before relying on it as a stop.

hotel.name: Opal
hotel.desc: Opal is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness and yoga destination set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island. Reaching the property requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. All cottage stays include daily breakfast and yoga and meditation sessions as part of the retreat experience.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2

hotel.name: Edgemount Guest House
hotel.desc: Edgemount Guesthouse is a single private suite added onto a historic home in Field, BC, situated within Yoho National Park just 27 km from Lake Louise. The self-contained second-floor suite features an open-concept layout with a full kitchen, queen bed, claw-foot bath, and a balcony with BBQ and mountain views. Field is an exceptional staging point for cyclists exploring the surrounding national parks, with access to the Icefields Parkway, Banff, and the UNESCO World Heritage landscapes of Yoho.

detail.address: 210 Kicking Horse Avenue, Field, BC V0A 1G0

hotel.name: Moonstone Cottage
hotel.desc: A standalone forest cottage on the 20-acre Nectar Yoga Retreat property on Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. The retreat sits in a forested setting with alder groves and is part of a wellness-focused property that also includes a thermal sanctuary.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

hotel.name: Mariner's Loft
hotel.desc: Mariner's Loft is a complex of seven spacious ocean-view vacation rental condos perched above Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island. Units are two- and three-bedroom with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and self-check-in, located in the walkable heart of Ganges village near shops, restaurants, and the famous Saturday Market. Select suites are dog-friendly, and the property offers private parking.

detail.address: 118 Rainbow Road, Salt Spring Island, BC, Canada

notes.Laundry: In-suite washer and dryer located in the hall closet with laundry detergent provided; ironing board and iron also available
notes.Nearby evening food: Located in the heart of Ganges village; website references 'the island's variety of restaurants' within walking distance

hotel.name: Wildernest
hotel.desc: Wildernest is a secluded vintage Airstream B&B perched on the forested slopes of Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from West Vancouver. The 1971 Airstream Landyacht 'Moonshot' sits on over an acre of land bordering the 450-hectare Bowen Island Eco Reserve, offering a rustic-luxe retreat for couples. Snug Cove with its ferry terminal and restaurants is a short distance away, though the property is reached via a short illuminated foot trail from the parking area.

notes.Laundry: Separate dedicated cabin includes a washroom, indoor shower and laundry
notes.Early or packed breakfast: 'Breakfast included' listed under Services in the overview amenities section
notes.Nearby evening food: Website notes property is 'a 5 minute drive from Snug Cove, ferry and restaurants'

hotel.name: Mariner's Lookout on Comox Bay
hotel.desc: Mariner's Lookout is a fully furnished one-bedroom vacation rental suite on the second floor of a private home, overlooking Comox Bay, the Beaufort Range, and the ever-changing harbour scene including Goose Spit Park. Run by Henrie (artist and gardener) and Pat (retired tugboat captain), longtime Comox Valley residents who are fluent in English and French and eager to share local knowledge. The property is a 10-minute walk from downtown Comox, the marina, and restaurants, with beach and forest trails accessible directly from the neighbourhood.

notes.Laundry: Laundry facilities are available to guests staying one week or more
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'excellent restaurants' are a 10-minute walk away in downtown Comox

hotel.name: Bona Manzi
hotel.desc: Bona Manzi is a self-contained cottage on Bowen Island, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb and marketed for its ocean views and peaceful setting. The property is a separate cottage rather than a room within a host's home. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver, making it a possible stopover for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast or Sea to Sky corridor.

hotel.name: Dancing Bear Inn
hotel.desc: Dancing Bear Inn is a characterful hostel occupying a heritage building on Nelson's historic Baker Street, featuring hardwood floors, bay windows, exposed beams, an antique fireplace, and a sunny BBQ patio. It positions itself as a home base for backcountry explorers and adventurers in the Kootenay region, with staff who can help plan both front-country and backcountry excursions. The surrounding downtown is walkable and sits within a few blocks of grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and outdoor gear shops.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hostel is 'only a few blocks away from: grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, art galleries, shopping and outdoor gear shops.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states the hostel is 'only a few blocks away from: grocery stores.'

hotel.name: Cedar Beach Ocean Lodge
hotel.desc: Cedar Beach Ocean Lodge is a small bed and breakfast with two rooms located on Thetis Island, a quiet Gulf Island accessible by BC Ferries from Chemainus. Its name suggests a beachside or ocean-view setting on Clam Bay Road. Thetis Island's car-light, rural character makes it a tranquil stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.

detail.address: 120 Clam Bay Road, Thetis Island, V0R 2Y0

hotel.name: HI Whistler
hotel.desc: HI Whistler is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Whistler, BC, one of Canada's most celebrated mountain resort communities and a hub for trail cycling, ski touring, and the Sea-to-Sky corridor. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers budget-friendly shared accommodation appealing to independent travellers and adventure seekers. Touring cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky route or exploring Whistler's extensive trail system would find it a practical, centrally located base.

hotel.name: Woods on Pender
hotel.desc: WOODS on Pender is a luxury glamping resort set on 7.3 wooded acres of Pender Island, offering three distinct accommodation styles: vintage Airstreams, rustic cabins, and motel rooms. Completely revitalized in 2015 from the former Inn on Pender Island, the property pairs a modern camp aesthetic with on-site dining, a CAMP Store, and a Nordic Spa. It is reached via BC Ferries to Otter Bay Terminal, roughly a 10-minute ride from the property, making it a natural destination stay on a Gulf Islands cycling tour.

detail.address: 4709 Canal Road, Pender Island, B.C., V0N 2M1

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant (Coffee + Kitchen) and CAMP Store are listed under Food + Drink on the property

hotel.name: Tofino Paddlers Inn
hotel.desc: Tofino Paddler's Inn is a nearly century-old historic harbourfront guest house — the town's original hotel — perched above Tofino Sea Kayaking on the downtown waterfront of Clayoquot Sound. With only five small rooms and shared washrooms and kitchen, the inn cultivates a communal atmosphere for adventurers and kayakers. Guests receive a discount on sea kayaking tours run from the shop directly below.

hotel.name: Hillcrest Avenue Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: Hillcrest Avenue Bed & Breakfast is a small owner-operated B&B in Ladysmith on Vancouver Island, notable for its ocean views and a full breakfast prepared with local ingredients. Guests can take their morning coffee on the deck while taking in the coastal scenery. Its location in Ladysmith places it conveniently along Vancouver Island touring routes.

hotel.name: Ocean Island Inn Backpackers
hotel.desc: Ocean Island Inn is a lively hostel occupying a historic 4-storey character building in the heart of downtown Victoria, celebrated in Lonely Planet and praised widely for its community atmosphere. It offers an unusually generous amenity package—free breakfast and dinner daily, a social lounge, and 24-hour front desk—alongside dedicated secure bike storage and an in-house bike rental operation. Its central location puts touring cyclists within easy reach of Victoria's waterfront routes, shops, and transit connections.

notes.Laundry: Website front page lists 'Laundry Facilities' as a core amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Hostel serves free dinner on-site nightly; website also describes location as 'just blocks from all the downtown attractions and amenities' including restaurants
notes.Nearby grocery: Guide page states 'Find everything you need nearby: coffee, groceries, drugstores...' all within a short walk of Ocean Island Inn
notes.Device charging: Room details page states dorm bunks include 'USB & power outlets' at each bunk
notes.Luggage storage: 'Secure Bike & Bag Storage' explicitly covers bags and luggage alongside bikes

hotel.name: Humming Bird Guest House
hotel.desc: The Hummingbird Suite is a self-contained one-bedroom rental with a private entrance, fully equipped kitchen, and a pull-out couch for extra guests, situated in the tiny mountain village of Field at the heart of Yoho National Park. Field sits on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor and the Kicking Horse River valley, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing the Rockies. The suite appears to be a single-unit property, suggesting a quiet, home-style stay rather than a traditional inn.

hotel.name: HI Penticton
hotel.desc: HI Penticton is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Penticton, BC, a South Okanagan town flanked by Okanagan and Skaha Lakes that serves as a natural staging point for touring cyclists tackling the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the surrounding wine-country routes. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers affordable shared accommodation in a region that draws cyclists from across the continent. Its downtown Ellis Street location puts guests within easy reach of the waterfront and local services.

hotel.name: Bodega Ridge
hotel.desc: Bodega Ridge is a 22-acre cabin resort on the wild north end of Galiano Island, featuring rustic log cabins with wood-burning fireplaces, soaker tubs, and cedar decks overlooking arbutus forest and the Salish Sea. The property has grown from a 1980s horse ranch into a full destination with on-site dining at Lola restaurant (currently temporarily closed and relocating) and The Pink Geranium Café and General Store. It is a popular base for island exploration, retreats, and destination weddings.

notes.Nearby grocery: The Pink Geranium Café and General Store is located on the Bodega Ridge property, described on the front page as a place to 'refuel'

hotel.name: Breezy Bay Bed & Breakfast
hotel.desc: Breezy Bay Bed & Breakfast is a guest house located near Sidney, BC, on the Saanich Peninsula — a region popular with touring cyclists for its rolling rural roads, ferry connections to the Gulf Islands, and proximity to Victoria. The property brands itself around outdoor adventure, suggesting an orientation toward active guests. The website is sparse on operational detail, so prospective cycling guests should contact the property directly to confirm facilities.

hotel.name: North Coast Trail Backpackers Hostel
hotel.desc: North Coast Trail Backpackers Hostel is a budget hostel in Port Hardy, BC, serving as a natural base for hikers and cyclists tackling the remote North Coast Trail on the northern tip of Vancouver Island. Port Hardy is a common start or end point for the Inside Passage ferry route, making this hostel a strategic stop for cycle tourists traveling between the BC mainland and Vancouver Island. The hostel is within the small Port Hardy town core.

hotel.name: The Homestead Tofino
hotel.desc: The Homestead Tofino is a self-catering oceanfront vacation home perched on a rocky point above Duffin Passage, a two-minute walk from downtown Tofino. The property sleeps up to 10 guests across five bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a private hot tub, fire pit, deck, and a dedicated storm-watch room designed for watching dramatic Pacific weather. It is managed by long-time Airbnb Superhost Cheryl, who has hosted international guests from this winter home for over seven years.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'Just steps away from an array of exquisite restaurants and the charming town center.'

hotel.name: Seabreeze Guest House
hotel.desc: The Seabreeze is a custom-built craftsman-style guest house in Richmond, BC, perched on a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking the Pacific Ocean and Gulf Islands. It offers three rooms with private en-suite bathrooms, jacuzzi soaker tubs, and ocean-view balconies, with a continental breakfast included in the rates. The property sits directly alongside the Richmond Dyke trails, with historic Steveston Village a short distance away.

notes.Nearby evening food: Attractions page lists multiple restaurants in Steveston Village (~5 min away), including Kisamo's Greek restaurant (3420 Moncton St) and Pajos Fish & Chips on the wharf

hotel.name: Caboose
hotel.desc: The Caboose is a private 1-bedroom cottage on Bowen Island, managed by the Bowen Island Concierge rental agency, offering ocean and mountain views alongside a fireplace and full kitchen. It holds a perfect 5.00-star rating across 7 reviews and is described by guests as spotless, private, and welcoming. Bowen Island itself is a small island community reachable by ferry from Horseshoe Bay, making this a scenic off-route option for touring cyclists exploring the lower Sunshine Coast corridor.

hotel.name: Vernon Hostel
hotel.desc: Vernon Hostel is a centrally located budget hostel in Vernon, BC, offering shared-bathroom rooms with linens and towels included. Guests have access to a shared kitchen, a lounge with TV and billiards, and on-site laundry. The property sits near Kalamalka Lake Provincial Park and is a convenient base for cycling routes to Silver Star Mountain Resort (19 km) and the broader Okanagan region.

notes.Laundry: Website states: 'Laundry facilities are also located on site.'

hotel.name: Big Bar Guest Ranch
hotel.desc: Big Bar Guest Ranch is a rural guest ranch located along Big Bar Road outside Clinton in British Columbia's interior. Situated in the rugged Fraser River canyon region, it offers a remote backcountry experience for travellers. Its OSM listing categorises it as a guest house, suggesting overnight accommodation for visiting cyclists passing through this sparsely serviced stretch of BC.

hotel.name: Point Grey Guest House
hotel.desc: Point Grey Guest House is a family-run guest house that has welcomed travellers to Vancouver's Point Grey neighbourhood since 1990, known for its warm, home-like atmosphere and host who personally assists with travel logistics. The property offers standard rooms and a self-contained Iona Garden Suite with a private entrance, outdoor patio, and fully equipped kitchen. Its central location puts guests a 10-minute walk from Point Grey Village's shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, with the beach reachable on foot in 20 minutes.

notes.Nearby evening food: Point Grey Village is a 10-minute walk with restaurants listed as a nearby amenity
notes.Nearby grocery: Point Grey Village is a 10-minute walk with grocery stores listed as a nearby amenity
notes.Luggage storage: Website explicitly lists 'free luggage storage' as one of the services provided to assist guests with travel complications

hotel.name: Cowichan River Lodge
hotel.desc: Cowichan River Lodge is a boutique private lodge perched on the banks of the Cowichan River, one of Canada's first Heritage-designated rivers and among North America's top-rated trout rivers. The property is rented exclusively as a full lodge for groups, making it suited to cycling clubs, family gatherings, or corporate retreats rather than individual walk-in guests. Host John helps guests connect with local outdoor pursuits including fishing, mountain biking, and wider exploration of the Cowichan Valley.

detail.address: 7461 Hudgrove Road, Lake Cowichan, BC V0R 2G0

hotel.name: Kilby Lodge
hotel.desc: Kilby Lodge is a guest house situated in Agassiz, BC, near the historic Kilby General Store and the confluence of the Fraser and Harrison rivers. The property sits in the rural Fraser Valley, a region popular with cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway corridor or connecting to Harrison Hot Springs. It holds a dedicated website and direct contact details, suggesting an actively managed accommodation.

hotel.name: Boho House
hotel.desc: Boho House is a self-catering vacation rental listed on Airbnb on Bowen Island, BC, a short ferry ride from West Vancouver. The Airbnb listing title references a 'Sanctuary Home & Spa' experience, suggesting a wellness-oriented property. As an unstaffed short-term rental, it likely functions as a self-check-in home rather than a traditional guest house with cycling support services.

hotel.name: Southswell Cabins
hotel.desc: South Swell Cabins is a collection of eight individually named oceanfront cabins nestled along Spring Cove on the rugged West Coast of Vancouver Island in Ucluelet. The property sits steps from the Wild Pacific Trail and a direct kayak/paddleboard launch, with the cedar barrel sauna and foreshore trail adding to its coastal character. A touring cyclist would find it an atmospheric and well-located base, within walking distance of Ucluelet's restaurants, breweries, and groceries.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the property is 'a short walk from all the amenities you'll want in Ucluelet, including restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, groceries and entertainment.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website explicitly lists 'groceries' among the walkable amenities in Ucluelet

hotel.name: Douglas House
hotel.desc: Douglas House is a bed and breakfast on West 13th Avenue in Vancouver's Cambie/Fairview neighbourhood, a residential area close to Queen Elizabeth Park and convenient transit links. As a small guest house it offers a more personal lodging experience than a hotel, and its central Vancouver location puts cyclists within easy reach of the city's extensive bike lane network and the Seaside Greenway. The property was last verified in OSM in October 2024.

hotel.name: Wells Gray Guest Ranch
hotel.desc: Wells Gray Guest Ranch is a Western-style guest ranch situated on Clearwater Valley Road, the primary corridor leading into Wells Gray Provincial Park — one of BC's most dramatic wilderness destinations. The ranch operates as an all-in-one booking platform for accommodations, horseback riding, and dining, including an on-site saloon. Its position on the Valley Road makes it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the park.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site saloon and dining reservation system visible in site navigation (Saloon, Dining Booking, Dining Reservations, Drink Menu pages)

hotel.name: Gingerbread Cottage Bed and Breakfast
