Positioned a short distance from central Victoria, it offers a familiar mid-range lodging option for cyclists touring Vancouver Island. As a branded chain property, it provides predictable standards and loyalty program integration for Wyndham Rewards members.

hotel.name: Sunwolf Riverside Resort
hotel.desc: Sunwolf Riverside Resort offers 13 contemporary riverside cabins nestled in old-growth forest halfway between Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stop on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor. The property includes Fergie's Cafe, an on-site brunch restaurant that has won Best Breakfast from locals every year since 2015, drawing on locally sourced ingredients. The resort is family-owned, pet-friendly, and holds a Sustainable Tourism Certification.

detail.address: 70002 Squamish Valley Rd, PO Box 244, Brackendale, BC V0N 1H0

hotel.name: Sooke Harbour House
hotel.desc: Sooke Harbour House is a boutique oceanfront hotel and resort perched at the edge of the Strait of Juan de Fuca on Whiffin Spit Road in Sooke, BC. The property features individually designed rooms and suites with West Coast styling, an on-site restaurant, cafe, and wine cellar, and has recently undergone a change of ownership and revival under Catalog Hospitality. For touring cyclists approaching from the Galloping Goose Trail or the southern tip of Vancouver Island, it represents a notable endpoint or overnight destination with ocean-view rooms and on-site dining.

detail.address: 1528 Whiffin Spit Rd, Sooke, BC V9Z 0T4

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Restaurant, Cafe & Wine Cellar referenced on the homepage

hotel.name: Four Points by Sheraton Victoria Gateway
hotel.desc: A four-story Sheraton-brand hotel in Victoria's McCallum area offering standard mid-range accommodation. As an established chain property, it provides reliable service; specific bike storage and tour-friendly services require direct inquiry.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham
hotel.desc: The Ramada by Wyndham Surrey/Langley is a mid-scale chain hotel situated on Highway 10 in Surrey, within the broader Langley/Surrey corridor of the Fraser Valley. As part of the Wyndham hotel family, guests can earn loyalty points on stays. Its highway-adjacent location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Metro Vancouver suburbs on longer tours.

hotel.name: Prestige Prince George Lodge
hotel.desc: The Prestige Prince George Lodge is part of a family-owned BC hospitality chain with 19 properties across 14 destinations in the province. Sitting on the Cariboo Highway in Prince George, it serves as a gateway stop for cyclists travelling through Northern BC. All Prestige properties are noted as dog-friendly and participate in the chain's loyalty rewards program.

hotel.name: WorldMark Victoria
hotel.desc: WorldMark Victoria is a Club Wyndham vacation ownership resort in the heart of Victoria, BC, steps from the Inner Harbour and the city's Victorian-era architecture. It holds an RCI Gold Crown Resort award and is managed by Wyndham Vacation Clubs. The resort offers suite-style accommodations and is noted for no air conditioning and limited parking, with 24-hour front desk service.

hotel.name: The Shepherd's Inn - Office
hotel.desc: The Shepherd's Inn is a family-owned roadside complex on the Alaska Highway at Mile 72, roughly 42 km northwest of Fort St. John, billing itself as 'An Oasis on The Alaska Highway.' The property combines a motel, full-service restaurant with to-go orders, a convenience store, and a fueling station under one roof. For northbound or southbound Alaska Highway tourers, it is a rare multi-service stop in a long, remote stretch of highway.

detail.address: 11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Road, Charlie Lake, BC V1J 8L5

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant confirmed by website: 'OPEN year round for restaurant, store and motel services'; to-go orders also available
notes.Nearby grocery: On-site convenience store confirmed by website: 'family owned and run business consisting of a motel, restaurant, convenience store and a fueling station.'

hotel.name: Delta Victoria Ocean Pointe Resort and Spa
hotel.desc: A full-service Delta Hotels property located at Songhees Road near Victoria's waterfront. As a resort-class accommodation with spa services, it provides standard hotel amenities for traveling cyclists. The location offers access to Victoria's downtown and waterfront areas.

hotel.name: Comfort Suites Kelowna
hotel.desc: Comfort Suites Kelowna is an 83-suite all-suite hotel on Highway 97 North, conveniently situated about 10 minutes from Kelowna Airport and close to downtown, beaches, and the Okanagan wine country. The property features an indoor pool with a 40-foot waterslide, a 24-hour fitness centre, and a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring. It is pet-friendly and offers a range of suite types including wheelchair-accessible and family configurations.

notes.Laundry: Coin Operated Laundry listed on the hotel facilities page
notes.Vending machines: Ice/Vending Machines listed as a hotel facility on the facilities page
notes.Device charging: Large Desk & Charging Station listed as a standard in-suite amenity

hotel.name: Kings Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Kings Motor Inn is an affordable highway motel on the Trans-Canada in Kamloops offering a range of room types including kitchenette options with mountain views. Guests have access to an indoor pool, a BBQ area, and 24-hour front desk service. It is a dog-friendly property positioned as a convenient stopover for travelers passing through Kamloops.

hotel.name: Rosellen Suites at Stanley Park
hotel.desc: Rosellen Suites is a boutique extended-stay hotel in Vancouver's West End, steps from Stanley Park and the Seawall — one of North America's premier urban cycling routes. Spacious suites from 600 to 1,900 square feet come with full kitchens, making meal prep practical for touring cyclists on multi-day itineraries. The quiet residential setting on Barclay Street puts cyclists within easy reach of English Bay, the Seawall, and the restaurant strips of Denman and Davie Streets.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated washing machines and dryers available on-site for guests
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is within walking distance of 'the many restaurants of Denman and Davie Street.'

hotel.name: Super 8 Kelowna
hotel.desc: Super 8 Kelowna is a Wyndham-branded motel situated on Highway 97 North, a major arterial route through Kelowna and a key corridor for cyclists touring the Okanagan. As part of a large national chain, it offers standardized roadside motel accommodations in a commercially dense area with numerous services nearby.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel & Suites Squamish
hotel.desc: A three-level Sandman Hotels property in central Squamish, offering standard hotel accommodations with air conditioning and Wi-Fi. As a branded chain hotel, it provides reliable lodging for touring cyclists passing through the area, though specific bicycle storage policies require direct inquiry.

hotel.name: Bathgate Resort & Marina
hotel.desc: Bathgate Resort & Marina is an accommodation facility with marina amenities located in Egmont, BC. It offers overnight lodging with WiFi for guests, positioned as a stopping point for travelers including cycling tourists.

hotel.name: Alpine Inn
hotel.desc: Alpine Inn is a motel in Valemount, a small community on the Yellowhead Highway in central BC. It provides overnight accommodation to travelers passing through this region and may serve as a stopping point for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Summerland Waterfront Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: A full-service waterfront resort set on a secluded stretch of Okanagan Lake shoreline, roughly midway between Penticton and Kelowna in the heart of BC wine country. Accommodation is offered in fully outfitted suite-style rooms with gourmet kitchens, and on-site facilities include iKhaya Day Spa, boat rentals, and complimentary kayak and stand-up paddleboard use. It sits along the popular Naramata Bench and South Okanagan cycling corridor, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring cyclists.

detail.address: 13011 Lakeshore Drive S., Summerland, BC V0H 1Z1

hotel.name: The Legends
hotel.desc: Legends Whistler is a slopeside condominium-style lodge in Whistler's quieter Creekside neighbourhood, offering one- to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens just steps from the Creekside Gondola to Whistler Blackcomb. Some suites overlook the 'Dave Murray' ski run, venue for the 2010 Winter Olympic Alpine events. The Creekside location gives touring cyclists a calmer base than the main village while remaining close to local dining and gondola access.

hotel.name: Middle Beach Lodge
hotel.desc: Middle Beach Lodge sits on 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront near Tofino, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newer treehouse accommodations perched above the rainforest. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rocky headlands, hand-cut forest walking trails, and an on-site lounge serving lunch and dinner. Ocean kayaking excursions are offered, making it a scenic base for exploring the Pacific Rim coast.

detail.address: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner menus starting at 11:30am daily

hotel.name: Rosewood Victoria Inn
hotel.desc: Rosewood Inn is a VI Resorts timeshare vacation club property housed in a historically preserved building steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Each unit is unique in style and décor, and the location puts cyclists within easy reach of heritage home neighbourhoods, Beacon Hill Park, and the Galloping Goose Trail. The Royal BC Museum and Fisherman's Wharf are also nearby on foot.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple nearby restaurants: Bard & Banker, James Bay Inn Restaurant, Harbour House Restaurant, Red Fish Blue Fish, 10 Acres Bistro, Floyd's Diner

hotel.name: Galiano Oceanfront Inn & Spa
hotel.desc: A boutique oceanfront hotel set along the rugged sandstone shores of Galiano Island in BC's Gulf Islands, just a 5-minute walk from the ferry terminal — making it easy to arrive without a car. The property includes the Atrevida Restaurant & Orca Lounge serving contemporary West Coast cuisine, and the Madrona Del Mar Spa. Smart car and van rentals are available on-site for touring the island's winding roads.

detail.address: 134 Madrona Drive, Galiano Island, BC V0N 1P0

notes.Nearby evening food: Atrevida Restaurant & Orca Lounge on-site, serving contemporary West Coast cuisine

hotel.name: Tyax Lodge & Chalets
hotel.desc: Tyax Lodge & Chalets is a remote wilderness lodge and wedding venue set on Tyaughton Lake in the Southern Chilcotin Range, north of Whistler near Gold Bridge, BC — a region well known for its mountain biking. The property offers lodge rooms, three self-catered private chalets (4-, 6-, and 9-bedroom), a campground, gourmet dining, a full spa, and heli-skiing, making it one of the more complete wilderness destinations in the BC interior. It has been nominated for Canada's Leading Wilderness Resort 2025 at the World Travel Awards.

detail.address: 1 Tyaughton Lake Road, Gold bridge, V0K 1P0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant, bar, and lounge at the lodge; dining is referenced throughout the website as a core lodge amenity
notes.Wi-Fi: Lodge Room Features list 'Complimentary WiFi (limited access)'

hotel.name: Schell Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Vernon offering overnight accommodation. Located on 35 Street, it serves travelers and tourists passing through the community.

hotel.name: Moberly Lodge
hotel.desc: Moberly Lodge is a log-lodge-and-cabins property set on 12 acres near Golden, BC, offering a range of rooms from lodge suites to self-contained cabins such as the Columbia and Kicking Horse Cabins. Guests consistently highlight the spectacular mountain views, a hot tub, and home-cooked breakfasts served at the lodge. Its secluded, wooded setting makes it a characterful overnight option for cyclists exploring the Rocky Mountain Trench and Kicking Horse corridor.

hotel.name: Edgewater Motel
hotel.desc: Edgewater Motel provides overnight accommodation in Penticton on Skaha Lake Road. It serves as a standard stopping point for travelers passing through the area, including touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Glacier Lodge
hotel.desc: Glacier Lodge is a vacation rental condo property in Whistler managed through WhistlerAccommodation.com (Blackcomb Peaks), which specializes in ski-in/ski-out rentals on Blackcomb Mountain. The three-storey building offers self-contained units typical of Whistler's condo-hotel market, with at least one unit (212) listed as an active rental. Its location near Chateau Boulevard places it within easy reach of Whistler Village and the surrounding trail network.

hotel.name: Middle Beach Lodge At The Beach
hotel.desc: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront retreat spectacularly set on 40 acres of West Coast wilderness, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newly added treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system for quiet nature walks. An on-site lounge serves lunch and dinner, and Tofino's eclectic village is just 3km away.

detail.address: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, British Columbia, Canada V0R 2Z0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner daily starting at 11:30am; Tofino village with restaurants is 3km away
notes.Nearby grocery: Tofino, 3km away, is described as having supply stores among its amenities

hotel.name: 5000 Motel
hotel.desc: 5000 Motel is a roadside accommodation located on Main Street in Penticton. It offers basic guest rooms in a cycling-friendly region. Specific amenities and bike-friendly features could not be verified due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Vesuvius Villas
hotel.desc: The Vesuvius Villas is an accommodation property on Salt Spring Island, BC, situated along Vesuvius Bay Road near the Vesuvius Bay ferry terminal. Its location would place touring cyclists close to the BC Ferries route connecting Salt Spring Island to Crofton on Vancouver Island. No current website content is available to describe the property further.

hotel.name: Harrison Beach Hotel
hotel.desc: Harrison Beach Hotel is a newly renovated boutique property managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, situated steps from Harrison Lake in scenic Harrison Hot Springs. The hotel offers lake-view and mountain-view suites with kitchenettes, an indoor pool, outdoor hot tub, and fitness room. Its central location—within walking distance of the beach, shops, and restaurants—makes it a practical base for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.

detail.address: 160 Esplanade Avenue, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is 'steps from the beach, shops, dining' in Harrison Hot Springs town centre

hotel.name: Bedford Regency Hotel
hotel.desc: The Bedford Regency is a 40-room European-style boutique hotel housed in one of Victoria's cherished heritage buildings near Bastion Square, with roots going back to the Garrick's Head Saloon of 1867. It sits on Government Street in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, Royal BC Museum, and Beacon Hill Park. Two on-site English pubs — Garrick's Head Pub and The Churchill — serve traditional pub fare and nearly one hundred craft and import beers.

detail.address: 1140 Government Street, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site restaurants: Garrick's Head Pub and The Churchill, both serving traditional English pub fare and a large selection of craft and import beers
notes.Luggage storage: Hotel policy states: 'Early arrivals can store luggage with us.'

hotel.name: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites Penticton
hotel.desc: A Marriott Fairfield Inn & Suites hotel in Penticton offering standard modern accommodation for traveling guests. Located on Eckhardt Avenue West, it provides a chain-hotel option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region. Bike storage and handling procedures remain unconfirmed.

hotel.name: Executive Suites Hotel & Conference Centre Burnaby
hotel.desc: A four-time TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice Award winner, the Executive Suites is a full-service, all-suite hotel in the Burnaby/Brentwood area with 125 spacious suites, each equipped with a fridge, microwave, and sink. The on-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar, outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre provide solid infrastructure for a multi-night stay. The hotel sits minutes from a SkyTrain station, giving car-free or bike-and-transit cyclists quick access to downtown Vancouver.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar serves meals and cocktails; room service also available
notes.Device charging: Room descriptions note 'custom work desk with multiple outlet' and 'work station with multiple outlet' in suite types

hotel.name: St. Regis Hotel
hotel.desc: The St. Regis Hotel is an independent, 100% Canadian-owned boutique hotel that has operated in the heart of downtown Vancouver since 1913, housed in a heritage building that has been extensively renovated. With 65 luxuriously appointed rooms and suites, it is steps from the Convention Centre, cruise ship terminal, and major shopping. A recipient of TripAdvisor Travellers Choice and Forbes Recommended Hotel awards, it includes complimentary full breakfast and Wi-Fi with every stay.

notes.Device charging: Room amenity lists include 'alarm clock with wireless phone charging' in all room types

hotel.name: North House Tofino
hotel.desc: North House Tofino is a luxury vacation rental company offering five self-catering properties on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, ranging from oceanfront hotel suites to a spacious six-bedroom oceanview home. Properties are positioned near Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and Clayoquot Sound, putting guests within reach of world-class surf beaches, ancient rainforests, and whale-watching opportunities. As a self-catering rental model, guests have private use of full accommodation units rather than traditional hotel services.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Country Meadows Inn
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Country Meadows is a full-service hotel in Aldergrove, BC, situated in the Fraser Valley between Langley and Abbotsford, about 45 minutes from Vancouver. Independently owned and operated by a family-run hospitality group with eight properties across BC and Alberta, the hotel features an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a variety of room types including Jacuzzi suites and accessible rooms. An on-site White Spot restaurant and complimentary hot breakfast make it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: White Spot Restaurant listed as on-site dining on the hotel website

hotel.name: Nancy Greene's Cahility Lodge
hotel.desc: Nancy Greene's Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room ski-resort hotel in the heart of Sun Peaks village, managed by Bear Country Property Management and named after Olympic skiing legend Nancy Greene. The property offers a range of unit types from standard hotel rooms to 3-bedroom suites, with ski-in/ski-out access directly onto the runs in winter. Its central village location puts guests steps from dining, shopping, and spa amenities, making it a convenient base for both winter and summer mountain activities.

hotel.name: Key-oh Lodge
hotel.desc: Key-oh Lodge is a 42-room hotel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Burns Lake, open since 2017, making it one of the newer accommodations in the area and a natural stopover for cyclists travelling between Prince George and northern BC communities. The lodge offers 24/7 front desk service, daily housekeeping, and a spacious parking area large enough for transport trucks and RVs. A sister property downtown (Key-oh Hotel) includes a restaurant and pub.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website states: 'a convenient grab-and-go breakfast bar to fuel you before you head out for the day.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Website footer notes a sister property: 'Hotel with Restaurant & Pub Downtown' in Burns Lake

hotel.name: Cherry Tree Inn
hotel.desc: Cherry Tree Inn is a quiet, family-owned motel set in 1.6 acres of gardens on the Saanich Peninsula, about 10 minutes north of downtown Victoria. It sits near the Galloping Goose Trail, a major multi-use cycling corridor, and is conveniently positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries, Washington State Ferries, or the Coho Ferry from Port Angeles. The property is pet-friendly and all rooms are non-smoking, offering a low-key countryside feel close to urban amenities.

detail.address: 4879 Cherry Tree Bend, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada V8Y 1S1

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Restaurants and Pubs' among nearby attractions

hotel.name: Days Inn & Suites by Wyndham Langley
hotel.desc: Days Inn & Suites by Wyndham Langley is a franchise chain hotel in Langley, BC, part of the broader Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. Located on Logan Avenue, it serves travelers passing through the Fraser Valley corridor east of Vancouver. Touring cyclists will find it a recognizable budget-tier overnight option in a community with urban services nearby.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Vancouver Airport - Richmond
hotel.desc: A 7-level Holiday Inn located on Cambie Road near Vancouver Airport in Richmond. Standard chain hotel offering reliable corporate amenities and free Wi-Fi. Touring cyclists can expect standard hotel services in a convenient location for airport access.

hotel.name: Arbutus Inn
hotel.desc: Arbutus Inn is a 52-room, 3-story affordable hotel centrally located on Douglas Street in Victoria at the crossroads of Burnside Road East and Dunedin Street. Offering renovated rooms with free parking and a National Car & Truck Rental kiosk on site, it sits within easy reach of downtown Victoria, Mayfair Mall, and the Gorge Waterway. Guest reviews consistently praise the friendly and accommodating staff, including willingness to hold luggage after checkout.

notes.Nearby evening food: Location page lists several nearby restaurants including Glo Restaurant + Lounge (dinner), Green Elephant Thai Food, Ramen Arashi, and Emmaline's, described as a walk or very short drive away
notes.Luggage storage: Google review (September 2025): 'They even stored our luggage for a few hours after we had checked out so that we could do a little more sight seeing before we had to leave.'

hotel.name: Executive Inn Whistler
hotel.desc: Executive Inn Whistler is a boutique hotel situated directly on Village Stroll in the heart of Whistler Village, part of the Executive Hotels & Resorts group. The property markets itself as a year-round adventure base with amenities including a heated outdoor pool, cardio fitness centre, and secure ski and bike storage. Its central village location gives touring cyclists immediate access to Whistler's trail network, restaurants, and services.

notes.Nearby evening food: Hotel dining page references affiliated on-site/nearby restaurants Trattoria di Como and Il Caminetto; hotel is also located in Whistler Village with abundant surrounding dining
notes.Wi-Fi: Amenities page lists 'Wi-Fi Internet Access'. Described as 'high speed wi-fi' in the hotel amenity fee section

hotel.name: Buckinghorse River Lodge
hotel.desc: Buckinghorse River Lodge is a hotel on the Alaska Highway in northern British Columbia. Located in a remote community, it provides accommodation for highway travelers. The Alaska Highway is a major cycling touring route.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Castlegar
hotel.desc: The Sandman Hotel Castlegar is a mid-size chain hotel on Columbia Avenue in Castlegar, part of the national Sandman Hotels group. Amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, free parking, and pet-friendly rooms, making it a comfortable layover for cyclists passing through the Kootenay region. The property has earned Bronze Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Continental breakfast listed as an available amenity on the hotel amenities page and referenced in individual room descriptions
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed under Room Features on the Standard Room detail page

hotel.name: Nicklen Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Grandpa's Heart at Nicklen Lake is a lakefront cabin resort set on two acres of Okanagan territory near Vernon, BC, offering seven named cabins of varying sizes from bunks to deluxe two-bedroom units. Guests can relax in a large gazebo overlooking Nicklen Lake, rent rowboats, or participate in occasional wellness and cultural programming. The property is dog-friendly and promotes a personalized, retreat-style experience away from city life.

detail.address: 23 Goat Mountain Road, Vernon, BC V1B3M6

hotel.name: The Plaza Hotel
hotel.desc: Built in 1928 and listed as a heritage property, The Plaza Hotel anchors downtown Kamloops with renovated rooms that blend preserved historic character with modern comforts. It operates an explicitly cyclist-focused program, offering a locked interior bike storage room, a dedicated bike cleaning station, and a biking-specific room rate. An on-site restaurant featuring locally-raised steak, complimentary hot buffet breakfast, and complimentary YMCA access make it a well-rounded base for multi-day touring.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page lists 'Laundry service' as a hotel amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant with menu centred on locally-raised steak
notes.Vending machines: Amenities page lists 'Pop machine' and 'Ice Machine' on-site
notes.Luggage storage: Amenities page lists 'Baggage and equipment storage' as a hotel service
notes.Bike wash / hose: Dedicated cleaning station with hose and spray nozzle, cleaning chamois cloths, and bike cleaning products

hotel.name: Strathcona Hotel
hotel.desc: A Victoria landmark since 1913, the Strathcona Hotel sits in the heart of downtown and combines a hotel with nine bars, a live music venue, and a liquor store under one roof. Known locally as 'The Strath,' it draws visitors and locals alike with BC's largest pub, the Sticky Wicket, offering food and live entertainment. A touring cyclist would find it conveniently located in the urban core with on-site evening dining and vibrant nightlife immediately available.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site food venues including the Sticky Wicket pub; website describes 'fresh food, exciting drinks' across several rooms including the Rooftop Patio, Clubhouse, and Games Room

hotel.name: Quality Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Standard Quality Inn & Suites chain hotel in Vernon, BC, offering conventional guest rooms. Located on 32 Street in the local area. A typical accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Mulvehill Creek Wilderness Inn and Wedding Chapel
hotel.desc: Mulvehill Creek Wilderness Inn is a small inn situated on Highway 23 South outside Revelstoke, a route that carries touring cyclists toward the Shelter Bay ferry and the Columbia River valley. Its name references the creek and wilderness setting along Upper Arrow Lake. It is the kind of remote roadside accommodation that touring cyclists on multi-day routes through the Selkirks would rely on.

hotel.name: Dutch Lake Motel
hotel.desc: Dutch Lake Motel is a motel accommodation in Clearwater, BC, located in the Thompson-Nicola backcountry. It provides lodging for cyclists and other travelers passing through the region.

hotel.name: Prestige Inn Nelson
hotel.desc: Prestige Inn Nelson is a full-service hotel on Front Street in Nelson, part of a family-owned British Columbia chain of 19 properties spanning the province from the Kootenays to Vancouver Island. Nelson sits at the heart of the Kootenay Rockies cycling region, making this a natural base for touring cyclists passing through or staging multi-day rides. The property is explicitly dog-friendly and offers a loyalty rewards program for repeat stays.

hotel.name: Granville Island Hotel
hotel.desc: Established in 1983, Granville Island Hotel is a boutique three-storey waterfront property perched on Vancouver's Granville Island, with direct views of False Creek and the downtown skyline. It has been recognized by Condé Nast Traveller, TripAdvisor, and Travel + Leisure as one of Vancouver's best hotels, and its location puts cyclists within walking distance of the seawall, False Creek Ferries, and the Granville Island Public Market. The surrounding neighbourhood offers artisan shops, live music, and waterfront dining right at the doorstep.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states hotel is 'steps away from the Granville Island Public Market, waterfront dining, artisan shops'; hotel also has its own Dine section
notes.Nearby grocery: Website references 'a fresh farmers market' and the Granville Island Public Market as immediately adjacent; a specialty/artisan public market selling fresh produce and food

hotel.name: Wahous Wilderness Lodge
hotel.desc: Wahous Wilderness Lodge is an Indigenous-owned floating retreat resting in the sheltered waters of Quait Bay within Ahousaht territory, deep in Clayoquot Sound. The lodge features 16 private guest rooms with waterfront decks, four secluded cabins, a cedar longhouse, a shoreline spa, and tide-to-table dining at its on-site restaurant. Stays are all-inclusive and immersive, centred on Nuu-chah-nulth cultural experience and soft adventure in old-growth rainforest.

hotel.name: The Maq Hotel
hotel.desc: The Maq Hotel is a recently reimagined boutique hotel sitting in the heart of Tofino with harbour views, locally commissioned art in every room, and a lively on-site scene that includes a café, bierhaus, and pub. With decades of history behind it and a self-described 'one-stop hub' ethos, it draws both travellers and locals alike. Touring cyclists finishing a west coast ride will find a centrally located, dog-welcoming base steps from Tofino's surf beaches and amenities.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site evening options: The BEAR Bierhaus ('oysters, cocktails, and coastal hangs — indoors or out on the sunny patio') and The MAQ Pub ('music, art, and that laid-back Tofino energy')

hotel.name: Ambassador Hotel
hotel.desc: The Ambassador Hotel is a three-storey hotel on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, situated in an area with dense transit links and walkable amenities. Its Granville Street location places it near the entertainment district and close to the Granville Bridge cycling corridor. The hotel's current operational status is uncertain as its domain has lapsed and been taken over by a third-party hosting company.

hotel.name: WILDPOD Glamping
hotel.desc: WILDPOD is a luxury glamping site on the Tofino waterfront consisting of six geodesic domes at the tip of Grice Point, each with panoramic views of Clayoquot Sound and the 5,000-year-old Tla-o-qui-aht village of Opitsat. The site is adults-only and couples-focused, with each self-contained dome featuring an ensuite bathroom, kitchenette, propane fireplace, and a private cedar deck with Adirondack chairs. Its position at the edge of Tofino's downtown core puts restaurants, shops, kayaking, and bike rentals within minutes on foot or by bike.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the location is 'easy walking distance to everything the town has to offer; bars, restaurants' and separately calls Tofino 'foodie heaven' with 'excellent restaurants' nearby

hotel.name: Gravity Haus
hotel.desc: Gravity Haus Revelstoke is a boutique adventure-lifestyle hotel positioned as a basecamp for skiers, riders, and outdoor explorers in Revelstoke, surrounded by the Selkirk and Monashee ranges. Formerly a Motel 6 and later known as Gateway Inn, it has been reimagined as part of a North American network of mountain-town hospitality properties. On-site amenities include hot tubs, the Lüft après bar, gear rentals, and access to nearby trails and bike paths.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Lüft bar listed as a Haus Perk for après; website mentions 'Aprés at Lüft'

hotel.name: Seaview Suites
hotel.desc: Seaview Suites is a family-owned premium suite property on Cordova Bay Road offering fully furnished one-bedroom suites with ocean views overlooking Haro Strait and towards Mount Douglas Park. Each suite comes with a full kitchen, ensuite washer/dryer, and complimentary Wi-Fi, making the property well-suited for self-catering stays of a week or longer. Located near the Cordova Bay area and a straightforward 20-30 minute ride from BC Ferries' Swartz Bay terminal, it sits at a natural entry point for cyclists arriving on Vancouver Island.

detail.address: 4550 Cordova Bay Road, Victoria, BC V8X 3V5

notes.Laundry: Ensuite washer and dryer included as standard in both Premium and Penthouse suite types

hotel.name: Travellers Motel
hotel.desc: Travellers Motel is a 12-room motel in Cranbrook, BC, winner of a 2022 Traveller Review Award, offering standard and kitchen-equipped rooms alongside an on-site launderette and BBQ facilities. Situated 7 minutes from the airport, it lies close to the Mara Trail and within easy reach of Fort Steele and the Canadian Museum of Rail Travel. Its central East Kootenay location makes it a practical overnight base for cyclists passing through or exploring the region.

detail.address: 2000 Cranbrook St N, Cranbrook, BC V1C 3T1

notes.Laundry: On-site launderette explicitly mentioned on the About Us page

hotel.name: Super 8
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham is a budget-friendly motel chain property situated on Victoria Street West at the western approach to Revelstoke, a town that serves as a natural hub for cyclists exploring the Columbia River valley and the surrounding mountain routes. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, guests can earn points toward future stays. The motel offers standard roadside accommodation in a community well-positioned between Rogers Pass and the Okanagan.

hotel.name: Rugged Mountain Motel
hotel.desc: A small 8-room motel in Woss, BC. Website unreachable; bike storage and touring amenities could not be verified. Direct contact recommended for cycling-specific inquiries.

hotel.name: Rivermount Motel
hotel.desc: Rivermount Motel is a year-round motel, campground, and RV park on the North Thompson River near Little Fort, BC, serving as a natural staging point for Wells Gray Provincial Park — 'Canada's Waterfall Park' — located 66 km away. The property doubles as a hummingbird sanctuary, with hundreds of birds from multiple species visiting May through August. An on-site fully licensed restaurant offers Chinese dine-in and takeout, and the surrounding corridor is renowned for fly fishing, hiking, hunting, and access to Sun Peaks Resort in winter.

detail.address: 4462 Yellowhead Hwy, Little Fort, BC V0E 2C0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant offers dine-in and takeout Chinese food; described as 'Fully Licensed' and suitable for small group gatherings

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Penticton Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Days Inn by Wyndham Penticton Conference Centre is a branded chain hotel located on Riverside Drive in Penticton, a hub community between Okanagan and Skaha Lakes on one of BC's most popular cycling corridors. The property includes conference facilities, positioning it as a mid-scale option for both leisure and business travellers. Penticton's location between two lakes makes it a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Vance Creek Hotel
hotel.desc: Vance Creek Hotel & Conference Centre is a boutique hotel situated in the heart of Silver Star Mountain Village, a four-season resort renowned for its mountain biking trail network. Guests can ride directly to and from the hotel door, with shopping and restaurants steps away in the village core. The property also offers suites with full kitchens and a range of vacation condos for longer stays.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states guests can 'stay close to shopping and restaurants in the heart of Silver Star Village.'

hotel.name: Canada's Best Value Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Canada's Best Value Inn & Suites Vernon is a budget-oriented hotel operated under the Sonesta brand family, positioned off Highway 97 at 32nd Street in Vernon's North Okanagan corridor — a common through-route for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Rockies. The property offers standard motel-style rooms with in-room appliances, a guest laundry facility, and truck and bus parking, making it functional for travellers with gear. A dense cluster of restaurants within 0.5 km provides easy access to evening meals.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'guest laundry facility' under property amenities
notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple restaurants within walking distance: BX Creek Bar & Grill (0.14 km), Dairy Queen (0.17 km), Kelly O'Bryan's Restaurant (0.22 km), Boston Pizza (0.45 km)

hotel.name: Hotel Grand Pacific
hotel.desc: Hotel Grand Pacific is a 10-storey full-service hotel on Belleville Street in downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature. The property offers multiple on-site dining venues, an Athletic Club, and event facilities, making it one of the more substantial independent hotels in the city core. Touring cyclists will find it centrally placed for exploring Victoria's extensive waterfront cycling routes.

hotel.name: Fairmont Vancouver Airport Hotel
hotel.desc: A Fairmont luxury hotel located at Vancouver International Airport. Provides convenient overnight accommodation for touring cyclists at the airport terminal. As a major international hotel chain, it offers reliable service standards and amenities typical of upscale airport hotels.

hotel.name: Snowbird Ski & Summer Resort
hotel.desc: The Snowbird is a collection of slope-side, multi-level townhomes in Whistler's Blackcomb Benchlands, offering 2–4 bedroom units sleeping up to 10 people. Each unit includes a full kitchen, gas fireplace, in-suite laundry, private deck, and access to a shared outdoor hot tub. A free shuttle to Whistler Village is provided, and the property sits steps from ski-in/ski-out access and close to Whistler's extensive summer mountain biking trail network.

notes.Laundry: In Suite Laundry listed in property facilities

hotel.name: Reef Point Cottages
hotel.desc: Reef Point Cottages is a collection of self-contained cottage rentals scattered across the rainforest-meets-ocean landscape of Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's wild west coast, with unit sizes ranging from studios to a three-bedroom cottage. Several units feature private hot tubs and forest or waterfront views, and the property is pet-friendly. It sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and Pacific Rim National Park, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring this stretch of the coast.

hotel.name: Kumsheen Rafting Resort
hotel.desc: Kumsheen Rafting Resort has operated on the Thompson River near Lytton since 1973, hosting over 300,000 guests on whitewater trips down the Thompson and Fraser Rivers, including the iconic Hell's Gate section. The resort offers a range of accommodations from power campsites to king cabins, anchored by a central pool and hot tub area with views of White Canyon. Located in one of BC's hottest, driest regions just three hours from Vancouver, it functions as a full-service vacation destination with on-site dining and live weekend music.

notes.Nearby evening food: Cutting Board Restaurant on-site serves breakfast and dinner; FAQ confirms 'breakfast and dinner at The Cutting Board Restaurant'
notes.Device charging: Resort facilities page states communal washrooms contain 'electrical charging outl[ets]' at both the Reception Office lower level and the Barn

hotel.name: Middle Beach Lodge
hotel.desc: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront resort set on 40 acres of rugged West Coast headland, featuring two lodges, twenty self-contained cabins, and treetop treehouse accommodations overlooking the Pacific. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, hand-cut forest trails for quiet nature immersion, and kayaking excursions — all roughly 3 km from the village of Tofino. The on-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner, making it a self-contained wilderness retreat with direct access to the Pacific Rim National Park Reserve area.

detail.address: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner daily

hotel.name: Sparkling Hill Resort
hotel.desc: Sparkling Hill Resort is a luxury adults-only 4-Diamond wellness resort perched on a granite ridge overlooking Okanagan Lake near Vernon, BC, founded by the Swarovski crystal family and decorated with over 3.5 million Swarovski crystals throughout its 149 rooms. The 40,000 sq. ft. KurSpa draws on the European hot-cold-rest healing philosophy and offers over 100 treatments. Touring cyclists arriving after a long day on the Okanagan will find multiple on-site dining venues, including a fine-dining restaurant and a casual café.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site dining outlets: PeakFine at Sparkling Hill (fine dining), Gerni's Farmhouse, Barrique & Java, and in-room dining service

hotel.name: Days Inn - Victoria On The Harbour
hotel.desc: Days Inn Victoria on the Harbour is a four-storey harbourfront hotel situated steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour, Parliament Buildings, and waterfront cycling trails. The property offers a range of rooms including kitchenette suites alongside a full harbourfront restaurant and bar with garden patio seating. Complimentary on-site parking is available for guests, making it a convenient downtown base for cyclists arriving by vehicle or needing secure car storage during a tour.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Harbourfront Restaurant & Bar offers all-day dining with dinner and evening drinks on a harbour-view garden patio; website also notes the hotel is 'steps from craft breweries'

hotel.name: Best Western Premier Aberdeen Kamloops
hotel.desc: A Best Western Premier hotel located just off the TransCanada Highway in Kamloops, offering views of the Thompson River Valley and surrounding mountains. The property sits close to Thompson Rivers University and key area businesses, making it a practical stop for cycle tourists passing through the interior of BC. An on-site restaurant serves all three meals.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant confirmed open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner per hotel overview page

hotel.name: Chameleon Hotel
hotel.desc: A family-operated hotel in downtown Castlegar, in business since 1953 and run by German-Canadian hosts who speak five languages. The property features an on-site restaurant specializing in authentic German and European cuisine, a licensed sunny patio, and a self-serve continental breakfast included with rooms. Touring cyclists will find it a characterful stop with free parking and proximity to Castlegar amenities.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant serving German and European cuisine; fully licensed patio also available

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Valemount Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A Best Western Plus property in Valemount, BC, positioned at the gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park and the Rocky Mountains. The hotel features an indoor pool, waterslide, and hot tub, along with suites offering kitchenettes and mountain views — useful for cyclists needing to dry out and recover after a long day on Highway 5. Valemount is a key overnight stop on the Icefields Parkway corridor and this is one of the town's most prominent full-service lodging options.

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Langley
hotel.desc: Travelodge by Wyndham Langley is a two-storey budget hotel situated on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, part of the nationally recognized Travelodge chain. It sits along a major highway corridor in the Fraser Valley, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Interior. As a branded chain property it offers a standardized lodging experience with predictable amenities.

hotel.name: The Sunset Hotel West End
hotel.desc: A 50-room hotel in Vancouver's West End. Offers free wireless internet. General-purpose accommodation useful for touring cyclists; bike-specific amenities could not be verified.

hotel.name: Duffin Cove Resort
hotel.desc: Duffin Cove Resort is a private oceanfront property in Tofino offering studios, waterfront cabins perched at the edge of a private cove (accessed via 50 stairs), and a full condo suite — all set against ancient rainforest and the rugged Clayoquot Sound shoreline. Operated under The MAQ Hotel group, it sits just steps from central Tofino while feeling distinctly removed from the bustle. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a genuine west coast retreat with free parking, though the cliff-and-staircase geography of the cabins would make loaded bike handling logistically demanding.

hotel.name: Delta Grand Okanagan Resort & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A Delta Hotels property (Marriott brand) located on Water Street in Kelowna's downtown waterfront. This full-service resort and conference centre is a midrange accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Harrison Spa Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned and operated motel in the village of Harrison Hot Springs, named after the Belgian town of Spa in tribute to its founding owner — a nod to the hot-springs resort tradition stretching back to Roman times. Situated steps from Harrison Lake with views of snow-capped mountains, the 24-room property sits at the intersection of outdoor adventure and lakeside relaxation. Two on-site restaurants (Basecamp Burger Joint and Picnic Cafe) offer guests a discount, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

detail.address: 140 Esplanade Ave, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: On-site Basecamp Burger Joint serves house-made breakfast starting at 7am daily, year-round; motel guests receive a 15% discount with room key
notes.Nearby evening food: Basecamp Burger Joint (on-site, open daily) and Picnic Cafe (on-site, open daily until 9pm year-round) both offer evening food; guests receive 15% discount

hotel.name: Pendray Inn
hotel.desc: Pendray Inn & Tea House occupies a stately Queen Anne mansion originally built in 1897 for industrialist William Joseph Pendray, making it one of Victoria's most historically distinctive hotels. The property sits steps from the Inner Harbour and Fisherman's Wharf, and is anchored by a signature Tea House serving Afternoon Tea, Scottish High Tea, and Traditional Sunday Roast Dinners. Rooms are individually appointed with heritage furnishings and named for figures in the mansion's history, offering an upscale immersion in the Victorian era.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Pendray Tea House offers Traditional Sunday Roast Dinner; website also references the tea house restaurant as the inn's signature dining venue

hotel.name: Wedgewood Hotel & Spa
hotel.desc: The Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned boutique luxury hotel that has anchored downtown Vancouver's entertainment district for over 40 years, situated directly across from Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery. As a distinguished Relais & Châteaux member and Michelin Key property, it offers 83 recently refurbished rooms, suites, and penthouses alongside the award-winning Bacchus Restaurant. The hotel operates a named 'Wedgewood Bicycles' concierge service, signalling cycling is part of its guest offering.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Bacchus Restaurant and Bacchus Lounge

hotel.name: Sandman Inn Cache Creek
hotel.desc: Sandman Inn is a hotel chain located in Cache Creek on Highway 1 South, a major cycling route through BC. It provides standard hotel accommodations for travelers. The highway location makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in the region.

hotel.name: The Vista Inn
hotel.desc: The Vista Inn is a locally owned, recently renovated motel in Kamloops offering unobstructed views of the river confluence and Mount Peter and Mount Paul. The building has been fully updated with new furnishings and no carpet, and rooms feature Nespresso machines, air conditioning, and balconies. It bills itself as centrally located with free parking, dog-friendly rooms, and a sustainability focus including recyclable coffee pods.

detail.address: 626 Columbia St W, V2C 1L1, Kamloops BC

notes.Laundry: Website front page: 'coin operated guest laundry facilities' available for longer stays or travellers passing through
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website front page: 'Grab-and-go breakfast — Grab a quick and easy breakfast before you start your day—included with standard rate packages.'

hotel.name: Gage Apartments at UBC
hotel.desc: Gage Apartments at UBC offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom self-contained suites with full kitchens on the University of British Columbia's forested Vancouver campus, available year-round to the general public. The property is carbon-neutral, with heating and hot water supplied by biomass generation and hydroelectricity, and select suites are pursuing LEED Gold Certification. A major bus exchange is located on campus, putting downtown Vancouver roughly 25 minutes away.

detail.address: 5959 Student Union Boulevard, Vancouver, BC V6T 1K2

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Laundry facilities available' under Gage Suites features

hotel.name: Azur Legacy Collection Hotel
hotel.desc: Azur Legacy Collection Hotel is a 5-star luxury boutique property in downtown Vancouver, and the first and only hotel in Western Canada to join the Leading Hotels of the World. The Art Deco-inspired building houses 104 rooms, suites, and penthouses across 14 floors, with a lobby restaurant (Dahlia) and a rooftop Middle Eastern restaurant and skybar (Lavantine) on the 14th floor. It sits in the heart of the Financial District, a short walk from the waterfront and Stanley Park.

detail.address: 833 West Pender Street, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, V6C 1K7

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Dahlia Restaurant offers a breakfast service period in the lobby
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dinner available at Dahlia (lobby) and Lavantine Rooftop Restaurant & Skybar (14th floor); hotel is also surrounded by world-class dining per website

hotel.name: The Bonniebrook Lodge
hotel.desc: The Bonniebrook Lodge is the Sunshine Coast's oldest and longest-running accommodation provider, an oceanfront heritage inn in Gibsons with roots going back nearly a century. Rated 4.5 stars (Inn category) by Canada Select, it occupies a dramatic shoreline setting with views over the Strait of Georgia. The on-site Chasters Restaurant is a well-regarded fine-dining destination offering seasonal farm-to-table menus, making it a notable overnight stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.

detail.address: 1532 Ocean Beach Esplanade, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V5

notes.Laundry: Cottage 1550 is described as having 'a fully equipped kitchen and laundry with all new appliances'; not confirmed for lodge suites or other room types
notes.Nearby evening food: Chasters Restaurant is on-site, serving evening à la carte and table d'hôte dinners with seasonal hours

hotel.name: The Royal Anne Hotel
hotel.desc: The Royal Anne Hotel is a historic boutique property in the heart of downtown Kelowna, tracing its origins to 1905 and rebuilt on the same Bernard Avenue site after a 1971 fire. It sits within steps of Okanagan Lake, City Park, and a wide range of restaurants, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the region. The nearby Kettle Valley Rail Trail is specifically called out by the hotel as a scenic cycling destination.

notes.Laundry: Free guest laundry listed as a hotel amenity on both the amenities page and accommodations page
notes.Nearby evening food: O'Flannigan's Pub located off-site immediately behind the hotel, offering pub fare, appetizers, karaoke, live music, and comedy nights

hotel.name: Embassy Inn
hotel.desc: Embassy Inn is an 80-room hotel occupying a five-storey building in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, within easy walking distance of the Inner Harbour, Beacon Hill Park, and the BC Legislature. Rooms range from traditional queens to suites with full kitchens, all with balconies and in-room safe. The hotel offers a complimentary hot buffet breakfast and surface or underground parking, making it a comfortable downtown base for cyclists exploring the city.

hotel.name: Maple Leaf Motel & RV Park Resort
hotel.desc: Maple Leaf Motel is a renovated motel and RV campground in Oliver, BC — Canada's self-styled Wine Capital — situated along Highway 97 close to more than 40 wineries. The property offers a range of room types, many with full kitchenettes, plus a heated outdoor pool shared with the RV campground. It is a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan wine corridor.

notes.Laundry: Campground park policies page states: 'Coin operated laundry is available on site.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Superior Room page lists 'Nearby Eatery' as a property amenity

hotel.name: Super 8
hotel.desc: Super 8 Cranbrook is a franchised budget motel on the main commercial strip of Cranbrook, part of the Wyndham Hotels family. Cranbrook serves as a gateway to the East Kootenay region and the surrounding mountains, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 3 or the Columbia Valley corridor. As a nationally recognized chain property, it offers a predictable, no-surprises stay in a town with good access to services.

hotel.name: Whistler Village Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Whistler Village Inn & Suites is an independent hotel spread across two lodges (Powder and Keg) tucked in a quiet cul-de-sac at the heart of Whistler Village, within 150 yards of the Excalibur Gondola and mountain bike trail access. The property offers a range of standard rooms and kitchen-equipped suites, a pool, and is dog-friendly. It is managed by Atlific Hotels and carries a short-term rental registration.

notes.Nearby evening food: Hotel is described as 'steps from the village's dining'; multiple guest reviews confirm walking distance to numerous restaurants in Whistler Village

hotel.name: Charming Family Hotel
hotel.desc: Listed in OSM as a hotel at 10100 Francis Road in Richmond, BC, this property was branded under the 'Elevate Rooms' company. The 'by Elevate Rooms' suffix in the name suggests it was part of a managed accommodation brand, though the brand's domain is currently listed for sale. No independent details about the property's facilities or character are available.

hotel.name: Beachside Motel
hotel.desc: Beachside Motel is part of Skaha Lake Motels, a trio of family-friendly properties clustered on Parkview Street mere steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. It serves as the central check-in point for all three motels in the group. Guests have direct access to Skaha Lake Park's extensive public amenities including volleyball courts, a waterpark, and a public gym directly opposite the motels.

hotel.name: Rosewood Hotel Georgia
hotel.desc: The Rosewood Hotel Georgia is a beautifully restored 1927 heritage landmark in the heart of downtown Vancouver, operating as a full-service luxury hotel with a spa, fitness centre, pool, and six distinct dining and bar venues on-site. The property is steps from Vancouver's shopping, entertainment district, and offers quick access to Stanley Park. Touring cyclists would find it a high-end urban base with extensive in-house dining options.

detail.address: 801 West Georgia Street, Vancouver, BC V6C 1P7

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site restaurants and bars: Hawksworth Restaurant, 1927 Lounge, The Georgia Bar, Reflections The Garden Terrace, Prophecy, and Bel Café

hotel.name: Hyatt Place Prince George
hotel.desc: Hyatt Place Prince George is a branded mid-scale hotel situated in downtown Prince George, a major waypoint city for cyclists travelling the interior of British Columbia. As part of the global Hyatt Place chain, it offers a consistent, full-service lodging experience in a city that anchors connections between several long-distance touring routes. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George will find it a convenient urban base with access to city services.

hotel.name: Kingston Hotel
hotel.desc: Kingston Hotel is a family-run, century-old budget boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, describing itself as Vancouver's Best Budget Boutique Hotel. The 25-room property offers a mix of private and shared-bathroom rooms, an on-site sauna, and a business centre, appealing to travellers seeking affordable accommodation steps from major city attractions. Its central Richards Street location puts a touring cyclist within easy reach of the seawall, transit, and urban amenities.

notes.Laundry: Gallery page lists 'Amenities Laundry' as a distinct amenity photo

hotel.name: The Sidney Pier Hotel & Spa
hotel.desc: The Sidney Pier Hotel is a contemporary seven-storey waterfront hotel situated on Sidney's vibrant harbour, designed around coastal aesthetics and the natural rhythm of the Salish Sea. The property includes an on-site farm-to-table restaurant (10 Acres at The Pier) and a full-service spa and salon (Haven Spa & Salon) that has served the community for over 15 years. Sidney's coastal cycling routes are highlighted by the hotel as a local attraction, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

notes.Nearby evening food: 10 Acres at The Pier is an on-site farm-to-table restaurant operating in partnership with 10 Acres Farm & Restaurant, serving seasonal ingredients from Vancouver Island

hotel.name: Poco Inn and Suites Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Poco Inn & Suites is a 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam, situated about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver and minutes from two SkyTrain stations. The property spans two wings offering a range of room types including kitchen suites and themed rooms, plus a fitness centre with sauna, on-site restaurant, lounge, and conference facilities. It sits near five golf courses, shopping, and dining, and has hosted at least one organized cycling fundraiser group (Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest).

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site full service dining restaurant and intimate lounge mentioned on hotel overview page

hotel.name: Hi Kelowna Hostel
hotel.desc: HI Kelowna is part of the Hostelling International Canada network, one of ten HI hostels in British Columbia and a well-established budget option on the Okanagan cycling corridor. Situated on Harvey Avenue, Kelowna's main arterial road, it is within reach of the city's lakefront, wineries, and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail. As a dedicated hostel, it caters to independent travellers including touring cyclists passing through one of BC's premier cycling regions.

hotel.name: Long Beach Lodge Resort
hotel.desc: Long Beach Lodge Resort is an award-winning luxury boutique hotel perched on the beachfront of Cox Bay in Tofino, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler and World Travel Awards as BC's leading boutique hotel. The property blends oceanfront lodge rooms and self-contained Rainforest Cottages with on-site surf lessons, a cedar sauna and hot pool, and a full-service spa. It is a full-amenity base camp for exploring the Pacific Rim coast, with e-bike rentals available through the Surf Club.

detail.address: 1441 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Laundry: Contact page confirms: 'Fitness Room & Laundry Open daily 6 a.m.–11 p.m.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Three on-site food outlets serve evening meals: The Great Room (dinner 5–8:30 p.m.), SandBar Bistro, and the Surf Club (open daily for dine-in and takeout)

hotel.name: Level
hotel.desc: Level Yaletown – Seymour is a boutique extended-stay hotel in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood offering spacious furnished suites and townhome-style accommodations with fully-equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry. The property features over 11,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenities including an outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and a 2,000 sq ft fitness centre with sauna. It sits steps from Yaletown's dining, shopping, and nightlife, and within minutes of beaches and outdoor recreation.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry washer and dryer included in all suites

hotel.name: Sidney Waterfront Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A family-owned waterfront hotel in Sidney, BC, operating since 1963 and situated at the foot of Beacon Avenue with direct beach access — the only hotel on Southern Vancouver Island with that distinction. Cyclists will find dedicated secure bike storage with e-bike charging, on-site laundry, and complimentary continental breakfast included with every room. The property sits close to the Sidney ferry terminal and is surrounded by shops, restaurants, and ocean-discovery attractions.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states 'On-site complimentary washer and dryer. Laundry soap available for purchase at front desk.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Riva Sidney – Restaurant' under Local Amenities
notes.E-bike charging: Front page and amenities page explicitly state 'Secure Bike Storage with EV Bike Charging Capabilities.'

hotel.name: Okanagan Seasons Resort
hotel.desc: Okanagan Seasons Resort is a family-friendly motel on Highway 33 West in Kelowna that has been operating since 1969, offering 68 rooms from standard queen units to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens. The property features both indoor and outdoor pools, a children's playground, outdoor volleyball, and picnic areas, making it a practical overnight base for groups and families. Its multicultural team and range of suite sizes — including kitchenette options — give touring cyclists flexibility for longer stays.

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry listed explicitly in the Facilities & Amenities section of the About page

hotel.name: Tigh-Na-Mara Seaside Spa Resort & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: Tigh-Na-Mara is a long-established seaside resort nestled among trees on Vancouver Island's central coast, offering accommodation ranging from pet-friendly rustic cottages to spa bungalows and oceanview rooms. The property includes the Grotto Spa and two on-site dining venues, making it a self-contained destination well suited to multi-night stays. Parksville's beaches and central island cycling routes are immediately accessible from the resort grounds.

notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site dining venues: Cedars Restaurant & Lounge and Treetop Tapas & Grill, both confirmed on the resort website

hotel.name: Gold Dust Motel
hotel.desc: Gold Dust Motel is a motel in Gold Bridge providing overnight accommodation for travelers.

hotel.name: Fairmont Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: The Fairmont Vancouver Airport is a luxury hotel physically integrated within Vancouver International Airport (YVR) in Richmond, BC, making it one of the few in-terminal airport hotels in Canada. Its location on Grant McConachie Way puts it at the heart of a major Pacific gateway and steps from the Canada Line rapid transit. For touring cyclists flying in or out of BC, it offers a premium on-site option at the region's busiest air hub.

hotel.name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Vancouver Delta
hotel.desc: Delta Hotels by Marriott is a 4-star hotel with 124 rooms in Delta, BC, offering non-smoking accommodation with free Wi-Fi. A mainstream chain hotel providing reliable lodging for touring cyclists passing through the region. Specific bike storage and handling procedures are not documented in available sources.

notes.Wi-Fi: Free Wi-Fi available (, no fee

hotel.name: Hilton Vancouver Metrotown
hotel.desc: Hilton Vancouver Metrotown is a full-service, 4-star hotel with 283 rooms situated in Burnaby's Metrotown district, one of Metro Vancouver's major urban centres. The property carries the Hilton brand flag, includes a bar on-site, and is wheelchair accessible. Its location adjacent to Metrotown Station makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver urban corridor.

hotel.name: Rosedale on Robson Suite Hotel
hotel.desc: Rosedale on Robson Suite Hotel is an all-suite property in downtown Vancouver where every room includes a fully-equipped galley kitchen and a separate living area, making it well-suited for multi-night stays. The hotel features an indoor pool complex with a lap pool, hot tub, and dual saunas, alongside an on-site breakfast room. It sits close to Pacific Central Station and Vancouver's sports and entertainment district.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on floors 5, 9, and 15
notes.Early or packed breakfast: On-site continental buffet breakfast at Goody's includes fresh baked goods, yogurt, fresh fruit, cereals, hot oatmeal, hard-boiled eggs, and hot/cold beverages; available daily including holidays

hotel.name: Peninsula Motor Inn
hotel.desc: A motel in Ucluelet offering overnight accommodation to travelers. No additional amenities or cyclist-specific facilities could be verified.

hotel.name: Prestige Hotel Kamloops
hotel.desc: Prestige Hotel Kamloops is an 87-room modern hotel in Kamloops' Aberdeen neighbourhood, part of a BC family-owned chain of 19 properties. Guests have access to an indoor pool, waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, and on-site dining at restaurant Isagani. Its location near Sun Peaks Resort and surrounding hills makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Thompson Plateau region.

hotel.name: Coast Capri Hotel Kelowna
hotel.desc: Coast Capri Hotel is a full-service hotel on Harvey Avenue — one of Kelowna's main cross-city routes — making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring Okanagan wine country, downtown waterfront, and nearby parks. The hotel offers on-site dining at Vintners Restaurant and a Coffeecopia coffee bar in the lobby, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool. Its location near Capri Centre Mall keeps a range of services within easy reach for cyclists resupplying or resting between legs.

notes.Nearby evening food: Vintners Restaurant on site; Coffeecopia Gourmet Coffee Bar in lobby

hotel.name: Holiday Park Resort
hotel.desc: Holiday Park Resort is a sprawling 67-acre RV and vacation condo resort situated between Kelowna and Vernon in Lake Country, BC, featuring 570 RV sites and 117 vacation condos. Founded in 1983 and open year-round, the resort is surrounded by championship golf courses, award-winning wineries, and ski hills. An on-site convenience store and bike rentals make it a practical staging point for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site licensed restaurant 'THYME at Ellison Lake' with a pub-style menu
notes.Nearby grocery: 'Up Front Market & Rentals' is an on-site convenience store

hotel.name: Sunshine Inn
hotel.desc: The Sunshine Inn Houston is part of a four-property Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert, and is described as the newest of the four properties. It offers kitchenettes and air conditioning and positions itself as a comfortable stop for travellers heading to or through the Yellowhead region. Free parking and free Wi-Fi are standard across all chain locations.

notes.Vending machines: Houston amenities page lists 'Vending Machine' among hotel amenities
notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can look after your luggage free of charge. If you arrive early or are not ready to take your bags after checking out, we will store your goods for the day.'

hotel.name: Hotel Ymir
hotel.desc: Built in 1896 during the Salmo River Valley mining boom, Hotel Ymir is one of the oldest surviving buildings in the West Kootenay region and has been fully restored as a country resort with a licensed dining room (Pau Hana), a lounge (Cowichan), and a remarkable world art collection. The hotel sits directly across from the old Burlington Northern Railway corridor, now a 50+ km converted rail trail ideal for hiking and cycling along the Salmo River. Accommodation ranges from hostel-style bunk rooms on the third floor to en-suite queen rooms and two suites with gas fireplaces.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site licensed Pau Hana Dining Room and Cowichan Lounge, described as offering food and drink service

hotel.name: The Orca Inn
hotel.desc: The Orca Inn is a historic inn in Alert Bay dating to the 1930s, occupying two former buildings from the community's fishing-industry heyday. It offers a range of rooms and suites — several with ocean views where Orca whales are sometimes spotted — along with an on-site pub featuring live music. The inn is run by a hands-on owner and sits in one of BC's most culturally rich island communities, home to the U'Mista Cultural Centre.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub and restaurant: 'Enjoy our outstanding restaurant and pub.' Pub is open Friday and Saturday nights

hotel.name: Cape Carraholly Retreat
hotel.desc: Cape Carraholly Retreat is a boat-access-only oceanfront sanctuary on 75 acres along the Burrard Inlet, reached by a complimentary boat shuttle from Rocky Point Park in Port Moody. Just 14 km from Vancouver, the property offers four three-bedroom lodges, five yurts, and a dome, each with a fire pit and hot tub, alongside shared amenities including a dry sauna, kayaks, and a beach shack. It borders Belcarra Regional Park, giving guests direct trail access — though the boat-only entry means touring cyclists must transport their bikes by boat.

hotel.name: Haida Way Motor Inn
hotel.desc: The Haida Way Motor Inn is Port McNeill's largest hospitality complex, offering 70 guestrooms and suites on the northern end of Vancouver Island near the harbour and BC Ferries terminal. The property includes a full-service restaurant, a lively pub, and a liquor store all on site, making it a convenient one-stop overnight for cyclists arriving by ferry or heading toward Port Hardy. It is approved by BCAA and Tourism BC.

notes.Laundry: Website business travel page lists 'Guest Laundry facilities' among amenities
notes.Drying area: Website business travel page lists 'Dry room' as an amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site full-service restaurant and licensed pub described on the front page and business travel page

hotel.name: Riverside Inn
hotel.desc: The Riverside Inn is a historic boutique hotel, restaurant, and liquor store perched on the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan, recently under new ownership with extensive renovations blending rustic and modern charm. Guest suites range from standard rooms to a full-kitchen suite, several with private balconies overlooking the river. The on-site River Cafe serves breakfast and lunch, and the property also houses the Best Buy Liquor Store — the largest beer, wine, and spirits selection in town.

detail.address: 56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, V0R 2G0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site bar and restaurant; about-us page states 'kids are welcome until 9pm' in the lower restaurant space, implying evening service; bar area with pool tables also noted

hotel.name: Valemount Vacation Inn
hotel.desc: Valemount Vacation Inn is one of the largest hotels in Valemount, offering 71 fully renovated rooms ranging from standard doubles to multi-room family suites sleeping up to eight. Situated near Highway 16 in the Robson Valley with mountain views, the property features on-site amenities including a restaurant, sauna, and hot tub. It serves as a practical base for year-round outdoor recreation in the Canadian Rockies, with hiking, rafting, and salmon fishing close by.

notes.Laundry: Laundry Facilities listed as a room amenity on the Deluxe 3 Queen Bed Suite page
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant mentioned in the About Us section: "all-new amenities like a restaurant, sauna and hot tub."

hotel.name: Cariboo Lodge Resort
hotel.desc: Cariboo Lodge Resort is a rustic log hotel in the heart of historic Clinton, BC, operating for over 41 years at the base of the Limestone Marble Range along the historic Cariboo Highway between Vancouver and Prince George. The property features an on-site pub and restaurant serving homestyle comfort food in a Western-themed atmosphere complete with a wood-burning fireplace, pool table, and outdoor patio. It sits close to multiple BC Provincial Parks offering hiking, mountain biking, fishing, and canoeing, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists traversing this stretch of the Cariboo.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub and restaurant

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kelowna - East
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kelowna - East is a chain hotel located on Powick Road in Kelowna. Offers Wi-Fi access. As a standard chain property, it provides reliable accommodation for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Blue Bear Ski-in/Ski-out Vacation Rental
hotel.desc: Ski-in/ski-out vacation rental apartment in Whistler. Suitable as accommodation for touring cyclists exploring the Whistler area.

hotel.name: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina
hotel.desc: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina is a full-service oceanfront resort and 55-slip marina in Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering private-patio guest rooms with views of Malaspina Strait. The property hosts the award-winning Seasider Bistro + Wine Bar + Patio, an on-site Cold Beer & Wine Store, the Salish Sea Spirits Distillery, and a fitness centre, all steps from the water. Its combination of resort lodging, a working fuel dock, and a complimentary shuttle to Town Centre Mall makes it a well-equipped base for touring cyclists exploring the northern Sunshine Coast.

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry listed under marina amenities: 'Fresh water, ice, coin laundry, showers & washrooms'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Seasider Bistro + Wine Bar + Patio on the waterfront, open Wednesday to Sunday for dinner

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Prince George
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Prince George is a budget chain motel located on Commercial Crescent in Prince George, a major service hub on cycling routes through central British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham family of brands, it offers standard motel amenities in a city that serves as a key overnight stop for cyclists traveling the Yellowhead corridor or exploring the region. The property is flagged as wheelchair accessible in OSM.

hotel.name: SureStay
hotel.desc: The SureStay by Best Western Castlegar is a 57-room hotel positioned as a gateway to the Great Kootenay outdoors, combining a modest Canadian design with chain-brand reliability. It offers a complimentary full breakfast served daily in the lobby and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Touring cyclists will find it a practical overnight stop on the Kootenay corridor with standard hotel comforts.

hotel.name: Glencoe
hotel.desc: Glencoe is a resident-owned motel and RV/campground situated directly across from Harrison Hot Springs' public mineral pool on Hot Springs Road. The property offers both motel rooms and serviced RV/tent sites, making it one of the few accommodations in town catering to both motorized and non-motorized visitors. Its central location in Harrison Hot Springs puts touring cyclists within walking distance of the lake, hot springs, and village amenities.

detail.address: 259 Hot Springs Road, Harrison Hot Springs, BC

hotel.name: Right Choice Camp & Catering - Pink Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Pink Mountain Lodge is an industrial work camp operated under the Right Choice Camp & Catering brand, now part of Dexterra Group's remote workforce hospitality division. Located at the northern end of the Alaska Highway corridor, it provides reservations-only lodging targeted at crews working remote resource extraction and construction projects. Touring cyclists passing through one of BC's most isolated stretches may find it a rare roofed option, but access appears to be oriented toward contracted workforce clients rather than the general public.

detail.address: KM 0.1 Attic Creek Road, Pink Mountain

notes.Laundry: Dexterra/Right Choice open lodge amenities listed on website include 'laundry' as a standard offering

hotel.name: Bodega Cove
hotel.desc: Bodega Cove is the waterfront cabin section of the Bodega Ridge resort on the wild north end of Galiano Island, offering one- and two-bedroom seaside log cabins overlooking the Salish Sea. Each cabin features rustic wood finishes, a wood-burning fireplace, soaker tub, private cedar deck, and a fully equipped kitchen. The property includes The Pink Geranium Café and General Store on-site, and is part of a broader 22-acre destination resort that hosts retreats and weddings.

notes.Nearby grocery: The Pink Geranium General Store is described as on-site at the Bodega Ridge property, steps from the Bodega Cove cabins

hotel.name: Pacific Shores Inn
hotel.desc: A hotel in Chemainus offering accommodation. Website verification failed, so details about bike facilities and amenities could not be confirmed.

detail.address: 9847 Willow St, Chemainus, BC V0R 1K1, Canada

hotel.name: Gibsons Landing Inn
hotel.desc: Gibsons Landing Inn is a boutique hotel in the heart of the coastal town of Gibsons, BC, with a convenient waterfront location and walking distance to the Gibsons Public Market and local shops. Newly renovated rooms include kitchenettes and range from standard queens to balcony suites with ocean glimpses. Guests who book direct receive a credit toward Crazy Red's Breads Bakery in the adjacent Gibsons Public Market — a handy perk for an early-morning cycling departure.

notes.Laundry: "Laundry Facilities" listed in the amenities section on all room pages

hotel.name: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Langley-Surrey
hotel.desc: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Langley-Surrey is a four-storey branded hotel on the Langley Bypass near the Surrey-Langley municipal boundary. Part of the Hilton portfolio, it offers mid-scale accommodation with consistent brand standards in a highway-adjacent setting. Its location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley corridor.

hotel.name: Prestige Vernon Lodge
hotel.desc: The Prestige Vernon Lodge & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in downtown Vernon featuring a distinctive tropical garden atrium with BX Creek flowing through it — a genuinely unusual setting that locals have affectionately called 'The Lodge' for decades. It is the largest event venue in the Northern Okanagan and caters equally to leisure travellers and conference groups. Touring cyclists will find an on-site brewhouse and restaurant, indoor pool and hot tub, fitness centre, and complimentary parking.

notes.Laundry: Website amenities list explicitly states 'Guest Laundry Machines'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site 'Restaurant Brewhouse and Lounge' listed in hotel amenities

hotel.name: SookePoint Ocean Cottage Resort
hotel.desc: SookePoint Ocean Cottage Resort is a cliffside luxury vacation-rental resort perched above the Pacific Ocean on the western edge of Vancouver Island, roughly 60 minutes from Victoria. It offers cottage suites ranging from intimate studios to 3-bedroom units, all featuring ocean views over Emerald Bay, kitchenettes or full kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, and balconies in most suites.
