The resort is pet-friendly and is managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, with active development underway to expand its oceanfront cottage and yacht-suite inventory.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Mission City Lodge
hotel.desc: A full-service Best Western Plus hotel in Mission, British Columbia, situated in the Fraser Valley and minutes from the US border crossing at Sumas, Washington — a useful stop on cross-border touring routes. The property offers an indoor pool, spa, and fitness centre alongside complimentary full hot-and-cold breakfast included with each stay. Its location on the Lougheed Highway makes it a practical overnight base for cyclists exploring the lower Fraser Valley.

hotel.name: Sea to Sky Hotel and Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Sea to Sky Hotel is a 52-room property in Garibaldi Highlands, Squamish — a town billed as the Outdoor Recreation Capital of Canada — with the RideHub Cafe operating inside the lobby and direct access to Garibaldi Provincial Park and Alice Lake trails. The hotel explicitly caters to adventure travellers including mountain bikers, with on-demand secure equipment storage and a 24-hour front desk. Its location on the Sea to Sky corridor places it roughly 30 minutes from Whistler and within walking distance of grocery and dining options.

detail.address: 40330 Tantalus Road, Garibaldi Highlands, British Columbia, Canada, V0N 1T0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists a 'neighbouring restaurant' and notes 'other quick food & beverage options only minutes away.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website amenities state: 'Find grocery and retail shopping, including sporting goods within walking distance.'

hotel.name: BEST WESTERN Cranbrook Hotel
hotel.desc: The BEST WESTERN Cranbrook Hotel is a franchise hotel property located on Cranbrook Street North in Cranbrook, a regional hub in BC's East Kootenay. Cranbrook serves as a common overnight stop for cyclists riding the Rocky Mountain routes and Kootenay region touring loops. As a full-service hotel brand, it offers a predictable baseline of amenities for travellers arriving by any means.

hotel.name: Pacific Sands Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Pacific Sands Beach Resort is a beachfront resort on Cox Bay in Tofino, BC, with over 50 years of operation and 122 suites and beach houses ranging from studios to a four-bedroom property. Rated #1 hotel in Tofino on TripAdvisor, it offers surf-in/surf-out access to what the resort calls Canada's top-rated surfing beach, with old-growth rainforest and coastal trails immediately accessible. All suites include fully equipped kitchens, making self-catering easy for touring cyclists using Tofino as a base.

detail.address: 1421 Pacific Rim Highway, PO Box 237, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

hotel.name: Silver Star Motel
hotel.desc: Silver Star Motel is a budget-friendly motel in Vernon, BC, well-positioned for access to Silver Star Mountain ski area, Okanagan wine country, and local golf courses. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette suites and pet-friendly options, with free on-site parking. Guests receive discount cards for several nearby restaurants, and fast food and coffee are within a two-minute walk.

detail.address: 3700 32nd Street, Vernon, British Columbia, Canada V1T 5N6

notes.Nearby evening food: Boston Pizza is directly next door; Kelly O'Bryans and White Spot are also nearby; multiple full-service restaurants listed on the /dining page within walking distance
notes.Device charging: Rooms page lists 'Charging stations' as a standard in-room amenity in all room types

hotel.name: Home2 Suites
hotel.desc: Home2 Suites by Hilton is a four-storey extended-stay hotel located in Fort St. John, a major service hub in northeastern BC on the Alaska Highway corridor. As an extended-stay property it typically offers suite-style rooms with kitchenettes, making it a practical base for cyclists doing multi-day trips through the Peace region. Fort St. John is a significant resupply point for anyone cycling the Alaska Highway.

hotel.name: Magnuson Hotel
hotel.desc: Magnuson Hotel is a motel located in Creston, BC, providing overnight accommodation for travelers. As a motel, it offers basic lodging suitable for touring cyclists passing through the area.

hotel.name: Whistler Peak Lodge
hotel.desc: A 115-room boutique property in the heart of Whistler Village, within a 10-minute walk of both Whistler Blackcomb Ski Resort and Whistler Mountain Bike Park. Suites range from 400–700 square feet and include fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes, fireplaces, and jetted tubs. The surrounding village puts cyclists steps from upscale restaurants, shops, and galleries.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website describes the lodge as 'in the center of Whistler Village's upscale restaurants, shops and galleries.'
notes.Luggage storage: Website lists 'Luggage Storage' explicitly under Lodge Amenities

hotel.name: Slumber Lodge
hotel.desc: Slumber Lodge is a motel on Lakeshore Drive in Penticton, BC, directly adjacent to Okanagan Lake and within easy reach of the Kettle Valley Railway (KVR) trail — one of BC's premier cycling routes. The property offers a range of suite types including lakeview, family, kitchen, and a wheelchair-accessible suite, with a seasonal outdoor BBQ area and heated pool. Its central location puts cyclists close to downtown Penticton restaurants, wineries, and the Penticton waterfront.

notes.Laundry: Guest Laundry (coin operated) listed under Property Amenities on the About page
notes.Nearby evening food: Restaurants listed under 'Amenities close to the hotel' on the About page
notes.Vending machines: Pop Machine (coin operated) and Ice Machine listed under Property Amenities on the About page

hotel.name: Blue Horizon Hotel
hotel.desc: The Blue Horizon is a locally owned, boutique-style hotel occupying a prime spot on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from Stanley Park, English Bay, and the Seawall cycling network. All guest rooms are corner rooms with private step-out balconies, many with views of English Bay and the North Shore mountains. The hotel holds a 3-Green Key Eco-Rating from the Hotel Association of Canada, reflecting a commitment to sustainable operations.

notes.Device charging: Website amenities list includes 'Charging Station'

hotel.name: Gibsons Garden Hotel
hotel.desc: The Gibsons Garden Hotel is the largest hotel in Gibsons, situated in the heart of Upper Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast roughly seven minutes from the Langdale Ferry Terminal. Its 54 rooms range from standard queens to kitchenette suites with cooktops, making it practical for multi-night or extended stays. An indoor heated pool, outdoor hot tub, dry sauna, and fitness centre round out a solid suite of recovery amenities for tired cyclists.

detail.address: 963 Gibsons Way, Gibsons, British Columbia V0N 1V8

notes.Laundry: Self-serve laundry mentioned on front page; 'onsite guest laundry facilities' confirmed on extended-stay page
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary Grab & Go items (coffee, muffins, fruits, juices, tea) available daily 7–10am
notes.Nearby evening food: Hotel website states property is 'within walking distance of the town's charming restaurants.'

hotel.name: The Parker Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Parker Hotel is a boutique property in Vancouver's Beach District, a short walk from English Bay Beach and the city's 22-kilometre seawall — prime waterfront cycling infrastructure. The hotel offers complimentary cruiser-style bike rentals and sits within easy reach of Yaletown, Granville Island, and Sunset Beach. Its rooftop bar, Parker Rooftop, is a notable on-site evening destination with panoramic city and ocean views.

notes.Nearby evening food: Parker Rooftop bar and restaurant is located on-site at the hotel; website describes it as 'Vancouver's Newest Rooftop Destination' with dining and bar service

hotel.name: Ocean Promenade Hotel
hotel.desc: Ocean Promenade Hotel is a locally owned boutique hotel opened in 2003, situated directly across from the beach on Marine Drive in White Rock, BC. It has earned multiple awards including an AAA/CAA Diamond rating and has been voted Best of the Peninsula since 2004. Guests are steps from the 2.5-kilometre White Rock Promenade, which leads to the heritage pier, dozens of restaurants, and Semiahmoo Bay beach.

notes.Nearby evening food: White Rock subpage states the promenade 'continues along the beach to... colourful sidewalk cafes, two dozen restaurants' starting 'just steps from our Hotel Lobby'

hotel.name: The Charles M Suites
hotel.desc: The Charles M is a furnished apartment and boarding house situated on the bank of Mission Creek in Kelowna's Mission neighbourhood, where the creek flows toward Lake Okanagan. Run by two friends with a shared love of travel and the outdoors, it positions itself as a home-away-from-home for stays ranging from a short vacation to a full semester. Bookings are handled through Airbnb or Discover Kelowna Resort Accommodations.

hotel.name: Northstar Mountain Village
hotel.desc: Northstar Mountain Village is a ski-in/ski-out quarter-share townhome resort perched directly on the slopes of Kimberley Alpine Resort. Units are designed for groups and families, each equipped with a private hot tub, fireplace, BBQ, and in-suite laundry. Guests also have access to a shared heated outdoor pool and the Alpine Room, a communal gathering space.

notes.Laundry: Website amenity list explicitly includes 'Private Laundry' in each unit

hotel.name: Heritage Inn Hotel & Convention Centre
hotel.desc: Heritage Inn Hotel & Convention Centre is a full-service hotel and convention venue in Cranbrook, part of a Western Canadian chain with over 40 years of hospitality. The property features an on-site restaurant (Skylight Cafe) and lounge (Heritage Lounge), plus meeting and banquet facilities. Cranbrook sits in the heart of the Kootenays, making this a well-positioned overnight stop for cyclists touring the Columbia Valley or Crowsnest Pass routes.

detail.address: 803 Cranbrook Street North, Cranbrook, BC V1C 3S2

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Skylight Cafe and Heritage Lounge confirmed by website navigation and dining section; take-out options also advertised
notes.Luggage storage: Reservation policies page states: 'If you arrive before check-in time (4:00 pm), we can hold your bags while you relax in the public area of the hotel or explore the local area until your room is available.'

hotel.name: English Bay Hotel
hotel.desc: English Bay Hotel is a five-storey independent hotel in Vancouver's West End, directly overlooking English Bay Beach and within easy walking distance of the Stanley Park Seawall — a premier cycling route. Every room comes with a fully equipped kitchenette including fridge, stove, oven, and cookware, making it well-suited for self-catering touring cyclists on longer stays. Four independent restaurants occupy the ground floor of the same building, and the surrounding West End neighbourhood offers dense urban amenities.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on-site, per /amenities/ page
notes.Nearby evening food: Four independent restaurants in the hotel building, each accessible from street-level; two offer breakfast. Hotel guests receive a 10–15% discount with their room key
notes.Luggage storage: Luggage storage available for guests, per /amenities/ page

hotel.name: South Thompson Inn & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The South Thompson Inn & Conference Centre is a 3-level hotel offering accommodation and conference facilities in Kamloops. Located on Shuswap Road, it provides wireless internet access and serves as standard hotel lodging for travelers in the region.

hotel.name: Coast Oliver Hotel
hotel.desc: Coast Oliver Hotel is a full-service branded hotel situated in Oliver, the self-proclaimed Wine Capital of Canada, steps away from Okanagan Valley wineries and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail cycling corridor. It holds the distinction of being the only hotel in Oliver with an indoor pool and hot tub, and provides a free hot breakfast buffet daily. Touring cyclists will find the location convenient for resupply and rest, with restaurants and cafes a short walk away.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is 'just a short walk from an array of restaurants and cafes'

hotel.name: Accent Inns Burnaby
hotel.desc: Accent Inns Burnaby is a BC family-owned hotel close to the Gilmore SkyTrain station, positioning itself as one of the most bike-friendly lodging options in Canada with complimentary bike rentals available to guests. The property is Rainbow Registered, holds BC Hotel Association housekeeping awards, and hosts the locally operated Bin 4 Burger Lounge on site. Its accessible location off Highway 1 and proximity to transit makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Greater Vancouver area.

notes.Laundry: 'A laundry room in case it's not just your bike that needs washing.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Bin 4 Burger Lounge serving burgers, craft beers, cocktails, and gluten-free/vegetarian options
notes.Bikes in rooms: 'Love your bike? Bring it to your room. No need to leave it in storage where you can't see it.' Bike-friendly rooms available on request
notes.Basic tools: 'Shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls.'
notes.Bike wash / hose: 'Bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' and 'Rags for cleaning your bike.'

hotel.name: Royal Scot Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Royal Scot Hotel & Suites is a full-service downtown Victoria hotel sitting steps from the Inner Harbour, offering everything from standard guestrooms to manor suites with full kitchens and separate sleeping areas. It explicitly markets itself as bike-friendly, with two dedicated bike lock-up areas and an on-site tune-up station on the property. A long-stay program and dog-friendly rooms round out an unusually flexible offering for touring cyclists planning an extended stop.

notes.Basic tools: Website amenities page: 'a tune-up station to keep you road- or trail-ready' listed alongside the bike lock-up locations

hotel.name: The Steveston Cafe & Hotel
hotel.desc: The Steveston Cafe & Hotel is a heritage property established in 1895 in the heart of Steveston Village, one of the most historically rich and cycle-friendly communities in Metro Vancouver. The building survived the great fire of 1918 and once housed soldiers during the 1900 fishing strike, and today it operates a popular breakfast cafe, bar, and liquor store on the ground floor. Cyclists staying here are steps from the Fraser River dyke trail, whale-watching tours, fresh seafood restaurants, and the working fishing docks that make Steveston a beloved destination.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site bar and restaurant; website also notes Steveston Village has 'many tasty fresh seafood restaurants' nearby
notes.Wi-Fi: WiFi is available in hotel rooms and is free of charge, per the amenities page

hotel.name: Island Travel Inn
hotel.desc: Island Travel Inn is a budget-friendly downtown Victoria hotel on Douglas Street, steps from the Inner Harbour, Parliament Buildings, Royal BC Museum, and Fisherman's Wharf — making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city core. The property operates a 24/7 front desk and offers free covered on-site parking. It is also positioned near public transit connections to BC Ferries and regional attractions such as Butchart Gardens.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated guest laundry facilities on-site (confirmed on About Us page)
notes.Vending machines: Vending machine (drinks and snacks) listed on Hotel Amenities page

hotel.name: Rainbow Suites
hotel.desc: Rainbow Suites is a rustic vacation rental condo sitting in the heart of Whistler Village, managed by Whistler Retreats & Property Management. Guests are a short walk from both the Whistler and Blackcomb gondolas and immediately surrounded by the village's restaurants, galleries, and shops. The property uses electronic door-code self-check-in with no on-site staff and no daily housekeeping.

notes.Nearby evening food: Events page states guests are immersed in 'more than a hundred bars and restaurants' in Whistler Village immediately surrounding the property

hotel.name: Sandman Inn & Suites Kamloops
hotel.desc: Sandman Inn & Suites Kamloops is a chain hotel location on Columbia Street in downtown Kamloops. It offers standard accommodation for touring cyclists passing through the area.

hotel.name: 100 Mile Motel & RV Park
hotel.desc: A family-run motel and RV park on Highway 97 in 100 Mile House, in the heart of BC's Cariboo region, recognized by Destination BC as a 'Very Clean, Good Economy & Valued Motel and Campground.' Accommodation ranges from standard and deluxe motel rooms to fully equipped kitchen units, with a year-round RV park offering full hook-ups operable in temperatures as low as -20°C. The property serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Cariboo Highway corridor.

notes.Laundry: RV park page lists 'Laundry Facilities' as an on-site amenity

hotel.name: Carleton Lodge
hotel.desc: Carleton Lodge is a condominium-style boutique hotel offering eight fully-equipped private suites on five stories at the base of Whistler and Blackcomb mountains, directly beside both high-speed gondolas. Managed by the Sundial Hotel, it provides 24/7 on-site guest services, maintenance, and security. Whistler is home to Crankworx and world-class mountain biking, making this a strategically located base for cyclists visiting the area.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the property is 'surrounded by beautiful mountain views, lakes and the bustling village atmosphere' with 'endless activities, shops, bars & restaurants' in Whistler Village

hotel.name: WorldMark Whistler - Cascade Lodge
hotel.desc: WorldMark Cascade Lodge is a Club Wyndham timeshare resort in Whistler's Northlands neighbourhood offering full suite-style accommodations, each with a fireplace and private deck suited to multi-night stays. The property positions itself as a four-season outdoor-adventure base in one of BC's premier mountain destinations. Stays are available to both timeshare owners and non-owners through Club Wyndham's non-owner travel deals program.

hotel.name: The Copeland
hotel.desc: The Copeland is a five-room heritage bed and breakfast occupying the 1900-era McCarty House in the heart of Revelstoke, built for the town's first mayor. It blends historic character with amenities pitched squarely at outdoor enthusiasts, including a detached secure garage for bikes and a dedicated gear drying room. Breakfast is handled via gift certificates to neighbouring Dose Coffee rather than in-house service.

notes.Laundry: Listed under General Amenities: 'Optional laundry service available (long stays only, please inquire).'
notes.Drying area: FAQ states 'a gear drying room at the back of the property'; Amenities list includes 'Drying room for winter/ski clothes and boots.'

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Langley Inn
hotel.desc: A 77-room Best Western Plus property situated in Langley City roughly 45 minutes east of downtown Vancouver, surrounded by farmland and recreational opportunities. The hotel has received the chain's 'Best of the Best' award for six consecutive years and offers an indoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre. Touring cyclists will find onsite coin laundry, complimentary hot breakfast, and an adjacent full-service restaurant and lounge convenient after a long day in the saddle.

detail.address: 5978 Glover Rd, Langley City, BC V3A 4H9

notes.Laundry: Onsite Coin Laundry listed in hotel amenities
notes.Nearby evening food: Ricky's Country Restaurant & Lounge listed as on-site amenity

hotel.name: Moon Water Lodge
hotel.desc: Moon Water Lodge is a boutique hotel perched on the Malahat along the Trans-Canada Highway, offering sweeping panoramic views of Saanich Inlet from private balconies in every room. Restored and reopened in 2014, the lodge ranges from luxury king suites to long-stay studios with full kitchens, and is pet-friendly throughout. Sustainability is central to the operation — the owners led the 'Strawless in BC' campaign and partner with Surfrider — making it a conscientious rest point roughly 25 minutes north of Victoria on a classic Vancouver Island cycling route.

detail.address: 265 Trans Canada Hwy, Malahat, BC V0R 2L0

hotel.name: Days Inn
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Victoria Airport Sidney is a chain hotel on Beacon Avenue in Sidney, BC, positioned near Victoria International Airport and the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal. Its location makes it a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists starting or ending a trip via ferry or floatplane. The property is part of the Wyndham Rewards network and operates as a standard mid-range roadside hotel.

hotel.name: Bramblebank Cottages
hotel.desc: Bramblebank Cottages is a well-appointed collection of seven private cottages and suites set on a park-like acre in the heart of Harrison Hot Springs village, within a short walk of Harrison Lake and local restaurants. Owned and operated by two friends who transformed a run-down property in 2017, the property features a communal hot tub, natural gas fire bowl, and complimentary kayaks on the bordering Miami River. The intimate venue also hosts small weddings and events for up to 80 guests with on-site accommodation for up to 34.

detail.address: 312 Lillooet Road, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

notes.Device charging: Alarm clock with phone charging port listed in amenities for Heron's Perch and The Nest suites

hotel.name: Holiday Inn and Suites Downtown
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn and Suites Downtown is a major hotel chain located in downtown Vancouver, providing centrally positioned accommodation for travelers and touring cyclists. The downtown location offers convenient access to urban amenities and cycling routes through the city.

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Duncan
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Duncan is a budget chain motel situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Duncan, BC, making it a convenient stop for cyclists riding Vancouver Island's primary touring corridor. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers standard chain-motel consistency in a town that serves as a practical hub for the Cowichan Valley region. The property's highway location puts it within reach of local services in Duncan.

hotel.name: Chateau Victoria Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: A locally owned and operated full-service hotel in downtown Victoria, open since 1976 and steps from the Inner Harbour and Parliament Buildings. The property is notable for Vista 18, Victoria's only rooftop restaurant, and the award-winning Clive's Classic Lounge. Touring cyclists will find bicycle storage, a guest laundry room, and EV charging among the listed amenities.

notes.Laundry: 'Guest Laundry Room' listed in website amenities
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining at Vista 18 rooftop restaurant and Clive's Classic Lounge, both mentioned prominently on the website

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Northern Grand Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A full-service six-storey Ramada by Wyndham franchise hotel in Fort St. John, in the Peace River region of northeastern BC. The property includes conference facilities, making it one of the larger hotel options in this northern community along the Alaska Highway corridor. Touring cyclists passing through on long-distance routes would find it a convenient urban base with standard hotel services.

hotel.name: Ramada Limited 100 Mile House
hotel.desc: A Ramada hotel in 100 Mile House offering standard accommodation. Serves as a reliable lodging option for touring cyclists passing through the region.

hotel.name: Poets Cove Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Poets Cove Resort & Spa is a luxury Arts and Crafts-style oceanfront resort on South Pender Island in the Gulf Islands, offering 22 lodge rooms, 15 cottages, and 9 villas along the shores of Bedwell Harbour. The property includes a spa, marina, and three on-site restaurants ranging from fine West Coast dining at Aurora to casual pub fare at Syrens Bistro. Cyclists arriving by BC Ferries to Pender Island will find a full-service destination resort with accessible units and pet-friendly options.

notes.Nearby evening food: Syrens Bistro & Lounge is on-site and described as open daily for lunch and dinner

hotel.name: Hampton Inn by Hilton Chilliwack
hotel.desc: Hampton Inn by Hilton Chilliwack is a mid-scale chain hotel located on Lickman Road in the Sardis area of Chilliwack, a common stopover town for cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley corridor. As part of the Hampton by Hilton brand, it offers a standardized full-service hotel experience. Its location near Highway 1 makes it a practical overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

hotel.name: Fossil Bay Resort
hotel.desc: Fossil Bay Resort is a small adult-only oceanfront cottage resort perched on the cliffs of the Juan de Fuca Strait near Shirley, roughly 55 km west of Victoria. Each self-contained cottage comes with a private hot tub, open fireplace, full kitchen, and large sundeck overlooking the water. The resort sits along West Coast Road amid beaches, hiking trails, and surf spots, making it a scenic base for exploring Vancouver Island's rugged south coast.

detail.address: 11033 West Coast Road, Shirley, BC V9Z 1G9

hotel.name: Metropolitan Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Metropolitan Hotel Vancouver is a 17-storey Marriott property located in downtown Vancouver on Howe Street. It offers standard hotel accommodations and guest services in the city's business core, convenient to downtown attractions and transportation.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Surrey
hotel.desc: A 3-level Holiday Inn Express & Suites in suburban Surrey, part of the InterContinental Hotels Group chain. Standard mid-range commercial accommodation suitable as a touring cyclist's overnight rest stop.

hotel.name: The Westin Resort & Spa Whistler
hotel.desc: The Westin Resort & Spa Whistler is a resort hotel operated under the Westin brand in Whistler, a premier cycling destination in British Columbia. The property offers accommodation and spa services to visitors. Touring cyclists would find this an available lodging option in Whistler.

hotel.name: Ocean Village Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Ocean Village Resort is Tofino's original beachfront resort, operating for 50 years on the shores of tinwis beach (formerly MacKenzie Beach). The property features rustic cedar cabins built from on-site timber in 1976, a rare indoor heated pool, and direct beach access for surfing and paddleboarding. It is a pet-friendly, family-oriented property nestled in Tofino's world-renowned surf and outdoor haven.

notes.Laundry: On-site, token-operated laundry room listed on amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website Instagram feed notes Surfside Tofino restaurant 'moved in next door' and is 'just a short walk away'

hotel.name: Accent Inns Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: Accent Inns Vancouver Airport is a BC-owned family hotel near YVR that markets itself as the most bike-friendly hotel chain in the province through its dedicated 'Bike Love' program, which includes free bike rentals for guests. Located in Richmond with a free SkyTrain connection to downtown Vancouver, it is a practical base for touring cyclists arriving by air or passing through the Lower Mainland. It is the first hospitality chain in Canada to have all locations Rainbow Registered by the CGLCC, reflecting a broadly inclusive ethos.

notes.Laundry: Listed as 'Laundry facilities' in the amenities icon list on the main location page

hotel.name: Imperial Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned motel situated directly on the historic Route 97 (Cariboo Highway) in the heart of 100 Mile House, the Imperial Motel explicitly welcomes cyclists and motorcyclists alongside business and family travellers. Rooms include a refrigerator, microwave, and air conditioning, with kitchenette units available for longer stays. It sits within walking distance of virtually all town shopping and dining, including the South Cariboo Visitor Centre and Waterfowl Reserve Lake.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the motel is 'within walking distance of almost all shopping and dining options in town.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states the motel is 'within walking distance of almost all shopping and dining options in town.'

hotel.name: The Latch Inn & Restaurant
hotel.desc: A hotel and restaurant in Sidney providing overnight accommodation and on-site dining for travelers. Located on Harbour Road, it serves as lodging for touring cyclists and other visitors to the area.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant (per business name)

hotel.name: Hotel DeOro
hotel.desc: Hotel DeOro is an owner-operated hotel situated in historic downtown Lillooet, BC, in business since 2005 with décor reflecting the character of this mountain town on the Fraser River. Guests have access to a fully-equipped shared kitchen and dining area built in 2017, along with self check-in and individual rooms featuring flat-screen TVs, mini fridges, and free Wi-Fi. Local restaurants are within a 5-minute walk, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Lillooet corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Most restaurants are only a 5 minute walk away'

hotel.name: Fairmont Waterfront
hotel.desc: The Fairmont Waterfront is a luxury hotel located at Canada Place in downtown Vancouver, part of the international Fairmont Hotels and Resorts brand. It offers a central downtown location for cyclists seeking premium accommodations in the city.

hotel.name: Blackcomb Lodge
hotel.desc: Blackcomb Lodge opened in December 1980 as Whistler Village's first hotel, independently owned and occupying a prominent corner directly on the Village Square with Whistler and Blackcomb mountains facing the building. Rooms are full-kitchen studios and suites renovated in 2017 in an alpine design, and the property includes an indoor pool, hot tub, dry sauna, and gym. Its central location places guests steps from ski lifts, downhill mountain biking access, and the village's dining and nightlife.

notes.Laundry: Listed as 'Laundry Facility' on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is 'steps from shopping, restaurants and Whistler's vibrant nightlife'; the award-winning Araxi Restaurant + Oyster Bar is described as the first restaurant guests encounter outside the lobby

hotel.name: Ukee Peninsula Motel
hotel.desc: Ukee Peninsula Motel is a newly renovated 19-room motel on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, situated between Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and the Broken Group Islands. Rooms range from accessible king suites to kitchenette units accommodating up to four guests, all on a private-entrance property with free parking. Its central Ucluelet location puts it within walking distance of local restaurants, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists exploring the Pacific Rim.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website Explore section states: 'All restaurants are walking distance to the lodge except #8 (10 min walk).'

hotel.name: Sylvia Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sylvia Hotel is a designated heritage building from 1912, covered in Boston ivy, sitting directly on English Bay beside Stanley Park. With 120 rooms and suites, it holds the distinction of hosting Vancouver's first cocktail lounge and has inspired a series of children's books through its resident stray cat. The hotel offers bike rentals and sits steps from the English Bay Seawall, making it a natural base for cycling the waterfront.

notes.Nearby evening food: Hotel has its own 'Eat & Drink' on-site dining described as a 'beachside dining experience'

hotel.name: Sunny Shores Resort & Marina
hotel.desc: Sunny Shores Resort & Marina is a family-oriented resort on Sooke Basin, located on Highway 14 about 30 km west of Victoria — a key stretch of Vancouver Island's south-shore cycling corridor. The property combines motel units, tent and trailer campsites with fire pits and picnic tables, and a full marina with boat launch, fuel, and charter fishing. On-site extras include a laundromat, 19-hole mini-golf, a tackle and convenience store stocked with basic food and camping supplies, and a children's playground.

notes.Laundry: Front page explicitly lists 'laundromat' among on-site amenities

hotel.name: Cassandra Hotel
hotel.desc: Cassandra Hotel is a small, family-run independent hotel on Kingsway in Vancouver's Collingwood neighbourhood, independently owned since 1982. It sits at the heart of a mile-long stretch boasting 50+ restaurants spanning 12+ cuisines, with late-night options steps from the front door. Rooms range from standard queens to a studio with kitchenette, and the hotel offers complimentary on-site parking — a notable rarity this close to downtown Vancouver.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website: 'Kingsway doesn't sleep. Late-night pho. The lights stay on. Your room is a two-minute walk back.' 50+ restaurants and food spots within an 8-minute walk
notes.Nearby grocery: TripAdvisor review quoted on the hotel's website (November 2025): 'close to groceries, food spots, and convenient transportation.'

hotel.name: Surfs Inn
hotel.desc: Surfs Inn is a family-owned collection of five self-contained suites and cottages perched in the rainforest overlooking Ucluelet harbour on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The property is walking distance to the Wild Pacific Trail, local beaches, and a variety of restaurants and cafes, and sits 40 km from Tofino. Units range from individual cottages to a larger guesthouse suited for families or groups, each with a well-equipped kitchen.

detail.address: 1874 Peninsula Rd, Ucluelet, BC, Canada, V0R 3A0

notes.Nearby evening food: Guide page lists multiple walk-to restaurants including Howlers Family Restaurant, Papis Cantina, Pluvio, Big Beach Lounge, Heartwood Kitchen, and Ucluelet Brewing, all on or near Peninsula Rd in Ucluelet

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport is a branded chain hotel in Richmond, BC, located near Vancouver International Airport on Sexsmith Road. It is operated by Wyndham Hotels and Resorts and was verified as an active property as recently as November 2025. Cyclists transiting the Greater Vancouver area may find it a convenient stopover, though no cycling-specific services could be confirmed from available content.

hotel.name: Little Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Little Beach Resort is a rustic coastal wellness retreat on the edge of Ucluelet offering kitchen-equipped cottages ranging from studio suites to a two-bedroom oceanview lodge, all steps from a pebble beach with kayak and paddleboard launch access. The property's cedar barrel sauna and outdoor cold plunge distinguish it as a recovery-focused stay, appealing to cyclists arriving from long days on the Wild Pacific Trail or Pacific Rim National Park routes. Guests note it is walking distance to town and close to the lighthouse trailhead.

hotel.name: Atrium Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Atrium Hotel Vancouver is an independent hotel on East Hastings Street, positioned close to Hastings Park and the PNE grounds. It offers a range of room configurations from standard queens to kitchenette suites, catering to solo travellers, families, and groups. The hotel promotes itself as a practical base for accessing downtown Vancouver, Stanley Park, BC Place, and the Convention Centre.

hotel.name: Liard Hot Springs Lodge
hotel.desc: A year-round lodge and RV park at Mile 497 on the Alaska Highway in northeastern BC, positioned roughly halfway between Fort Nelson (300 km south) and the BC-Yukon border (140 km north) — a genuinely remote resupply and rest point on a major touring corridor. The property sits directly across from the second largest natural hot springs in Canada, with a 15-minute walk along a boardwalk through boreal forest to reach soaking pools that run 42–52°C year-round. Accommodation ranges from hotel rooms to mini-cabins, campsites, and RV hookups, all served by an on-site restaurant offering breakfast through dinner.

detail.address: Mile 497 Alaska Highway, Liard River, V0C 1R0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant with full lunch and dinner menu

hotel.name: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Vancouver-Downtown
hotel.desc: The Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Vancouver-Downtown is a full-service hotel located on Robson Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, one of the city's main pedestrian and shopping corridors. As part of the Hilton family of brands, it offers suite-style rooms suited to extended stays. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Stanley Park Seawall, the False Creek cycling network, and urban services along Robson.

hotel.name: Hilton Whistler Resort
hotel.desc: The Hilton Whistler Resort is a full-service hotel operated under the global Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand, situated on Whistler Way in the core of Whistler village. Whistler is one of British Columbia's most celebrated cycling destinations, known for its extensive trail network and mountain bike infrastructure, making this hotel a natural base for cyclists visiting the area. As an internationally branded resort property, it is likely to offer a broad range of guest services, though specifics could not be confirmed from available sources.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Sands
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Sands is an eco-certified, six-storey hotel on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, marketed on its booking page as having 'retro flair' and access to ocean breezes and city attractions. The property offers professional meeting rooms and reliable internet access. Its location in a dense, walkable neighbourhood puts guests within easy reach of English Bay and Vancouver's urban cycling network.

hotel.name: Discovery Bay Resort
hotel.desc: Discovery Bay Resort is a waterfront suite-style resort in downtown Kelowna offering fully furnished suites with views of Okanagan Lake, the city, and mountains. Each suite includes a full kitchen and in-suite laundry, making it practical for multi-night touring stays. The resort is steps from the waterfront boardwalk — described on the site as suitable for cycling — as well as restaurants, a casino, and live entertainment.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry facilities mentioned explicitly: 'in-suite laundry facilities' listed as a standard suite feature
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the resort is 'just steps away from coffee shops, restaurants, casinos, and live entertainment venues.'

hotel.name: Hotel Zed Kelowna
hotel.desc: Hotel Zed Kelowna is a BC-owned, retro-themed boutique hotel on Abbott Street in the heart of Kelowna, part of a small chain also operating in Victoria and Tofino. The property leans into a 1970s aesthetic with quirky lobby decor, board games, and typewriters, and offers a seasonal pool, hot tub, and sauna. It is marketed as an inclusive, personality-driven alternative to conventional hotel stays in the Okanagan.

hotel.name: Hilton Doubletree
hotel.desc: The DoubleTree by Hilton Kamloops is a full-service hotel situated in downtown Kamloops on St Paul Street, close to the Thompson River and the city centre. As part of the Hilton brand, it offers the amenities expected of a mid-to-upper-tier chain hotel in a mid-sized BC city. Kamloops sits at the confluence of major cycling routes in the BC interior, making this a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through.

hotel.name: Paradox Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: Paradox Hotel Vancouver is an independent luxury boutique hotel occupying Arthur Erickson's iconic twisting tower on the Golden Mile of downtown Vancouver, holding Forbes Travel Guide Four Star (2025–2026) and AAA Four Diamond ratings. The 147-room property includes the award-winning Xylia Natural Spa, Mott 32 Vancouver restaurant, and Mansion Nightclub. Its central location places guests within easy reach of Stanley Park, Granville Island, and Vancouver's urban cycling network.

hotel.name: Radisson Blu Vancouver Airport Hotel & Marina
hotel.desc: Radisson Blu airport hotel in Richmond providing standard overnight accommodation for travelers. The property offers convenient lodging for cyclists passing through the Greater Vancouver region. Specific bike-friendly amenities are unverified.

hotel.name: The Westin Wall Centre Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: The Westin Wall Centre Vancouver Airport is a major Marriott property in Richmond, near Vancouver International Airport, making it a convenient overnight option for touring cyclists transiting the region. As a branded hotel, it offers reliable accommodations, though specific bike storage and handling procedures should be confirmed directly when booking.

hotel.name: West Coast Wilderness Lodge
hotel.desc: West Coast Wilderness Lodge is a boutique oceanfront wilderness resort in the remote village of Egmont on BC's Sunshine Coast, established in 1997 on seven acres of coastal rainforest at the confluence of four major waterways. The resort offers two accommodation streams: all-inclusive Heritage Lodge packages and year-round, self-catering Villas on the Inlet with full kitchens and private balconies. It sits at the gateway to guided kayaking, Zodiac tours to Skookumchuck Rapids and Princess Louisa Inlet, float plane excursions, and dozens of coastal rainforest hiking and biking trails.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Inlets Restaurant; Heritage Lodge packages include meals, and Villas guests can inquire about restaurant access

hotel.name: The Royal Kelowna
hotel.desc: The Royal Kelowna is a waterfront all-suite luxury resort in downtown Kelowna, situated directly on Okanagan Lake with condo-style suites featuring gourmet kitchens, in-suite laundry, and furnished balconies with lake or lagoon views. Managed by Bellstar Hotels & Resorts, the property's rooftop offers a heated infinity pool, hot tubs, fitness centre, and BBQs. Its lakefront location in downtown Kelowna puts touring cyclists close to the city's waterfront paths and Okanagan amenities.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry (washer & dryer) listed as a standard feature in all units on the /rooms page
notes.Nearby evening food: Neighbouring Playtime Casino Kelowna has a neighbourhood pub-style restaurant, mentioned on /amenities page

hotel.name: Times Square Suites Hotel
hotel.desc: Times Square Suites Hotel is a locally-owned, condo-style apartment hotel on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, operating since 1998 with studio-to-two-bedroom suites featuring full kitchens, in-suite washer/dryer, and a rooftop patio with BBQ grills. The hotel sits within a mixed-use building that houses restaurants and shops, with local grocery stores immediately outside the front door and Stanley Park a short walk away. It targets families, couples, and extended-stay guests seeking home-like comfort in a walkable, food-rich neighbourhood.

detail.address: 1821 Robson Street, Vancouver, British Columbia V6G 3E4

notes.Laundry: Each suite has an in-suite washer and dryer; website states 'Our suites is equipped with an en-suite washer and dryer' and 'in-suite laundry' is listed as a core amenity throughout the site
notes.Nearby evening food: Restaurants are within the hotel building complex; Dining & Services page states 'a diverse array of dining options—from cozy cafés to celebrated restaurants' within a 5-10 minute stroll, and 'dozens of multi-ethnic neighbourhood eateries begin right outside the front door.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'Local grocery stores... begin right outside the front door.'

hotel.name: Pacific Shores Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Pacific Shores Resort & Spa is a thirteen-acre waterfront resort set alongside Craig Bay near Nanoose Bay on Vancouver Island, offering suite-style accommodations with full kitchens and in-suite washer/dryers. The property includes indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a wellness spa, on-site physiotherapy, and 10 pickleball courts. Seasonal guest use of cruiser bikes, kayaks, and stand-up paddle boards makes it a comfortable base for exploring the Parksville-Qualicum corridor.

notes.Laundry: In-suite washer/dryer included in all room types per room description page: 'All comes with washer/dryer'
notes.Wi-Fi: Included in daily resort fee per amenities page: 'Our daily resort fee includes wifi, parking, arrival bottled water, in-room tea and coffee'

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Chemainus Inn
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Chemainus Inn is an award-winning suite-style hotel situated in the artsy Vancouver Island town of Chemainus, celebrated for its outdoor mural trail and live theatre. It sits roughly midway between Victoria and Nanaimo on the Island Highway corridor, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the east coast of Vancouver Island. Complimentary hot breakfast is included with every stay.

detail.address: 9573 Chemainus Road, Chemainus, British Columbia V0R 1K5

hotel.name: The Alpenglow Lodge
hotel.desc: The Alpenglow Lodge is a vacation rental complex in Whistler Village managed by MountainView Accommodation, offering apartment-style stays steps from the village core. The property includes a hot tub and swimming pool (currently closed for renovation) and an elevator serving multiple floors. Its central Whistler location makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

hotel.name: The Wickaninnish Inn - On The Beach
hotel.desc: The Wickaninnish Inn is a celebrated Relais & Châteaux boutique hotel nestled between ancient rainforest and the Pacific Ocean on Chesterman Beach, one of Tofino's most dramatic surf beaches. Built around a philosophy of rustic West Coast elegance, it houses The Pointe Restaurant, Ancient Cedars Spa, and the Henry Nolla Art Gallery, making it a full-destination property. For a touring cyclist completing the Pacific Coast route, it represents a high-end end-of-stage reward with sweeping storm-watch views and on-site fine dining.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining includes The Pointe Restaurant, On the Rocks Bar, Howard's Wine Cellar, and the casual Driftwood Café, all operated by the Inn

hotel.name: The Crystal Lodge
hotel.desc: Crystal Lodge is a long-established full-service hotel sitting in the heart of Whistler Village, steps from the ski hill and Bike Park, with over 30 years of operation. It caters explicitly to cyclists with a dedicated bike valet, secure complimentary bike storage, and on-site washing and tuning stations. Touring cyclists will also appreciate the heated outdoor pool, hot tub, and sauna for post-ride recovery.

notes.Drying area: Website mentions 'boot and glove dryers' as part of the ski/board/bike valet service area
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is surrounded by 'restaurants, pubs, shops, and village strolls that Whistler is famous for' directly outside the door
notes.Basic tools: Website lists 'washing and tuning stations' under Bike Service, implying on-site tools for basic bike maintenance
notes.Bike wash / hose: Website explicitly states 'washing and tuning stations' under the Bike Service amenity

hotel.name: Steveston Waterfront Hotel
hotel.desc: A boutique apartment-style hotel spread across two riverfront buildings in Steveston Village, a historic fishing village where the Fraser River meets the Pacific Ocean. Suites range from studios to three-bedroom layouts, each with a fully equipped kitchen and contactless digital-key check-in via a guest portal. Its location in the heart of Steveston puts cyclists steps from the waterfront and the village's renowned seafood dining scene.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry available in select suite types including the Studio; confirmed on Suites page ('In-suite Laundry*' with asterisk denoting some suite types) and Extended Stays page ('many include in-suite laundry')

hotel.name: Super 8 Saanichton Victoria Airport
hotel.desc: A two-storey Super 8 by Wyndham property situated in Saanichton, just minutes from Victoria International Airport and a short ride from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal. It sits in a practical spot for cyclists arriving or departing the Southern Gulf Islands and Tsawwassen routes. As a national chain hotel it offers standardised, predictable lodging in an otherwise low-density suburban area.

detail.address: 2477 Mount Newton Cross Road, Saanichton, BC

hotel.name: Fairways Hotel on the Mountain
hotel.desc: Fairways Hotel on the Mountain sits along the first fairway of Bear Mountain's Mountain Course, home to Canada's only 36-hole Nicklaus Design golf complex. The 65 air-conditioned rooms and suites offer kitchenettes or full kitchens, balconies with golf course views, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. For touring cyclists, the location on the Saanich Peninsula puts the Galloping Goose Regional Trail and West Shore communities within easy reach.

hotel.name: Inn at the Quay
hotel.desc: Inn at the Quay is a 13-storey waterfront hotel perched over the Fraser River in New Westminster, offering private balconied rooms with unobstructed river views and direct access to the boardwalk along the river. The hotel sits immediately next to the RiverMarket at Westminster Quay and is a short walk from a SkyTrain station, making it a practical base for exploring Greater Vancouver by transit or bike. Pet-friendly rooms and fully accessible ADA rooms with roll-in showers are available.

detail.address: 900 Quayside Drive, New Westminster, BC V3M 6G1

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Boathouse Restaurant referenced in the Soccer Fan Package promotion; website also notes cafes and restaurants along the boardwalk and at New Westminster Quay
notes.Nearby grocery: Contact page states 'the hotel is conveniently located right next door to the Market,' referring to RiverMarket at New Westminster Quay

hotel.name: Okanagan Royal Park Inn
hotel.desc: A hotel in Vernon, British Columbia offering Wi-Fi. Unable to verify additional amenities or cycling-specific facilities due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Ramada Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: The Ramada Inn & Suites Penticton is a mid-scale chain hotel situated in the Okanagan Valley, a region highly popular with touring and recreational cyclists. Part of the Wyndham Hotels portfolio, it offers standard hotel amenities in a community that serves as a hub for the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and other regional cycling routes. Cyclists passing through Penticton would find this a centrally located overnight option, though specific cycling services are unconfirmed.

hotel.name: Blue Bear B&B
hotel.desc: A bed and breakfast located in Tofino, a popular cycling destination on Vancouver Island's west coast. The B&B provides accommodation for tourists and visitors in the area.

hotel.name: Kootenay Country Inn
hotel.desc: A motel in Cranbrook, BC offering overnight accommodation. Situated in the Kootenay region, it serves as a waypoint for touring cyclists traveling through the area.

hotel.name: Motel 6
hotel.desc: Motel 6 operates a motel in Cranbrook offering overnight lodging for travelers. The facility provides a stopping point for touring cyclists traveling through the region.

hotel.name: Hotel Eldorado
hotel.desc: The Hotel Eldorado is a historic luxury lakefront property on Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, founded in 1926 by Countess Bubna and celebrating its centennial in 2026. It occupies what the hotel describes as the most coveted spot on Okanagan Lake, with panoramic water views and award-winning dining at its on-site Lakeside Dining restaurant. A touring cyclist staying here arrives at a landmark heritage property with direct lake access and upscale Okanagan hospitality.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Bed & Breakfast Package offered: 'Enjoy a delicious breakfast served at the historic Lakeside Dining restaurant overlooking the lake, with fresh local ingredients made by our in-house culinary team.' Also included in the Memorial Cup package as 'daily breakfast for two.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Lakeside Dining restaurant described as award-winning, with breakfast service confirmed via the Bed & Breakfast package

hotel.name: The Magnolia Hotel & Spa
hotel.desc: The Magnolia Hotel & Spa is a 4.5-star luxury boutique hotel founded in 1998 and located steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour, recognized by the MICHELIN Guide, Travel + Leisure, and Condé Nast Traveler as one of Canada's top hotels. A touring cyclist will find a complimentary fleet of hotel bicycles with helmets, bike locks, and curated riding trails, as well as 24-hour concierge service ready to suggest local routes and experiences. The on-site Courtney Room restaurant draws on Vancouver Island ingredients and serves breakfast through dinner seven days a week.

notes.Nearby evening food: The Courtney Room restaurant is on-site at 619 Courtney Street, serving dinner seven days a week

hotel.name: Scott's Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Scott's Inn & Suites is a budget-friendly, centrally located hotel in downtown Kamloops that has been in operation for over 60 years. The property offers studio through three-bedroom suites, many with full kitchenettes, making it well-suited for touring cyclists on multi-day or extended routes. On-site amenities include a grab-and-go food and coffee counter, a rooftop sundeck with BBQ, and free parking with space for large or oversized vehicles.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Guest Laundry – Convenient on-site laundry for long-term stay guests' as a named amenity on both the front page and the /amenities-draft/ subpage

hotel.name: Hampton Inn by Hilton Kamloops
hotel.desc: The Hampton Inn by Hilton Kamloops is a branded mid-scale hotel located on Rogers Way in Kamloops, a major hub city in BC's interior Thompson River corridor. As part of the global Hampton by Hilton chain, it offers standardized amenities expected of the brand in a city well-positioned for cyclists crossing the province. Kamloops sits at the junction of several major cycling routes, making this a practical overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Jade Mountain Motel
hotel.desc: A motel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Chase, BC, offering convenient roadside accommodation for touring cyclists. The property provides Wi-Fi access to guests.

hotel.name: Pointhouse, Suites on Sargeant Bay
hotel.desc: Pointhouse Suites on Sargeant Bay is a boutique oceanfront estate on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, offering a mix of B&B suites and self-catered vacation rentals with contemporary West Coast architecture and sweeping ocean views. The property sits on a private, secluded stretch of coastline and includes hot tubs, a Nordic-inspired spa, and complimentary kayaks for some suites. Operated by Heather and Bob Newman, it draws consistently enthusiastic reviews for its personalized hospitality and dramatic natural setting.

hotel.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Kamloops
hotel.desc: Mid-range hotel offering standard business amenities and reliable service. A predictable overnight waypoint for touring cyclists in Kamloops.

hotel.name: Chilcotin's Waterfront Resort & Motel
hotel.desc: Chilcotin's Waterfront Resort & Motel sits on the shore of Nimpo Lake in the remote West Chilcotin, offering log cabins built by TV-featured Timber Kings, lakeside motel units, and RV sites with mountain and lake views. It operates year-round, drawing visitors for summer fishing and floatplanes as well as winter snowmobiling in the Rainbow Mountains. For a touring cyclist passing through one of BC's most isolated regions, this is a rare full-service accommodation stop with diverse lodging options.

detail.address: 1874 Otter Road, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

notes.Laundry: Cabin one is described as having a washer and dryer on the cabins page
notes.Nearby grocery: RV sites page notes the nearby Nimpo Lake General Store carries food, fishing licenses, propane, and fuel

hotel.name: The Como Hotel
hotel.desc: The Como Hotel is a newly opened 32-room boutique hotel in Vancouver's West End, a few minutes' walk from Stanley Park and English Bay. It offers complimentary e-bike loans to guests and dedicated bike, ski, and luggage storage alongside private secured underground parking. The mix of studio and multi-bedroom kitchen suites makes it a practical and comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the city.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website describes the hotel as 'Surrounded by eateries and bars'
notes.Device charging: Room descriptions list a 'USB-C outlet' as standard in all suites
notes.Luggage storage: Website explicitly lists 'Bike, ski and luggage storage' as a hotel amenity

hotel.name: Legends Hotel
hotel.desc: Legends Whistler is a condominium-style slopeside lodge at Whistler Creekside, offering 1-3 bedroom suites with full kitchens just steps from the Creekside Gondola. Several suites overlook the Dave Murray ski run, site of the 2010 Winter Olympic Alpine events. The property is part of a small group of three Creekside hotels and caters primarily to families and groups seeking spacious self-catering accommodation.

hotel.name: Embarc Ucluelet
hotel.desc: Embarc Ucluelet is a Hilton Grand Vacations timeshare resort situated beside a fishing village on Vancouver Island within the Water's Edge resort complex on Harbour Crescent. The property offers 1- and 2-Bedroom Suites with full kitchens, fireplaces, and private patios or balconies with water views, plus a full-service day spa on site. It sits close to the Wild Pacific Trail, Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, and a range of ocean adventure activities, making it a notable base for those who can secure a booking.

notes.Laundry: Laundry listed under resort amenities; in-suite washer and dryer confirmed in 1-Bedroom Suite description

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel & Suites Abbotsford
hotel.desc: Sandman Hotel & Suites Abbotsford is a four-level hotel in Abbotsford. As part of the Sandman Hotels chain, it provides standard overnight accommodation. The property serves touring cyclists and other travelers.

hotel.name: Fred Tibbs Condo Hotel
hotel.desc: Fred Tibbs Condo Hotel is a purpose-built strata hotel on Main Street in central Tofino, operating as tourist accommodation since 1997, where each suite is individually owned but collectively managed. The two-storey building offers ocean-view studio and loft suites within easy walking distance of cafes, restaurants, shops, and the waterfront. A full-service café and bakery operates on the ground floor, and the building includes a kayak and canoe launch.

notes.Laundry: 'Common laundry facilities' listed as a building amenity on the website
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the building is 'close to cafes, shops, restaurants and the oceanfront'; guest reviews confirm 'walkable to shops, restaurants.'

hotel.name: SureStay
hotel.desc: The SureStay by Best Western Rossland Red Mountain is a motel on Highway 3B at the edge of Rossland, a mountain town celebrated for Red Mountain Resort's skiing and trail riding. It offers free breakfast and a hot tub, making it a comfortable base for cyclists tackling the hilly terrain of the Kootenay Boundary region. As a Best Western-affiliated property it participates in the BWH Rewards loyalty program.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website amenity icons include 'free-breakfast'; body text states 'Enjoy a balanced and delicious breakfast with choices for everyone. Fill up on coffee before you head out for the day.'

hotel.name: Hyatt Place Kelowna
hotel.desc: Hyatt Place Kelowna is a 161-room branded hotel located in Kelowna's Enterprise Way commercial corridor. As part of the international Hyatt Place chain, it offers the consistent service standards and facilities typical of a mid-to-upper-tier business and leisure hotel. Its location near Kelowna's main commercial strip makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

hotel.name: Fuller Lake Chemainus Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Chemainus with Wi-Fi access. Specific amenities and current operational status could not be verified due to website inaccessibility.

hotel.name: Residence Inn Vancouver Downtown
hotel.desc: A Residence Inn by Marriott in downtown Vancouver. The brand focuses on extended-stay accommodations with kitchen facilities and full amenities. Located centrally on Hornby Street, it provides convenient downtown accommodation for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: The Tide's Inn
hotel.desc: Paradise Seashell Motel is a roadside motel on the West Island Highway in Parksville, a popular cycling corridor on Vancouver Island's eastern shore. Its location puts cyclists within reach of Parksville's beaches and town centre. OSM records free Wi-Fi on site, though no further amenity details could be verified.

hotel.name: Coast Chilliwack Hotel by APA
hotel.desc: Coast Chilliwack Hotel by APA is a 110-room full-service chain hotel operated by Coast Hotels, situated close to downtown Chilliwack in the Fraser Valley. The property offers an indoor pool, sauna, hot tub, fitness centre, and on-site dining at Montana's BBQ & Bar, which serves smoked BBQ and comfort food. It sits a short drive from Highway 1 with free self-parking on site, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.

notes.Nearby evening food: Montana's BBQ & Bar is on-site, described as serving in-house smoked BBQ, Canadian comfort-food favourites, and hearty breakfasts from early morning to late night
notes.Vending machines: Website lists a '24/7 lobby market' on-site

hotel.name: Civic Hotel
hotel.desc: Civic Hotel is a 144-room independent boutique hotel and part of Marriott's Autograph Collection, situated in the heart of Surrey City Centre steps from the SkyTrain. Each floor celebrates a distinct BC region through the photography of Rick Blacklaws, giving the property a strong sense of place rooted in British Columbia's landscape and culture. The hotel includes an outdoor 25-metre lap pool, whirlpool, and 24-hour fitness centre, making it a comfortable urban base — though no cycling-specific services are advertised.

hotel.name: Chalet Continental Motel
hotel.desc: Chalet Continental Motel is a pet-friendly motel in Valemount, BC, set in a valley surrounded by the Rockies, Monashees, and Cariboo mountain ranges. It sits roughly 20 minutes from Mount Robson and about 80 minutes from Jasper National Park, making it a natural overnight stop on the Yellowhead corridor. The motel offers updated rooms with multiple bed configurations including family suites, a BBQ area, and winter plug-ins.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Coquitlam
hotel.desc: Ramada by Wyndham Coquitlam is a mid-scale chain hotel on Lougheed Highway, a major arterial road in the Tri-Cities area of Metro Vancouver. As part of the Wyndham portfolio, it offers standard hotel services in a suburban location with road access to regional cycling routes and amenities. Touring cyclists passing through the Metro Vancouver–Coquitlam corridor may find it a practical overnight stop.

hotel.name: George Point Inn
hotel.desc: Grouse Creek Motel is listed on OSM as a roadside motel on King George Boulevard, a major commercial arterial corridor in the Surrey/North Delta area of the Lower Mainland. The property sits in a commercial landuse zone convenient to Highway 10 and regional cycling routes. No current operational detail could be confirmed due to the domain being redirected to an unrelated gambling site.

hotel.name: Huntingdon Manor
hotel.desc: Huntingdon Hotel and Suites is a historic three-storey inn situated steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature, offering a boutique atmosphere with sustainability credentials including Biosphere Certification and the 2019 Ecostar Greenest Lodge Award. The property operates a community garden established during the COVID-19 pandemic in partnership with the James Bay Neighbourhood Association. Its central James Bay location puts a touring cyclist within easy reach of Victoria's waterfront, ferry terminals, and downtown core.

notes.Wi-Fi: Not contradicted by website content

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Nanaimo
hotel.desc: The Ramada by Wyndham Nanaimo is a chain hotel on Rosehill Street in Nanaimo, BC, part of the global Wyndham Hotels & Resorts portfolio. Nanaimo serves as a primary arrival and departure point for cyclists taking BC Ferries to and from the Lower Mainland, making a centrally located hotel here a practical overnight stop. No cycling-specific services or infrastructure could be confirmed from the available website content.

hotel.name: Royal Camp - Lodge 147 (Mile 147)
hotel.desc: Lodge 147 is a prefabricated, single-storey industrial work camp operated by Royal Camp Services Ltd at Mile 147 of the Alaska Highway, roughly 5 km north of Pink Mountain, BC. It is primarily designed as workforce housing, with professional culinary teams providing daily meals on site. Advance reservations are required, making it a planned stopover rather than a drop-in option for cyclists traversing this remote stretch of northern British Columbia.

hotel.name: Days Inn
hotel.desc: Days Inn Vancouver Downtown is an 85-room heritage hotel housed in a building dating to 1918, located in Vancouver's downtown core near Gastown, Canada Place, and Waterfront Station. The property retains original wood flooring and old-world charm while offering on-site dining at the Chelsea Restaurant and the Butcher & Bullock pub. It sits within easy cycling distance of the Stanley Park seawall, a 10 km loop that circumnavigates the park.

detail.address: 921 West Pender Street, Vancouver, British Columbia V6C 1M2

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary continental breakfast served daily starting at 7am in the Chelsea Room; restaurant-style, not packed to go
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Butcher & Bullock pub serves contemporary pub food, craft beers, and cocktails; Chelsea Restaurant also on-site

hotel.name: The Hotel at River Rock
hotel.desc: The Hotel at River Rock is an 11-storey full-service hotel attached to the River Rock Casino Resort on the Fraser River in Richmond, operated by Great Canadian Entertainment. It markets itself as a destination for romantic getaways, business travel, and weekend breaks, with the casino, restaurants, and live entertainment on site. Touring cyclists would find it a sizeable urban hotel with easy access to the River Road cycling corridor along the Fraser.

hotel.name: Northern Rockies Lodge
hotel.desc: Northern Rockies Lodge is a full-service resort on the shores of Muncho Lake at Mile 462 of the Alaska Highway, roughly halfway between Whitehorse and Fort St. John — making it a rare concentration of services in one of northern BC's most remote corridors. The property spans hotel rooms, motel units, cabins, lakeshore chalets, an RV park, a fully licensed dining room and lounge, sauna, and an on-site gas station. It also serves as the base for floatplane-accessed backcountry fishing expeditions into the Muskwa-Kechika wilderness.

detail.address: Mile 462 Alaska Highway, Muncho Lake, BC V0C 1Z0

notes.Laundry: RV park page lists 'coin shower, laundry facilities' available for guests
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site fully licensed dining room and lounge listed among the lodge's own facilities

hotel.name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Oyster Bay Ladysmith
hotel.desc: A Wyndham-branded budget hotel situated on the Trans-Canada Highway at Oyster Bay, just outside Ladysmith on Vancouver Island. Part of the Microtel Inn & Suites chain, it offers a roadside overnight option on the busy Island corridor. Touring cyclists riding the Trans-Canada between Victoria and Nanaimo will find it a convenient stop along a stretch with limited accommodation.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express & Suites is a six-storey mid-range hotel in Chilliwack, part of the international IHG brand. The property offers standard hotel accommodations typical of the Express & Suites format. Specific details about bike storage and handling have not been verified.

hotel.name: Grand Park Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Grand Park Hotel & Suites is a mid-scale hotel on the Granville entertainment strip in downtown Vancouver, within walking distance of False Creek, Yaletown, English Bay, and Stanley Park. Room types range from standard queens to full-kitchen suites and a penthouse, and a top-floor rooftop lounge with communal kitchen and mountain views sets it apart from typical urban hotels. An on-site White Spot restaurant, 24-hour fitness centre with sauna, and secured underground parkade make it a practical urban base for touring cyclists arriving in the city.

notes.Laundry: Website front page states 'laundry machines for guest use' are available at the hotel
notes.Nearby evening food: White Spot restaurant is located directly in the hotel lobby; website describes it as open daily until late night

hotel.name: Flamingo Motel
hotel.desc: The Flamingo Motel is a small, owner-operated motel in Cranbrook offering a range of cabin-style rooms and suites, many with full kitchenettes. The property sits adjacent to a path leading directly to Elizabeth Lake Sanctuary and its wildlife trails, putting nature-based riding and walking within easy reach. Green spaces with BBQs, a fire pit, and a seasonal creek give it a relaxed character uncommon for a roadside motel.

detail.address: 432 Van Horne St S, Cranbrook, BC V1C 4W7

hotel.name: Cusheon Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Cusheon Lake Resort is the only lakeside resort on Cusheon Lake on Salt Spring Island, occupying four acres at the tip of a peninsula so every cabin faces directly onto the water. The resort offers a mix of one- and two-bedroom log cabins and cedar chalets, all with wood-burning fireplaces and fully equipped kitchens. A touring cyclist staying here would be 10 minutes by road from the town of Ganges, with complimentary canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, a barrel sauna, and two outdoor hot tubs on site.

detail.address: 171 Natalie Lane, Salt Spring Island, B.C., Canada V8K 2C6

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the resort is 'only a 10-minute drive to the main town of Ganges, which has restaurants' — walking/cycling distance but town is close
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states Ganges (10-minute drive) has 'grocery stores, pharmacies, gas stations' and more

hotel.name: Black Rock Oceanfront Resort
hotel.desc: Black Rock Oceanfront Resort is a luxury oceanfront property perched on a dramatic headland above the Pacific Ocean in Ucluelet, surrounded by the Wild Pacific Trail and the rugged rocky coast of West Vancouver Island. The resort offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes or full kitchens, gas fireplaces, soaking tubs, and furnished balconies. On-site amenities include the Drift Spa with outdoor hot tubs, a seasonal plunge pool, and direct trailhead access to the Wild Pacific Trail—making it a scenic base for exploring the Pacific Rim region.

hotel.name: Island West Resort
hotel.desc: Island West Resort is a full-service waterfront resort in the fishing village of Ucluelet, offering motel rooms with kitchenettes, RV and tent sites, marina moorage, and fishing charter services. The property sits on the inlet overlooking the boat basin and is within walking distance of Ucluelet's shops, cafes, and hiking trails, with the Pacific Rim National Park a short drive away. The on-site Eagles Nest Pub/Restaurant and marina store make it a self-contained base for exploring the west coast of Vancouver Island.

notes.Laundry: On-site Laundromat referenced on both the motel page ('on-site Laundromat for your convenience') and the camping page ('close to showers, Laundromat, Marina Store')
notes.Nearby evening food: Eagles Nest Pub/Restaurant is on-site at the Marina; motel page also notes walking distance to additional restaurants
notes.Nearby grocery: FAQ states resort is 'within walking distance to giftshops, grocery & hardware stores, banks, cafes, post office, and liquor store.'

hotel.name: Prestige Hotel
hotel.desc: The Prestige Vernon Hotel is a full-service hotel situated across from Vernon Square Shopping Centre in Vernon, BC, and is part of the family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain spanning 19 locations across British Columbia. The property offers a range of room types from standard kings and queens to multi-level loft suites with kitchenettes, catering to both business and leisure travellers. It sits within easy reach of Vernon's beaches, parks, golf courses, and ski resorts, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Okanagan region.

notes.Laundry: Website amenities list explicitly includes 'Guest Laundry Machines'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant listed as a hotel feature ('Restaurant') on the overview amenities list

hotel.name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Fort Saint John
hotel.desc: The Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham is a modern budget-oriented hotel on the south side of Fort St. John, a major service hub along the Alaska Highway corridor. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, guests can earn and redeem loyalty points. Fort St. John is a practical overnight stop for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway, and this property sits within reach of the town's commercial amenities.

hotel.name: Blue Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Blue Mountain Lodge is a self-catering vacation property on the shores of Christina Lake, offering lodge suites, cabin rentals, cottages, and full-service RV sites on 1.5 acres less than two minutes' walk from the lake. All units are self-contained with kitchenettes, BBQs, and linens included, and the property sits within easy reach of the area's hiking and biking trails. The lodge is pet-friendly and operates a seasonal rental model from the May long weekend through Labour Day.

detail.address: 81 Kingsley Road, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ lists several restaurants in and around Christina Lake: Kool Treat (burgers, fries, pizza, ice cream, bubble tea), Cascade Par 3 – Dueling Oaks (daily specials and cocktails), The Ice Creamery, and The Shack Donair + Taco Bar
notes.Nearby grocery: FAQ states 'There is the Huckleberry Market, and the Sunday Market in the summer' in Christina Lake

hotel.name: Hotel Willo
hotel.desc: Hotel Willo (formerly YWCA Hotel Vancouver) is a social enterprise hotel in downtown Vancouver where every stay funds YWCA BC programs supporting women and families. The hotel offers a wide range of room types, from budget singles with hallway bathrooms to multi-bed family suites, plus shared kitchens and laundry facilities in common areas. It sits steps from BC Place, Rogers Arena, and SkyTrain connections, making it a practical base for exploring the city.

notes.Laundry: Guest testimonial on website states: 'very good common areas including many bathrooms, kitchens, laundries, etc.'

hotel.name: Capital CityCenter Hotel
hotel.desc: An 84-room hotel located on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria's city center, providing convenient accommodation for cycling tourists exploring Vancouver Island.

hotel.name: Manteo Resort - Waterfront Hotel & Villas
hotel.desc: Manteo Resort is a waterfront hotel and villas property on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, operating under the Eldorado Resort group. The resort sits along the lake corridor and offers access to the adjacent Eldorado Yacht Club, which provides kayak and paddleboard rentals alongside motorized watercraft. Touring cyclists would find it a scenic lakeside base for exploring Kelowna's wine country and the Okanagan rail trail network.

hotel.name: Blackcomb Springs Suites
hotel.desc: Blackcomb Springs Suites By Clique is a slopeside all-season resort hotel on Blackcomb Mountain, offering studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites each with a full kitchen, gas fireplace, and private balcony. It is one of Whistler's true ski-in, ski-out locations, placing guests directly on mountain trails within minutes. A free BC Transit bus stops at the front entrance for quick access to Whistler Village restaurants and services.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page: 'The hotel features app-operated laundry machines on each upper level floor.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Front page: 'Whistler Village a short 15-minute walk or 5-minute shuttle ride away, you can be close to restaurants and shopping.'
notes.Vending machines: Amenities page: 'Our vending machines are stocked with ice cream, snacks, and drinks. All items are available to purchase 24-hours a day.'

hotel.name: Trans Canada Motel
hotel.desc: A classic roadside motel sitting directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, positioned as a natural rest stop for cyclists completing the Thompson River corridor stretch of the route. Ten of the rooms include full kitchenettes, and facilities include coin laundry, BBQ, and a 24-hour front desk. Small pets are permitted and the motel is fully non-smoking throughout.

detail.address: 2505 East Trans Canada Highway, Kamloops, BC V2C 4A9

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry mentioned on front page; 'Laundry' and 'Ironing Service' listed under Services in the Facilities section
notes.Wi-Fi: Website states: 'Free wireless internet access available in public areas and all guest rooms.'

hotel.name: The Met Hotel
hotel.desc: The Met Hotel is a 27-room heritage boutique hotel occupying an 1892 Victorian-style building in the heart of downtown New Westminster, featuring over-height ceilings, private floor lobbies, and waterfront views in select rooms. The property includes an on-site Taphouse & Kitchen (Howe Sound) and a liquor store, and sits within walking distance of the New Westminster Quay and the Columbia SkyTrain station, putting Downtown Vancouver roughly 30 minutes away.

detail.address: 411 Columbia Street, New Westminster, BC V3L 1A9

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Taphouse & Kitchen (Howe Sound) listed as a hotel establishment in the navigation and photo gallery
notes.Vending machines: Pop and snack machines located on the second floor; ice machine at hotel reception
notes.Device charging: Spacious desk with outlets placed conveniently for laptops and cell phones listed as a standard room amenity on all room-type pages

hotel.name: Myra Canyon Lodge
hotel.desc: A family-run ranch lodge with four guest suites situated 20 minutes above Kelowna at the edge of Myra-Bellevue Provincial Park, directly adjacent to the legendary Kettle Valley Railway trestles. The Kurz family lives on-site alongside goats, horses, chickens, and dogs, creating a working-ranch atmosphere with private decks and valley views. No televisions (except one suite), campfires, and morning animals make it a genuinely unhurried base for exploring the Myra Canyon trestle route.

hotel.name: Robin Hood Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Robin Hood Inn & Suites is a motel located on Gorge Road East in Victoria, BC, positioned near the Gorge Waterway and within cycling distance of downtown Victoria. As a roadside motel-style property it would offer basic overnight accommodation for touring cyclists passing through the capital region. Its status and current operations are uncertain given the lapsed domain.

detail.address: 136 Gorge Road East, Victoria, BC V9A 1L4

hotel.name: Canadas Best Value Inn & Suites Kamloops
hotel.desc: Canadas Best Value Inn & Suites Kamloops is a mid-range motel on Columbia Street offering easy access to the Trans-Canada Highway and Kamloops' downtown core and riverfront.
