The property is part of the Sonesta brand family and features an on-site café, Kirsten's Hideout, where guests receive a complimentary American-style breakfast each morning. Standard rooms include a mini-fridge and microwave, while suites offer full kitchenettes and separate living space for longer stays.

notes.Laundry: Website states guests can 'take advantage of our laundry or business amenities.'

hotel.name: Pemberton Valley Lodge
hotel.desc: Pemberton Valley Lodge is a Canadian-owned, all-suite hotel on the Sea to Sky Highway about 20 minutes north of Whistler, serving as a quieter and more affordable base for exploring the Sea to Sky corridor. The lodge features a dedicated Bike Program with complimentary bike rentals, a pool and hot tub, on-site dining, EV charging stations, and keyless room entry. It sits at the edge of a four-season outdoor adventure hub encompassing mountain biking, hiking, river rafting, and more.

detail.address: 1490 Sea to Sky Highway, Pemberton, V0N 2L1

notes.Laundry: Two-bedroom suites have a washer and dryer in-suite; laundry detergent available at Guest Services Desk. Not confirmed for studio or one-bedroom suites
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Café YPS offers happy hour specials; website also links to a Local Dining Guide

hotel.name: Hitching Post Motel
hotel.desc: The Hitching Post Motel is a motel located on the Sea-to-Sky Highway in Mount Currie. Website information is currently unavailable, limiting details on facilities and services for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Inn on Long Lake
hotel.desc: Inn on Long Lake is a lakeside resort on the north shore of Long Lake in Nanaimo, BC, where all rooms and suites include private balconies or patios overlooking the water. Guests can kayak or paddleboard on the 1.5 km lake, use a fitness room, and relax by a fire pit — with complimentary continental breakfast included. Its location is convenient to both Departure Bay and Duke Point BC Ferries terminals, making it a practical base for cyclists travelling on or off Vancouver Island.

hotel.name: Pacific Rim Motel
hotel.desc: A family-run, 30-room motel owned by the Corlazzoli family and centrally located in downtown Ucluelet overlooking the harbour on BC's rugged west coast. The motel sits within walking distance of the Wild Pacific Trail, the Ucluelet Aquarium, and kayaking tour operators, making it a practical base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and the surrounding coastline. Rooms range from standard queen and twin configurations to fully equipped kitchen units across four levels, with step-free access available.

notes.Nearby evening food: Homepage states the motel is 'within easy reach of family eateries, cafés, takeaways and fine dining restaurants with many showcasing the fresh, local produce of the area.'

hotel.name: Four Points by Sheraton Kelowna Airport
hotel.desc: A Four Points by Sheraton hotel located on the access road to Kelowna International Airport, convenient for touring cyclists arriving or departing the region by air. A six-level commercial building operated by Marriott. Specific bike storage and guest amenities remain unconfirmed.

hotel.name: Empire Motel
hotel.desc: Empire Motel is a motel in Penticton situated about one and a half blocks from Skaha Lake, one of the Okanagan's popular summer beach destinations. The property features a swimming pool, BBQ area, and a courtyard, and bills itself as offering unique rooms. It sits within easy reach of Skaha Lake water sports, local fruit stands, and nearby Okanagan wineries.

hotel.name: Siesta Suites
hotel.desc: Siesta Suites is a 96-suite motel in Kelowna's South Pandosy district, situated walking distance from Gyro Beach and directly across from Mission Park Mall. The property features two pools (including Kelowna's largest outdoor pool, seasonal), a fitness facility, and self-serve laundry, catering to families, business travelers, and groups. Its pedestrian-friendly neighborhood surrounded by restaurants and shops makes it a practical base for exploring the southern Okanagan by bike.

detail.address: 3152 Lakeshore Road, Kelowna, British Columbia V1W 3T1

notes.Laundry: Self serve laundry listed on amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is located 'near restaurants, shopping and beaches' in Kelowna's South Pandosy district

hotel.name: Howard Johnson by Wyndham Victoria
hotel.desc: Howard Johnson by Wyndham Victoria is a three-storey chain hotel on Gorge Road East, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts portfolio. Located in Victoria, BC, it serves as a familiar mid-range overnight option for touring cyclists arriving on Vancouver Island. The property is within the city and provides standard hotel room accommodation as a base for exploring Victoria and connecting to regional cycling routes.

notes.Wi-Fi: Not corroborated by fetched website content which is generic Wyndham boilerplate

hotel.name: Best Western Dorchester Hotel
hotel.desc: A five-storey heritage boutique hotel situated in the heart of downtown Nanaimo, directly overlooking Nanaimo Harbour with 71 non-smoking rooms and suites. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Departure Bay and Duke Point BC Ferries terminals and the downtown waterfront. The hotel offers complimentary parking and free guest laundry, making it a practical overnight stop on a multi-day coastal tour.

detail.address: 70 Church Street, Nanaimo, British Columbia V9R 5H4

notes.Laundry: Website states 'free guest laundry machines' as part of the hotel amenities package
notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Restaurants: Gourmet food blocks away' as a hotel amenity highlight for guests

hotel.name: Coast Coal Harbour Hotel by APA
hotel.desc: Coast Coal Harbour Vancouver Hotel by APA is a modern, full-service hotel on West Hastings Street in Vancouver's Coal Harbour waterfront district, recently renovated with updated rooms. It sits within easy walking distance of Canada Place, Stanley Park, and Gastown, making it a practical base for urban cycling exploration. On-site amenities include an all-day restaurant (Prestons Restaurant + Lounge), a heated outdoor pool and whirlpool open year-round, an exercise gym, and an on-site spa.

detail.address: 1180 West Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 4R5

notes.Nearby evening food: Prestons Restaurant + Lounge is an on-site all-day restaurant offering dinner service alongside Happy Hour cocktails
notes.Luggage storage: Website states: 'Luggage storage makes it more convenient to explore before check-in at 4pm or after check-out at 12pm.'

hotel.name: Econo Lodge Vernon
hotel.desc: Econo Lodge is a budget motel chain offering basic roadside accommodation in Vernon. This location provides WiFi internet access to guests. Cyclist-specific amenities such as bike storage and laundry could not be verified due to website access restrictions.

hotel.name: Alderwood Farm
hotel.desc: Alderwood Farm is a heritage hobby farm on Bowen Island offering accommodation in farmhouse suites and a private garden cottage, alongside a specialty food shop and a full slate of wellness services including Gyrotonic training, massage, yoga, and breathwork. Founded on a philosophy of food-as-medicine and daily immersion in nature, the farm is home to donkeys, emus, chickens, and resident wildlife on a peaceful rural property. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from West Vancouver, making this a surprisingly accessible island escape for cyclists touring the southern BC coast.

detail.address: 1351 Adams Rd, Bowen Island, V0N 1G2 B.C. CANADA

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'Close enough to the cove to enjoy the many great eateries.'

hotel.name: Dolphin Motel
hotel.desc: Dolphin Motel is a simple, independently run motel nestled at the edge of old-growth forest in Tofino, a short walk from Chesterman Beach. It has operated for over 28 years and offers kitchenette suites and sleeping units with room-front parking. The motel sits directly beside Tofino Bike shop, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists Wildside Grill and Tacofino as immediately adjacent neighbours
notes.Nearby grocery: Website names 'Beaches Grocery' as next door to the motel

hotel.name: Salt Spring Inn
hotel.desc: Salt Spring Inn is a hotel and restaurant located in Ganges, the main village on Salt Spring Island, BC—a popular destination on the Southern Gulf Islands cycling circuit. The inn combines guestrooms with a full-service restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner, making it a convenient base for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries. Its central Ganges location puts it within reach of island trails, shops, and the Saturday farmers market.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant serves dinner; menu

hotel.name: Edgewater Inn
hotel.desc: A hotel located on Beach Avenue in Peachland, BC. The inn serves the accommodation needs of travelers visiting the Okanagan region.

hotel.name: La Quinta Inn Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: La Quinta Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport is a five-story chain hotel in Richmond, BC, situated near Vancouver International Airport and the Alderbridge Way corridor. For touring cyclists arriving or departing by air, it offers a familiar mid-scale option in a commercially dense area with good road access. The hotel is part of the Wyndham Rewards program and operates under the La Quinta by Wyndham brand.

hotel.name: Columbia Hotel
hotel.desc: Historic hotel established in 1900 on Columbia Street in downtown Vancouver. Long-standing accommodation option in the city center, though specific cyclist amenities could not be verified due to website access limitations.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Pitt Meadows Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Pitt Meadows Inn & Suites is a full-service chain hotel on Lougheed Highway in Pitt Meadows, offering a range of room types from standard kings to suites with kitchenettes and mini-fridges. The hotel features an outdoor pool and complimentary breakfast, making it a comfortable overnight base in the lower Fraser Valley. It sits along a major highway corridor convenient to the Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge cycling routes.

detail.address: 19267 Lougheed Highway, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2J5

hotel.name: Harrison Hot Springs Resort
hotel.desc: Harrison Hot Springs Resort is a landmark full-service resort on the shores of Harrison Lake, anchored by five natural mineral hot springs pools that rank among the most concentrated in North America. The property includes a wellness spa, multiple restaurants, and the historic Copper Room supper club with nightly live entertainment. It sits at the edge of the Fraser Valley foothills, making it a potential base for road and gravel cycling into the surrounding mountains and lakeside routes.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site dinner venues: The Copper Room (dinner with nightly live entertainment, reservations required), Islands Patio & Lounge (casual menu, cocktails), and Gardenia (sushi, cocktails, wine)

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Nanaimo
hotel.desc: Travelodge by Wyndham Nanaimo is a branded chain hotel located on Terminal Avenue North in Nanaimo, BC, part of the Wyndham Rewards loyalty network. Situated near the Nanaimo ferry terminal area, it is conveniently positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries. As a Travelodge franchise property, it offers standard budget-to-mid-range accommodation in an urban setting.

hotel.name: Sonder at Revival
hotel.desc: Sonder at Revival is a design-forward, app-driven hotel in Vancouver's West End offering keyless entry and a digital concierge model in place of traditional front-desk staffing. The property sits two blocks from English Bay and delivers easy access to Stanley Park, Denman Street dining, and the city's well-developed bike lane network. It is part of the global Sonder brand, which manages approximately 9,000 units across 40+ cities and targets travellers who want stylish, self-sufficient stays.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website highlights 'global cuisine along Denman Street' including specific restaurant Kingyo as an example
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'convenient access to a mall with a grocery store and other essentials.'
notes.Luggage storage: Listed explicitly as a top building amenity: 'Luggage Storage.'

hotel.name: Best Western
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Kamloops Hotel is an award-winning, eco-friendly property situated on Tk'emlúps te Secwépemc territory in Kamloops, explicitly catering to cyclists with dedicated bike-friendly rooms and on-site bike storage facilities. The hotel sits within walking distance of restaurants, pubs, and groceries, and is a short ride from Kamloops' extensive mountain biking trail networks. Amenities include a heated indoor saltwater pool, complimentary breakfast, and two EV charging stations.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is 'easy walking distance to restaurants, pubs, groceries, and shopping.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states the hotel is 'easy walking distance to restaurants, pubs, groceries, and shopping.'
notes.Bikes in rooms: Website (Rooms page) states bikes can be stored 'in your room'; dedicated ground-floor 'Bike Friendly 2 Queen Beds' room type with laminate flooring listed for easy bike access

hotel.name: Bowmont Motel
hotel.desc: Bowmont Motel is a family-oriented motel in Penticton situated steps from Okanagan Lake and directly across from Loco Landing Amusement Park, in the heart of BC wine country. The property features an outdoor pool (described as Penticton's largest motel pool), a hot tub, a covered BBQ kitchen area, and a large grassy courtyard with picnic tables. Room types range from studio queens to multi-bedroom family suites, many with full kitchens.

notes.Laundry: On-site guest laundry confirmed in FAQ ('we have on site guest laundry') and listed as 'Laundry Facilities' on the main amenities section and About Us page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the motel is 'only a short walk from shops and restaurants' and 'within walking distance of restaurants.'

hotel.name: Okanagan Lakefront Resort
hotel.desc: A fully renovated lakefront motel sitting directly on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Penticton, offering suites and rooms ranging from studio configurations to two-bedroom kitchen suites. The property features an observation deck overlooking the lake, outdoor fire pits, and a garden area, with a sandy beach just steps away. It sits near the trailhead region for the famous Kettle Valley Rail Trail, making it a convenient base for cycle tourists exploring the South Okanagan.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website about-us page lists immediate neighbours: Lickity Splitz Ice Cream Shop, Elma's Tapas Bar, and Salty's Beach House, all described as steps from the property

hotel.name: Tantalus Resort Lodge
hotel.desc: Established in 1980, Tantalus Lodge is one of Whistler's original hotels, offering spacious suite-style accommodations tucked into a quiet forest setting just a 5-minute walk from Whistler Village. All suites include full kitchens, wood-burning fireplaces, and private balconies, with shared outdoor hot tubs, a heated pool, and a barrel sauna on the property. Touring cyclists will find it a self-contained base with kitchen facilities for preparing their own food and easy access to the full range of village amenities.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states lodge is 'just a 5 minute walk from endless dining and shopping options in Whistler Village'
notes.Luggage storage: Website states 'For hotel guests, luggage storage is available at no additional fee'

hotel.name: Northwinds Hotel Revelstoke
hotel.desc: Northwinds Hotel Revelstoke is a modern two-storey mountain hotel operated by Basecamp Resorts, located minutes from downtown Revelstoke and the surrounding trail network. Part of a growing collection of Canadian mountain retreats, it offers rooms ranging from standard king rooms to multi-bed apartments sleeping up to eight guests, with locally sourced bath products and comfortable linens. Its location makes it a practical launching point for cyclists exploring the trails, shops, and scenery of one of BC's most celebrated mountain towns.

hotel.name: Hyatt Regency Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Hyatt Regency Vancouver is a large full-service luxury hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, steps from Burrard SkyTrain Station and a short ride from the Stanley Park seawall. As a flagship Regency-brand property, it offers the amenity depth typical of major urban convention hotels. Touring cyclists finishing or starting a BC coastal route will find it well-positioned for access to the city's extensive waterfront cycling network.

hotel.name: Carey Centre
hotel.desc: Carey Centre is a 5-level accommodation facility in Vancouver operated by an educational institution. It serves as lodging for students, visiting scholars, or institutional guests. Touring cyclists should contact the facility directly to confirm bike storage and cycle-specific amenities.

hotel.name: Hyatt Vancouver Downtown Alberni
hotel.desc: A 62-storey luxury hotel in downtown Vancouver's West End, formerly operating as the Shangri-La Vancouver before rebranding under Hyatt. The tower is one of Vancouver's tallest buildings, placing guests steps from the Coal Harbour seawall and Stanley Park cycling routes. Touring cyclists arriving downtown will find this a high-end base with immediate access to the city's primary waterfront bike corridor.

hotel.name: Powderhorn
hotel.desc: Powderhorn is a 3-star apartment-style accommodation located 200 metres from the slopes of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler. The property features a common area rooftop hot tub with mountain views, and larger units include vaulted ceilings and a whirlpool tub in the master bath. Parking and lift access via shuttle or on foot are available, making it convenient for active visitors to the resort.

hotel.name: Armstrong Inn
hotel.desc: Armstrong Inn is a motel in Vernon offering overnight accommodation to visitors. Touring cyclists can use it as a lodging option during their journeys.

hotel.name: The Coast Abbotsford Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: A boutique-style hotel in Abbotsford, BC, part of the Coast Hotels chain, situated near Highway 1 with a short walk to restaurants, bars, and nightlife. Recently refreshed rooms include free Wi-Fi, mini fridges, and complimentary continental breakfast for all guests. The hotel also features an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre, providing a comfortable rest stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Deluxe free continental breakfast included daily for all guests, available in a dedicated breakfast room
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states hotel is 'just a short walk from some of the city's best restaurants, bars and nightlife.'

hotel.name: Easter Seals House
hotel.desc: Easter Seals House is a 49-suite hotel-style facility on Oak Street in Vancouver run by Easter Seals BC/Yukon, located just blocks from major hospitals and treatment centres. It primarily serves adults and families traveling to Vancouver for medical appointments, as well as caregivers seeking respite, in a fully wheelchair-accessible and supportive environment. Suites include kitchenettes, and the building offers underground parking and on-site laundry in a neighbourhood with restaurants and supermarkets within walking distance.

notes.Laundry: Central laundry room and on-site laundry machines explicitly listed in amenities section
notes.Nearby evening food: Respite Program page states 'Delicious restaurants... are within walking distance.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Respite Program page states 'supermarkets... are within walking distance.'

hotel.name: Marriott Pinnacle Downtown
hotel.desc: Marriott Pinnacle Downtown is a full-service hotel in Vancouver's downtown core, offering free WiFi and wheelchair accessibility. As a major international chain hotel, it provides standard accommodation services for traveling cyclists. Visitors should contact the hotel directly to discuss secure bike storage and handling of touring equipment.

hotel.name: Le Soleil Hotel and Suites
hotel.desc: Executive Hotel Le Soleil is a boutique luxury property in downtown Vancouver that opened in 1999 and has held AAA Diamond recognition while ranking among Canada's top 25 most luxurious hotels. All 113 suites are styled with 18th-century Parisian decor paired with modern amenities, and the on-site Alouette Bistro offers French-inspired dining. Its central Hornby Street location places arriving cyclists steps from the city's waterfront, transit, and surrounding neighbourhoods.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel
hotel.desc: Sandman Hotel Vernon is a mid-size chain hotel offering standard and kitchenette rooms with an indoor pool and fitness centre. An on-site Denny's restaurant provides convenient dining, and the hotel has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions for sustainability practices measured against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Pet-friendly rooms and free overnight parking are available, making it a practical overnight stop on a touring route through the Okanagan.

notes.Nearby evening food: Denny's Restaurant is on-site, listed under both the amenities page and individual room descriptions
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed under Room Features on the Standard Room, 1 King Bed subpage

hotel.name: Howard Johnson
hotel.desc: Howard Johnson by Wyndham is a national chain hotel situated along Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, a key hub for cyclists traveling the Alaska Highway corridor. The two-storey property offers standard hotel accommodations under the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program. For touring cyclists passing through northeastern BC, it represents a reliable overnight stop in an otherwise remote stretch of highway.

detail.address: 8540 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 5L6

hotel.name: Pathfinder Motel
hotel.desc: A motel on Lougheed Highway in Chilliwack. Provides wireless internet access to guests. Detailed information about cycling-specific facilities is not available.

hotel.name: Cloudside Hotel
hotel.desc: Cloudside is a top-rated independent boutique hotel sitting in the heart of Nelson's historic downtown, consistently ranked #1 on TripAdvisor, Expedia, and Google. Each individually designed room or suite features private bathrooms, fridges, air conditioning, and high-speed Wi-Fi, with private off-street parking at the rear of the property. The location is walkable to Nelson's shops, dining, and cafes, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the West Kootenays.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'all the shops, dining and cafes are right on our doorstep' in reference to the downtown Nelson location

hotel.name: The Oceanfront Hotel
hotel.desc: The Oceanfront Hotel is the only hotel on Malcolm Island, located seconds from the Sointula ferry terminal and family-owned since 1978. The colorful, sprawling waterfront building offers 15 rooms—most with ocean-view decks, full kitchens or kitchenettes, and gas fireplaces—plus a newly renovated beachfront suite. The island is renowned for orca watching, hiking, and a free community bike-lending program, making it a distinctive base for cyclists exploring BC's remote north island.

notes.Laundry: Website states rooms 'feature cable TV's, WIFI and free laundry'; Beach Suite also has its own washer & dryer
notes.Nearby evening food: About Our Island page lists 'bakeries, deli's, cafes and burger bars' as present in Sointula
notes.Nearby grocery: About Our Island page references the island's co-op general store, described as the oldest cooperative store in BC (est. 1909)

hotel.name: Eagan Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Eagan Lake Resort is a small, family-oriented wilderness fishing resort on the west end of Eagan Lake near Bridge Lake, offering five log cabins and seven campsites on six acres of lakefront property. The resort is noted for Kokanee and rainbow trout fishing, with boat and motor rentals, marine gas, and fishing licenses available on-site, plus access to numerous surrounding lakes. Under new management since September 2025, the property also lists hiking and mountain biking among its recreational activities, making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists exploring the South Cariboo.

detail.address: 8648 Eagan Lake Rd, Bridge Lake, V0K 1E0

notes.Laundry: About page states: 'A Laundromat, shower, and toilets are located centrally in the resort.'
notes.Nearby evening food: About page states: 'There is a grocery store and restaurants close by.'
notes.Nearby grocery: About page states: 'There is a grocery store and restaurants close by.'
notes.Wi-Fi: Front page states 'Stay connected with available WIFI for Cabins rentals'; cabins page notes 'WIFI is available for a nominal fee.'

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Castlegar BC
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Castlegar BC is a budget motel chain property situated in Castlegar, a small city at the confluence of the Columbia and Kootenay rivers in the BC interior. It sits along 18th Street, a main commercial corridor that gives touring cyclists straightforward access to services. As a branded Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards program, which may appeal to cyclists doing multi-night tours across the region.

hotel.name: Hotel Belmont Vancouver
hotel.desc: Hotel Belmont Vancouver is a newly renovated boutique-style hotel in the MGallery Collection by Accor, positioned at the centre of Vancouver's Entertainment District on Nelson Street. The property offers a range of room types from classic doubles through to a top-floor two-storey Belmont Suite, and leans into the neighbourhood's energy with an on-site restaurant and bar and nightclub. Its central downtown location puts guests within easy reach of BC Place Stadium, Granville Island, Stanley Park, and the Vancouver Convention Centre.

notes.Laundry: Valet cleaning service listed as a standard amenity on the rooms+rates page
notes.Nearby evening food: About page states 'a diverse selection of restaurants and lounges surrounding the hotel within this enlivened neighborhood.'
notes.Device charging: In-room wireless mobile device charging listed as a standard amenity on the rooms+rates page
notes.Luggage storage: Luggage assistance listed as a standard amenity on the rooms+rates page

hotel.name: Ramada Kamloops
hotel.desc: Ramada Kamloops is a mid-range hotel chain property on Columbia Street West offering standard accommodation to travelers. A reliable option for touring cyclists seeking lodging in Kamloops.

hotel.name: West Coast Suites
hotel.desc: West Coast Suites is UBC's premium on-campus hotel offering studio and one-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, situated on the forested UBC Vancouver peninsula about 20-25 minutes from downtown. Operated year-round by UBC Student Housing, the property is heated by biomass generation and hydro electricity, reflecting UBC's sustainability focus. Guests have access to laundry facilities on-site and are steps from the campus's beaches, gardens, and biodiversity museum.

detail.address: 5961 Student Union Boulevard, Vancouver, BC V6T 2C9

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Laundry facilities available' under West Coast Suites features

hotel.name: Versante Hotel
hotel.desc: Versante Hotel is Richmond BC's only independent luxury boutique hotel, a 100-room, 15-storey property minutes from Vancouver International Airport that has earned rankings among Canada's top luxury hotels by Condé Nast, Tripadvisor, and U.S. News & World Report. The hotel features bold, art-forward design with bespoke commissioned pieces in the lobby, a rooftop pool, 24-hour fitness room, and complimentary airport shuttle van. Attached restaurant Bruno and on-site dining make it a distinctive overnight option for cyclists passing through the Richmond/YVR corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: Bruno restaurant attached to the hotel; multiple guest reviews reference on-site dining

hotel.name: Ruby Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Ruby Lake Resort is an Italian family-owned nature retreat set on an 88-acre bird sanctuary and natural reserve on the Sunshine Coast, operating since 1993. Guests choose from lagoon-view cottages, rainforest glamping tents, or rustic tiny wood cabins beside one of BC's warmest lakes, surrounded by forest, wetlands, and abundant wildlife. The on-site La Trattoria Italiana restaurant serves authentic north-Italian cuisine prepared with locally sourced, farm-to-table West Coast ingredients.

detail.address: 15426 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Madeira Park BC V0N2H1

notes.Nearby evening food: La Trattoria Italiana is the on-site Italian restaurant serving authentic north-Italian cuisine with West Coast ingredients
notes.Device charging: Glamping tents described as equipped with 'comfortable beds, power, and lighting', indicating electrical access in accommodation units

hotel.name: Accent Inns Victoria
hotel.desc: Accent Inns Victoria is a BC-owned family hotel that explicitly markets itself as bike-friendly, offering free bike rentals to all guests as part of its standard amenity package. The hotel sits near Mile 0 of the Trans-Canada Highway, making it a symbolically significant stop for touring cyclists completing or beginning long-distance routes. It is Rainbow Registered, strongly pet-friendly, and features an on-site restaurant for evening meals.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on-site, plus same-day valet dry-cleaning service (Monday–Saturday)
notes.Nearby evening food: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is an on-site restaurant with burgers, gluten-free and vegetarian options, Victoria craft beers, and cocktails
notes.Bikes in rooms: Website explicitly invites guests to bring bikes to their rooms as part of the Bike Love program; guests request a 'bike-friendly room' at booking
notes.Basic tools: Website lists 'shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls' plus rags for cleaning
notes.Bike wash / hose: Website confirms 'bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' available at every Accent Inns location

hotel.name: Element Vancouver Metrotown
hotel.desc: Element is a Marriott-owned extended-stay hotel brand featuring modern, spacious rooms. This Burnaby location offers 169 rooms in the Metro Vancouver area. As a major chain property with full services, it provides reliable accommodation for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Reynolds Resort
hotel.desc: Reynolds Resort is a lakeside retreat on Canim Lake in BC's Cariboo region, offering seven cabins with kitchenettes, lake-view sundecks, and private fire pits, as well as full-service RV sites with 30-amp electrical, water, and sewer hookups. The resort sits outside cell coverage range, surrounded by mountains and wildlife, with on-site access to fishing, kayaking, paddle boarding, and a marina. It serves as a scenic basecamp for exploring nearby Canim and Mahood Falls and extensive ATV trails.

detail.address: 3789 Canim-Hendrix Lake Road, Canim Lake, V0K 1J0

notes.Wi-Fi: Website instructs guests to enable wi-fi calling before arriving; RV sites page notes 'some can enjoy wifi from your very own site', confirming resort-wide Wi-Fi network

hotel.name: Tofino Motel Harborview
hotel.desc: Tofino Motel Harborview is a small, water-view motel in Tofino managed under Island Village Properties, which also offers waterfront condos, cabins, and apartments for short or long-term stays. It sits within walking distance of seafood restaurants, cafes, and boat tour operators in one of Vancouver Island's most celebrated coastal destinations. Cyclists exploring the area have ready access to surfing, hiking, and biking on the beaches of Tofino.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'conveniently located with a quick walk to a wide range of world-class seafood restaurants and cafes'

hotel.name: Nectar Yoga Retreat
hotel.desc: Nectar Yoga Retreat is a wellness and yoga retreat centre set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island, reached by a 20-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Founded around 2014, it offers overnight cottage stays, hosted yoga and meditation retreats, and group or corporate rentals in a nature-immersed setting. In 2025 the owners added Mist Thermal Sanctuary next door, featuring private sauna and cold plunge experiences in the forest.

detail.address: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

hotel.name: Ten-ee-ah Lodge
hotel.desc: Ten-ee-ah Lodge is a remote wilderness resort on Spout Lake in the Cariboo region of BC, founded in 1942 as a hunting base camp and now offering log cabin accommodations, camping, and a European-inspired restaurant with West Coast cuisine and local craft beer. The only property on Spout Lake and situated 1,077 metres above sea level, it is accessed via 21 km of maintained gravel road and caters to an international clientele, particularly from Europe. Touring cyclists willing to make the remote approach will find a full-service destination with on-site dining, canoeing, kayaking, and hiking.

detail.address: Spout Lake Road, Lac La Hache, V0K 1T0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and lounge serving European-inspired West Coast cuisine with 3-course dinners on a patio overlooking Spout Lake; full bar with Okanagan wines, Canadian whiskeys, and local craft beer on tap

hotel.name: Ramada Hotel Downtown
hotel.desc: The Ramada Plaza Prince George bills itself as the city's largest hotel, occupying a prominent spot on historic George Street in the heart of downtown Prince George. Guests can choose from renovated Premiere Guest Rooms to Jacuzzi Suites and Presidential Suites, with an indoor pool, whirlpool, fitness centre, business centre, and an onsite Starbucks. Its central downtown location places touring cyclists within easy walking distance of the regional conference centre, government offices, and a noted local restaurant scene.

detail.address: 444 George Street, Prince George, BC V2L 1R6

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'explore our neighborhood's thriving local restaurant scene, including our own Cornerstone Kitchen & Lounge (currently closed for renovations).'
notes.Device charging: Premiere Guest Rooms feature an in-room safe with an internal outlet capable of charging devices up to a 17" laptop

hotel.name: The Quality Inn
hotel.desc: A Quality Inn motel in Nanaimo, part of the Choice Hotels chain. Offers standard motor lodge accommodation for touring cyclists passing through the city.

hotel.name: Lost Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Lost Lake Lodge is a suite-style condo-hotel tucked into Whistler's Benchlands neighbourhood, backing onto the Chateau Whistler Golf Course and bordered by Lost Lake Park — making it an appealing base for cyclists exploring the area's trail networks. The property offers fully equipped 1- and 2-bedroom suites with full kitchens, a year-round outdoor heated pool, fitness room, and game room. Guests can reach the ski gondolas and village via a free Upper Village Shuttle, and a 'Bike Rentals' link on the site suggests awareness of cycling as a core guest activity.

detail.address: 4660 Blackcomb Way, Whistler, British Columbia V0N 1B4

notes.Laundry: Website amenities list explicitly includes 'Washer / Dryer' in each suite

hotel.name: Mary's Motel
hotel.desc: Mary's Motel is a family-run motel situated in the heart of downtown Golden, surrounded by three mountain ranges in the Canadian Rockies. It offers several room types — from basic Queen Suites to a Honeymoon Suite with a jacuzzi — along with an indoor pool and sauna. The motel is within walking distance of Golden's shops, bars, and restaurants, and 12 km from Kicking Horse Mountain Resort.

detail.address: 603 8th Ave N, Golden, British Columbia, V0A 1H0

notes.Nearby evening food: About page states guests are 'within walking distance of the local shops, bars and restaurants' in Golden's downtown

hotel.name: Creston Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: Creston Hotel & Suites is a hotel in Creston, BC with wireless internet access. Located at 1418 Canyon Street, it provides accommodation for travelers visiting the area.

hotel.name: The Blaylock Mansion
hotel.desc: The Blaylock Mansion is a 4.5-star historic estate set on 3 acres above Kootenay Lake near Nelson, BC, built around the legacy of mining magnate Selwyn Blaylock and featuring manicured tiered gardens, an outdoor pool, a private tennis court, and one of the largest arboretums in southern BC. It operates as a body-and-mind retreat and wedding venue with gourmet breakfast prepared each morning for guests. Touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays would find a genuinely scenic and distinctive stay within easy reach of Nelson's services.

hotel.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Suites Victoria
hotel.desc: The DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Suites Victoria is a 17-storey full-service hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria at 777 Douglas Street. As part of Hilton's DoubleTree brand, it occupies a prominent city-centre location convenient to the Inner Harbour and the city's restaurant and shopping districts. Touring cyclists arriving in Victoria would find this a well-situated base from which to explore the city or depart on regional routes.

hotel.name: Pluvio Restaurant + Rooms
hotel.desc: Pluvio is an acclaimed boutique restaurant-and-rooms property in the heart of Ucluelet village, recognized as Canada's Best Destination Restaurant and one of Canada's 100 Best Restaurants. The hotel comprises just four spacious rooms (400+ sq ft each), two of which are ground-floor garden-view suites accessible via a ramp, set behind the restaurant beside a working kitchen garden. Guests are invited to dine, spend the night, and wake to a complimentary breakfast, with the Wild Pacific Trail and Pacific Rim National Park Reserve a short ride away.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant (Pluvio) serves dinner nightly; restaurant is part of the same property

hotel.name: Royal Hotel
hotel.desc: A hotel located in Fernie, BC on 1st Avenue. Current operational status and amenities cannot be verified due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn
hotel.desc: A Holiday Inn branded hotel in Surrey offering standard chain hospitality. Suitable as a waypoint for touring cyclists looking for reliable accommodations in the area.

hotel.name: Hearthstone Lodge
hotel.desc: Hearthstone Lodge is an intimate suite-style property situated in the heart of Whistler Village, a three-minute walk from the base of both Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains and adjacent to the Whistler Conference Centre. The location puts cyclists within easy reach of the world-class Whistler Bike Park, the paved Valley Trail network, and the broader Sea to Sky trail system. Grocery and liquor stores occupy the ground floor of the same building.

notes.Laundry: Onsite laundry explicitly listed as a property service in the Tourism Whistler DMO listing
notes.Nearby grocery: Property description states 'Liquor and grocery stores downstairs'

hotel.name: Accent Inns
hotel.desc: Accent Inns Kamloops is a BC-owned, family-operated hotel just off Highway 1, positioning it as a natural stop for cyclists travelling between Vancouver and the Rockies. The property markets itself as the bike-friendliest hotel chain in BC through its 'Bike Love' program, which includes bikes-in-rooms, a wash and tuning station, a 37-piece tool kit, and free bike rentals. It is also Rainbow Registered and pet-friendly, making it a notably inclusive stop for touring cyclists travelling with companions.

notes.Laundry: Laundry facilities listed as a property amenity on the main Kamloops page; laundry room also referenced on the bike-friendly page ('a laundry room in case it's not just your bike that needs washing')
notes.Nearby evening food: 'Restaurant onsite' listed as an amenity icon on the main Kamloops location page
notes.Bikes in rooms: Bike-friendly page explicitly states 'Love your bike? Bring it to your room' and that guests can request a bike-friendly room at reservation
notes.Basic tools: Bike-friendly page lists a 'shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls' plus rags for cleaning
notes.Bike wash / hose: 'Bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' listed on the bike-friendly page

hotel.name: Victoria Regent Waterfront Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Victoria Regent Waterfront Hotel & Suites is an award-winning luxury property set directly on Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering a range of standard king rooms and condo-style one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens and private balconies. Its prime downtown location places touring cyclists within easy reach of Victoria's Inner Harbour pathways and the city's shops, museums, and restaurants. The hotel includes a free underground parking garage as a standard guest amenity.

hotel.name: SureStay by Best Western Richmond Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: SureStay by Best Western Richmond Vancouver Airport is a mid-scale chain hotel on Westminster Highway in Richmond, positioned for quick access to Vancouver International Airport. The property includes complimentary breakfast and high-speed internet, and some rooms offer kitchen or kitchenette facilities, making it a practical base for multi-night stays. Richmond's dense restaurant corridor and proximity to the Fraser River delta make it a useful overnight stop for cyclists traveling the lower mainland.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website amenity badges explicitly list 'free-breakfast' for this property

hotel.name: Rainbow Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Rainbow Motor Inn is a roadside motel in Sardis on Yale Road serving travelers in the Chilliwack area. As a traditional motel accommodation, it provides overnight lodging to passing visitors. Specific amenities and cyclist-friendly services could not be verified due to website access failure.

hotel.name: Panorama Mountain Village
hotel.desc: Panorama Mountain Resort is a self-contained alpine village nestled in the BC Kootenay Rockies, offering ski-in/ski-out accommodation alongside a full range of summer mountain biking activities. The compact village puts restaurants, pubs, cafés, equipment rentals and hot pools steps from guest rooms, making it a rare all-in-one destination in a remote mountain setting. It ranks in the top 10 in North America by vertical drop and draws both winter and summer adventure travellers.

notes.Nearby evening food: Village has 'a great variety of restaurants, retail therapy, pubs, and cafés' on-site per the About page

hotel.name: The Hue Hotel, Ascend Hotel Collection
hotel.desc: The Hue Hotel is an Ascend Collection hotel in Kamloops. As a Choice Hotels property, it offers overnight accommodation in the area. The hotel has Wi-Fi internet access.

hotel.name: Savoy Hotel
hotel.desc: The Savoy Hotel is a century-old, beautifully restored three-storey boutique hotel on Baker Street in the heart of downtown Nelson, BC, offering twelve rooms with luxury finishes including heated bathroom floors and Nespresso makers. Exclusive guest amenities include a rooftop hot tub with views over Kootenay Lake, a gas fire pit patio, and a locally crafted cedar sauna bookable by the hour. The hotel is steps from Nelson's restaurants, breweries, and trailheads, making it a comfortable base for cycling the Kootenays.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the hotel is 'steps away from the best restaurants, breweries' in downtown Nelson

hotel.name: Abercorn Hotel, Trademark Collection by Wyndham
hotel.desc: The Abercorn Hotel is a full-service hotel in Richmond, BC, operating under Wyndham's Trademark Collection brand, which groups independently spirited hotels with distinct local character. Located on Bridgeport Road near Richmond's commercial core and close to YVR airport, it is a practical base for cyclists exploring the Fraser delta and the regional trail network. As a Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.

hotel.name: Days Inn Kelowna
hotel.desc: Days Inn Kelowna is a mid-scale chain hotel situated on Highway 97 North on the north end of Kelowna, a key cycling corridor in the Okanagan. The property features a seasonal outdoor heated pool, outdoor whirlpool, fitness facility, and a complimentary breakfast café. Wheelchair-accessible and pet-friendly rooms are available, and the outdoor courtyard offers a relaxed setting after a long day on the road.

notes.Laundry: Guest Coin Laundry Facilities listed on the amenities page
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website lists 'Complimentary Daybreak Café Breakfast' as an included amenity; no detail on earliest serving time

hotel.name: Coast Hillcrest
hotel.desc: Coast Hillcrest Hotel is a full-service Coast Hotels chain property in Revelstoke, BC, positioned at the base of the Selkirk and Monashee Mountains within easy reach of Revelstoke Mountain Resort. The hotel features on-site dining at the Begbie Room and Mountain View Terrace, a lounge with fireplace, an indoor and outdoor hot tub, steam room, dry sauna, fitness centre, and an on-site spa. It offers a free seasonal shuttle to the ski hill and is pet-friendly, making it a comfortable recovery base after long days in the mountains.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining at Begbie Room and Mountain View Terrace; evening drinks at Guides Lounge

hotel.name: Riverside Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned motel in Penticton, BC, positioned near the city's wine, music, and festival scene in the Okanagan. As one of the larger motels in Penticton, it offers room types ranging from cozy studios to two-bedroom family suites, most with kitchenette or full kitchen facilities. The property features a heated outdoor saltwater pool and communal courtyard, making it a comfortable base for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'Onsite laundry... available for our guests.'

hotel.name: Fairmont Chateau Whistler
hotel.desc: The Fairmont Chateau Whistler is a flagship luxury mountain resort hotel positioned at the base of Whistler-Blackcomb in the heart of Whistler Village, making it one of the most prominent accommodation options on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The property includes multiple restaurants, bars, a spa, fitness facilities, pools, and golf, as well as ski access, catering to guests seeking full-service resort amenities. Touring cyclists will find themselves steps from Whistler Village's extensive trail network and services.

notes.Nearby evening food: Hotel has on-site restaurants and bars per website Dine section ('Restaurants, Bars, Breakfast'); Whistler Village location also provides many additional options
notes.Wi-Fi: Expected at a luxury hotel of this tier but not explicitly confirmed in website text

hotel.name: Xenia
hotel.desc: Xenia Centre is a 38-acre nature sanctuary on Bowen Island, celebrating 30 years of land stewardship and offering unique wooden cottages and yurts nestled among old-growth trees, meadows, and protected forests. The centre operates as a retreat and event venue focused on healing, creativity, and personal transformation. Bowen Island is reached by BC Ferry from Horseshoe Bay, making Xenia a distinctive off-the-beaten-path overnight option for cyclists willing to take the short ferry crossing.

detail.address: 782 Smith Road, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

hotel.name: The Uptowner Motel
hotel.desc: The Uptowner is a newly renovated 22-room boutique motel in the heart of Creston, BC, overhauled under new ownership in 2022 with modern furnishings, a fully equipped gym (including showers), an indoor hot tub, and a cedar dry sauna — the only hotel in Creston with a sauna on site. It sits within walking distance of the Creston Community Complex and is pet-friendly, making it a comfortable base for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region's trails, orchards, vineyards, and mountain terrain.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple nearby options: Wild North microbrewery (live music), Frisky Whiskey (live music and dancing), Korean Basasak Chicken, Casey's Community House, Memories of India, Panago Pizza, and others

hotel.name: Hummingbird Oceanside Suites
hotel.desc: A waterfront vacation rental in Dorman Bay on Bowen Island, offering four private suites in a main house plus a separate modern cabin with sweeping ocean views to the north, east, and south. Guests share a wood barrel sauna, hot tub, communal fire pit, lawn games field, and a wooden staircase descending directly to the ocean. Cyclists can reach the property via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay — bikes are permitted on the ferry — followed by a 15-minute ride from Snug Cove terminal.

notes.Nearby evening food: Property is a 5-minute drive from Snug Cove, described as having restaurants and shops
notes.Nearby grocery: Property is a 5-minute drive from Snug Cove, described as having shops

hotel.name: Radisson Hotel Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: The Radisson Hotel Vancouver Airport is a full-service branded hotel on Cambie Road in Richmond, positioned within a few kilometres of Vancouver International Airport. It sits at the edge of Richmond's extensive cycling network, making it a practical staging point for cyclists beginning or ending a BC tour with a flight. As an internationally branded airport hotel, it offers a broad range of standard traveller amenities within a larger property.

hotel.name: The Grand Nanaimo Hotel
hotel.desc: The Grand Nanaimo Hotel is a boutique 70-room property set in a natural rock garden with lush foliage and fruit trees, offering six room types alongside townhouse apartments for longer stays. The hotel houses a restaurant and bar serving West Coast, European, and Asian cuisine, an acclaimed weekend afternoon tea, and hosts the annual Nanaimo Wine Festival and Nanaimo Whisky Festival with over 150 international whiskies on offer. Located near shopping malls and minutes from downtown Nanaimo, it makes a comfortable base for exploring Vancouver Island by bike.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and bar serving food and beverages; in-room dining service also available

hotel.name: The BnB on Bowen Island

For touring cyclists completing the Howe Sound circuit or island-hopping routes, Bowen Island serves as a compact overnight destination reachable via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay. No further details about the property's size, style, or facilities could be confirmed.

hotel.name: Knights Inn Kamloops
hotel.desc: Knights Inn Kamloops is an economy motel situated off the Trans-Canada Highway near Thompson Rivers University, offering straightforward, no-frills accommodation in a convenient location for travellers passing through Kamloops. The property provides free outdoor parking with large-vehicle spaces and free continental breakfast included with stays. Its proximity to Riverside Park and adventure outfitters like Adams River Rafting makes it a practical base for exploring the Thompson Valley.

hotel.name: Delta Whistler Village Suites
hotel.desc: A Delta Hotels by Marriott property located in central Whistler Village. This upscale hotel serves touring cyclists visiting the popular Whistler cycling area and offers proximity to dining and services.

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops
hotel.desc: Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-range chain hotel situated on Columbia Street in Kamloops, a major interior BC city and natural waypoint for cyclists travelling the Trans-Canada or Thompson Valley routes. Part of the global Travelodge brand under Wyndham, it offers standard hotel-style accommodations in a commercially serviced area with easy access to downtown amenities.

hotel.name: Soggy Frog Guest Suite on Bowen
hotel.desc: A self-contained guest suite located on Bowen Island, a small car-accessible island reachable by a short BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The property is listed on Airbnb as a standalone apartment-style unit in a residential house. Bowen Island is a popular day-trip and touring destination with quiet roads and scenic landscapes, making accommodation options here particularly valuable to cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

hotel.name: Econo Lodge Maple Ridge
hotel.desc: Econo Lodge is a budget motel chain property on the Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge. It provides basic overnight accommodation as part of the nationwide Choice Hotels network. Touring cyclists would find it a straightforward, budget-friendly rest stop on this major provincial route.

hotel.name: Pleasant Valley Motel
hotel.desc: Pleasant Valley Motel is a family-run, two-storey budget motel on Highway 16 (the Yellowhead Highway) in Houston, BC, operating since 1993. Rooms are fully renovated and include kitchenettes, and the property has an on-site casual restaurant serving hot meals — a genuine convenience for cyclists arriving after a long day on the road. The motel is pet-friendly on request and offers free parking, making it a practical base for touring the Bulkley Valley corridor.

hotel.name: City Centre Motel
hotel.desc: City Centre Motel is a motel accommodation in Creston, BC, potentially convenient for touring cyclists passing through the area. However, operational status and cyclist-specific facilities cannot be confirmed due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Whiskey Landing Lodge
hotel.desc: Whiskey Landing Lodge is a hotel property in Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's west coast, situated near the Pacific Rim and accessible via Highway 4 — a popular end-point for touring cyclists completing the island's west coast routes. No current website content is available to characterize the property further.

hotel.name: North Vancouver Hotel
hotel.desc: North Vancouver Hotel is a recently renovated motel-style property situated at the base of the North Shore mountains, minutes from Grouse Mountain, the Capilano Suspension Bridge, and the Horseshoe Bay Ferry Terminal. The hotel offers a variety of room types including kitchenettes, pet-friendly rooms, and suites, with complimentary continental breakfast and free parking. Its location near major North Shore cycling corridors and ferry connections makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists moving between Vancouver Island and the mainland.

hotel.name: Flaming Motel

An on-site picnic area with BBQ facilities provides a convenient spot to prepare food at the end of a ride. The property sits within easy walking distance of Cherry Lane Mall and is well-positioned for exploring the Skaha Lake corridor and South Okanagan wine routes.

notes.Nearby evening food: Cannery Brewing 2.1 mi and Tim Hortons 2.2 mi listed as nearby attractions on aggregator site

hotel.name: Inn at Laurel Point
hotel.desc: Inn at Laurel Point is a seven-story luxury waterfront hotel on Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering 200 rooms and suites across the Erickson and Laurel wings, all with private balconies and harbour views. The hotel is home to the Aura Waterfront Restaurant + Patio, an indoor pool, and a fitness studio, and is operated by Paul's Restaurants Ltd. Its location on Montreal Street places touring cyclists at the edge of the Inner Harbour with easy access to Victoria's waterfront pathways.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Aura Waterfront Restaurant + Patio and Inn Room Dining service listed on the website

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Vernon
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Vernon is a national chain hotel located on 26 Street in Vernon, BC, in the heart of the Okanagan — a popular hub for cycling routes including the Okanagan Rail Trail. As a full-service chain property it offers the predictability and accessibility that touring cyclists value when covering long distances through the region.

hotel.name: Tide's Inn B&B

hotel.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Fairfield Inn & Suites is a Marriott-operated mid-range hotel chain with a location in Vernon. The brand is known for consistent service standards and reliable accommodations across its properties. This property represents a familiar, established option for touring cyclists seeking standard overnight lodging.

hotel.name: Twin Lakes Golf Course & RV Park
hotel.desc: Twin Lakes is a 285-acre golf resort nestled in a scenic valley surrounded by rock cliffs near Kaleden, BC, offering 76 full-hookup RV sites alongside an 18-hole golf course. The clubhouse features a concession/snack shack with local wines and micro-brewed beers and an outdoor patio overlooking the course. Touring cyclists will find hiking and biking trails, sandy beaches, and over twenty local wineries all within a 20-minute ride.

hotel.name: Nita Lake Lodge

Positioned at the intersection of forest paths and mountain bike trails, it offers suite-style rooms with gas fireplaces, an award-winning spa, and complimentary canoes and paddleboards in summer. A complimentary village shuttle connects guests to central Whistler, and four on-site dining venues make it a self-contained basecamp.

hotel.name: Hotel Zed Tofino

It promotes itself as home to the world's first bike path routed directly through the hotel lobby, making it a genuinely cycling-forward property. Situated seven minutes on foot from Chesterman Beach and ten minutes by bike from Tofino's shops and restaurants, it offers on-site dining at ROAR and a free outdoor BBQ at the Lanai.

hotel.name: Hotel Penticton, Ascend Hotel Collection

hotel.name: The Landis Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Landis Hotel & Suites is a 15-storey downtown Vancouver hotel offering suite-style accommodation on Hornby Street. hotel.name: Lord Stanley Suites On The Park
hotel.desc: Lord Stanley Suites On The Park is a boutique-style service apartment building offering furnished one- and two-bedroom suites located directly beside Stanley Park in downtown Vancouver. The property sits steps from the Coal Harbour Seawall and Stanley Park cycling trails, making it a strategically convenient base for cyclists exploring Vancouver's celebrated waterfront cycling network. hotel.name: Lightwater Cove

The property offers four ocean-view suites with private decks, spa treatments, botanical gardens, and lily ponds, positioning itself as a high-end wellness retreat. Touring cyclists would find it a serene and scenic basecamp for exploring Salt Spring Island's coastline and trails.

The hotel pitches itself as an affordable, casual alternative with a relaxed, spontaneous vibe.

hotel.name: Trickle Creek Lodge

The Kimberley Alpine Resort high-speed quad chairlift is just steps from the hotel's back door, and the property sits near the Peak to Plaza trail network popular with hikers and cyclists. Touring cyclists will find a full-service hotel experience including on-site dining, a heated outdoor pool and hot tubs, underground parking, and guest laundry.

hotel.name: Coast Parksville Hotel

The hotel is pet-friendly and participates in the Coast Hotels Refreshingly Green sustainability program.

hotel.name: The Burrard
hotel.desc: The Burrard is a locally-owned, independent boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, housed in a building that retains mid-century motor inn character while offering contemporary design and amenities. Its central Burrard Street location makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city, with numerous restaurants, attractions, and the waterfront within easy reach. The hotel markets itself as a stylish, playful alternative to chain properties, appealing to travellers who want personality alongside convenience.

hotel.name: Helm's Inn

The property includes an on-site guest laundromat and lobby computer, making longer stays more practical.

hotel.name: Lakeview Inns & Suites – Fort Nelson

hotel.name: Backeddy Resort and Marina

The property encompasses twenty varied accommodation units — from modern waterfront cabins to geodesic glamping domes and vintage A-frames — alongside a full-service marina, an oceanfront pub, and an on-site rental fleet including mountain bikes. Its location makes it a natural base for cyclists exploring the upper Sunshine Coast, with hiking, ocean kayaking, and wildlife viewing immediately accessible.

hotel.name: Rosedale Condominiums

The property markets itself as a home-base for both business and leisure travelers exploring British Columbia.

hotel.name: Ramada Hotel Creston

It sits along a major touring route connecting the Crowsnest Pass corridor with the Kootenay Lake ferry, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling east-west through the valley. As a full-service hotel it offers the standard amenities expected of the Ramada brand.

hotel.name: The George Dawson Inn
hotel.desc: The George Dawson Inn is a full-service 80-room hotel situated at Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway in Dawson Creek, a historic launching point for northern BC and Yukon travel. It offers an on-site restaurant, complimentary full hot breakfast, fitness centre access, and coin-operated laundry — solid practical amenities for a multi-day touring stop. The property is five minutes from Dawson Creek Airport and within reach of local restaurants and services.

Units combine open-concept kitchens with full hotel services—including on-site restaurants, a heated outdoor pool, and three slopeside hot tubs—all 250 steps from the Sundance and Sunburst Express Chairlifts. The property is a practical mountain base for cyclists exploring Sun Peaks resort trails and the surrounding Thompson Highlands.

hotel.name: The Listel Hotel Whistler

The hotel features a Cedar Gallery Floor showcasing Indigenous Canadian art and the legendary Bearfoot Bistro restaurant with its underground wine cellar and Grey Goose Ice Room. Touring cyclists will find secure bike storage, guest laundry, and immediate access to Whistler's world-class trail network right outside the door.

notes.Laundry: Website states: 'Our guest laundry facilities make extended stays a breeze.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Bearfoot Bistro restaurant is on-site; hotel is in Whistler Village described as 'brimming with excellent dining and lively nightlife.'

hotel.name: Best Western Northgate Inn

The property is individually owned and operated under the Best Western brand, making it a consistent, accessible base for cyclists exploring central Vancouver Island.

hotel.name: The Fairmont Empress Hotel

Operating as a full-service luxury property with dining, a spa, fitness centre, and pools, it occupies a prime downtown location at the foot of Government Street directly across from the inner harbour and BC legislature grounds. Touring cyclists arriving in Victoria will find it at the geographic and symbolic heart of the city.

The motel features a heated outdoor pool, covered picnic shelter with BBQs, and an on-site laundromat open to both guests and the public with commercial-grade machines capable of handling quilts and sleeping bags. Its central Main Street location puts touring cyclists within walking distance of groceries, dining, and the Shuswap Lake boat launch.

hotel.name: Abigail's Hotel

hotel.name: Hotel Zed Victoria
hotel.desc: Hotel Zed Victoria is a retro-themed, BC-owned boutique hotel on Douglas Street, part of a small three-property chain celebrating a '70s aesthetic and inclusive, quirky hospitality. hotel.name: Coast Hotel and Convention Centre

hotel.name: Patricia Hotel

It offers a no-frills urban base in one of the city's most storied districts.

hotel.name: Haida House at Tllaal
hotel.desc: Haida House at Tllaal is a Haida-owned Indigenous cultural tourism lodge nestled along the banks of the Tlell River on Haida Gwaii, offering 10 lodge rooms and 12 oceanside cabins across 50 acres of river and ocean frontage. The property specializes in authentic Haida cultural adventures, with access to forest trails, a fruit orchard, and beach, on one of Canada's most remote and ecologically distinct archipelagos. Reaching it requires either a ferry from Prince Rupert or a flight to Sandspit, making it a genuine end-of-the-road destination for touring cyclists on Haida Gwaii.

hotel.name: Comfort Inn Chilliwack

As a Choice Hotels franchise, it offers consistent mid-range accommodation standards familiar to travelers across North America. Without access to current website information, specific amenities available to cycling guests cannot be confirmed.

hotel.name: Quality Hotel Airport (South)
hotel.desc: Quality Hotel Airport (South) is a Choice Hotels-branded property located near Vancouver International Airport in Richmond. As a chain hotel offering standard accommodation, it provides overnight lodging for touring cyclists passing through the lower mainland.

hotel.name: Rosemead House (nee The Olde English Inn)
hotel.desc: Rosemead House is a 28-room luxury boutique hotel occupying a restored 1906 Edwardian manor in Esquimalt, formerly known as The Olde English Inn. Rooms are split between the historic Manor Collection and the more modern Grove Collection, with the latter offering elevator access. The property includes an on-site restaurant, Janevca Kitchen & Lounge, and a spa, positioning it as a high-end destination stay near Victoria.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Janevca Kitchen & Lounge serves family-style meals with local ingredients; booking available via the hotel website

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Lake Country/Winfield Area
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Lake Country/Winfield Area is a budget chain motel situated on the Okanagan Highway in the Lake Country/Winfield community north of Kelowna. Part of the global Wyndham Hotels network, it offers roadside accessibility along a popular Okanagan cycling corridor. As a franchise property, amenities can vary from the brand standard and would need direct confirmation for cyclist-specific needs.

detail.address: 9564 Highway 97 North, Lake Country, BC V4V 1T7

hotel.name: Wonowon Lodge
hotel.desc: Wonowon Lodge is a large camp-style accommodation at Mile 101 of the Alaska Highway in remote northern BC, operating primarily as a workers' lodge for the oil and gas industry with 289 suites ranging from standard rooms to full well-site configurations with private kitchens. The facility includes a fully catered dining room, recreation centre with pool table and ping pong, two fitness rooms, and laundry. For Alaska Highway touring cyclists, it represents one of the few substantial accommodation and meal options in this isolated stretch between Fort St. John and Fort Nelson.

detail.address: Mile 101 Alaska Highway, Wonowon, BC V0C 2N0

notes.Laundry: Website states 'Full laundry' and 'laundry facilities-supplies included' as part of room and board; in-building laundry facilities mentioned for all room types
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Fully catered dining described as covering 'any working shift' with 3 meals per day plus snacks always available, indicating meals are served outside standard morning hours
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site catered dining room described as covering all shifts with 3 meals per day and snacks available at all times

hotel.name: Red Lion Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A full-service hotel in Victoria's Saanich district, the Red Lion Inn & Suites holds the distinction of being the only hotel directly on the Galloping Goose Regional Trail, giving guests immediate trail access for cycling into the city or outward toward Sooke. The property features an outdoor pool, an on-site sports lounge, and an adjacent Cantonese restaurant, along with a complimentary pass to a nearby fitness facility. Major shopping, transit hubs, and multiple grocery options are within easy walking distance.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site V Lounge (sports bar) and Jade Fountain Restaurant on the property; multiple restaurants also listed in adjacent Saanich Plaza and Uptown Centre within 5–15 min walk
notes.Nearby grocery: Walmart Supercenter and Whole Foods Market both listed at Uptown Centre within 5–15 minutes walking distance

hotel.name: Casa Loma Lakeshore Resort
hotel.desc: Casa Loma Lakeshore Resort is a waterfront resort property on Okanagan Lake in West Kelowna, offering self-contained suite-style accommodations managed as vacation rentals. The property features two beaches, a seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub, tennis courts, communal BBQs, and boat docks, with Kalamoir Regional Park walking trails immediately nearby. It sits on a quiet lakeshore road just west of Kelowna, making it a scenic base for cycling the surrounding wine country and Okanagan rail trail.

detail.address: 2777 Casa Loma Road, West Kelowna, V1Z 1T6

hotel.name: Vedder River Inn
hotel.desc: Built in 2010, the Vedder River Inn is an award-winning, Canadian-owned motel nestled in the Fraser Valley near Vedder Crossing, roughly 100 km east of Vancouver. It offers a wide range of rooms and suites—from standard double rooms to full-kitchen executive suites sleeping up to seven—along with a complimentary continental breakfast each morning. The property sits steps from the Vedder River and Trans-Canada Trail, with fine dining, pubs, and franchise eateries immediately nearby.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the inn is in 'a robust area of town, complete with fine dining, pubs, popular franchised food eateries, and unique shops' described as just steps away

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham 100 Mile House
hotel.desc: The Super 8 by Wyndham in 100 Mile House is a national-brand motel located in a small hub town on the Cariboo Highway (Highway 97), a key artery for touring cyclists riding the interior of BC. As part of the Super 8 chain, it offers a predictable mid-range motel experience in a town with limited accommodation options. For cyclists doing long days on the Cariboo, it represents a reliable overnight stop in an otherwise sparsely serviced corridor.

hotel.name: Rosedale Manor
hotel.desc: Rosedale Manor is a furnished apartment complex in Duncan, BC — the 'City of Totems' on Vancouver Island — offering 1 and 2 bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens for daily or weekly stays. The property sits on landscaped grounds with indigenous West Coast plantings and is described as a short, flat walk to Duncan's town centre. A touring cyclist would find a home-like base with access to nearby cultural attractions including totem poles, wineries, the Chemainus murals, and the Crofton ferry to Salt Spring Island.

hotel.name: Billy Barker Casino Hotel
hotel.desc: The Billy Barker Casino Hotel is a downtown Quesnel landmark whose exterior is modelled after the Fraser River paddle wheelers of the 1860s gold rush, complete with a paddle-wheel facade and a statue of miner Billy Barker on top. Originally opened in 1961 as the Billy Barker Inn, it has grown into a full-service hotel with a casino (100 slot machines), restaurant, lounge, and showroom, making it an unusual and historically flavoured overnight stop in the Cariboo. The front desk is staffed around the clock, and the on-site restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and supper every day.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant/lounge serves supper daily (Sun–Thurs and Fri–Sat evenings)

hotel.name: Manning Park Lodge
hotel.desc: A hotel accommodation located in Manning Park, a provincial park in the North Cascades region of British Columbia. Serves as a base for visitors exploring the park's hiking, cycling, and outdoor recreation opportunities.

hotel.name: Executive Airport Plaza Hotel Richmond
hotel.desc: A hotel in Richmond near Vancouver International Airport, part of the Executive Hotels chain. Convenient location for cyclists passing through the greater Vancouver area.

hotel.name: Sheraton Vancouver Wall Centre Hotel
hotel.desc: A 4-star Sheraton property with 733 rooms in downtown Vancouver's Wall Centre complex on Burrard Street. As a major chain hotel, it offers corporate-standard accommodation with a central downtown location convenient to the city's attractions and services.

hotel.name: Takysie Lake Store & Resort
hotel.desc: Takysie Lake Resort is a remote, family-run lakeside retreat roughly 70 km south of Burns Lake, offering rustic cabins and RV/tent sites on a lake celebrated for its wild BC rainbow trout fishing. Under new ownership since 2024, the multigenerational family crew operates an on-site café, general store, hardware store, pay-at-pump gas station, and mechanic shop, making it a rare self-contained stop in an otherwise sparse stretch of BC interior. For touring cyclists, it provides fuelling, food, and overnight shelter in a genuinely secluded and scenic backcountry setting.

detail.address: 37530 Eakin Settlement Road, Burns Lake, V0J 1E4

notes.Nearby evening food: Takysie Cafe on-site offering home-cooked meals
notes.Nearby grocery: Takysie Market Store on-site; hardware store also stocked on-site

hotel.name: Wetherly Inn & Spa
hotel.desc: Wetherly Inn & Spa is a high-end bed and breakfast on Salt Spring Island offering rooms with soaker tubs, propane fireplaces, and garden balconies, plus a full-service spa and heated outdoor pool. A continental breakfast buffet is included with every room, and a morning wake-up tray is delivered to each guest. The property is a tranquil, upscale retreat well-suited to cyclists looking for a restorative stop on a Salt Spring Island tour.

detail.address: 169 Armand Way, Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 2B6

hotel.name: Pan Pacific Whistler Mountainside
hotel.desc: Pan Pacific Whistler Mountainside is a full-service luxury hotel located at the base of Whistler Mountain on Sundial Crescent, steps from the Whistler Blackcomb ski and bike park village. Part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group, it offers suite-style accommodation in one of BC's premier mountain resort destinations. Touring cyclists finishing or passing through the Sea-to-Sky corridor will find it centrally placed in Whistler Village.

hotel.name: Best Western Premier Prestige Oceanfront Resort
hotel.desc: A five-storey oceanfront resort framed by the waters of Sooke Harbour, offering panoramic coastal views and coastal-inspired décor in the small town of Sooke on Vancouver Island's southwestern tip. Part of the WorldHotels Luxury collection within the Best Western Premier brand, it sits along the West Coast Road — a scenic cycling corridor connecting Sooke to the Juan de Fuca Trail trailheads. Touring cyclists finishing or starting multi-day routes in the area will find a full-service hotel option at this location.

detail.address: 6929 West Coast Road, Sooke, BC V9Z 0V1

hotel.name: Westwood Motel
hotel.desc: Westwood Motel is a renovated motel situated off Highway 97 in 100 Mile House, a common overnight stop on the BC Interior touring corridor. Rooms include a refrigerator, microwave, and coffee maker, and BBQ facilities are available on site. The motel sits within a short walk of several restaurants and is close to the 100 Mile House Airstrip.

notes.Laundry: Listed under main facilities as 'Loundry Srvice' on the aggregator site front page
notes.Nearby evening food: Cask & Cleaver Brewing at 953 ft and Subway at 0.2 mi listed as nearby

hotel.name: Prestige Lakeside Resort, WorldHotels Elite
hotel.desc: A 101-room waterfront resort situated on Kootenay Lake in Nelson, within walking distance of downtown and backed by views of the Selkirk Mountains. The property features on-site dining at Port701 Marinaside and is surrounded by opportunities for kayaking, boating, and exploring the broader Kootenay region. Its central Nelson location makes it a comfortable overnight base for cyclists passing through the area.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining at Port701 Marinaside confirmed in website overview; hotel is also within walking distance of downtown Nelson

hotel.name: Sun Peaks Grand Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: Sun Peaks Grand is the only full-service hotel in Sun Peaks Resort, Canada's second-largest ski area, situated ski-in/ski-out just 250 steps from the lifts and surrounded by 84+ km of mountain bike trails. The property offers a dedicated Ski & Bike Valet with complimentary secure overnight bicycle storage off the lower lobby. Guests have access to two on-site restaurants, an outdoor heated pool, a fitness centre, and — in the Residences — fully-equipped kitchens with in-suite laundry.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry confirmed in the Residences; not explicitly mentioned for standard hotel rooms
notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site restaurants: Mantles Restaurant & Lounge and Morrisey's Public House

hotel.name: Bulkley Valley Motel
hotel.desc: The Bulkley Valley Motel is an owner-operated motel in New Hazelton on Highway 16, sitting at the junction with Highway 37 between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a natural overnight stop on the northern BC touring corridor. It claims to be the only property in New Hazelton with full-sized kitchen units, with four such rooms available alongside standard rooms, all positioned away from the highway and railway tracks for a quieter rest. The surrounding block includes a grocery store next door, a laundromat across the street, and five restaurants within 200 metres.

detail.address: 4444 Highway 16, Box 6, New Hazelton, BC V0J 2J0

notes.Laundry: Laundromat is across the street (stated on /rooms page under 'Amenities Close By')
notes.Nearby evening food: 5 restaurants within 200 metres of the motel (per /rooms page)
notes.Nearby grocery: Grocery store is next door (per /rooms page and front page)

hotel.name: The Shoreline Tofino
hotel.desc: The Shoreline Tofino is a boutique oceanfront hotel built in the late 1960s, renovated and rebranded in 2017 into a collection of A-frame cabins and suites perched among old-growth cedars at the water's edge. The property has a relaxed surf-shack aesthetic and gives all guests access to a cedar barrel sauna, outdoor shower, and surf shed. It sits within a 10–15 minute walk of Tofino's town centre, restaurants, and a seaplane terminal, with surf beaches a short drive away.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists Wolf in the Fog, Shelter, and Shed as a 10-minute walk; town centre also 10 minutes on foot

hotel.name: Pinnacle Lodge
hotel.desc: Pinnacle Lodge is a Westgate Resorts property in the mountain resort village of Sun Peaks, BC, positioned as a full-service accommodation base for exploring the surrounding ski and outdoor recreation area. Operated by Vacation Internationale under the Westgate brand, it offers hotel-style stays with attentive service in a purpose-built resort community. Sun Peaks is one of BC's larger ski resorts and sees significant summer trail activity, making this lodge a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the Thompson Okanagan highlands.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Vancouver City Centre
hotel.desc: Sandman Hotel Vancouver City Centre is a downtown Vancouver hotel located on West Georgia Street in the city's business district. It is part of the Sandman Hotels chain and provides standard accommodation for travelers. Cycling tourists should contact the hotel directly to inquire about bike storage and touring-specific amenities.

hotel.name: Coast Kamloops Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A large full-service hotel in Kamloops featuring a signature tropical atrium with an indoor saltwater pool, hot tub, sauna, and wading pool. Notably the only hotel in Kamloops with an on-site liquor store, and home to Table twelvefifty, a restaurant with valley views from a patio. With 30,000 square feet of event space and a 24-hour front desk, it is a well-equipped base for touring cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley.
