notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Table twelvefifty serves modern cuisine with valley views and a patio

hotel.name: Swans Hotel & Brewpub
hotel.desc: A heritage boutique hotel occupying a restored 1913 warehouse in downtown Victoria, Swans offers 31 loft-style suites featuring exposed brick, original timber beams, and artworks from the founder's personal collection. The building also houses a full-production brewery, a pub with 58 beers on tap, and a liquor store — making it a destination in its own right. It sits at the edge of Victoria's oldest Chinatown, within easy walking distance of the harbour and the city's downtown core.

notes.Laundry: Website room amenity lists for Studio, One Bedroom, and Two Bedroom suites all include 'On-site Laundry'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub with 58 beers on tap at 1601 Store St; about page lists dozens of nearby restaurants including Earls, Cactus Club, and numerous local pubs within walking distance

hotel.name: JW Marriott parq Vancouver
hotel.desc: A luxury hotel in downtown Vancouver's entertainment district. As a high-end Marriott property, it provides modern accommodation suitable as a staging point for touring cyclists, though specific bike storage and handling procedures could not be verified.

hotel.name: Schell Motel Express
hotel.desc: Schell Motel Express is a motel located in Vernon, BC, a hub city in the North Okanagan often visited by touring cyclists riding the Okanagan Valley routes. As an express-branded property it likely offers straightforward overnight accommodation in a convenient roadside setting. Cyclists travelling through Vernon may find it a practical stopover, though specific cyclist services are unconfirmed.

hotel.name: Rowena's Inn on the River
hotel.desc: Rowena's Inn on the River is the heritage inn wing of Sandpiper Resort, a full-service riverside property set along the Fraser River near Harrison Mills in the Fraser Valley. The inn offers character-named rooms with river and forest views, sitting alongside rustic cabins, Scandinavian-styled luxury nature cabins, RV sites, a par-72 golf course, and an on-site restaurant. Touring cyclists arriving here would find a scenic, well-appointed stop with multiple accommodation tiers and on-site dining in a striking mountain-and-river landscape.

detail.address: 14282 Morris Valley Rd. Harrison Mills, BC, Canada V0M 1L0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site River's Edge Clubhouse restaurant serves lunch and dinner daily per the /dine/ page, described as open to golfers, guests, and locals

hotel.name: Sky Blue Waters Motel
hotel.desc: Sky Blue Waters Motel is a lakeside resort on Shuswap Lake in Tappen, BC, offering 8 fully equipped motel units with kitchens, living areas, and air conditioning. Situated halfway between Calgary and Vancouver — just 16 km west of Salmon Arm and 1.8 km off the Trans-Canada Highway — it makes a convenient overnight stop on a cross-province tour. The broader resort also includes a campground with full and partial hookups, giving cyclists with tents or trailers an alternative to motel rooms.

hotel.name: Pan Pacific Vancouver
hotel.desc: Pan Pacific Vancouver is a five-star waterfront hotel situated atop the Canada Place convention centre and cruise ship terminal, offering panoramic views of Burrard Inlet and the North Shore mountains. It is one of Vancouver's flagship luxury properties, positioned at the heart of the downtown waterfront and steps from the seawall cycling network. The hotel caters primarily to business and leisure travellers, though its central location makes it a potential high-end base for cyclists exploring the region.

hotel.name: Delta Hotels Vancouver Downtown Suites
hotel.desc: Delta Hotels Vancouver Downtown Suites is a 22-storey hotel in downtown Vancouver's business district, operated by Marriott. Located on West Hastings Street, it provides modern accommodation in the city center. As a major international hotel chain, it serves business and leisure travelers.

hotel.name: Sunny Beach Motel
hotel.desc: Sunny Beach Motel is a lakeside motel situated steps from Skaha Lake and Skaha Lake Park in Penticton, operated as part of the Skaha Lake Motels group of three properties. It offers studio through two-bedroom suites sleeping up to six, most with kitchenette facilities. The location puts guests within easy reach of Penticton's beach, shops, and cafes along the Skaha Lake corridor.

notes.Laundry: Website states guests have access to 'in-house laundry facilities'

hotel.name: Lonsdale Quay Hotel
hotel.desc: A hotel located in North Vancouver at Lonsdale Quay. No business information or amenity details are currently available.

hotel.name: Chilcotin Lodge
hotel.desc: Built in 1940 as a hunting lodge, the Historic Chilcotin Lodge is one of the last remaining authentic frontier lodges in BC, located on the Chilcotin Plateau about 30 minutes west of Williams Lake along Highway 20. The lodge offers ten individually decorated rooms plus RV and tent camping, a fully licensed dining room, and a Burger Bar/Bakery café. It sits close to spectacular destinations including Farwell Canyon and Junction Sheep Range Provincial Park, and won the 2022 Tourism Excellence Award from the Williams Lake and District Chamber of Commerce.

detail.address: 1080 Stack Valley Road, Riske Creek, BC V0L 1T0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site licensed dining room serving gourmet meals; website says 'call to reserve your seat for Burgers or a Home-cooked Meal, during our normal dinner hour.' Burger Bar/Bakery is a second on-site option (seasonal)

hotel.name: Hume Hotel & Spa
hotel.desc: The Hume Hotel & Spa is a historic boutique hotel in downtown Nelson, BC, operating since 1898 with Victorian-era architecture, original brick fireplaces, and restored mouldings alongside modern spa and dining facilities. Cyclists staying here are steps from Nelson's amenities and have access to four distinct on-site dining venues ranging from a jazz lounge and craft-beer pub to a summer beer garden. The hotel's Aura Spa & Salon offers massage, infrared sauna, and body treatments — appealing recovery options after a long day on the saddle.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site evening dining venues: Mike's Place Pub, Library Lounge (live jazz, full menu), General Store Restaurant, and a seasonal Beer Garden — all operated by the hotel

hotel.name: Hospitality Inn
hotel.desc: The Hospitality Inn is a motel-style property perched on a hillside above Kamloops, offering panoramic views of the city, rivers, and surrounding valley from its open terraced lawns. Centrally located within easy walking distance of downtown, Thompson Rivers University, and the Tournament Capital Centre, it serves families, sport teams, conference groups, and golfers. Guests have access to a seasonal heated outdoor pool, whirlpool, barbeque area, and rooms with full or mini kitchens — a practical, affordable base in a cycling-rich region.

detail.address: 500 Columbia Street West, Kamloops, BC V2C 1K6

notes.Laundry: Coin-up laundry on site (amenities page)
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states easy walking distance to 'restaurants and pubs' in downtown Kamloops

hotel.name: Sasquatch Inn
hotel.desc: The Sasquatch Inn is a small, family-owned country inn in Harrison Mills, BC, built by the Maclean family in 1954 and still operated by them today — celebrating 72 years in 2026. Set on the Lougheed Highway about an hour east of Vancouver, it offers 12 guest rooms alongside a full pub and liquor store in a single roadside complex. The inn has a long tradition of community events including an annual Motorcycle Show & Shine, making it a well-known stop along this corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub serves food until 10pm Sun–Thu and 11pm Fri–Sat

hotel.name: Pacific Retreat
hotel.desc: Pacific Retreat is a three-bedroom oceanfront vacation rental home on the rugged west coast of Tofino, professionally managed by Tofino Vacation Rentals. The property offers sweeping ocean views, a hot tub, and an expansive cedar deck, with Tonquin Beach a ten-minute walk away. Its fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, and proximity to the village make it a comfortable self-catering basecamp for exploring Pacific Rim's beaches and rainforest trails.

notes.Laundry: Washer/Dryer listed in property amenities on the website
notes.Nearby evening food: Property description states the village of Tofino is 'nearby and within easy walking distance'; operator's explore page confirms award-winning restaurants and cafes throughout the region

hotel.name: Prestige Prince Rupert Hotel
hotel.desc: The Prestige Oceanview Hotel Prince Rupert is a full-service hotel steps from the Inner Harbour in Prince Rupert, offering ocean views, a complimentary breakfast buffet with hot waffle bar, a fitness room, and free parking. It is part of the Prestige Hotels & Resorts family of 19 BC properties and caters to both leisure and business travellers. Prince Rupert is a key gateway to the BC Ferries Inside Passage route and Alaska, making this hotel a practical stop for long-distance touring cyclists.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary deluxe breakfast buffet with hot waffle bar included for guests; described as starting early on both weekdays and weekends

hotel.name: Crash Hotel Squamish
hotel.desc: Crash Hotel Squamish is a hip boutique hotel perched above one of Squamish's liveliest bars and nightclubs, blending hostel energy with hotel privacy in the heart of downtown. Rooms feature mountain-inspired designs — think vintage ski equipment and original artwork — with many offering views of the Stawamus Chief. Situated on the Sea to Sky Highway between Vancouver and Whistler, it operates entirely digitally with keyless entry and 24/7 text-based guest support.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site bar and nightclub below the hotel; website describes walkable downtown with restaurants and breweries
notes.Luggage storage: Baggage Storage listed as a hotel amenity on website

hotel.name: Rodeway Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A Rodeway Inn motel providing standard mid-range accommodation in Kamloops. Located on Rogers Way, this property serves as a convenient stopping point for travelers and cyclists passing through the area.

hotel.name: Bear Lodge
hotel.desc: Bear Lodge is a fully-equipped condo-style property situated on Whistler Village Stroll, steps from the Whistler Mountain Gondolas and the Marketplace Centre. Units come with full kitchens, in-suite washer/dryer, and some offer private balconies and wood-burning fireplaces. Its central Village location puts a wide range of dining, shopping, and nightlife immediately outside the door.

notes.Laundry: Website states units include washer/dryer
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'a multitude of shopping, dining and nightlife options at your doorstep'

hotel.name: Mineral Springs Resort
hotel.desc: Canada's only seaside mineral springs resort, set on 29 acres of subtropical rainforest on Salt Spring Island. Guests stay in private oceanfront cabins and have exclusive access to therapeutic mineral waters drawn from a well 150 feet below the ocean floor. A guest testimonial mentions bikes available for use on the property, suggesting a bike-friendly atmosphere.

detail.address: 1460 North Beach Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1J4

hotel.name: Lord Aberdeen Hotel
hotel.desc: Lord Aberdeen Hotel is a hotel in Vernon, BC. Detailed information was unavailable due to website access issues.

hotel.name: Pinnacle Hotel Harbourfront
hotel.desc: The Pinnacle Hotel Harbourfront is an 18-storey Coal Harbour waterfront hotel steps from the Stanley Park seawall and Vancouver Convention Centre, offering harbour and North Shore mountain views. Operating under the Pinnacle family since 2015, it provides an on-site bistro and bar (p2b), indoor pool, and fitness centre alongside renovated rooms. Notably for cyclists, the hotel lists electric-assist bikes as a guest amenity, making it a convenient base for exploring Vancouver's extensive seawall and cycling network.

detail.address: 1133 West Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 3T3

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site p2b Bistro + Bar listed as a signature hotel amenity; reviews also note 'many choices of restaurants and stores nearby' in downtown Vancouver

hotel.name: Sandman Inn Cranbrook
hotel.desc: The Sandman Inn Cranbrook is a full-service hotel on Cranbrook Street North, part of the national Sandman Hotels chain, featuring an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant. The property has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Room options include studios with full kitchens, making it a practical base for multi-day touring cyclists needing space to prepare food.

detail.address: 405 Cranbrook Street North, Cranbrook, BC V1C 3R5

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Denny's Restaurant listed as a dining option in amenities and individual room pages
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed as a standard room feature on the individual room detail page

hotel.name: The Parkside Hotel & Spa
hotel.desc: The Parkside Hotel & Spa is a sustainability-focused, Canadian-owned all-suite hotel in downtown Victoria offering 126 suites with full kitchens, private balconies, and spa-inspired bathrooms. Touring cyclists will find it notably welcoming, with dedicated secure bike storage, a curated biking guide, and a central downtown location ideal for exploring the city by bicycle. The property also features an on-site spa, rooftop fire pits, a pool and hot tub, and a floating sound meditation experience.

notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'our Guest Services Team is always happy to assist by storing your luggage until your room is available.'

hotel.name: Loden Hotel
hotel.desc: The Loden is a 77-room boutique hotel in Vancouver's Coal Harbour neighbourhood, holding a MICHELIN Key Award in 2024 and 2025 and ranked #1 hotel in Vancouver on TripAdvisor since 2020. It offers personalized service and high-end amenities steps from the downtown waterfront and Stanley Park cycling routes. The adjoining Tableau Bar Bistro is a French restaurant open for breakfast through dinner and in-room dining.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Tableau Bar Bistro, adjoined to the hotel lobby, is listed as open for breakfast
notes.Nearby evening food: Tableau Bar Bistro on-site serves dinner and happy hour

hotel.name: Terrace Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Terrace Beach Resort is a collection of individually named beachfront cabins and elevated boardwalk lofts nestled in the Pacific rainforest on the sheltered tip of the Ucluelet peninsula. Units are designed in a rustic-elegant style with open-beam construction, fireplaces, and kitchens or kitchenettes, many with private hot tubs or soaker tubs. The resort sits steps from the Wild Pacific Trail's Lighthouse Loop, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the wild west coast of Vancouver Island.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'easy access to the town of Ucluelet for dining, shops, and local attractions.'

hotel.name: West Coast Motel on the Harbour
hotel.desc: A family-operated motel centrally located at Ucluelet's Small Craft Harbour (Boat Basin), offering a range of suites from compact euro sleepers to a full Fisherman's House. Guests receive complimentary access to an attached 3,000 sq ft fitness centre with indoor pool and sauna, plus an outdoor cookshack with BBQ, sink, and propane crab pot. The property sits within walking distance of the Wild Pacific Trail and local restaurants, and is 10 minutes from Pacific Rim National Park — making it a convenient base for exploring the west coast.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the motel is 'within easy walking distance to restaurants' in central Ucluelet

hotel.name: Lil'tem' Mountain Hotel
hotel.desc: The Lil'tem' Mountain Hotel is a 100% Indigenous-owned property operated by Tsal'alh Development LP on behalf of the Tsal'alh Band, nestled between Anderson and Seton Lakes in the remote Seton Valley of BC's St'át'imc traditional territory. Part of a larger hospitality group that also includes an RV park and mountain cabins, the hotel sits at the end of the adventurous 30 km Highline Road — a dirt route with technical sections connecting Anderson Lake to Seton Portage that is a natural draw for touring cyclists. All accommodations include a full kitchenette, and visitors are advised to arrive well-prepared as the valley has limited cell service and few services.

detail.address: 6757 Seton Portage Road, Seton Portage, BC V0N 3B0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'the Highline pub is a great spot for lunch & dinner' — the Highline Pub and Restaurant is attached to the local shop on-site
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states: 'There is a small shop for basic essentials attached to our local Highline Pub and Restaurant.'

hotel.name: Motel 6 Saanichton, BC - Victoria Airport
hotel.desc: Motel 6 is a budget chain motel located near Victoria Airport in Saanichton. Offers standard motel accommodation and is a convenient stopping point for touring cyclists in the Sidney area.

hotel.name: Wildwood Lodge
hotel.desc: Wildwood Lodge is a 51-unit strata condominium building in Whistler, constructed in 1988 and managed by WRM Strata Services. Its commercial front desk is operated by Outpost Whistler, suggesting units are available as vacation rentals to visiting guests. Situated on Spearhead Drive, the property is within Whistler's resort corridor, which is a hub for both ski and cycling tourism.

hotel.name: Pinnacle Hotel Whistler Village
hotel.desc: A boutique hotel situated in the heart of Whistler Village, offering studio suites each equipped with a full kitchen, gas fireplace, and whirlpool bath. The property sits at the corner of Northlands Boulevard and Main Street, putting cyclists within easy walking distance of the village's shops, restaurants, and trail network. An outdoor heated pool and hot tub with mountain views rounds out the on-site amenities.

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states 'there are two fantastic on-site restaurants to choose from'; navigation lists ALPHA CAFÉ, Quattro at Whistler, and Alta Bistro under Dining
notes.Wi-Fi: FAQ confirms 'free wireless internet/WIFI is available in all public areas and rooms'

hotel.name: Bayshore Waterfront Inn
hotel.desc: Bayshore Waterfront Inn sits at the Inner Harbour of Ucluelet Marina, offering direct views of the harbour, mountains, and wildlife including sea lions, seals, and eagles. The property offers multiple room types—from standard queen rooms to two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, electric fireplaces, and barbecue patios. Ucluelet is a gateway to Pacific Rim National Park and the Broken Group Islands, making this inn a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the west coast of Vancouver Island.

hotel.name: Pinnacle Hotel at the Pier
hotel.desc: A full-service waterfront hotel in North Vancouver, the Pinnacle Hotel at the Pier sits steps from the famous Lonsdale Quay with views of the harbour and North Shore mountains. The hotel offers elegantly appointed rooms, two on-site restaurants (The Lobby Restaurant & Lounge and Pier 7 Restaurant & Bar), a health club, and a pool. Its central location near the Quay Market & Food Hall and proximity to North Shore breweries make it a well-situated urban base for touring cyclists.

detail.address: 138 Victory Ship Way, North Vancouver, BC V7L 0B1

notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site restaurants: The Lobby Restaurant & Lounge and Pier 7 Restaurant & Bar, both listed on the website
notes.Nearby grocery: Website features a 'Quay Market & Food Hall Package', indicating the Lonsdale Quay Market & Food Hall is within walking distance
notes.Luggage storage: Listed as 'Complimentary Luggage Storage' on the /services-amenities page

hotel.name: The Westin Bear Mountain Golf Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: The Westin Bear Mountain Golf Resort & Spa is a five-level Marriott resort in Victoria offering accommodation alongside golf and spa facilities. As a branded resort property, it provides standard hotel-level services and infrastructure suitable for touring cyclists making a full-service overnight stop.

hotel.name: Elizabeth Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Elizabeth Lake Lodge is a Canadian-owned, family-operated alpine-style lodge on the southwest edge of Cranbrook, uniquely positioned with walking trails to Elizabeth Lake Bird Sanctuary starting directly from the property. All rooms and suites include full kitchens and overlook the sanctuary. The lodge provides complimentary loaner bicycles for guests and is steps from the 26km paved Rails-to-Trails route connecting Cranbrook to Kimberley.

detail.address: 590 Van Horne Street South, Cranbrook, BC V1C 4W7

hotel.name: Sandman Inn Smithers
hotel.desc: Sandman Inn Smithers is a chain hotel on Highway 16 West serving the Yellowhead Highway corridor through Smithers. It has earned Bronze Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting an active sustainability program including a GreenStep EcoFund contribution per guest night. An on-site Tim Hortons operates 24 hours, and the property includes a fitness centre and business centre.

notes.Nearby evening food: Tim Hortons 24-Hour Restaurant listed as an on-site dining option in room descriptions
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed as a standard room feature on the room detail subpage

hotel.name: Ranchland Inn
hotel.desc: Ranchland Inn is a motel in Kamloops located on the Trans-Canada Highway, providing overnight accommodation to traveling cyclists and other visitors.

hotel.name: Fraser River Lodge
hotel.desc: Fraser River Lodge is an Indigenous-owned (Cheam First Nation) nature retreat on 18 acres along the Fraser River, featuring views of Mount Cheam and a resident bison herd. The lodge hosts overnight stays, guided fishing charters on the Fraser (sturgeon, salmon, steelhead), wellness programming, and weddings, with on-site dining and a wide range of outdoor adventures. It sits on McDonald Road near Agassiz, making it a scenic stop for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: Lodge lists 'Dining' as a core on-site service under Things To Do, and references dining experiences for both corporate and wedding guests throughout the website

hotel.name: The Tides Cottages
hotel.desc: The Tides Cottages is a 3-acre oceanfront resort on Pender Island in the Southern Gulf Islands, operating on a site that has been continuously run as a resort since 1942 and is billed as the longest-standing resort in the region. The property features a heritage house dating to 1928, four individual cottages with private decks and ocean views, a seasonal pool and year-round hot tub. Touring cyclists reaching Pender Island by ferry will find self-contained cottage units with kitchens or kitchenettes — a practical base for island exploration.

hotel.name: Coast Fraser Inn
hotel.desc: Coast Fraser Inn is a full-service chain hotel in Williams Lake operated by Coast Hotels, offering comfortable rooms with mountain views and a free hot breakfast each morning. An on-site Boston Pizza provides a reliable evening meal option after a long day in the saddle, and the hotel is conveniently located about 10 minutes from Williams Lake Regional Airport. It is a solid base for exploring the Cariboo region, with a hot tub and fitness centre available for recovery.

notes.Nearby evening food: Boston Pizza on-site; website states 'In the afternoon and evening, satisfy your appetite with a delicious meal at Boston Pizza.'

hotel.name: The Valley View Motel
hotel.desc: The Valley View Motel is a motel in Creston, BC. It provides wireless internet access for guests. Without accessible website information, specific details about cycling amenities cannot be confirmed.

hotel.name: Twin Creeks Motel
hotel.desc: Twin Creeks Motel sits on Highway 6 three blocks from downtown Lumby, roughly 20 km from Vernon, offering air-conditioned king, double queen, and kitchenette rooms. The motel is positioned as a base for the surrounding Monashee country, with the area well-known for cycling, mountain biking, hiking, and water recreation on nearby Mabel Lake. The website references a second affiliated property under a 'Canada's Best Value Inn' brand, suggesting a small chain operation.

hotel.name: St. Andrews By The Lake
hotel.desc: St. Andrews By The Lake Golf Resort is a scenic nine-hole golf resort set among rolling hills and willow-lined lakeside views in Kaleden, BC, about 15 minutes south of Penticton. Overnight guests stay in one of five clubhouse guestrooms or a fully furnished suite, each with a private entrance and walk-out patio overlooking the course. On-site amenities include a heated outdoor pool and The Painted Turtle Bistro, which serves pub-style food and drinks on a patio framed by the South Okanagan landscape.

detail.address: 111 St. Andrews Drive, Kaleden, BC V0H 1K0

notes.Nearby evening food: The Painted Turtle Bistro is on-site at the resort, offering patio and indoor dining with a pub-style menu including food and drinks

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Vancouver-Centre (Broadway)
hotel.desc: A Holiday Inn hotel in central Vancouver on West Broadway. Offers standardized chain accommodations with a downtown location providing access to Vancouver's urban amenities and cycling infrastructure.

hotel.name: Walnut Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Walnut Beach Resort is a lakefront suite hotel occupying Osoyoos Lake's only private beach, set against vineyard-covered hills in Canada's only desert region. Suites feature fully equipped kitchens, and the on-site Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar provides casual dining with patio seating and lake views. The resort bills itself as a gateway to Okanagan wine touring, golf, and cycling in one of British Columbia's warmest and most scenic valleys.

detail.address: 4200 Lakeshore Drive, Osoyoos, British Columbia, Canada V0H 1V6

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar with indoor and patio dining

hotel.name: Sandman Inn McBride
hotel.desc: Sandman Inn McBride is a hotel located in McBride, BC, serving travelers including touring cyclists. As a hotel, it provides overnight accommodation and standard amenities. Specific bike storage arrangements and handling procedures should be confirmed directly with staff.

detail.address: 1051 South East Frontage Road, McBride, V0J 2E0

hotel.name: Econo Lodge Kelowna
hotel.desc: A renovated, centrally located motel in downtown Kelowna operating under the Choice Hotels banner, with 108 suites and guest rooms across a two-storey building. Touring cyclists will find it notable for its dedicated bicycle storage locker — an explicit listed amenity — alongside an indoor pool, hot tub, and an on-site restaurant. Its position on Harvey Avenue places it close to the Okanagan Lake waterfront and Kelowna's urban cycling network.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page lists 'Self serve laundry' (noted with asterisk indicating additional charges apply)
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Amenities page lists 'Free light breakfast' served daily; rooms page confirms continental breakfast is included with all rooms
notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page lists 'Mekong restaurant on site'

hotel.name: Harbour House Hotel
hotel.desc: Harbour House Hotel is a historic waterfront property at the head of Ganges Harbour, Salt Spring Island, originally opened in 1916 and fully rebuilt after a two-year renovation. With 50 rooms — most overlooking the harbour — and an on-site farm-to-table restaurant sourcing from local island producers, it is widely regarded as the island's premier hotel. Touring cyclists will find it steps from Ganges Village and the famous Saturday Market.

notes.Nearby evening food: Woodley's Kitchen & Bar on-site, open daily

hotel.name: Dilworth Inn
hotel.desc: The family-owned Dilworth Inn is a pet-friendly hotel located across from Orchard Park Shopping Centre and steps from Mill Creek Linear Park, about 10 minutes from downtown Kelowna. All room types include complimentary continental breakfast and free Wi-Fi, with options ranging from standard queens to kitchenette suites. Its location adjacent to Highway 97 makes it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Kelowna corridor.

notes.Nearby evening food: Rooms page states the inn is 'within easy walking distance of a selection of restaurants and bars'

hotel.name: Victoria Marriott Inner Harbour
hotel.desc: A 19-story Marriott hotel in Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering centrally located accommodation in downtown Victoria. The property is part of a major international chain and serves as a base for touring travelers. The Inner Harbour location places guests near attractions and dining options.

hotel.name: Westward Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Westward Inn & Suites is a fully renovated motel in Langley, BC, sitting at the intersection of Fraser Highway and Highway 10 with straightforward access to the Vancouver region and the US border. The property offers two-bedroom suites and family suites with full kitchens, making it practical for groups or cyclists on extended tours. Willowbrook Shopping Centre, with over 150 shops and services, is directly across the street.

notes.Laundry: Listed explicitly as a popular amenity on the website homepage
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the property is within walking distance of restaurants and local attractions

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Kelowna Hotel & Suites is a branded highway hotel on the main Highway 97 corridor, positioned as a base for exploring the Okanagan Valley's wineries, golf courses, and family activities. The property features the 97 Street Pub, an on-site restaurant and pub offering meals throughout the day. Its location on the primary north-south route through Kelowna makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists moving through the region.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site 97 Street Pub described as 'your on-site go-to for the best bites while in Kelowna'

hotel.name: The Village Gate House
hotel.desc: The Village Gate House is a Whiski Jack Resorts condo property sitting at the heart of Whistler Village, offering studios through two-bedroom loft suites with full kitchens and optional private hot tubs. It sits steps from the lifts of Whistler/Blackcomb and from the trailheads of Whistler's renowned mountain bike park, making it a natural base for cycling and ski touring alike. The property is operated by a locally rooted company with four decades of Whistler hospitality experience.

notes.Laundry: Website facilities list: 'Free Laundry Facilities'
notes.Nearby evening food: Property description states 'steps from shops, dining, and nightlife'

hotel.name: Motel 6
hotel.desc: Motel 6 is a national chain motel offering basic overnight accommodation in Surrey. Located on King George Boulevard, it provides convenient access to the local area and confirms Wi-Fi availability for guests.

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops Mountview
hotel.desc: The Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops Mountview is a chain hotel situated in the Mountview area of Kamloops, a city that sits at the junction of several major cycling corridors in BC's Interior. As part of the Travelodge brand under Wyndham, it offers a recognizable mid-range accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through or staging rides in the Thompson Valley region. Kamloops is a natural overnight stop on routes such as the Trans Canada and the Kettle Valley, making this hotel a practical base.

hotel.name: Heritage Inn
hotel.desc: Heritage Inn is a former Best Western hotel situated in Hope, BC, at the junction of several major routes including the Trans-Canada and Crowsnest highways — a natural overnight stop for long-distance cyclists. The property is surrounded by the dramatic scenery of the Fraser Canyon and Cascade Mountains, and Hope itself has a quirky claim to fame as a location used in numerous Hollywood films. Rooms include standard amenities such as microwave, mini fridge, and free high-speed internet.

hotel.name: Poco Inn & Suites Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam, about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver, with East and West wing rooms ranging from standard queens to themed suites and a kitchen suite. The hotel offers a dining restaurant, room service, lounge, and a fitness centre with sauna on-site. A past testimonial from the Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest charity cycling ride confirms the property has hosted touring cyclists.

hotel.name: REO Resort
hotel.desc: REO Resort is a long-running, award-winning eco-adventure glamping resort perched on the edge of the Nahatlatch River deep in the Fraser Canyon, reached via a forest service road roughly 2.5 hours from Vancouver. Founded in 1982 and still family-operated, it offers all-inclusive packages combining whitewater rafting, yoga, guided canyon hikes, and riverside glamping in hand-peeled log and canvas tents. A touring cyclist willing to venture off-pavement would find a fully catered wilderness base with three chef-prepared meals daily and a TripAdvisor Hall of Fame reputation.

detail.address: 61755 Nahatlatch Forest Service Rd, Boston Bar, V0K 1C0

hotel.name: Tropicana Suite Hotel
hotel.desc: The Tropicana Suite Hotel is a hotel located on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. As a suite-style hotel in a central location, it offers accommodation to touring cyclists, though specific bike storage and cyclist-oriented amenities could not be verified.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Inner Harbour
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Inner Harbour is an 8-storey hotel occupying a prime position on Victoria's famous Inner Harbour, within walking distance of the Parliament Buildings, Fisherman's Wharf, and Beacon Hill Park. It offers a full range of amenities including a seasonal outdoor heated pool, sauna, whirlpool, fitness centre, and complimentary breakfast, making it a comfortable urban base for touring cyclists. The hotel also runs a Winter Long Stay program with extended weekly and monthly rates, appealing to cyclists who linger in Victoria.

detail.address: 412 Quebec Street, Victoria, British Columbia V8V 1W5

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry facilities listed on /amenities page
notes.Vending machines: Ice, vending and snack machines listed on /amenities page

hotel.name: Buckinghorse River Lodge
hotel.desc: Buckinghorse River Lodge is a hotel on the Alaska Highway at Mile 175, near Pink Mountain, BC. Located in northern British Columbia on Highway 97, it provides overnight accommodation for travelers passing through this remote region.

detail.address: Mile 175 Alaska Hwy Number 97, Pink Mountain, V0C 2B0

hotel.name: Hastings House Country House Hotel
hotel.desc: Hastings House is a member of Relais & Châteaux and occupies 22 acres of oceanfront property overlooking Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island, offering 18 individually styled suites and cottages. The estate includes an acclaimed farm-to-table Manor Dining restaurant and the cedar-clad Wellspring Spa, drawing on produce from onsite gardens. Its location is within easy walking distance of the village of Ganges, making it a comfortable base from which to explore Salt Spring Island by bike.

detail.address: 160 Upper Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2S2

hotel.name: The Coast Victoria Harbourside Hotel
hotel.desc: A waterfront hotel situated on Victoria's Outer Harbour, steps from Fisherman's Wharf and within easy reach of the BC Parliament Buildings, Royal BC Museum, and downtown Victoria. The property features Victoria's only indoor/outdoor pool overlooking the harbour, a fitness centre, and the on-site Blue Crab Seafood House serving fresh West Coast seafood. Gated underground parking with EV charging and a free on-demand shuttle to James Bay and downtown make it a convenient base for exploring the region.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Blue Crab Seafood House restaurant offering fresh, seasonal West Coast dining and local seafood with waterfront views

hotel.name: Big White Ski Resort
hotel.desc: Big White Ski Resort is a large four-season mountain resort located above Kelowna in BC's Okanagan Highlands. In summer, it operates a Bike Park and offers guided eBike tours alongside a full village with accommodation, dining, and on-mountain services. The resort is a self-contained destination with restaurants, food trucks, a market, medical services, and online grocery ordering.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists on-site 'Restaurants, Food Trucks & Market' under Food & Dining
notes.Nearby grocery: Website navigation includes 'Order Groceries Online' as a resort service, indicating grocery access at the resort village

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Surrey
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Surrey is a 2-star budget hotel sitting on King George Boulevard, a major north-south arterial through Metro Vancouver's southern suburbs. It is part of the Wyndham franchise network and caters to road-side travellers passing through the Surrey–Delta corridor. Touring cyclists coming off the Trans Canada Trail or heading toward the ferry terminals at Tsawwassen may find it a practical overnight base in an otherwise urban stretch.

hotel.name: Linda Vista Motel
hotel.desc: Linda Vista Motel is a motel on King George Boulevard in Surrey providing overnight accommodation. It serves traveling cyclists requiring lodging in the area.

hotel.name: Sons of Norway
hotel.desc: Sons of Norway operates this heritage camp and cultural lodge serving the Norwegian-American community for cultural events and gatherings. Located in Durieu, British Columbia, the property accommodates group visits for heritage activities. Specific information about touring cyclist amenities is unavailable from current online sources.

hotel.name: Best Western King George Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A Best Western-branded hotel on Surrey's King George Boulevard, offering standard chain hotel rooms and an indoor pool available year-round. The property is positioned along a major arterial corridor in the Fraser Valley, making it a straightforward base camp for cyclists exploring the Surrey–Langley area. As part of the Best Western Rewards program, it caters to a wide range of travellers including families.

detail.address: 8033 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC V3W 5B4

hotel.name: Best Western Premier Chateau Granville Hotel & Suites & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A 118-room boutique-style hotel operating since 1975 in Vancouver's Entertainment District, at the corner of Granville and Helmcken streets — three minutes' walk from the Yaletown–Roundhouse Canada Line station. The property offers some of the largest one-bedroom suites on Granville Street, with private balconies and layouts that sleep up to five guests. Its downtown location puts cyclists within walking distance of the seawall, Stanley Park, Granville Island (via Aquabus), and the full length of the Seaside Greenway.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'dozens of restaurants, bars, and theatres are within a one- to two-block radius' of the hotel
notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'For guests arriving before check-in, we hold luggage at the front desk at no charge.'

hotel.name: SureStay Plus Hotel by Best Western Salmon Arm
hotel.desc: A newly renovated hotel situated directly off the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, roughly halfway between Vancouver and Calgary. Shuswap Lake is a short walk away, and the broader area offers over 1,400 kilometres of hiking and biking trails. Part of the BWH Hotels / Best Western family, it offers standard chain-hotel amenities in a convenient highway-accessible location.

detail.address: 61 10th Street SW, Salmon Arm, British Columbia V1E 1E4

hotel.name: Bella Coola Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Bella Coola Mountain Lodge is a boutique hotel on Highway 20 in Hagensborg, sitting at the edge of the Great Bear Rainforest and Tweedsmuir Provincial Park in one of BC's most remote and scenic valleys. The property traces its roots to around 1895 and has long served as a rest stop for travelers making the long journey into the Bella Coola Valley. The current owners also operate Bella Coola Grizzly Tours, giving guests direct access to guided fjord, hot springs, and wildlife excursions.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Continental breakfast available as a guest add-on; includes locally roasted coffee, tea, homemade muffins, granola, farm-fresh eggs, cereal, oatmeal, toast, bagels, and yogurt. Served in the on-site Bistro; not available during winter months

hotel.name: Sitka
hotel.desc: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront resort situated on the working marina in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory. The property anchors an on-site Adventure Centre offering whale watching, bear watching, kayaking, hot springs tours, guided fishing, a gym, and a marina, making it a full-service basecamp for West Coast exploration. Shelter Restaurant operates on-site, and the resort is within walking distance of Tofino's shops, cafés, and trailheads.

notes.Laundry: FAQ states: 'There is a laundry facility located in the Adventure Centre. Please call 778.841.0186 to inquire about access.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Shelter Restaurant is on-site at 634 Campbell Street; website describes it as offering local wild-caught seafood and a diverse menu

hotel.name: Rosedale Motel
hotel.desc: The Rosedale Motel is a long-established, family-oriented property in Summerland, BC, sitting just two blocks off Highway 97 in the heart of the Okanagan Valley. It offers a range of accommodation from standard rooms to two-bedroom cottages with full kitchens, set amid attractive landscaping. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient base for the Kettle Valley Railway trail, Okanagan Lake beaches, and the surrounding wine region.

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry listed in amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Zia's Stonehouse is right next door' and notes guests can walk to restaurants

hotel.name: The Spanish Villa Motel
hotel.desc: The Spanish Villa Motel sits directly across from Okanagan Lake on Penticton's bustling 'Sunset Strip,' placing guests steps from the beach and within walking distance of restaurants, shops, and the channel float. The property has operated for decades as a go-to base for Okanagan visitors, offering room types ranging from studio units to multi-bedroom lakeview suites with full kitchens and balconies. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient hub for exploring the valley's wineries, golf courses, and Peach City Beach Cruise events.

notes.Laundry: Laundry Facilities listed explicitly as a property amenity on both the home page and About page
notes.Nearby evening food: About page states the motel 'is surrounded by Penticton's finest restaurants.'

hotel.name: Howard Johnson
hotel.desc: Howard Johnson by Wyndham Downtown Kamloops is a mid-scale chain hotel located on Columbia Street in downtown Kamloops, a major hub on cycling routes through the interior of British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham Hotels group, it offers standard hotel services in a convenient downtown location within walking distance of the Thompson River. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops on the Trans Canada or other interior routes would find it a practical overnight option in the city centre.

hotel.name: Summit Lodge Boutique Hotel
hotel.desc: Summit Lodge is a pet-friendly boutique hotel tucked into the quieter, forested edge of Whistler Village, with a lobby anchored by a stone fireplace, slate floors, and untreated wood plank walls. It sits within walking distance of village shops and a supermarket, and has on-site dining at Sachi Sushi, popular with locals. The hotel's summer offerings explicitly highlight hiking and biking as activities guests can base themselves here to enjoy.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Sachi Sushi restaurant mentioned on the website as a dining option, described as popular with locals
notes.Nearby grocery: Guest review quoted on the website states 'a short distance away from a supermarket and town shops.'

hotel.name: Best Western
hotel.desc: The Best Western Peace Arch Inn is a three-storey hotel on King George Boulevard in South Surrey, situated close to the Peace Arch Canada-US border crossing — a natural overnight stop for cyclists doing a cross-border tour. The property sits within a short ride of White Rock Beach, Crescent Beach, and Semiahmoo Bay, offering easy access to the White Rock Promenade and the coastal scenery of the Semiahmoo Peninsula.

hotel.name: Bethlehem Retreat Centre
hotel.desc: Bethlehem Centre is a multi-faith charitable retreat and educational centre nestled on the forested shores of Westwood Lake at the foot of Mt Benson on Vancouver Island. It offers 37 guest rooms across four guesthouses, seven distinct gathering spaces, and homemade meals, welcoming individuals and groups seeking contemplation, spiritual exploration, and community. A touring cyclist arriving here would find a quiet, nature-surrounded setting with full lodging and dining in one of Nanaimo's more serene corners.

hotel.name: April's White Raven Home
hotel.desc: April's White Raven House is a waterfront guest house on northern Haida Gwaii in Old Massett, operated by Haida artist SG̱áana Jaad (April White), who also maintains an on-site gallery. The eight-room property sits on Masset Inlet with direct beach access and sweeping inlet views, offering a distinctly Haida cultural immersion. Touring cyclists would find it a compelling base for exploring North Beach, Tow Hill, ancient Haida villages, and the broader Gwaii Haanas region.

detail.address: 50 Raven Ave, Old Massett, BC V0T 1M0

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham West Kelowna BC
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham West Kelowna BC is a franchise motel located on Westgate Road in West Kelowna, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. Situated near the Okanagan Lake corridor, it serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the wine country routes and rail trails of the central Okanagan. As a Super 8 property it offers standard motel-style accommodation with direct road access.

hotel.name: Tiki Shores Motel
hotel.desc: Tiki Shores Inn & Suites is a 120+-room lakeside resort property situated directly across the street from Okanagan Beach in Penticton, offering spacious suites with full kitchens ranging from studios to penthouses. The See & Do page explicitly highlights the nearby Kettle Valley Trail (Trans-Canada Trail) and City of Penticton Trails Network, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan. On-site amenities include a heated outdoor pool, BBQ areas, an on-site restaurant, and a guest laundromat.

notes.Laundry: Website front page and amenities list state 'The on-site guest laundromat.'
notes.Nearby evening food: About page states 'Along the Lakeshore stretch, there are fire pits, vendors, parks and restaurants'; property also has an on-site restaurant

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sandman Hotel Penticton is a mid-scale chain hotel on Burnaby Avenue offering a full suite of amenities including an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an unusual indoor pickleball court. The property has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting a genuine sustainability program including an EcoFund contribution per guest night. An on-site Denny's restaurant operates around the clock, making it a convenient base for cyclists arriving at variable hours.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Denny's 24-Hour Restaurant confirmed in amenity lists and room descriptions
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed as a room feature on the Standard Room, 1 King Bed subpage

hotel.name: Sandman Suites Vancouver on Davie
hotel.desc: A 24-level hotel on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, part of the Sandman Suites chain. The property includes wheelchair-accessible facilities and is suitable for travelers needing overnight accommodation during cycling tours.

hotel.name: Clarion Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Clarion Hotel & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in Abbotsford featuring newly renovated rooms and suites alongside a large conference and events facility. Guests have access to an indoor heated pool, hot tub, and a fitness centre with cardio equipment. The on-site White Spot restaurant — a beloved BC institution — serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, making it a convenient base for a cycling stop in the Fraser Valley.

detail.address: 36035 North Parallel Road, Abbotsford, BC V3G 2C6

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site White Spot Restaurant open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner; room service also available

hotel.name: Quarterdeck Inn
hotel.desc: The Quarterdeck Inn is an oceanfront resort and marina in Port Hardy, the northern terminus of Vancouver Island — a natural start or finish point for cyclists completing the Island Highway. The property offers 40 rooms and suites ranging from standard rooms to ocean-view apartments with full kitchens, set along Hardy Bay with sweeping coastal views. An independently operated Mexican-inspired restaurant (Oceanside Cantina) sits on-site, and the attached marina is one of the largest on northern Vancouver Island.

detail.address: 6555 Hardy Bay Road, Port Hardy, V0N 2P0

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry Facility listed as a hotel amenity, located next door on the Marina side; laundry also available at the marina
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website front page states 'Guests can start their day with a convenient grab-and-go breakfast.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Oceanside Cantina on-site serves Mexican-inspired cuisine including dinner, 7 days a week
notes.Vending machines: Vending Machine explicitly listed under Hotel Amenities on the /amenities/ page

hotel.name: Duncan Motel
hotel.desc: Duncan Motel is a roadside motel located on Alexander Street in Duncan, a small city in the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island. Duncan lies along a key Vancouver Island cycling corridor connecting Victoria to Nanaimo and beyond, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists. The property appears to be a standard motel-style accommodation with ground-floor room access typical of the format.

hotel.name: Mount Baker Hotel
hotel.desc: The Baker Hotel is a meticulously restored 1923 Art Deco boutique property in the heart of downtown Cranbrook, welcoming guests with vintage-inspired décor, soaker tubs, and kitchenette suites across three room tiers. The hotel has been part of Cranbrook's cultural fabric for over a century and underwent a significant restoration after 2018. Its downtown Baker Street location puts cyclists within walking distance of restaurants, shops, and a grocery store.

notes.Laundry: Listed as 'Laundry Facilities' on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Fenwick & Baker Public House is a full-service restaurant located on the main floor of the hotel
notes.Nearby grocery: Amenities page states a grocery store is within easy walking distance of the hotel
notes.Vending machines: Hospitality Room on the second floor features a vending machine, ice machine, and water dispenser

hotel.name: Harbour Light Motel
hotel.desc: A 28-room motel in Nanaimo providing standard overnight lodging. Free WiFi and air conditioning are available. A conventional roadside motel option for touring cyclists needing accommodation in the region.

hotel.name: Meares Retreat B&B
hotel.desc: Meares Retreat is a small, intimate two-suite waterfront bed & breakfast perched on an 80-foot cliff above the Pacific Ocean near Tofino, BC, with sweeping ocean and mountain views from each private-entrance suite. Both suites feature gas fireplaces, private outdoor hot tubs on a cliff-top deck, and a continental breakfast tray delivered to the door each morning. The property sits minutes from Tonquin Beach and local hiking trails, making it a scenic and secluded base for exploring BC's wild west coast.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express Kamloops
hotel.desc: A four-level Holiday Inn Express hotel with 81 rooms on Kamloops' Versatile Drive commercial corridor. Part of a reliable mid-range hotel chain offering consistent service, breakfast, and Wi-Fi. A standard overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the region.

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Kamloops
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-range chain hotel located in Kamloops, BC, a major hub on popular touring routes including the Trans Canada and Crowsnest corridors. As part of the Wyndham brand, it offers standard hotel services in a city with good access to services, restaurants, and supply shops. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops will find this a convenient overnight option in an otherwise large, spread-out city.

hotel.name: KAYANARA
hotel.desc: Kayanara is a farm stay resort near Eagle Creek, BC, offering handcrafted cabins built from timber harvested on the property, including distinctive blue-tinted wood left by the Blue Pine Beetle. Accommodation ranges from fully equipped multi-bedroom cabins with wood stoves and private decks to RV campsites with 30/50-amp hookups, pull-through access, and tenting. The property also functions as an event venue, lending it a range of facilities uncommon for a rural BC stopover.

notes.Laundry: Washer and dryer available in a separate building, confirmed for Bear Cabin, Wolf Cabin, and RV campsites

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Abbotsford Bakerview
hotel.desc: A two-storey Travelodge franchise property situated on Sumas Way in Abbotsford, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. It sits near the Trans-Canada corridor, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. As a national chain property, it offers the consistency and predictability of branded budget accommodation.

hotel.name: Econo Lodge Inn & Suites - North Vancouver
hotel.desc: A family-owned 95-room motel with an alpine aesthetic, situated 10 minutes north of downtown Vancouver near the Capilano Suspension Bridge, Grouse Mountain, and the Sea to Sky highway to Whistler. Room options range from standard queen beds to full kitchen suites and extended-stay units, making it a practical multi-night base for cyclists exploring the North Shore trail network. Free parking for vehicles and vans is highlighted, and the surrounding area offers direct access to hiking and biking trails.

detail.address: 1748 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7P 3B4

notes.Laundry: On-site coin laundry listed on the amenities page and referenced on the front page
notes.Early or packed breakfast: 'Grab and go breakfast' explicitly offered for king bed room and extended-stay guests; complimentary daily breakfast included for all guests
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states Park Royal shopping centre with 'many dining options' is nearby

hotel.name: Comfort Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Comfort Inn & Suites is a branded hotel chain property on Highway 16 in Terrace, BC. The hotel offers standard guest accommodations with Wi-Fi internet access. Specific amenities for cyclists, including bike storage and handling procedures, could not be verified from available information.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel & Suites Prince George
hotel.desc: The Sandman Hotel & Suites Prince George is a mid-scale chain property offering room types from standard doubles to two-bedroom kitchen suites, making it practical for multi-night touring stays requiring a kitchenette. The hotel has earned Gold Certification from GreenStep Solutions, assessed against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting meaningful operational sustainability commitments. Guests have access to a pool, exercise gym, coin-operated laundry, and two on-site restaurants.

detail.address: 1650 Central Street East, Prince George, V2M 3C2

notes.Laundry: Coin-Operated Laundry listed in Services & Amenities on the hotel's website
notes.Nearby evening food: Moxies and Denny's are listed as on-site amenities; Denny's described as 'anytime dining' for late-night and morning meals

hotel.name: Tofino Resort and Marina
hotel.desc: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront resort situated in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory, with harbour-view rooms and an on-site Adventure Centre offering kayaking, whale watching, bear watching, and fishing charters. The property includes the Shelter Restaurant, Tuff Fit Gym, and a working marina, and is within easy walking distance of Tofino's shops, trails, and eateries. It functions as a full-service West Coast adventure basecamp rather than a simple overnight stop.

notes.Laundry: FAQ states: 'There is a laundry facility located in the Adventure Centre. Please call 778.841.0186 to inquire about access.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Shelter Restaurant is located on the resort property at 634 Campbell Street; described as offering local wild-caught seafood and other dishes

hotel.name: St. Eugene Golf Resort & Casino
hotel.desc: St. Eugene Golf Resort & Casino is a full-service Indigenous-affiliated resort set within the traditional territory of the Ktunaxa Nation in a secluded valley on the banks of the St. Mary's River, about 10 minutes from downtown Cranbrook. The property features 125 guest rooms and suites with views of Fisher Peak and the Purcell and Rocky Mountains, an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Les Furber, a casino, and on-site dining. Its interpretive centre and Indigenous heritage programming make it a culturally distinctive stop in the East Kootenays.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site casual and upscale restaurants
notes.Wi-Fi: FAQ states: 'Our WiFi is free to all hotel guests. Network is SEGRC-Public. No password is required.'

hotel.name: The Thompson Hotel
hotel.desc: The Thompson Hotel is a full-service hotel and conference centre in downtown Kamloops offering a range of room types from Double Queen to Family and Double King Suites. The property features an indoor heated pool, fully equipped fitness room with cardio equipment, a 24/7 games room, and an on-site Breakfast Bistro. It is pet-friendly and welcomes guests with dogs, making it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Thompson Valley.

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry available 24/7, listed in all room-type descriptions on the website
notes.Early or packed breakfast: On-site Breakfast Bistro; note seasonal reduced days (bistro closed some weekdays) per website

hotel.name: Woodstone Manor
hotel.desc: Woodstone Manor is a 12-room hotel situated on Galiano Island, one of British Columbia's Southern Gulf Islands accessible only by BC Ferries. Its location makes it a natural base for cyclists exploring Galiano's quiet rural roads, with the island's limited traffic and scenic terrain being a draw for touring riders. The property appears to be an established, independently operated accommodation in a community with very few lodging options.

detail.address: 743 Georgeson Bay Road, Galiano Island, V0N 1P0

hotel.name: Traveler's Motel Penticton
hotel.desc: A family-run motel nestled on the shores of Skaha Lake in Penticton, steps from Skaha Lake Park with views of the surrounding mountains. Rooms range from a basic queen to three-bedroom suites, all with full bathrooms and most with in-suite kitchens — practical for touring cyclists wanting to self-cater. A seasonal outdoor pool and BBQ area add to the appeal for warm-weather visitors.

detail.address: 3590 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6G7

notes.Laundry: Listed under Guest Services on the amenities page as 'Laundry facilities'
notes.Nearby evening food: Guest review quoted on the homepage references the motel as 'close to restaurants'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states an eight-minute walk to Rexall and a fifteen-minute walk to Walmart
notes.Wi-Fi: Amenities page lists 'Free Wifi (all rooms & some public areas)'

hotel.name: Kitoki Inn
hotel.desc: Kitoki Inn is a boutique forest retreat on Bowen Island offering bright, modern cabins and a private open-air onsen-style bathhouse, reached by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in North Vancouver. The inn is deliberately designed around digital detox and nature reconnection, with no televisions but an entertainment library of books, games, and puzzles. It operates with a two-night minimum and a fully contactless check-in process, making it a quiet, self-contained base for cyclists exploring Bowen Island.

detail.address: 503 Collins Rd, Bowen Island, British Columbia VON 1G1

hotel.name: Vogue Hotel
hotel.desc: Vogue Hotel is a downtown Vancouver hotel located on Granville Street, one of the city's main commercial corridors. The hotel's own website highlights the Granville Street area with a walking tour video, suggesting its appeal is largely tied to its central urban location. For a touring cyclist, the Granville Street position places it within walking distance of the dense restaurant, grocery, and entertainment options of Vancouver's downtown core.

hotel.name: Sandman Signature Kamloops Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sandman Signature Kamloops Hotel is a multi-storey full-service hotel in downtown Kamloops offering rooms and suites ranging from standard kings to full-kitchen suites. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, seasonal outdoor patio, and two dining venues—Moxies Restaurant and the Shark Club Sports Bar & Grill—making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists needing a hot meal after a long day. The property is pet-friendly, smoke-free, and offers free overnight parking.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Moxies Restaurant and Shark Club Sports Bar & Grill confirmed on amenities page

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Cranbrook Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A mid-scale chain hotel in Cranbrook operated by Wyndham Hotels and Resorts, located at 600 Cranbrook Street North in the heart of the East Kootenay region. The property includes a conference centre, making it one of the larger lodging options in the area. Cranbrook sits at the crossroads of several touring routes through the Rockies and Purcell Mountains, making this hotel a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through southeastern BC.

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Kamloops On The Hill
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Kamloops On The Hill is a franchise motel situated on the hill above Kamloops at 1521 Hugh Allan Drive, part of the well-known Super 8 budget chain under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella. It offers standard motel-style accommodation in a city that sits at the crossroads of several major touring routes through the BC Interior. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops would find it a familiar, no-frills overnight base close to the Trans-Canada and Coquihalla corridors.

hotel.name: Tiki Village Motel
hotel.desc: Tiki Village Inn is a Polynesian-themed motel and suite property in Vernon, BC, offering standard rooms, executive suites, and kitchenette units arranged around an inner courtyard with a heated pool. The property caters to short visits and extended stays alike, with free parking, on-site laundry, BBQ and picnic facilities, and a fenced dog park. Its location near major Okanagan thoroughfares and within walking distance of Vernon Jubilee Hospital makes it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists passing through the valley.

notes.Laundry: On-site Guest Laundry Facilities listed explicitly in hotel amenities page
notes.Wi-Fi: Complimentary Wi-Fi listed as a hotel amenity; website states 'high speed wireless connection free of charge from anywhere on our facilities.'

hotel.name: Polaris Lodge
hotel.desc: A Polaris Lodge in Kimberley.

hotel.name: The Shore Kelowna
hotel.desc: The Shore Kelowna is a luxury all-suite property on Okanagan Lake in the Lower Mission neighbourhood, offering fully furnished studio through three-bedroom suites with in-suite kitchens, private balconies, and shared outdoor spaces. The property sits steps from Gyro Beach and connects to Kelowna's lakeside paths, with the website featuring a dedicated cyclists' guide to the city among its blog content. It also offers vacation-stay options alongside its primary long-term rental offering.

notes.Laundry: In-suite washer and dryer listed as a standard suite amenity on both the front page and /live/ page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'dining, shopping, fitness and entertainment, all within walking distance' and references 'celebrated restaurants' in the neighbourhood description

hotel.name: The Coast Bastion Inn
hotel.desc: The Coast Bastion Hotel is a 14-storey full-service hotel perched on the downtown Nanaimo waterfront, offering harbour and ocean views from every room via Juliet or full-size balconies. Part of the Coast Hotels chain, it features on-site dining at Minnoz Restaurant + Lounge and is steps from the Harbour Air terminal, making it convenient for cyclists arriving or departing by seaplane. The hotel explicitly welcomes bikes and offers storage, and its city-centre location puts cyclists within easy reach of Vancouver Island's ferry connections and trail network.

notes.Nearby evening food: Minnoz Restaurant + Lounge is on-site at the hotel

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express Vancouver Airport - Richmond
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express branded hotel near Vancouver Airport in Richmond. A standard mid-range chain hotel offering free Wi-Fi. Part of the IHG group with typical business-hotel amenities.

hotel.name: Riverland Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Riverland Inn & Suites sits directly on the Thompson River with Mount Peter and Mount Paul as a backdrop, roughly a 20-minute walk from downtown Kamloops. The property offers nearly 60 rooms including kitchenette suites, jacuzzi rooms, and a family suite sleeping six. An outdoor BBQ and sun terrace facing the river gives touring cyclists a practical place to clean up and cook.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated washing machines and dryers available to guests on-site
notes.Nearby evening food: Dining page states cafés, coffee shops, chain restaurants, fast food, and finer dining are 'just minutes away'

hotel.name: Coast Tsawwassen Inn
hotel.desc: Coast Tsawwassen Inn is a contemporary, suite-style hotel operated by the regional Coast Hotels chain, positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal — a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing to Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands. Rooms feature mini fridges, microwaves, and free wi-fi, and the property includes a fitness centre and on-site Browns Socialhouse restaurant. The hotel offers free parking and free electric vehicle charging stations on site.

detail.address: 1665 56 Street, Delta, British Columbia V4L 2B2 Canada

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Free continental breakfast served from 6am Monday–Friday and 6:30am weekends/holidays in the hotel lobby
notes.Nearby evening food: Browns Socialhouse operates on-site and is described as offering dining in the afternoon and evening

hotel.name: The Josie Hotel, Autograph Collection
hotel.desc: The Josie Hotel is an Autograph Collection property located in Rossland, British Columbia, a mountain community in the province's Interior. Part of Marriott's distinctive brand portfolio, the hotel provides accommodation for visitors to the area.

hotel.name: MacKenzie Beach Resort
hotel.desc: MacKenzie Beach Resort is one of Tofino's oldest beach resorts, substantially renovated since 2017, offering a mix of vintage Airstream trailers, surf bungalows, cabins, and forest campsites steps from the Pacific Ocean. The resort leans into a laid-back West Coast 'Drifter Code' atmosphere with hot tubs, a sauna, beach rentals, and cocktails on-site. It sits on the Pacific Rim Highway about 2.5 km from downtown Tofino, connected by a dedicated bike path — making it a convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the area.

detail.address: 1101 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Laundry: Main page lists 'laundry facilities' among resort amenities added during renovation

hotel.name: Quality Inn Downtown Inner Harbour
hotel.desc: A Quality Inn branded hotel located in Victoria's downtown Inner Harbour area on Blanshard Street. As a chain hotel property, it offers standard lodging services for visitors to the region. A resource for touring cyclists passing through Victoria.

hotel.name: Waters Edge Shoreside Suites
hotel.desc: Waters Edge Shoreside Suites occupies its own small spit of land within Ucluelet Harbour, offering self-contained condo suites with full kitchens, private entrances, and many featuring outdoor soaker tubs on decks overlooking the inlet and marina. The property sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and serves as a natural launching point for Pacific Rim National Park, storm watching, and marine wildlife tours. An on-site Aveda day spa adds a distinctive amenity for guests looking to recover after time on the road.

hotel.name: Days Inn Nanaimo
hotel.desc: Days Inn Nanaimo is a 79-room mid-range hotel positioned midway between the Duke Point and Departure Bay Ferry Terminals, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists arriving or leaving Vancouver Island by ferry. The property is one of the few hotels in Nanaimo with an indoor pool and hot tub, and it offers an on-site full-service restaurant (Ricky's All Day Grill) as well as a complimentary continental breakfast. Pet-friendly and kitchenette rooms are available, and the front desk is staffed around the clock.

detail.address: 809 Island Highway South, Nanaimo, BC V9R 6Z2

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry on site listed under General amenities
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary cold continental breakfast included with stay, served in the Gabriola Room on the Pool Level; coupon redeemable at on-site Ricky's All Day Grill for a hot breakfast alternative
notes.Nearby evening food: Ricky's All Day Grill on-site with table service and takeout; limited room service also available

hotel.name: The Aspens
hotel.desc: The Aspens on Blackcomb is a slope-side condominium complex in Whistler's Upper Village offering ski-in/ski-out access directly to Blackcomb Mountain. Managed by Blackcomb Peaks Accommodations, it features over 60 fully-equipped one- and two-bedroom condos with full kitchens, a heated outdoor pool, and three hot tubs. The complex sits about a 5–10 minute walk from Whistler Village, providing convenient access to restaurants, services, and the valley trail network.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel & Suites Williams Lake
hotel.desc: A mid-scale chain hotel and suites property in Williams Lake offering standard rooms, studio suites, and multi-bedroom kitchen suites across several floors. The property holds GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices benchmarked against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, including linen-reuse, recycling, and an EcoFund contribution program. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a Denny's Restaurant with room service.

notes.Nearby evening food: Denny's Restaurant on-site with room service available, confirmed on front page and room listings
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed as an in-room amenity in the Standard Room subpage

hotel.name: DoubleTree by Hilton North Vancouver
hotel.desc: The DoubleTree by Hilton North Vancouver is a full-service hotel situated in North Vancouver's Capilano area, part of the globally recognized Hilton family of brands. It sits within easy cycling distance of the North Shore trail network, Capilano River, and the Lynn Valley corridor, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the area. Touring cyclists can expect the standard amenities of a large hotel brand, though specific cyclist-focused services are unverified.

hotel.name: Harrison Village Motel
hotel.desc: Harrison Village Motel is a two-storey commercial motel situated in the center of Harrison Hot Springs, a resort village celebrated for its natural hot springs and sandy lake beaches. The property offers a cafeteria on-site and free parking, placing it within easy reach of the village's downtown amenities. For touring cyclists, it serves as a convenient base for exploring the Fraser Valley and the mountain roads of the surrounding region.

detail.address: 280 Esplanade Avenue, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

hotel.name: Delta Hotels Kamloops
hotel.desc: Delta Hotels Kamloops is a Marriott-branded hotel located on Victoria Street in downtown Kamloops, one of the region's established chain accommodations. As a full-service property, it serves both business and leisure travelers and provides reliable lodging in a central location. Touring cyclists will find this property conveniently situated within Kamloops city center.

hotel.name: Motel 6
hotel.desc: Motel 6 is a budget accommodation chain with a location in Fort St. John on 100 Street. It provides straightforward overnight lodging for travelers and cyclists passing through the area. As part of a widely available chain, it offers consistent, affordable accommodation.

hotel.name: Beach Grove Motel
hotel.desc: Beach Grove Motel is a small 15-room independently-run motel in the Tsawwassen neighbourhood of Delta, nestled beside Beach Grove Golf Club and within walking distance of Centennial Beach and Boundary Bay. Guests on their way to or from the BC Ferries terminal in Tsawwassen find it a convenient and unpretentious stopover, and reviews consistently highlight the friendly hands-on owners and clean, recently-refreshed rooms. Room types range from basic queen rooms to family rooms with full kitchenettes, catering to longer or self-catered stays.

notes.Laundry: Coin operated Laundromat on site — confirmed on all room subpages
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states motel is 'a short walk away from major shopping and dining'; about page specifies 'Tsawwassen mall, Dining, Shopping and Banking facilities are just walking distance'

hotel.name: Villa Motel
hotel.desc: The Villa Motel is a 30-unit motel perched beside Nelson's iconic Big Orange Bridge with direct views of Kootenay Lake and the surrounding mountains. Eight room types — including full kitchenette suites — make it a practical base for longer stays in the Kootenay region. Downtown Nelson's Baker Street is a five-minute drive away, and Lakeside Park with its beach is a short walk across the bridge.

notes.Laundry: Private guest coin-op laundry listed on the Groups & Corporate page

hotel.name: Wildwood Cabins
hotel.desc: Wildwood Cabins is a cluster of four handcrafted post-and-beam cabins set on a 5-acre forested property on Bowen Island, built from local and reclaimed timber and boasting panoramic Pacific Ocean views from rock bluffs. With a 4.98-star Airbnb rating across over 3,000 reviews, the property includes a Nordic wood-fired barrel sauna, an outdoor firepit, an on-site yoga loft, and trails through old-growth forest. Cyclists arriving by ferry will find themselves within walking distance of two cideries and a farm market, with beaches and trails a short ride away.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website mentions two cideries within walking distance, plus Alderwood Farm and Meadowbrook Market nearby
notes.Nearby grocery: Website lists Meadowbrook Market and Alderwood Farm as nearby options for 'food or supply stock up'

hotel.name: Toad River Lodge
hotel.desc: Toad River Lodge is a family-owned full-service complex on Reflection Lake at Mile 422 of the Alaska Highway, offering motel rooms, lakeside cabins with kitchenettes, and a 23-site RV park — all open year-round. The lodge is famous for its ceiling-mounted hat collection of over 7,200 hats from around the world, and includes an on-site restaurant, laundromat, Canada Post outlet, and a service garage with tire repair, gas, diesel, and propane. For cycle tourists riding remote northern BC, it is one of the few full-service stops in a very long stretch of highway.

detail.address: Mile 422 Alaska Highway, Toad River, VOC 2X0

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'NEW Laundromat with washers and dryers at a nominal fee' on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Full-service restaurant on site open all year round serving home-cooked meals and baked goods

hotel.name: The Marquise
hotel.desc: The Marquise is a six-story condominium lodge perched on Blackcomb Benchlands in Whistler, offering ski-in/out access across the street. It features a large hot tub under a glass dome with mountain views, a heated outdoor pool open year-round, and a fitness room. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable base in the heart of the Whistler corridor.

notes.Laundry: Listed explicitly under Services as 'Onsite laundry'

hotel.name: The Wickaninnish Inn
hotel.desc: The Wickaninnish Inn is a celebrated boutique hotel perched at the edge of Chesterman Beach between ancient rainforests and the Pacific Ocean, and a member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection. The inn features multiple on-site dining venues including The Pointe Restaurant, On the Rocks Bar, and a seasonal Driftwood Café, as well as the Ancient Cedars Spa and an art gallery. Its location adjacent to Pacific Rim National Park Reserve makes it a compelling base for cyclists exploring Tofino's beaches and trails.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site dining venues confirmed: The Pointe Restaurant, On the Rocks Bar, Driftwood Café, and Summer Crab Cookout listed on website

hotel.name: Sunshine Inn Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sunshine Inn Hotel is one of four properties in a small Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a common long-distance cycling route. The Smithers location sits in downtown Smithers at the foot of Hudson Bay Mountain, making it a convenient base for the Bulkley Valley. Continental breakfast is included, parking accommodates vehicles of all sizes including RVs and trailers, and 24-hour front desk service is available.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website states: 'Continental Breakfast is included in our Burns Lake, Smithers and Terrace locations.'
notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can look after your luggage free of charge. If you arrive early or are not ready to take your bags after checking out, we will store your goods for the day.'

hotel.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A 6-level Marriott-branded hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Revelstoke. Provides standard hotel accommodation for touring cyclists passing through this mountain community.

hotel.name: Mountain View Motel & Restaurant (Mile 100)
hotel.desc: Mountain View Motel & Restaurant sits at Mile 100 on the Alaska Highway in the small community of Wonowon, northern BC, a strategically placed stop on one of North America's great long-distance cycling routes. The two-storey motel includes an on-site restaurant, offering both a bed and a hot meal in a section of highway where services can be widely spaced. Its Alaska Highway milepost location makes it a natural landmark and resupply waypoint for cycle tourers heading to or from Alaska.

hotel.name: Star Lodge
hotel.desc: Star Lodge is a motel in Kamloops positioned near Thompson Rivers University, with rooms featuring mountain and river views and balconies overlooking the South Thompson River valley. The property caters to a broad range of travellers with bus and truck parking, pet-friendly rooms on request, and proximity to outdoor activities including mountain biking, hiking, and fishing.
