A picnic area, guest laundry, and ample parking make it a practical stop for those passing through or exploring the Kamloops region.

detail.address: 775 Columbia Street West, Kamloops, BC V2C 1K9

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry facilities listed on front page and amenities page
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Rooms page states 'From our delicious continental breakfast to our free high-speed internet'
notes.Nearby evening food: Website notes 'Numerous shops, eateries and cocktail lounges can be found nearby'
notes.Nearby grocery: Things To Do page lists nearby Superstore and Walmart

hotel.name: Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre is a 189-room, 4-star hotel operated by Marriott on Dominion Street in Burnaby, BC. It includes a dedicated conference centre, making it a major venue for events and business travel in the Metro Vancouver area. Cyclists staying here are within reach of Burnaby's urban trail network and the broader Lower Mainland cycling infrastructure.

hotel.name: New Royal Inn Hotel
hotel.desc: New Royal Inn is a hotel located on Twelfth Street in what appears to be New Westminster, BC. Its website is live but contains almost no descriptive content, making it difficult to assess what the property offers. A touring cyclist would have no way to confirm bike-friendly services from publicly available information.

hotel.name: Lemon Creek Pioneer Campground
hotel.desc: Lemon Creek Pioneer Campground (OSM-listed as 'Lemon Creek Lodge') is a 26-site campground in the Slocan Valley near Winlaw, BC, offering both RV hookups and treed tenting sites with firepits, indoor washrooms with hot showers, and a covered gazebo. The property sits in a quiet, non-commercial setting and is within reach of the Slocan Rail Trail and Galena Trail, two popular cycling corridors in the West Kootenays. It also accommodates small group events such as family reunions and weddings.

hotel.name: Polson Park Motel
hotel.desc: The Polson Park Motel is a mid-sized motel sitting directly opposite Polson Park in central Vernon, BC, on Highway 97. Rooms range from standard queen configurations to kitchenette units, and the property features a courtyard with barbecue and an outdoor pool. Its central location puts cyclists within easy reach of downtown Vernon, restaurants, and the Vernon Jubilee Hospital.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Close to restaurants, golf courses and downtown.'

hotel.name: Admiral Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Three-level motel located on Belleville Street in Victoria. Provides lodging for touring cyclists visiting the area.

hotel.name: Harrison Lake Hotel
hotel.desc: Harrison Lake Hotel is a pet-friendly hotel on a quiet side street in Harrison Hot Springs, just steps from the Harrison Hot Springs Public Pool and the village town centre. The surrounding region offers an abundance of outdoor pursuits including hiking, biking, canoeing, kayaking, and golfing, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley. The hotel includes a Courtyard Cafe serving a continental breakfast buffet as part of its Bed & Breakfast package.

hotel.name: Marland Motel
hotel.desc: Marland Motel is an 18-room property on the quiet edge of Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering a range of room types from simple sleeping rooms to one-bedroom family units and standalone cottages, most with full kitchens for longer stays. It sits within walking distance of restaurants and the beach, and is close to outdoor attractions including the Sunshine Coast Trail, salmon fishing charters, and scuba diving sites. Pets are welcome, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring the northern Sunshine Coast.

detail.address: 7156 Thunder Bay Street, Powell River, V8A 1E6

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the motel is 'just a short walk to restaurants and the beach.'

hotel.name: Canadian Princess Lodge
hotel.desc: The Canadian Princess Lodge is a historic 46-room waterfront lodge and marina perched on the edge of the Ucluelet Boat Basin, halfway between Long Beach and the Wild Pacific Trail. All rooms include private balconies, fridges, microwaves, and free WiFi, with most offering water or garden views. The lodge makes an excellent base for touring cyclists exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, the Wild Pacific Trail, and the surrounding west coast scenery.

detail.address: 1943 Peninsula Rd PO BOX 220, Ucluelet, British Columbia V0R 3A0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states lodge is 'steps away from the downtown core' and 'nearby many local sights, attractions, shops and restaurants'; Restaurants listed as an in-town activity

hotel.name: Level Furnished Living
hotel.desc: Level Furnished Living is the Yaletown–Richards outpost of the Level Hotels chain, offering upscale furnished suites positioned between short-term hotel stays and longer monthly rentals. Located in Yaletown, one of Vancouver's most walkable and transit-connected neighbourhoods, it targets urban travellers who want home-like space in a boutique hotel setting. The brand emphasises spacious layouts and 'lifestyle amenities,' though the specifics of those amenities are not detailed on the public homepage.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Baker Street Inn & Convention Center
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Baker Street Inn is the only full-service hotel on Nelson's storied Baker Street, placing cyclists at the heart of this eclectic Kootenay mountain town celebrated for its arts scene and outdoor recreation. The property includes a convention centre and offers amenities such as free breakfast and kitchenette-equipped rooms, catering to a wide range of guests. Nelson sits at the confluence of several popular cycle-touring routes through the West Kootenay region.

hotel.name: Canadian Inn
hotel.desc: A motel in Surrey offering accommodation to travelers. Current amenities and services cannot be fully verified without access to current website information.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Victoria
hotel.desc: A Sandman brand hotel located on Douglas Street in Victoria. As a mid-range hotel chain, it serves as potential overnight accommodation for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Rivendell Retreat Centre
hotel.desc: Rivendell Retreat Centre is a Christian contemplative community and place of retreat situated on Bowen Island, a short BC Ferries ride from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The centre offers individual and group retreats across several sacred spaces — a Lodge, Cottage, Hermitage, and writers' cottage — set amid forest trails with views of mountains and sea. Retreatants bring their own food and share a communal kitchen, and the grounds include a network of walking trails through old-growth forest.

detail.address: 600 Rivendell Rd, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0

hotel.name: Carmana Hotel
hotel.desc: Carmana Hotel is a Canadian-owned, 96-suite boutique high-rise in Vancouver's downtown financial and shopping district, offering spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens and floor-to-ceiling windows. Originally opened in 1999 as Carmana Plaza, it caters strongly to extended-stay guests and corporate travellers, with long-term rates available for stays of 90 days or more. It sits steps from the Stanley Park seawall, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city's premier waterfront cycling routes.

notes.Laundry: Self-serve laundry on the 3rd floor, open 24/7. Same-day professional laundry and dry-cleaning also available on request
notes.Wi-Fi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in all suites and public areas; login instructions and password provided at front desk on check-in

hotel.name: Pemberton Hotel
hotel.desc: Pemho Pub is Pemberton's main nightlife venue, hosting regular live music acts ranging from BC blues bands to folk-pop groups, along with specialty performance nights. The pub features arcade games and a full bar, with active event programming through at least mid-2026. The name 'Pemho' appears to be a contraction of its historical identity as the Pemberton Hotel, though the current website makes no mention of accommodation.

hotel.name: Woodrun Lodge
hotel.desc: Woodrun Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out condominium-style property on the slopeside of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler's Upper Village area, managed as vacation rentals by WhistlerAccommodation.com. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, washers/dryers, gas fireplaces, and wifi, with access to a shared heated outdoor pool and hot tub. A touring cyclist would find it a well-appointed mountain base with slope views and convenient access to both the Upper and Main villages.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'wash/dryer' as an in-unit feature

hotel.name: Best Western Inn at Penticton
hotel.desc: Best Western Inn at Penticton is a full-service hotel on Skaha Lake Road, positioned between Skaha Lake and downtown Penticton in the heart of Okanagan cycling country. The property features an indoor pool and hot tub, complimentary breakfast, and rooms with kitchenette options. It sits near the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the Penticton waterfront, making it a practical base for multi-day touring cyclists.

detail.address: 3180 Skaha Lake Road, Penticton, BC V2A 6G4

hotel.name: Cove Lakeside Resort
hotel.desc: The Cove Lakeside Resort is a full-service lakefront resort on Okanagan Lake in West Kelowna, offering spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom condo-style suites with fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, and private balconies. The resort features two seasonal outdoor pools, hot tubs, a spa, tennis and pickleball courts, and direct waterfront access with paddleboards and boat rentals. Its location near West Kelowna wineries and within a short ride of grocery stores and downtown amenities makes it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

notes.Laundry: In-suite washer and dryer confirmed in all suite types (one-, two-, and three-bedroom descriptions)
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant confirmed via Spring Suite Escape package: 'complimentary $50 gift card to spend at the restaurant or spa.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Guest review quoted on front page references 'grocery stores to fill your kitchen during your stay' as central to the West Kelowna location

hotel.name: Celadon Lodge
hotel.desc: A 16-unit mountain-view hotel in Radium Hot Springs offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units with or without kitchenettes. Located on the Banff-Windermere Parkway in a mountain recreation area.

detail.address: 5000 Banff-Windermere Parkway, Radium Hot Springs, V0A 1M0

hotel.name: The Buccaneer Inn
hotel.desc: The Buccaneer Inn is a harbour-front motel situated directly across from Newcastle Channel, steps from Nanaimo's Harbourside Walkway and a short distance from the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal — a practical staging point for cyclists crossing to or from the Mainland. The inn offers a range of suites with full kitchens, ocean views, and an outdoor BBQ area, giving touring cyclists a self-catering option in a waterfront setting. It is operated under the Evergreen Hospitality Group umbrella despite marketing itself as a family-run inn.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'enjoy waterfront dining just a few minutes from the Inn' and references local cafes and restaurants in Downtown Nanaimo within easy reach

hotel.name: Crystal Cove Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a highly-rated oceanfront property on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins, serviced RV sites, and glamping trailers with 5th-wheel RVs — rated #1 Resort in Tofino and #1 in Canada for Families on TripAdvisor. The resort sits directly on a kilometre of sandy coastline with tidal rocks and small islands accessible at low tide, making it a destination in itself. An on-site café, Bean at the Cove, and fully stocked cabin kitchens round out the self-contained experience.

hotel.name: August Jack Motor Inn
hotel.desc: August Jack Motor Inn is a motel on Squamish's main downtown strip, Cleveland Avenue, positioning itself as a base camp for Sea-to-Sky outdoor adventures including cycling, hiking, kitesurfing, and skiing. The property sits within walking distance of the town's restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, and civic amenities. It markets mountain or garden views, a fire pit, and BBQ facilities alongside its standard room offerings.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states Cleveland Avenue is 'lined with coffee shops, boutiques, and restaurants' and specifically names Howe Sound Brewery and Cliffside Cidery within walkable distance

hotel.name: Château Okanagan
hotel.desc: Château Okanagan is a European-inspired luxury estate on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, BC, comprising two distinct properties — the Grand Residence and the Estate Villa — across 44 acres with a kilometre of private shoreline and on-site vineyards. Featured on Netflix's 'Million Dollar Secret,' it accommodates up to 24 guests across 12 rooms and offers a private spa, beach access, tennis court, and wine country setting. The Estate Villa allows individual room bookings, making it the more accessible option for solo cyclists or couples touring the Okanagan, though the entire estate is gated and advance reservation is required.

hotel.name: Hampton Inn Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: Hampton Inn Vancouver Airport is a mid-scale Hilton-brand hotel situated in Richmond close to Vancouver International Airport, making it a practical stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As part of the Hampton by Hilton chain it offers standardized amenities expected of a full-service airport hotel. Its Bridgeport Road location places it near the Canada Line rapid transit corridor and within the broader Richmond cycling network.

hotel.name: Canadas Best Value Inn
hotel.desc: Canada's Best Value Inn is a motel in Valemount on the Yellowhead Highway corridor, part of a regional budget hotel chain. Cycling-specific amenities and current operational status could not be verified due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Tyndall Stone Lodge
hotel.desc: Tyndall Stone Lodge is a 12-unit condo complex in Whistler Village North managed by Whiski Jack Resorts, offering two-bedroom and two-bedroom plus loft suites with fully equipped kitchens and powerful air conditioning. Located adjacent to Olympic Plaza and steps from Whistler's world-class restaurants and nightlife, it serves as a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area's renowned mountain biking trails. The free Village shuttle stops nearby, putting both the Whistler and Blackcomb lift bases within easy reach.

notes.Nearby evening food: Property described as being in Whistler Village North, 'steps from Shops/Restaurants' with 'world-class shops, restaurants and nightlife'

hotel.name: Prestige Aberdeen Lodge Kamloops
hotel.desc: Prestige Aberdeen Lodge Kamloops is a 39-room lodge property in the Aberdeen area just off the Trans-Canada Highway, part of BC's family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain. The lodge offers an onsite restaurant, fitness centre, and coin laundry, and guests have access to the indoor pool and waterslide at the adjacent Prestige Kamloops Hotel. A complimentary continental breakfast is included with all stays, making it a practical and comfortable base for cyclists passing through Kamloops.

notes.Laundry: Guest coin laundry listed among hotel amenities on the website
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary continental breakfast included with stay, available daily; selections include cereal, breads and pastries, yogurt, juice, and coffee or tea
notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite restaurant listed among hotel amenities; property is also described as steps from dining in the Aberdeen area

hotel.name: Tofino Motel - Harbourside
hotel.desc: A motel in Tofino providing overnight accommodation on Campbell Street. Details about cyclist-specific amenities and services could not be verified due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Happy Day Inn
hotel.desc: Happy Day Inn is a hotel-motel hybrid in the heart of Burnaby, about 20 minutes from Downtown Vancouver, offering a range of room types from standard to suites, some with fully equipped kitchenettes. The property includes free secured parking, complimentary continental breakfast, a fitness room and sauna, and coin laundry. Its central location near multiple transit options makes it a practical base for exploring Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry listed on the /amenities/ page

hotel.name: Alpine Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Alpine Inn & Suites is a family-owned motel in Nelson, BC offering 30 newly renovated rooms — from standard queens to full-kitchen family suites and a jacuzzi suite — in a European-style hospitality setting. It sits one minute from downtown Nelson and 20 minutes from Whitewater Ski Resort, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region. The variety of room configurations, including suites sleeping up to six guests, suits both solo tourers and small cycling groups.

detail.address: 1120 Hall Mines Road, Nelson, BC V1L 1G6

notes.Laundry: Website (/the-inn/) states 'Laundry facilities with soft drink machine and ice machine'
notes.Vending machines: Website (/the-inn/) mentions 'soft drink machine and ice machine' on premises

hotel.name: Prestige Inn Kelowna
hotel.desc: The Prestige Beach House Kelowna is a contemporary lakeside hotel situated steps from Hot Sands Beach and directly across from City Park on Okanagan Lake, with easy walking access to downtown Kelowna. Part of a family-owned BC collection of 19 properties, it sits close to the Myra Canyon trestle cycling route and Okanagan waterfront paths that touring cyclists frequent. Guests have access to an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, and an on-site restaurant.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant West Coast Seafood & Raw Bar; guests receive 25% off breakfast there

hotel.name: SoLo Suites
hotel.desc: SoLo Suites is a modern condo-hotel in Langford on BC's Westshore, roughly 25 minutes from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Its 40 suites across six concrete-and-steel storeys each include a full kitchen and in-suite laundry, making it well-suited to multi-night touring stays. The property sits near outdoor recreation areas and provides easy access to both Westshore amenities and greater Victoria.

notes.Laundry: Website states every suite includes in-suite laundry
notes.Wi-Fi: Not explicitly

hotel.name: Pangea Pod Hotel
hotel.desc: Pangea Pod Hotel is Canada's first pod hotel, placing private capsule-style sleeping pods inside a designer, social setting minutes from Whistler's gondolas. It occupies a hybrid niche between hostel affordability and hotel privacy, with an on-site restaurant and bar (The Living Room) and a rooftop patio that the hotel bills as Whistler's only. The property is explicitly inclusive and welcomes guests of all genders, backgrounds, and sexual orientations.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Living Room restaurant and bar offers breakfast sandwiches, grab-and-go deals, artisan flatbread pizzas, sandwiches, salads, sharing plates, craft beers, and signature cocktails

hotel.name: Ace Western Motel
hotel.desc: Ace Western Motel is a motel in Clearwater, British Columbia, providing accommodation for travelers in the area. Website verification was not possible at time of review due to connectivity issues.

hotel.name: Sheraton Vancouver Airport Hotel
hotel.desc: A Sheraton hotel located near Vancouver International Airport in Richmond, providing standard hotel accommodations for travelers. Specific bike storage and amenity details could not be verified due to website access restrictions.

hotel.name: Georgian Court Hotel
hotel.desc: The Georgian Court Hotel is a boutique 4-star property in downtown Vancouver with 180 guest rooms, executive suites, and penthouse suites, situated steps from BC Place Stadium, Rogers Arena, and the city's extensive cycling network. The hotel runs a named Bicycle Service program — one of the few Vancouver hotels to list it as a formal amenity — providing guests with complimentary loaner bikes with helmets and locks, plus e-bike rentals arranged at the front desk. Its location near the Seawall and Stanley Park routes makes it a practical base for urban cycling exploration.

notes.Laundry: Website amenities list explicitly includes 'Laundry and Dry Cleaning Services'

hotel.name: Pomeroy Inn and Suites
hotel.desc: Pomeroy Inn and Suites is a full-service hotel in Fort St. John offering air-conditioned rooms and internet access. Located on Alaska Road North, it welcomes guests with bicycles. Specific bike storage arrangements and other cyclist-specific amenities should be confirmed directly with the hotel.

detail.address: 9320 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 6L5

hotel.name: Canadas Best Value Inn Mile 0
hotel.desc: A mid-range motel operating under the Sonesta/Canada's Best Value Inn brand, positioned at the historic 'Mile 0' landmark in Lillooet — a natural gateway to the BC Interior for cyclists travelling the Gold Rush Trail or Fraser Canyon corridor. The property offers a range of room types from standard rooms with mini-fridges and microwaves to a family suite and a honeymoon suite with jetted tub, all in a compact Main Street location within easy walking distance of several restaurants. Truck and bus parking is listed as a property feature, suggesting the site can accommodate larger vehicles and loaded bikes.

notes.Laundry: Website features section explicitly lists 'Guest Laundry'
notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple restaurants listed within walking distance: Dina's Place (0.2 km), Lillooet Inn Restaurant (0.2 km), Deano's Pizza (0.4 km), Lillooet's Cookhouse Restaurant (0.9 km), and others up to 1.3 km
notes.Vending machines: Website features section lists 'Vending/Ice Machines'

hotel.name: Victorian Royal Suites
hotel.desc: Royal Victoria Suites is a timeshare resort property operated by VI Resorts (Vacation Internationale / Westgate) in a fully renovated heritage building in the heart of Victoria. It sits on Government Street within walking distance of major sights, restaurants, and the Inner Harbour. A rooftop deck with BBQ is available for guests.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists several nearby restaurants including Swan's Pub, Irish Times Pub, John's Place Restaurant, Il Terrazzo, The Tapa Bar, and Bard & Banker

hotel.name: Evolution Whistler
hotel.desc: Evolution Whistler is a modern, pet-friendly condo-style hotel in Whistler's original Creekside Village, offering spacious one-to-three-bedroom suites with full kitchens, fireplaces, and in-suite laundry. Located steps from the Creekside Gondola, it features year-round outdoor heated pools, hot tubs, and a eucalyptus steam room. The property is operated as part of a small collection of Creekside hotels and appeals to couples, families, and adventure-focused travellers seeking self-contained suite accommodation.

notes.Laundry: All suites include an in-suite washer and dryer per website description

hotel.name: L' Hermitage
hotel.desc: L'Hermitage is a 60-room luxury boutique hotel at the corner of Robson and Richards Streets in the heart of downtown Vancouver, blending European chic with West Coast sophistication. It offers a range of rooms and suites, including studio units with fully equipped Eggersmann kitchens and in-unit washer/dryers, alongside a rooftop heated outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness studio, and the on-site L'Orangerie dining room and lounge. The property caters primarily to business and leisure travelers seeking a high-end boutique experience in a central urban location.

notes.Laundry: Boutique Solarium Room and kitchen-equipped suites include a full-size stacked washer/dryer combo in-unit
notes.Nearby evening food: L'Orangerie Dining Room & Lounge is on-site; in-room dining also available

hotel.name: Seaside Hotel
hotel.desc: Seaside Hotel is a boutique waterfront property on the North Vancouver shoreline, operated under the Executive Hotels & Resorts group, with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Vancouver skyline from signature rooms featuring natural Pacific Northwest-inspired design. The hotel includes an on-site Italian restaurant (Provisions Italiana) and a third-floor spa with floor-to-ceiling ocean views. Located steps from the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal, it offers straightforward transit access to both North Shore outdoor recreation and downtown Vancouver.

detail.address: 130-125 Victory Ship Way, North Vancouver, BC V7L 0G5

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Provisions Italiana serves Italian cuisine; described as 'some of the most delectable cuisine on the west coast' in a lounge setting

hotel.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Kelowna
hotel.desc: Fairfield Inn & Suites is a mid-range Marriott hotel in Kelowna, housed in a 4-level building on Powick Road. The property offers conventional hotel accommodations for business and leisure travelers. Specific bike storage arrangements and cycling-focused services are not documented in available sources.

hotel.name: Quality Inn & Suites Downtown Vancouver
hotel.desc: Quality Inn & Suites Downtown Vancouver is a mid-range Choice Hotels property on Granville Street, centrally positioned between Gastown, Yaletown, and Stanley Park. The hotel houses The Morrissey, a full-service pub and restaurant with a rock-and-roll theme, directly on the premises. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of Vancouver's seawall and mixed-use cycling paths.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Hot breakfast served daily at The Morrissey Pub and Restaurant; hotel guests receive a discount on the full breakfast menu including bacon, eggs, potatoes, and toast
notes.Nearby evening food: The Morrissey Pub and Restaurant is located within the hotel, offering meals, drinks, and a large whiskey and scotch selection

hotel.name: The Spot
hotel.desc: The Spot is a tech-forward boutique hotel in Nanaimo offering keyless smart locks, contactless mobile check-in, and minimalist modern rooms with rainfall showers and in-room mini-fridges. Located on Terminal Avenue North, it sits within easy reach of the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists crossing between Vancouver Island and the mainland. Free parking is available for all guests and a 24/7 virtual concierge provides around-the-clock support.

detail.address: 950 Terminal Ave N, Nanaimo, BC V9S 4K4

notes.Device charging: Dedicated desk area with USB charging ports in each room

hotel.name: Quality Inn Waddling Dog
hotel.desc: The Quality Inn Waddling Dog is a charming Tudor-style hotel positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal, Victoria International Airport, and Butchart Gardens—making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing Vancouver Island. The property houses the award-winning Waddling Dog Pub and an onsite beer, wine, and spirits store, so food and drinks are steps away after a long day in the saddle. It is dog-friendly and includes a complimentary hot breakfast each morning.

detail.address: 2476 Mt. Newton X Road, Saanichton, British Columbia V8M 2B8

notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite Waddling Dog Pub serves lunch and dinner; /dining page describes pub food, pints, and comfort dishes with a west coast twist
notes.Vending machines: Explicitly listed under Hotel Amenities on /amenities page: 'Vending Machine'

hotel.name: Stork Nest Inn
hotel.desc: Stork Nest Inn is a family-owned boutique inn a short walk from downtown Smithers in the Bulkley Valley, operating since 2018. All rooms include a private washroom, bar fridge, flat screen TV, WiFi, and air conditioning units installed in 2023. A hot made-to-order breakfast starting at 6am is included with every stay, making it a practical base for early-starting cyclists exploring the region.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Hot breakfast included with every stay, served from 6am each morning with made-to-order eggs, sausages, ham, hash browns, pancakes, toast, cereals, fresh fruit, coffee, tea, and juices

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Cranbrook
hotel.desc: Travelodge by Wyndham Cranbrook is a national-chain motel located on Cranbrook Street North in Cranbrook, BC, a hub community on the Kootenay cycling corridor. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar mid-range motel experience for travellers passing through the East Kootenay region. Cranbrook serves as a practical resupply and rest stop for cyclists on routes such as the Trans Canada Trail and Crowsnest Highway.

hotel.name: Comfort Inn & Suites Surrey
hotel.desc: Comfort Inn & Suites Surrey is a four-storey chain hotel in Surrey, BC offering room types ranging from standard queen rooms to Jacuzzi suites, pet-friendly rooms, and suites with kitchenettes. The hotel provides a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, free on-site parking with oversized vehicle spaces, a fitness centre, and an outdoor patio. It sits directly across from the Surrey Sports & Leisure Complex, giving touring cyclists convenient access to Olympic-sized indoor pools and additional fitness facilities.

notes.Laundry: Coin Operated Laundry listed on amenities page

hotel.name: Thunderbird Motor Inn
hotel.desc: A motor inn located in Duncan, BC. Provides accommodation for travelers, though specific amenities and bike policies could not be verified.

hotel.name: Century Plaza Hotel and Spa
hotel.desc: Century Plaza Hotel is a 3-star all-suite downtown Vancouver property offering studio suites and one-bedroom suites ranging from 400 to 650 square feet, many with full kitchens. The hotel features an indoor pool, on-site steakhouse (C|Prime Modern Italian Steak and Wine), and a café (Beyond Coffee). Situated on Burrard Street, it is a short walk from Vancouver's main entertainment and shopping districts and approximately 1.5 km from BC Place.

notes.Nearby evening food: C|Prime Modern Italian Steak and Wine (Steakhouse) and Beyond Coffee café are on-site at the hotel
notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states overnight baggage storage is available; bags can also be stored at no charge on the day of arrival and on the day of departure

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: A Sandman Hotel franchise location situated near Vancouver Airport in Richmond, providing hotel accommodation for travelers in the airport area and surrounding region.

hotel.name: Predator Ridge Resort
hotel.desc: Predator Ridge is a master-planned four-season resort community in the Okanagan Valley, about 15 minutes south of Vernon, offering vacation home rentals amid 36 holes of championship golf and an extensive trail network. Touring cyclists can rent bikes on-site and access trails connecting to Ellison Provincial Park and the Okanagan Rail Trail, with a shuttle service also available. The resort serves as a natural basecamp for Okanagan wine country, with eight award-winning wineries on the nearby Scenic Sip Wine Route within a short ride or drive.

detail.address: 301 Village Centre Place, Vernon, BC V1H 1T2

notes.Nearby evening food: RANGE restaurant, bar + patio and Pallino's are both on-site at the resort; Commonage Market also on property
notes.Nearby grocery: Commonage Market is an on-site market at the resort

hotel.name: Creston Valley Motel
hotel.desc: Creston Valley Motel — self-described as the 'Clean to the Corners' motel — sits just east of downtown Creston within walking distance of pubs, coffee shops, and restaurants, making it a convenient overnight stop on BC's southern interior routes. The property offers a range of room types from single-bed units to full kitchen suites, a drive-through parking lot that accommodates trailers and RVs, and free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout. Pet-friendly rooms are available on request, and the about page notes walking distance to Creston's hospital for any emergencies.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'within walking distance from the local pubs, coffee shops and restaurants' and about page reiterates 'Walking distance from local pub'
notes.Vending machines: Room pages state 'Vending machines with drinks are provided on the property'
notes.Wi-Fi: Front page: 'Extremely fast internet and wi-fi is free for motel guests'; about page: 'High Speed Internet and Wi-Fi in our rooms at no charge'; room pages list 'Free WiFi' in room details

hotel.name: Embarc Vancouver
hotel.desc: Embarc Vancouver is a Hilton Grand Vacations (formerly Diamond Resorts) vacation ownership resort situated in downtown Vancouver, offering studio and one- and two-bedroom suite accommodations with kitchenettes or full kitchens. The property is steps from Stanley Park, the Seawall, Granville Island, and the Vancouver Art Gallery, making its location appealing to cyclists exploring the city. As a vacation membership product, it is unclear whether the property accepts standard overnight bookings from independent travellers.

hotel.name: Fairfield Inn & Suites West Kelowna
hotel.desc: Fairfield Inn & Suites West Kelowna is a Marriott-branded hotel located on Carrington Road in West Kelowna. It offers the standardized mid-range service typical of the Fairfield Inn chain. A familiar accommodation option for touring cyclists seeking reliable chain hotel service.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Langley
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Langley is a 3-level hotel providing standard chain accommodation in Langley. The property offers Wi-Fi access. Touring cyclists should contact the hotel directly to discuss bike storage and handling options.

hotel.name: Mount View Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Oliver, BC offering overnight accommodation to travelers in the South Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Opus
hotel.desc: OPUS Vancouver is a 96-room boutique luxury hotel in Yaletown, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler (Top Hotel in Western Canada 2025) and Forbes Travel Guide. The property features on-site Italian dining at Capo and a cocktail bar (The Spritz), along with spa bathrooms, digital check-in, and dog-friendly policies. A touring cyclist overnighting here would find an upscale urban base steps from Vancouver's restaurant and shopping district, though no cycling-specific services are advertised.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Capo restaurant serves Italian lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch; The Spritz cocktail bar also on-site

hotel.name: Surf Motel
hotel.desc: A small, family-operated oceanfront motel built in 1960, perched on Dallas Road with 180-degree views of the snow-capped Olympic Mountains across the Strait of Juan de Fuca. All rooms include kitchenettes, oceanfront balconies, and free off-street parking. The motel is within walking distance of Victoria's Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park, and sits on a main bus route.

hotel.name: Artisan Suites on Bowen
hotel.desc: Artisan Suites on Bowen is a smoke-free, pet-free, self-check-in boutique hotel offering four individually designed suites on Bowen Island, located in the commercial hub of Artisan Square roughly 800 m from the ferry dock. The property is accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver, making it a natural stopover for cyclists touring the island. Guests staying more than one night are asked to leave upper parking spaces free for day shoppers, suggesting some awareness of visitor turnover.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple dinner venues listed on /todo page within Artisan Square and the cove: Barcelona Tapas & Wine Bar, The Bowen Pub (open 7 days/week lunch and dinner), Doc Mogan's (seafood, pasta, steaks & salads), and others

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express is a chain hotel in Golden, BC offering accommodation to traveling cyclists. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi access. Specific services and facilities for touring cyclists could not be verified from available sources.

hotel.name: Exchange Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The EXchange Hotel Vancouver is a luxury boutique hotel occupying the former Vancouver Stock Exchange building, recognized as Vancouver's first LEED Platinum heritage conversion. The historic Art Deco structure has been transformed by an international architectural collaboration and is now listed in the Michelin Guide and featured by Condé Nast Traveler. Situated in the core of downtown Vancouver, it is less than 200 metres from Waterfront SkyTrain station and 350 metres from the cruise ship terminal.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining includes Hydra Estiatorio Mediterranean & Bar, Bar Hydra, and Hydra Café, all located within the hotel

hotel.name: Whale's Tail Guest Suites
hotel.desc: Whale's Tail Guest Suites offers condo-style vacation rentals in the heart of Ucluelet, with one, two, and three bedroom suites featuring full kitchens that provide a genuine home-away-from-home experience. The property sits within walking distance of the Wild Pacific Trail, restaurants, and local tour operators, making it a convenient base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park and the coast. Guests have complimentary access to the adjacent West Coast Fitness Centre, a 3,000 sq ft facility with indoor pool, sauna, and harbour views.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states suites are 'within easy walking distance to restaurants.'

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Riverport Richmond
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express & Suites is a 147-room chain property in Richmond's Riverport area on Number 6 Road. It offers convenient overnight lodging for touring cyclists traveling through the Lower Mainland.

hotel.name: Barclay Hotel
hotel.desc: The Barclay Hotel is a 3-storey heritage-style property with 85 guestrooms on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, positioned between Stanley Park, the Vancouver Art Gallery, and Pacific Centre Mall. It markets itself as a comfortable, affordable base in the heart of the city, steps from the Seawall — a major cycling route. The Den cocktail bar is on-site, and Cora's Restaurant sits immediately next door for meals.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website cites 'Robson Street's amazing dining and shopping experiences'; on-site The Den offers cocktails; Cora's Restaurant is next door

hotel.name: Four Seasons Resort Whistler
hotel.desc: Four Seasons Resort Whistler is a luxury hotel in central Whistler, operated by the Four Seasons brand. It provides free wireless internet access to guests. The property serves as full-service accommodation in the heart of Whistler.

hotel.name: Best Budget Inn & Suites Kamloops
hotel.desc: Budget motel chain location on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops. Basic roadside accommodation convenient for travelers on the highway corridor.

hotel.name: Clayoquot Retreat
hotel.desc: Clayoquot Retreat is a three-bedroom cedar A-frame cabin set on a private 0.4-acre old-growth property just a two-minute walk from South Chesterman Beach and its surf break. The rustic but updated cabin features a wood-burning stove, outdoor hot tub, fire pit, and a surf/wetsuit drying rack, making it a comfortable base for beach-going, surfing, and exploring the Tofino coastline. It is a fully self-catering rental listed on Airbnb, VRBO, and the local BlueCrush platform.

notes.Drying area: Amenities page explicitly lists a 'surf/wetsuit drying rack' outside the cabin
notes.Bike wash / hose: Amenities page lists an 'outdoor hot shower' described for post-surf use; could serve as a bike rinse point

hotel.name: Auberge Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Auberge Vancouver Hotel occupies the historic Terminal City Tower in downtown Vancouver, rising above Burrard Inlet with sweeping views of the harbour and North Shore mountains. It is a full-service luxury property featuring a 25-metre indoor pool, fitness centre, squash courts, saunas, and steam rooms, positioned steps from the Canada Place seawall and cycling paths leading toward Stanley Park. Touring cyclists will find the central location convenient to Vancouver's main waterfront cycling corridors and the historic streets of Gastown.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Area Dining' as a hotel feature and the Gastown attractions subpage names multiple nearby restaurants within walking distance, including Cork & Fin, L'Abbattoir, Meat & Bread, and others

hotel.name: Middle Beach Lodge At The Headland
hotel.desc: Middle Beach Lodge occupies 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront just outside Tofino, offering two lodges, twenty self-contained rustic cabins, and distinctive treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property encompasses nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system designed for slow, quiet exploration. Touring cyclists are 3 kilometres from Tofino's village services and can dine on-site at the Headlands Lounge.

detail.address: 400 MacKenzie Beach Road, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner daily; website states 'Starting at 11:30 am each day, the Headlands Lounge at Middle Beach Lodge invites you to order from our new Lunch and Dinner menus.'

hotel.name: First Tracks Lodge
hotel.desc: First Tracks Lodge is an upscale ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood, offering spacious designer suites ranging from one to four bedrooms, each with full kitchens. The property sits at the base of the Whistler Gondola and features four-season pools, hot tubs, and a lobby library, making it one of the more refined lodging options in Creekside. Touring cyclists visiting Whistler's world-class trail network would find it a quiet, well-appointed base away from the bustle of Whistler Village.

hotel.name: Hidden Cove Lodge
hotel.desc: Hidden Cove Lodge is an off-the-grid, ocean-front eco-lodge nestled in the rainforests of Northern Vancouver Island on Johnstone Strait, powered by wind, solar, and generator. The property offers ocean-side cottages and a dining room, and has held TripAdvisor's Certificate of Excellence since 2013. It sits in a remote and spectacular wildlife corridor — orca, humpback whales, and grizzly bears are common draws — making it a notable destination lodge for cyclists exploring the northern Island Highway corridor.

detail.address: 1 Hidden Cove Road, Telegraph Cove, V0N 2R0

hotel.name: Apple Tree Inn
hotel.desc: Apple Tree Inn is a family-oriented motel tucked between Okanagan and Skaha lakes in Penticton, BC, offering kitchen suites and sleeper units alongside a seasonal outdoor heated pool and free barbecues. Its location on Skaha Lake Road puts cyclists within a short ride of the beach, wine country, and the broader Okanagan Valley touring network.

detail.address: 2406 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6E9

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry Service listed on room-services page
notes.Nearby evening food: Room-services page states 'Close Proximetry to a Variety of Restaurant Choices'

hotel.name: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing Company
hotel.desc: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing Company is Squamish's original craft brewery, founded in 1996 with the help of John Mitchell — the 'grandfather of micro-brewing' — and has since won awards at the Canadian Brewing Awards, North American Brewer's Awards, and BC Beer Awards. The 20-room boutique inn occupies the upper floor of the brewpub building in Downtown Squamish, giving guests immediate access to craft beer and a full kitchen without leaving the property. Pet-friendly rooms are available, and the location puts guests within walking distance of the Stawamus Chief and Sea to Sky trail networks.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site brewpub and taphouse in the same building; rooms page states all room types include 'access to Howe Sound Brewing and Brewpub.'

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Abbotsford BC
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Abbotsford BC is a budget motel on Sumas Way, well positioned along the Trans-Canada corridor as a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling through the Fraser Valley. The property includes a swimming pool and in-house laundry. Guests benefit from a noted 10% discount at the adjacent Abbey Road Taphouse.

notes.Nearby evening food: OSM description states Abbey Road Taphouse is nearby and guests receive a 10% discount on purchases there
notes.Wi-Fi: Not confirmed by website content

hotel.name: Lakeside Villa Inn and Suites
hotel.desc: Lakeside Villa is an owner-operated boutique motel tucked between Skaha and Okanagan Lakes in Penticton, featuring a private on-site Nordic Spa ('Skahä Nordic') with hot/cold therapy. Renovated suites range from studios to one-bedroom units, many with full kitchens and glimpses of Skaha Lake. The property includes private access to Barefoot Beach and explicitly provides storage for bikes, kayaks, and paddleboards — a practical stop for multi-day touring cyclists in the Okanagan.

detail.address: 4201 Skaha Lake Road, Penticton, BC V2A 0K4

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Guest Laundry' under property essentials

hotel.name: Christian Cove Lode
hotel.desc: Christian Cove Lodge is a secluded group retreat tucked away on Pitt Lake, designed for gatherings such as weddings, family reunions, and corporate retreats. It accommodates groups of 10 or more, with a private suite available for smaller parties, and an onsite caretaker to ensure a smooth stay. Its remote lakeside setting and modern comforts make it a distinctive stop for cyclists exploring the Pitt Meadows area.

hotel.name: The Craigmyle
hotel.desc: The Craigmyle is a heritage boutique hotel with 15 individually decorated rooms and suites, situated two minutes' walk from Craigdarroch Castle in Victoria's Rockland neighbourhood. It operates on a no-daily-housekeeping model, emphasises environmental sustainability (chemical-free laundry, linen reuse program), and offers flexible self-check-in/check-out — practical for cyclists arriving on their own schedule. The property explicitly warns of many stairs throughout the building, which is worth noting for cyclists travelling with heavily loaded bikes.

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry room available on-site; website states 'Fresh towels are available at any time in our guest laundry room.'
notes.Luggage storage: Website states: 'You may make arrangements with our Innkeeper to leave your luggage with us safely if you arrive earlier or wish to leave later.'

hotel.name: Wingate by Wyndham Kamloops
hotel.desc: Wingate by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-scale Wyndham-brand hotel situated on Rogers Way in Kamloops, a city that sits at the confluence of the North and South Thompson Rivers and is a common overnight stop on the TransCanada touring route. As part of the Wingate chain, the property targets business and leisure travellers with extended-stay-style amenities. Its location on the eastern edge of the city provides reasonable access to the Trans-Canada corridor.

notes.Wi-Fi: Website content did not surface amenity details to

hotel.name: Oasis Inn
hotel.desc: Oasis Inn is a family-run motel on Gordon Drive in central Kelowna with over 25 years of continuous operation at the same location. All rooms include A/C, fridge, microwave, and wireless internet, and the property offers on-site coin-op laundry. Its central Kelowna position puts cycling tourists close to the city's beaches, wineries, and Okanagan trail networks.

notes.Laundry: On-site coin-op laundry mentioned on website front page

hotel.name: Woodlands Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Woodlands Inn & Suites is Fort Nelson's locally owned hotel at Mile 300 on the Alaska Highway, a natural waypoint for cyclists traversing northern British Columbia. The four-storey property offers spacious pet-friendly rooms—many with full kitchens and living areas—alongside complimentary breakfast, an on-site restaurant and lounge, a fitness centre, and a steam room. A 24/7 lobby store stocked with snacks, frozen meals from M&M Food Market Express, and personal care items, plus an on-site liquor store, adds practical convenience for long-haul travelers.

notes.Laundry: Listed in amenities page title: 'Hotel Amenities | Fitness Centre, Restaurant, Laundry, Extended Stay Services'
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary breakfast included with stay, featuring waffles, omelettes, sausages, fresh pastries, cereal, yogurt, fruit, coffee, tea, and juices
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site One Restaurant and 1 Lounge offer dinner and casual evening fare

hotel.name: Western Lodge
hotel.desc: Western Lodge is a boutique hotel in Kimberley, BC, situated close to the ski hill and a short distance from downtown. The property hosts The Porch, an on-site restaurant and bar located downstairs offering home-cooked meals and cocktails. The hotel also markets itself as a flexible event venue and appears to be run by LPI Hospitality Group.

detail.address: 2665 Warren Avenue, Kimberley, British Columbia V1A 1T7, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: The Porch restaurant is located on-site downstairs, open Wed–Sun, serving meals, cocktails, and snacks

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Emerald Isle
hotel.desc: A two-storey pet-friendly hotel situated in the heart of Sidney-by-the-Sea, a short walk from the waterfront, local bookshops, and restaurants of this charming Vancouver Island town. The property offers complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals so guests can explore the Saanich Peninsula without their own wheels, alongside a fitness centre stocked with Peloton equipment. It serves as a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing via the nearby BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal.

detail.address: 2306 Beacon Avenue, Sidney, British Columbia V8L 1X2

notes.Laundry: Self-serve guest laundry facilities available; coin-operated machines with detergent available at the front desk

hotel.name: Four Seasons Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned budget motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, operating since the 1970s with 34 ground-floor rooms. Kitchenettes with microwaves and fridges make it practical for self-catering travellers, and a heated outdoor pool and whirlpool offer a welcome end-of-day recovery option. It sits next door to restaurants and five minutes from downtown, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley corridor.

detail.address: 1767 Trans Canada Hwy E, Kamloops, BC V2C 3Z6

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry listed on amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page states 'Restaurants (next door)'

hotel.name: Crown Resort Motel
hotel.desc: A motel on Penticton's West Lakeshore Drive offering standard overnight accommodation. The location on a main waterfront road may be convenient for cycling tourists traveling through the Okanagan.

hotel.name: Nomad Motel
hotel.desc: A compact motel in Clinton along the Cariboo Highway. Basic roadside accommodation for travelers passing through the Cariboo region.

hotel.name: Sandman Signature Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sandman Signature Hotel & Suites Langley is a full-service hotel offering a range of room types from standard rooms to loft and jacuzzi suites, many with kitchenettes or full kitchens. It holds a GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices measured against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Touring cyclists will find an on-site restaurant (Moxies), indoor pool, 24-hour front desk, and free parking, though bike-specific services are not documented online.

notes.Laundry: Washer/dryer included in Standard Suite (1 King Bed, Sofa Bed, Kitchen) room type per website room listings
notes.Nearby evening food: Moxies restaurant on-site with room service available, listed as a hotel amenity
notes.Device charging: USB charging ports listed as a room feature in the Standard Room description

hotel.name: Port-O-Call Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Port-O-Call Inn & Suites is a 42-unit motel on Terminal Avenue North in Nanaimo, positioned minutes from the city's ferry terminals and major highway routes. Part of the Roadside Hospitality portfolio, it offers four room categories ranging from standard queens to family suites, all equipped with mini fridges, microwaves, and coffee machines, with suites adding a full kitchenette. The property markets itself to ferry travellers, road trippers, and extended-stay guests including snowbirds, making it a practical stopover point on Vancouver Island.

detail.address: 505 Terminal Ave N, Nanaimo BC V9S 4K1

hotel.name: Hilton Vancouver Airport Hotel
hotel.desc: A 16-storey full-service Hilton property situated in Richmond adjacent to Vancouver International Airport. The hotel serves travellers connecting through YVR and sits within Richmond's extensive cycling network, making it a plausible overnight stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As a flagship Hilton brand hotel it offers a broad range of on-site services, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities could not be confirmed.

hotel.name: Grandview Motel
hotel.desc: Grandview Motel is a family-owned and operated two-storey motel situated on a quiet street about 700 m from downtown Kamloops in the Thompson Valley. Guests enjoy rooms with fridges, coffee makers, flat-screen TVs, and optional kitchenettes, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool, gas BBQs, and a shaded picnic area. Pet-friendly and centrally located near Thompson Rivers University and Royal Inland Hospital, it offers a practical and affordable overnight base for cyclists moving through the interior of BC.

hotel.name: Victorian Hotel
hotel.desc: Built in 1897 at the height of Vancouver's Gold Rush era, the Victorian Hotel is the oldest hotel in the city, a meticulously restored four-story brick heritage building in the heart of downtown. Its 42 rooms blend original exposed brick walls, Victorian mouldings, and grand ceilings with Canadian oak hardwood floors and contemporary furnishings. Ideally situated steps from Gastown, Yaletown, and BC Place, it offers touring cyclists a historically rich and centrally located base in one of Canada's most cycling-friendly cities.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Italian restaurant listed as a hotel feature on the website amenities list

hotel.name: Penticton Lakeside Resort
hotel.desc: Penticton Lakeside Resort & Conference Centre sits on the shores of Okanagan Lake, offering a private licensed beach, marina, boat rentals, pool, hot tub, and a floating sauna. Three on-site restaurants — The Bufflehead Cafe, The Barking Parrot Bar, and The Hooded Merganser — all have pet-friendly patios, and the resort is steps from Okanagan Lake Park and surrounding trail networks. It serves as a full-service base for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan wine country and rail trails.

detail.address: 21 Lakeshore Drive West, Penticton, BC V2A 7M5

notes.Nearby evening food: Three on-site restaurants: The Bufflehead Cafe, The Barking Parrot Bar, and The Hooded Merganser; all offer pet-friendly patios

hotel.name: Tower Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: The Tower Inn is described as the finest full-service hotel in Quesnel, located in the heart of the historic Cariboo Gold Rush country. It was selected as the overnight stop for the Rocky Mountaineer train on its Whistler-to-Jasper route, reflecting its standing as the city's premier lodging option. Touring cyclists staying here are a short walk from downtown shopping, restaurants, and local attractions.

notes.Laundry: Same-day laundry service and same-day dry cleaning listed in hotel amenities on /amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Begbie's Bar and Bistro serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with seating for up to 70 people
notes.Vending machines: Vending machine listed in hotel amenities on /amenities page

hotel.name: Radisson Hotel
hotel.desc: A 3-star Radisson Hotel in Fort St. John, part of the Choice Hotels chain. This mid-range hotel provides standard overnight accommodation for travelers passing through northern BC. It offers a convenient stop for cyclists touring the Alaska Highway corridor.

hotel.name: 2400 Motel
hotel.desc: The 2400 Motel is a mid-century motor court dating to 1946, set on 3.5 acres of landscaped grounds along Vancouver's Kingsway corridor in the Collingwood neighbourhood. Its 65 rooms and bungalows follow a detached layout with private entrances and free parking right at the door — an atmospheric alternative to high-rise hotels and a recognizable filming location for movies and TV. Touring cyclists will find it conveniently placed near transit, restaurants, and a mall, with pet-friendly rooms and full kitchens available in select units.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the Kingsway/Collingwood neighbourhood has 'lots of shops, restaurants, and a mall' nearby

hotel.name: Greystone Lodge
hotel.desc: Greystone Lodge is a boutique ski-in/ski-out accommodation at the base of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler, BC, offering individually owned and styled one- and two-bedroom suites managed on-site by Acer Vacation Rentals. It is a practical summer mountain-biking base as well as a winter destination, with secure bike storage, a heated saltwater pool, two hot tubs, and free underground parking in a building of only 50 units. Whistler Village is roughly a 7–10 minute walk or a short bus ride away, putting restaurants and grocery stores well within reach.

notes.Laundry: About Us page lists 'Coin-Operated Laundry' as a lodge amenity; confirmed in body text: 'There is a coin operated laundry facility in the building.'
notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states 'There are several restaurants within walking distance to Greystone Lodge'; site includes a dedicated Whistler Restaurants page
notes.Nearby grocery: FAQ explicitly references grocery stores in Whistler and recommends Nester's Market for pre-order delivery to the lodge
notes.Vending machines: About Us page lists 'Vending Machine' as a lodge amenity; body text confirms 'a vending machine for quick snacks.'

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza
hotel.desc: Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza is a six-storey full-service hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, shops, and dining. The property offers a range of room types from traditional rooms to family suites with full kitchens, catering to both short stays and extended visits. Valet parking with EV charging is available on-site, and guests note the walkable location and attentive front-desk staff.

hotel.name: Four Points by Sheraton Surrey
hotel.desc: A Four Points by Sheraton hotel in Surrey. As a branded mid-market hotel, it offers standard commercial accommodation services to business and leisure travelers passing through the region.

hotel.name: Hotel Rialto
hotel.desc: Hotel Rialto is a family-owned heritage boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, built on a dream by Italian immigrant Danilo Danzo who first visited in the late 1960s and later transformed the building into a love letter to his homeland. The five-storey property sits at the edge of Canada's oldest Chinatown, surrounded by eclectic local shops and walkable to Victoria's main attractions. The on-site Palms Inspired Kitchen and Cocktails is cited as one of the city's top restaurant and lounge experiences, with Vintage Spirits next door.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Palms Inspired Kitchen and Cocktails described as 'one of the top restaurant and lounges in the city — is just through the lobby'; website also notes hotel is surrounded by 'endless bars and restaurants'
notes.Luggage storage: Policies page states: 'Should you arrive early for check in, we can store your luggage until your room is ready to be occupied.'

hotel.name: Sundial Boutique Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sundial Hotel sits 75 metres from the Whistler Village Gondola in the heart of Whistler Village, with direct access to over 80 mountain biking trails and a prime position during events like Crankworx. Guests stay in spacious, fully-equipped suites — some with private hot tubs — designed for multi-day adventure stays. A dedicated ski and bike valet service handles equipment storage and heavy lifting throughout a guest's stay.

notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can store luggage free of charge during the day you check-in and check-out.'

hotel.name: Malahat Bungalows Motel
hotel.desc: Malahat Bungalows Motel is a roadside motel on the Trans-Canada Highway serving the Sidney area. It operates as bungalow-style accommodation, a format that can provide flexible overnight lodging for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Loon Lake Lodge and Retreat Centre
hotel.desc: Operated by the University of British Columbia, Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre is a year-round retreat and conference destination tucked inside the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest, less than an hour east of Vancouver. The property can accommodate up to 195 guests across several distinct buildings ranging from Whistler-style lodge facilities to dormitory-style student housing. A touring cyclist looking for a remote forest setting with on-site dining and multiple accommodation tiers would find this a distinctive overnight option near Golden Ears Provincial Park.

detail.address: 14500 Silver Valley Road, Maple Ridge, V4R 2R3

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel & Suites Kelowna
hotel.desc: Sandman Hotel & Suites is a branded chain hotel in Kelowna offering standard overnight accommodation. The property provides Wi-Fi access to guests.

hotel.name: Executive Suites Hotel and Resort Squamish
hotel.desc: Executive Suites Hotel & Resort is an all-suite, condo-style resort on the Sea to Sky Highway, 40 minutes from both Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stopover for cyclists riding the corridor. The property actively courts mountain bikers with a dedicated Stay & Bike package, front-desk trail maps, and suites large enough to bring bikes inside. With 111 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites each featuring full kitchens and private balconies, it offers touring cyclists more living space than a typical hotel room.

detail.address: 40900 Tantalus Road, Garibaldi Highlands Squamish, British Columbia, V8B 0R3

notes.Laundry: Extended-stay suites have 'Convenient in-suite laundry including washer and dryer' per /extended-stays/ page; unclear if standard suites also include in-suite laundry
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining mentioned on front page: 'Free Bird Table & Bar' and restaurant 'Norman Rudy's.'
notes.Bikes in rooms: Website /biking/ page: 'All suites are large enough that you can bring your bikes in for the night.'

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Victoria - Colwood
hotel.desc: A 5-level Holiday Inn Express & Suites franchise hotel in Colwood near Victoria. Standard mid-range hotel accommodation offering free wireless internet. Suitable as a basic overnight stop for touring cyclists in the greater Victoria region.

hotel.name: Old Towne Inne Chuckwagon Bar & Grill
hotel.desc: Old Towne Inne is a Western-themed motel and restaurant in Boston Bar, set at the heart of the Fraser Canyon on the Trans-Canada Highway. The property offers four self-contained cabins with kitchen facilities and private bathrooms, plus three additional rooms above the restaurant, making it one of the only lodging options in this small canyon town. The attached Chuckwagon Bar & Grill is a well-reviewed local institution famed for its burgers, homemade soup, and over-21 burger varieties.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Chuckwagon Bar & Grill serves lunch, dinner, and drinks; described as the only restaurant in Boston Bar

hotel.name: Meares Vista Inn
hotel.desc: Meares Vista Inn is a family-owned and operated motel on Campbell Street in Tofino, open since 2012 and self-described as 'simply clean and comfortable.' It offers four room configurations — Single Queen, Queen Suite, Upper Double Queen, and Lower Double Queen — and bills itself as an unpretentious, relaxed base for exploring Tofino's beaches and surrounding coastal wilderness. The owners also support local staff by providing space for RV living on the property.

detail.address: 760 Campbell Street, Tofino, BC, V0R 2Z0, Canada

hotel.name: Mountain Retreat
hotel.desc: Mountain Retreat Hotel & Suites is an 87-room full-service hotel in Squamish, BC, positioned on Progress Way near Highway 99 along the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. The property features an indoor heated pool with waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, an on-site restaurant and cocktail lounge (Timberwolf Restaurant and Lounge), and an attached Beer and Wine Store. It is dog-friendly and offers free parking including space for RVs, making it a comfortable and self-contained base for cyclists exploring the region.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page lists 'Laundromat, washer and dryer' on-site
notes.Nearby evening food: Timberwolf Restaurant and Lounge is on-site, offering dinner service and a cocktail lounge with a cedar bar and wall fireplace
notes.Vending machines: Amenities page lists 'soda, vending and ice machine available on two floors'
notes.Wi-Fi: Amenities page lists 'Complimentary WIFI available in public areas' and 'Complimentary in-room WIFI'

hotel.name: Coast Metro Vancouver Hotel
hotel.desc: The Coast Metro Vancouver Hotel is a newly rebranded, fully renovated property in Burnaby sitting directly beside the HWY 1 on-ramp and within walking distance of Rupert SkyTrain station, offering a 20-minute transit ride to downtown Vancouver. The two-level, elevator-free building features an open-air courtyard and garden, a 24-hour guest lounge with coffee station, and pet-friendly rooms with private balconies and views of the North Shore mountains or Vancouver cityscape. Its position at the Vancouver–Burnaby boundary makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland or staging longer trips east toward the Fraser Valley or west toward the North Shore and BC Ferries terminals.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website explicitly mentions 'shopping and dining at The Amazing Brentwood or Metropolis at Metrotown, BC's largest shopping centre' as nearby options

hotel.name: Lodestone Flats Motel
hotel.desc: Lodestone Flats is a boutique-style motel under new ownership in the small community of Tulameen, positioned just steps from Otter Lake and the Tulameen River in the Similkameen Valley. The property operates with self check-in and keyless entry—no front desk—and sits within walking distance of local trails and the community general store. Cyclists passing through the Similkameen will find it a convenient and low-fuss base for exploring the region's riding and outdoor recreation.

notes.Nearby grocery: Website states property is 'just steps away from...the general store'

hotel.name: Osborne Bay Resort
hotel.desc: Osborne Bay Resort is an oceanfront camping and cottage resort perched along the shores of Crofton, BC, offering full-service RV sites, log cottages with fully-equipped kitchens, a rentable 40-foot oceanfront RV, and beachside camping. Open year-round, it sits close to the Crofton ferry terminal—a convenient jumping-off point for Salt Spring Island—and within easy pedalling distance of the Cowichan Valley trail network and the Chemainus murals town. The resort's laundromat, free hot showers, and diverse lodging formats make it a practical multi-night base for touring cyclists exploring southern Vancouver Island.

detail.address: PO Box 391, 450 Charlotte St., Crofton, BC V0R 1R0

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundromat located at the log house by the park entrance; change available at office; extended hours can be arranged with staff

hotel.name: Naramata Courtyard Suites
hotel.desc: A renovated boutique motel in the heart of Naramata village, offering 9 micro-suites—4 with kitchenettes—arranged around a xeriscaped courtyard. Originally one of Naramata's earliest roadside motels, it has been reimagined as a self-catering retreat with keyless check-in and modern comforts. The property sits minutes from the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and is within walking distance of the beach, local cafes, and Okanagan wineries.

hotel.name: SureStay
hotel.desc: SureStay by Best Western is a mid-range hotel on Capilano Road in North Vancouver, situated roughly 22 miles from Vancouver International Airport and 16 miles from downtown Vancouver. It offers standard rooms and suites under the Best Western loyalty umbrella, with complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet included. Its location near the base of Capilano makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the North Shore or using the area as a staging point before or after crossing into Vancouver.

detail.address: 1634 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7P 3B4

hotel.name: Noble House Suites
hotel.desc: Noble House Suites is a two-room boutique bed & breakfast perched on the bank of the Granby River in Grand Forks, offering a Romance Room with a king bed and wheelchair accessibility and a Daly Room with two queen beds, each with an electric fireplace and soaker tub. Guests have full access to shared amenities including a hot tub, movie theater, full kitchen, and laundry facilities, and the property backs onto riverside walking trails. Hosts Sean and Kathy Noble also operate an on-site confectionery, Noble House Sweets, whose treats are offered to overnight guests.

notes.Laundry: Website states guests enjoy full access to laundry facilities on site

hotel.name: Villa Eyrie Resort
hotel.desc: Villa Eyrie Resort is a luxury mountain resort perched high above Finlayson Arm on the Malahat, with panoramic views stretching to the Olympic Mountains and Mount Baker. Inspired by Lake Como and Italian alpine architecture, the property features elegantly appointed suites, the Alpina Restaurant, a Tuscan Spa, and curated experiences including mushroom foraging and winery visits. Named among TripAdvisor's top 10% of hotels worldwide, it sits directly on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor between Victoria and the rest of Vancouver Island — a natural overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Langley
hotel.desc: Sandman Hotel Langley provides accommodation in Langley, BC with complimentary Wi-Fi for guests. As a hotel chain property, it offers standard lodging services to touring cyclists passing through the area. Specific details about bike storage and other touring-specific amenities cannot be verified due to website access issues.

hotel.name: 4 Pines Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned motel established in 1960 in the heart of Lillooet, 4 Pines Motel spans three buildings offering everything from budget rooms to honeymoon suites with jacuzzi and fireplace. Its downtown location puts touring cyclists within walking distance of Lillooet's services, and the motel sits along the scenic Highway 99 corridor connecting Whistler and the Interior. Rooms range from simple queens to full two-bedroom kitchen suites suited for longer stays.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states: 'With 4 Pines Motel's convenient on-site laundromat facilities, you'll never have to over-pack on clothing.'

hotel.name: Horstman House
hotel.desc: Horstman House is a boutique collection of one-to-three bedroom condominium-style residences perched on Blackcomb Mountain, steps from the Home Run trail and Lost Lake Park. Touted as one of Whistler's only true luxury private residence accommodations, it offers ski-in access and a free shuttle to both Whistler and Blackcomb lifts. The property sits close to Whistler Village and features in-unit full kitchens and washer/dryers, making extended stays comfortable for active travellers.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states rooms include 'washer/dryers'

hotel.name: Eagle Lodge
hotel.desc: Eagle Lodge is part of the Town Plaza Suites complex in Whistler Village North, offering studio, one- and two-bedroom condos with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and in-suite washer/dryers. It sits a short walk from both mountain gondolas and the Whistler Conference Centre, making it a convenient self-catering base for cyclists exploring the Sea to Sky corridor. The surrounding Village North puts restaurants, shops, and nightlife immediately at hand.

notes.Laundry: Website states all units include an in-suite washer/dryer
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'excellent restaurants, shops and nightclubs right on your doorstep' in Whistler Village North

hotel.name: Bluebird Motel
hotel.desc: A budget motel centrally located in Nanaimo, just five minutes' drive from the Departure Bay BC Ferries terminal — a key arrival and departure point for cyclists on the Vancouver Island route. Rooms include kitchens or kitchenettes and standard amenities including free WiFi. Restaurants and grocery stores are described as a short walk away.

detail.address: 995 Terminal Ave N, Nanaimo, BC V9S 4K3

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Restaurants, grocery stores, and amenities are all a short walk away.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'Restaurants, grocery stores, and amenities are all a short walk away.'
notes.Vending machines: Website states 'Vending machines offering drinks are available.'

hotel.name: Kokanee Glacier Resort
hotel.desc: Kokanee Glacier Resort is a resort-motel situated just outside Nelson, BC on Highway 3A, offering suites with full kitchens, living rooms, and bedrooms for a comfortable multi-night stay. It serves as a basecamp for the Kootenays' outdoor offerings—mountain biking, hiking, fishing, hot springs, skiing, and golf at several nearby courses. The property has an on-site restaurant and partners with local activity operators to round out a touring itinerary.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant promoted prominently on the homepage: 'Visit Kokanee Glacier Resort Restaurant Now!'

hotel.name: Round-Up Motel
hotel.desc: The Round-Up Motel is a two-storey property sitting right on Highway 97 (Cariboo Highway) at the south end of Clinton, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the historic Gold Rush Trail corridor. Rooms range from standard queen beds to full kitchen suites, and free parking accommodates vehicles towing trailers up to 50 feet. Clinton's small downtown — restaurants, pubs, a liquor store, grocery stores, and the Cariboo-area Clinton Museum — is all within easy walking distance of the motel.

notes.Nearby evening food: Activities page lists 4 restaurants (including 2 Western-style and a Chinese restaurant with Saturday buffet), plus 2 pubs, all described as within walking distance of the motel
notes.Nearby grocery: Activities page lists 'Grocery and Convenience stores' as within walking distance
notes.Device charging: Rooms page lists 'In-Wall USB charging ports in each room' as a standard room amenity

hotel.name: Fairmont Hotel Vancouver
hotel.desc: The Fairmont Hotel Vancouver is a landmark luxury property in the heart of downtown Vancouver, a grand chateau-style building that has anchored West Georgia Street since 1939. Part of the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts portfolio, it offers upscale accommodations alongside on-site dining, a spa, and fitness facilities. Its central location places touring cyclists within walking distance of the city core, the seawall, and major transit connections.

hotel.name: Vancouver Airport Marriott Hotel
hotel.desc: The Vancouver Airport Marriott is a full-service hotel in Richmond, located near Vancouver International Airport. It provides accommodation for cycling tourists and other travelers.

hotel.name: Waterfront Inn
hotel.desc: Waterfront Inn is one of three beachside motels under the Skaha Lake Motels group, situated steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. Rooms include air conditioning and kitchen or kitchenette options, and the motel is pet friendly. It sits directly across from Skaha Lake Park, which offers volleyball courts, a waterpark, and other public amenities. Note that check-in for all three properties is handled at the Beachside Motel at 3624 Parkview Street.

hotel.name: Holiday House Seaview Motel
hotel.desc: Holiday House Seaview Motel is a pet-friendly motel located on Esplanade Avenue in Ladysmith, a small harbour town on Vancouver Island's east coast roughly midway between Nanaimo and Duncan. The 'Seaview' name suggests ocean views over Ladysmith Harbour and the southern Gulf Islands. Its Esplanade Avenue address places it close to Ladysmith's waterfront, making it a convenient stop for cyclists on the Island's east-coast touring corridor.

hotel.name: Premiere Suites Victoria
hotel.desc: Premiere Suites Victoria is an extended-stay furnished apartment property aimed at corporate and relocation guests needing stays of 30 nights or more. Located on Johnson Street in downtown Victoria, it is part of the national Premiere Suites Alliance network of 10,000+ furnished suites across Canada. A touring cyclist staying here would have access to a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and a dedicated workspace in a residential-style setting.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'in-suite laundry' as a standard inclusion across the Alliance network

hotel.name: Adara Hotel
hotel.desc: The Adara Hotel is a modern boutique hotel in the heart of Whistler Village, steps from the base of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains. It features a rooftop heated outdoor pool, hot tub, and firepit open year-round, along with an in-house dining partnership with Stonesedge Kitchen. The hotel holds a Green Key Eco-Rating and is dog-friendly, making it a practical and comfortable base for cycling and multi-sport touring.

notes.Nearby evening food: In-house dining via Stonesedge Kitchen (mezzanine level, lunch/dinner/brunch); dining page also lists FireRock Lounge and Black's Pub as nearby evening options
notes.Luggage storage: Amenities page states 'Complimentary ski, golf, bike, and luggage storage.'

hotel.name: Motel 6 Kamloops
hotel.desc: Motel 6 Kamloops is a budget motel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, part of the well-known Motel 6 chain. It offers standard motel accommodation convenient for touring cyclists passing through the region.

hotel.name: Riviera Plaza & Conference Centre, Vernon, BC
hotel.desc: Riviera Plaza & Conference Centre is a hotel and conference facility in Vernon, BC. Website suspension prevents verification of current operations and cyclist amenities.

hotel.name: Alpine Inn
hotel.desc: A motel in Chilliwack offering overnight accommodation to traveling cyclists and other guests. Provides complimentary Wi-Fi to guests.

hotel.name: The Douglas, Autograph Collection
hotel.desc: The Douglas is an upscale hotel in downtown Vancouver offering full-service accommodation. Located on Smithe Street in the city core, it provides a central base for cyclists exploring Vancouver.

hotel.name: Swiss Sunset Inn
hotel.desc: Swiss Sunset Inn is a motel located on Skaha Lake Road in Penticton, a popular cycling destination in BC's Okanagan region. Positioned near Skaha Lake, it sits along a corridor frequently used by touring cyclists on routes such as the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and Okanagan wine country loops. The motel format typically offers ground-floor rooms and on-site parking, which can be convenient for cyclists with loaded bikes.

hotel.name: Retasket Lodge & RV Park
hotel.desc: Retasket Lodge & RV Park is a 20-room motel and 8-site RV park set on a hilltop above Lillooet, proudly owned and operated by the T'it'q'et First Nation, with 360-degree views over the Fraser River and surrounding mountains. The property also offers Seton Lake Cabins — four separate lakeside cabins with full kitchens, sleeping up to six — a short distance from Seton Lake's beach and boat launch. Lillooet sits at a crossroads of several major cycling routes and the amenities page calls out mountain biking, hiking, and gold panning among nearby activities.

hotel.name: Best Western Cowichan Valley Inn
