hotel.desc: The Best Western Cowichan Valley Inn is a full-service hotel in Duncan on Vancouver Island, positioned along the Cowichan Valley corridor as the area's flagship Best Western property. The on-site CVI Restaurant and Lounge provides sit-down dining, making it a convenient stop after a day of riding. As a well-established branded hotel it draws repeat visitors to the region north of Victoria.

detail.address: 6457 Norcross Road, Duncan, British Columbia V9L 6C6 Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site CVI Restaurant and Lounge described in hotel overview as offering 'some of the finest eating experiences in the Cowichan Valley'

hotel.name: Summerland Motel
hotel.desc: Summerland Motel is a beachside property in Summerland, BC, billed as the town's closest motel to Okanagan Lake and sitting right off the main highway. The motel offers a range of room types from standard doubles to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool and inner courtyard garden. It is a practical base for cyclists touring the Okanagan, with local dining, wineries, and a grocery store all nearby.

notes.Laundry: Guest testimonial on front page lists 'ice machine, laundry' among on-site amenities
notes.Nearby grocery: Guest testimonial on front page states 'Close to grocery store.'

hotel.name: Shoreline Condo Resort
hotel.desc: Shoreline Resort (marketed as Shoreline Condo Resort) sits directly adjacent to the sandy beach of Okanagan Lake in Penticton, offering studio through three-bedroom suites and condos. The property is within easy walking distance of downtown restaurants, wineries, breweries, and the South Okanagan Events Centre. Its beachfront location makes it a practical base for cyclists touring the Okanagan, with free parking and an outdoor pool rounding out the stay.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Guest Laundry' under Amenities Facilities & Services
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'Steps to … restaurants, wineries and breweries that Penticton is renowned for.'
notes.Vending machines: Website lists 'Pop Machines' under amenities

hotel.name: Aava Hotel
hotel.desc: Located two minutes' walk from Whistler Village and five minutes from the Whistler and Blackcomb Mountain gondolas, Aava Whistler markets itself as Whistler BC's bike-friendliest hotel, offering a dedicated bike vault, bike valet service, and a wash-and-tool station all at no charge. The hotel also features a heated pool, hot tub, and underground parking, making it a well-equipped basecamp for multi-day cycling adventures in the Sea-to-Sky corridor. It is dog-friendly and has accessible rooms, broadening its appeal to a wide range of touring cyclists.

notes.Basic tools: Website explicitly lists a 'wash and tool station' offered at no charge
notes.Bike wash / hose: Website explicitly lists a 'wash and tool station' offered at no charge

hotel.name: Hotel Squamish
hotel.desc: Hotel Squamish is a hotel in Squamish, British Columbia, a popular stop for touring cyclists in the province. The property is located on Second Avenue in the town center.

hotel.name: Executive Plaza Hotel
hotel.desc: The Executive Plaza Hotel is a 140-room boutique luxury hotel in Coquitlam, consistently ranked as a top TripAdvisor property and certified as a 3 Green Key Global sustainability partner. It offers contemporary rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows, an on-site restaurant and bar (The Wild Fig) with room service, and a rooftop pool deck with hot tub, steam room, and tennis court. Situated near Lougheed Mall, Highway 1, and public transit, it serves both business and leisure travellers in the Burnaby/Coquitlam/New Westminster corridor.

notes.Laundry: Laundry / Dry-cleaning service explicitly listed on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: The Wild Fig Restaurant & Bar is located in the hotel lobby; room service also available during operation hours

hotel.name: Woodside Inn
hotel.desc: Woodside Inn is a small, independently owned boutique motel on Mount Woodside near Harrison Mills, operating since 1958 and offering four individually decorated one-bedroom suites, each with a private entrance, kitchenette, full bathroom, and parking. The property sits above the confluence of the Harrison and Fraser rivers in a scenic Fraser Valley location renowned for salmon fishing, eagle watching, and paragliding. It is about 15 minutes from Harrison Hot Springs and 1.5 hours from Vancouver.

notes.Nearby evening food: Location page lists Rivers Edge Restaurant as approximately 3 minutes away

hotel.name: Strawberry Island Stays Tours Charters
hotel.desc: Strawberry Island is a unique floating-cabin resort located on a small island just 30 seconds by water taxi from downtown Tofino, offering three rentable cabins (Halibut House, Seabass Suite, Yellow House) as well as ocean fishing charters and island adventure tours including Hot Springs Cove. The operation has over 15 years of experience and is a distinctly West Coast experience combining private island accommodation with guided ocean activities. Access is exclusively by water, so touring cyclists would need to arrange bike transport to reach the cabins.

detail.address: 4th St, Strawberry Island Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

hotel.name: Sunshine Lodge Inn
hotel.desc: Sunshine Lodge is a small hotel located on North Road in Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast, a popular cycling destination accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay. The property is tagged in OpenStreetMap as offering Wi-Fi, though this cannot be independently confirmed. Its status and current operation are uncertain as the registered website now resolves to an unrelated personal blog.

hotel.name: The Inn at Tough City
hotel.desc: The Inn at Tough City is a distinctive waterfront boutique hotel in Tofino built largely from salvaged materials, including over 45,000 bricks from Vancouver's Gastown and stained-glass windows imported from Scotland. Its 8 individually decorated rooms look directly onto Clayoquot Sound, and the property includes an eclectic on-site sushi bar with an extensive menu of fresh local seafood. Founded roughly 30 years ago by 'Crazy Ron' and Johanna Vanderkley, the Inn is known for its relaxed, home-style atmosphere that stands apart from chain or resort hotels.

notes.Nearby evening food: Links page names several nearby restaurants as 'friends in town': SoBo (sobo.ca), Common Loaf (commonloaf.com), and Schooner Restaurant (schoonerrestaurant.ca)

hotel.name: Harrison Hot Springs Resort
hotel.desc: Harrison Hot Springs Resort is a landmark lakeside resort in Harrison Hot Springs, BC, built around five natural mineral pools averaging 1,300 parts per million of dissolved mineral solids — among the most concentrated in North America. The property includes a full-service spa, multiple restaurants ranging from a casual lakeside family restaurant to fine dining with nightly live entertainment, and wedding facilities. Touring cyclists arriving here encounter a classic BC resort destination on the shores of Harrison Lake with the coastal mountains as a backdrop.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site evening dining venues confirmed: The Copper Room (dinner with nightly live entertainment), Islands Patio & Lounge (cocktails and casual menu), and Gardenia (sushi, cocktails, fine dining)

hotel.name: Fairmont Pacific Rim
hotel.desc: A 5-star luxury hotel located in Vancouver's Canada Place waterfront development. A major chain property offering standard hotel amenities to touring cyclists, though specific bike storage and handling arrangements are unverified.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Quesnel
hotel.desc: The Sandman Hotel Quesnel is a newly renovated, full-service hotel in Quesnel, BC, part of the national Sandman chain, featuring an indoor pool, fitness centre, on-site Denny's Restaurant with room service, and 24-hour front desk. It has earned Silver GreenStep Sustainability Certification through a formal evaluation against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. For touring cyclists moving through the Cariboo region, it offers practical amenities including coin-operated laundry, free parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi across all room types.

notes.Laundry: Coin-Operated Laundry explicitly listed in the hotel amenities on the website
notes.Nearby evening food: Denny's Restaurant on-site with room service available, listed prominently in amenities and room descriptions
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed under room features on the Grand Room subpage

hotel.name: Brentwood Bay Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Brentwood Bay Resort & Spa is a 33-room adults-only luxury boutique resort perched on the edge of a glacial fjord on the Saanich Inlet, a short ride from downtown Victoria. The property is built around water-based experiences — a full marina with boat tours and a shuttle to The Butchart Gardens — alongside a spa with heated outdoor pools, thermal sauna, and cold plunge. Multiple on-site dining venues serving local Vancouver Island ingredients make it a self-contained recovery destination for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

detail.address: 849 Verdier Avenue, Victoria, British Columbia, V8M 1C5, Canada

notes.Early or packed breakfast: The Arbutus Room is explicitly listed as serving breakfast daily; in-room dining is also offered as a curated service
notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site venues — The Arbutus Room and The Lodge Kitchen & Bar — both serve dinner; The Lodge is walk-in only

hotel.name: Crystal Cove Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a long-established oceanfront resort on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins (several beachfront, with hot tubs and fireplaces), year-round fully serviced RV sites tucked under old-growth trees, and glamping in 5th-wheel trailers. Rated the #1 resort in Tofino by TripAdvisor, it sits steps from a kilometre of sandy coastline with an on-site coffee shop (Bean at the Cove). It is 100% pet-friendly, making it a welcoming base for cycle tourists exploring the remote western coast of Vancouver Island.

hotel.name: Valemount Hotel
hotel.desc: Valemount Hotel is located on the main street of Valemount, a small community in north-central BC along the Yellowhead Highway. The hotel provides overnight accommodation for touring cyclists and other travelers passing through this remote region. Its main-street location makes it accessible to cyclists navigating regional tour routes.

hotel.name: The Cabins at Terrace Beach
hotel.desc: The Cabins at Terrace Beach is a west coast cabin resort established in 2002, perched above Terrace Beach in Ucluelet with direct access to the Wild Pacific Trail's Lighthouse Loop. The property offers a range of accommodation from contemporary passive-built oceanfront cabins with Pacific views to rainforest loft cabins nestled in old-growth forest, most of which are pet friendly and include private parking stalls. Touring cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor would find it a scenic basecamp with immediate trail access and a full kitchen in every unit.

hotel.name: Langley Hwy Hotel
hotel.desc: A hotel in Langley providing overnight accommodation for touring cyclists. Located on 88 Avenue in a semi-rural area, it serves as a convenient rest stop for cyclists traveling the region.

hotel.name: Coal River RV & Lodge
hotel.desc: Coal River Services RV Park & Lodge sits at the confluence of the Coal and Liard Rivers on the Alaska Highway in the Northern Rockies of BC, roughly 30 minutes north of Liard Hot Springs. Originally built in 1949, the property offers lodge rooms, full-hookup RV sites, dry camping, and an on-site cafe famous for bison burgers. It is one of the few full-service stops for long-haul travellers on this remote stretch of the Alcan.

detail.address: Mile 533 Alaska Highway, Coal River, V0C 1Z0

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundromat on site; website states 'a small coin-operated laundromat if you just can't stand one more day!'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site cafe serving home-cooked menu items including bison burgers and bison jerky

hotel.name: Arundel Mansion
hotel.desc: Arundel Mansion is a heritage building constructed in 1910 in downtown New Westminster, offering Edwardian-era furnished suites decorated in craftsman style with bay windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, and vintage claw-foot tubs. The property also manages the adjacent Towle House Victorian rental homes and a rentable restaurant suite, giving it an unusually eclectic character. New Westminster's SkyTrain connections place central Vancouver about 20 minutes away, making this a historically rich base for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Restaurants, shops, bars, night club, buses and skytrain are only a stone's throw away.'

hotel.name: The Inn at the Union Club
hotel.desc: The Inn at the Union Club is the guest accommodation wing of the Union Club of British Columbia, a heritage private members' club founded in 1879 and situated in the heart of downtown Victoria near the inner harbour. The inn offers 22 guest rooms and suites and is open to Union Club members and their guests, as well as members of more than 400 affiliated clubs worldwide. Guests receive access to the club's Executive Fitness Centre, billiards room, rooftop terrace, and dining facilities as part of their stay.

hotel.name: Reynolds Hotel
hotel.desc: Reynolds Hotel is a historic boutique hotel built in 1941 in Lillooet, BC, set against the backdrop of the Coast Mountain Range and Fraser Canyon. Extensively renovated with locally cut and milled wood floors and antiques throughout, it blends period character with modern room amenities. Rated one of the top 10 sleeps on the Sea-to-Sky Corridor by 99 North Magazine, it also features an on-site restaurant and pub serving home-cooked meals.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Reynolds Restaurant (home-cooked meals) and Reynolds Pub both operate evenings on select days of the week

hotel.name: Le Chamois
hotel.desc: Le Chamois is a boutique ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's upper Village, situated steps from Blackcomb Mountain's Wizard and Magic chair lifts. Rooms feature in-suite kitchenettes, mountain or courtyard views, and European-inflected décor. It positions itself as a four-season base camp — summer guests have direct access to mountain biking and hiking trails alongside on-site bike rentals through lodge shops.

notes.Laundry: Front page amenities list explicitly includes 'Self-Serve Laundry'
notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page references 'on-site restaurant' as part of the property's features
notes.Device charging: Amenities page lists 'Fitness center with gym, charging station' among property features

hotel.name: Embarc
hotel.desc: Now operating as Hilton Grand Vacations Club Whistler, this landscaped resort sits adjacent to a designated nature preserve with views of Blackcomb Mountain. It offers suite-style accommodations ranging from studios to 3-bedroom units, each with kitchenette or full kitchen facilities and private balconies. The surrounding area provides direct access to Whistler's trail network, and the concierge material specifically references cycling through the area's winding trails.

notes.Laundry: Listed explicitly as an amenity on the resort's amenities section of the website

hotel.name: Chute Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Chute Lake Lodge is a historic mountain resort perched above the Naramata Bench, situated directly along the Kettle Valley Railway corridor — one of BC's most celebrated multi-day cycling routes. Originally built around 1920 as a logger's bunkhouse and rail water stop, it now offers a range of accommodation from rustic cabins and lodge rooms to yurts and glamping tents. The lodge rents e-bikes and offers cycling distance information to Penticton and Kelowna, making it a natural basecamp for KVR touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan highlands.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily; lodge page notes elevated dinner offerings for special and group events

hotel.name: Moby Dick Inn
hotel.desc: The Moby Dick Inn is a 63-room family hotel in Prince Rupert, strategically located minutes from the BC and Alaska Ferry Terminals and the Via Rail Station, making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The property offers a fully licensed on-site restaurant with room service and a reputation for breakfast, plus guest laundry and kitchenette rooms. Prince Rupert sits at the northern terminus of the BC Ferries Inside Passage route, a key gateway for cycle-touring the north coast.

notes.Laundry: On-site guest laundry room confirmed: 'The Moby Dick Inn has an on-site laundry room available for our guests.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site licensed restaurant serves meals daily: 'Our crew serves excellent meals daily in a bright informal setting. Fully licensed.'

hotel.name: Pan Pacific Whistler Village Centre
hotel.desc: Pan Pacific Whistler Village Centre is a luxury full-service hotel situated at the heart of Whistler Village on Blackcomb Way, part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group chain. Its village-centre location places guests steps from Whistler's extensive trail network and the Valley Trail multi-use path. The property is undergoing elevator maintenance through mid-2026 but remains fully operational.

hotel.name: Shawnigan Lake Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Shawnigan Lake Beach Resort is a privately owned and operated lakefront condo resort on six and a half acres along Shawnigan Lake on Vancouver Island, about 30 minutes north of Victoria. It is the only beach-side resort on the lake, offering direct beach access, watercraft mooring, an indoor pool, and a range of lawn and court sports. Accommodations are individually owner-managed condos, each fully self-contained with a kitchen and private deck with barbecue.

detail.address: 2046 Widows Walk, Shawnigan Lake, BC V8H 2G5

notes.Laundry: Website states each condo includes an in-suite washer and dryer

hotel.name: Cox Bay Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Cox Bay Beach Resort is a 40-suite beachfront property on the Pacific Rim Highway just outside Tofino, offering one- and two-bedroom self-contained beach house suites with full kitchens and in-suite laundry. The resort sits steps from Cox Bay Beach, a world-class surf break, and features an infrared sauna, outdoor hot tub, fitness centre, and lookout pavilion overlooking the Pacific. It caters to surfers, families, and outdoor travellers seeking a base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve.

detail.address: 1431 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry listed as a unit feature for one-bedroom beach houses; assumed consistent across unit types

hotel.name: Best Western Mountainview Inn
hotel.desc: A three-storey Best Western hotel in Golden, BC, positioned as a gateway to Yoho and Kootenay National Parks and the Trans-Canada Highway corridor through the Rockies. The hotel features a lobby fireplace, indoor pool, business center, and complimentary breakfast included with every stay. Touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley will find it a comfortable full-service base in a town well-placed between major mountain passes.

hotel.name: Ramada Kelowna Hotel and Conference Centre
hotel.desc: A full-service 135-room hotel and conference centre situated on Harvey Avenue in central Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard rooms to themed and loft suites. The property includes Mickie's Pub & Patio, an on-site sports pub and restaurant, and conference facilities capable of hosting up to 350 guests. Its location near the Okanagan Valley's wineries and the region's largest shopping mall makes it a convenient overnight stop for touring cyclists exploring the interior.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'laundry service' as a standard room amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Mickie's Pub & Patio is an on-site sports pub and restaurant open to guests, with a patio option

hotel.name: Panda Pod Hotel
hotel.desc: A hotel in Richmond. Specific amenities and cyclist services could not be verified due to website access failure.

hotel.name: Hope Inn and Suites
hotel.desc: Hope Inn and Suites is a hotel in Hope on Old Hope-Princeton Way, providing overnight accommodation for travelers passing through the community.

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express Vancouver-Metrotown (Burnaby)
hotel.desc: Holiday Inn Express Vancouver-Metrotown is a chain hotel in Burnaby's Metrotown commercial district offering standard accommodations. It provides a reliable overnight option for cycling tourists traveling through the region.

hotel.name: Skwachàys Lodge
hotel.desc: Skwachàys Lodge is Vancouver's Indigenous boutique hotel, transformed from a derelict SRO into a social enterprise that pairs 18 uniquely designed guest rooms with on-site housing and studio space for 24 Indigenous artists. Each room is a collaboration between a top hotel designer and an Indigenous artist, making the hotel itself a functioning gallery. It sits at the crossroads of Gastown, Chinatown, and Railtown, placing guests in the heart of Vancouver's historic east side.

detail.address: 31 West Pender Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 1R3

hotel.name: Prestige Rocky Mountain Resort Best Western Premier Collection
hotel.desc: The Prestige Rocky Mountain Resort is a full-service 111-room hotel in Cranbrook offering a range of room types including kitchenette suites and the novelty of sleeping in a repurposed train car. The property features two on-site restaurants (Fire and Oak and BRIXX Brewhouse), a spa, indoor pool, hot tub, and athletic centre. Positioned just off the main highway, it serves as a well-appointed base for cyclists exploring the East Kootenay region.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurants Fire and Oak and BRIXX Brewhouse confirmed in hotel overview text

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Chateau Fort St. John
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Chateau Fort St. John is a modern, full-service hotel positioned directly on Alaska Highway 97, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists travelling the iconic highway corridor through northeast BC. The property offers kitchenette-equipped rooms and a complimentary full hot breakfast, giving touring cyclists options for self-catering and a hot start to the day. Fort St. John bills itself as the 'Energetic City' and serves as the main service hub for the Peace Country, so most supplies and services a cyclist might need are close at hand.

hotel.name: The Sutton Place Hotel
hotel.desc: The Sutton Place Hotel is a full-service luxury hotel located in downtown Vancouver's Burrard Street corridor, offering room tiers ranging from standard Sutton Rooms to multi-bedroom suites with soaker tubs and wet bars. The property features an indoor heated pool, Vida Spa, a dedicated wine merchant, and the on-site Boulevard Kitchen & Oyster Bar. Touring cyclists would find a full concierge, onsite laundry, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property, though no cycling-specific facilities are advertised.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page explicitly lists 'Onsite laundry' and 'Same day dry cleaning'

hotel.name: Westin Bayshore
hotel.desc: The Westin Bayshore is a Marriott chain hotel located in Vancouver's Bayshore neighborhood. It's a full-service hotel providing standard accommodations to various travelers. For a touring cyclist, it represents a mainstream hotel option in Vancouver.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Burnaby Hotel
hotel.desc: A newly renovated Best Western Plus hotel on Kingsway in central Burnaby, positioned minutes from Metropolis at Metrotown — the Vancouver area's largest shopping mall. The property markets comfort and convenience for travelers exploring Greater Vancouver, with easy access to transit and urban amenities. Its location on a major arterial corridor makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver region.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website describes Metropolis at Metrotown as nearby, mentioning 'world class retail, restaur[ants]' accessible from the hotel

hotel.name: Fred Tibbs Vacation Rentals
hotel.desc: Fred Tibbs Condo Hotel is a strata hotel on Main Street in central Tofino, purpose-built as tourist accommodation in 1997, where each unit is individually owned and managed through various rental companies or OTAs. The two-storey building offers studio and loft suites with ocean views, a ground-floor café and bakery, and a kayak and canoe launch. Its walkable location puts touring cyclists steps from Tofino's restaurants, shops, and the waterfront.

notes.Laundry: 'Common laundry facilities' listed under AMENITIES on /stays.html
notes.Nearby evening food: Website and multiple guest reviews confirm the building is 'walkable to shops, restaurants' in central Tofino

hotel.name: Divya Sutra Suites on Robson Downtown Vancouver
hotel.desc: Divya Sutra Suites is an 11-story boutique hotel on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, offering 41 rooms ranging from queen suites to multi-bedroom penthouses, many with full kitchens suitable for self-catering touring cyclists. The location places guests within walking distance of Stanley Park and the world-class seawall cycling network. The hotel is pet-friendly (dogs under 20 lb) and offers 24-hour self-parking with both outdoor and basement options, plus EV car charging.

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry facility equipped with washers and dryers available every day; daily housekeeping also available
notes.Luggage storage: Front desk will store luggage before check-in if room is not yet ready

hotel.name: Accent Inn Kelowna
hotel.desc: Accent Inn Kelowna is a family-owned BC motel in downtown Kelowna running a dedicated 'Bike Love' program that treats cyclists as first-class guests rather than an afterthought. Touring cyclists can bring their bike directly into their room, access a professional-grade 37-piece tool kit, and use an on-site bicycle wash and tuning station. The hotel is Rainbow Registered, pet-friendly, and sits within a 20-minute drive of over 40 Okanagan wineries with abundant trail and beach access nearby.

notes.Laundry: Listed as a standard amenity: 'Laundry facilities' with icon on the main Kelowna hotel page
notes.Nearby evening food: Ricky's All Day Grill is on-site, described as serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner
notes.Bikes in rooms: 'Love your bike? Bring it to your room. No need to leave it in storage where you can't see it' — part of the formal Bike Love program at all Accent Inns locations
notes.Basic tools: 'Shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls' — available at every Accent Inns location
notes.Bike wash / hose: 'Bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' and 'Rags for cleaning your bike' — listed as standard Bike Love amenities

hotel.name: Grand Park Hotel Vancouver Airport
hotel.desc: The Grand Park Hotel Vancouver Airport is an independently branded mid-scale hotel in Richmond's Golden Village, a few minutes from YVR with a complimentary shuttle running every 30 minutes. It sits on the city's 'Food Street' with over 50 restaurants within walking distance, directly across from Lansdowne Mall, and near a Canada Line station for quick access to downtown Vancouver. The hotel has 140 rooms, an onsite restaurant, a 24-hour fitness centre, EV charging stations, and an open parking lot without height restrictions.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'over 50 ethnic restaurants within easy walking distance' on the famous Food Street; onsite Bella Roma Italiano Bar & Grill also serves dinner
notes.Device charging: Rooms page lists USB outlets in all room types

hotel.name: Lamplighter Motel
hotel.desc: A motel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, a major cycling touring corridor through British Columbia. Offers roadside accommodation for cyclists traveling through the region.

hotel.name: Greenbrier Hotel
hotel.desc: Greenbrier Hotel is a three-level hotel located on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi access to guests.

hotel.name: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Kelowna Airport
hotel.desc: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Kelowna Airport is a 140-room mid-scale hotel situated directly adjacent to Kelowna International Airport in the Lake Country/Winfield area. Part of the globally recognized Hampton by Hilton brand, it serves both air travellers and regional visitors exploring the Okanagan. Its location on Innovation Drive puts cyclists within reach of Kelowna's trail networks and wine country routes.

hotel.name: Wells Gray Inn
hotel.desc: Wells Gray Inn is a 34-room hotel centrally located on Highway 5 in Clearwater, positioned as a base for exploring Wells Gray Provincial Park's mountains, rivers, and waterfalls. The inn features on-site dining through a diner with room service, Monroe's Fine Dining Restaurant and Lounge, and a bar and grill, as well as an outdoor hot tub, infrared sauna, and massage therapist for post-ride recovery. Summer activities in the area include biking, rafting, canoeing, and hiking.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Monroe's Fine Dining Restaurant & Lounge and Wells Gray Inn Bar and Grill with live entertainment

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre bills itself as Abbotsford's largest full-service hotel, with a conference centre, two indoor pools, a fitness centre, and an onsite restaurant (Ricky's Country Restaurant). The property specializes in group and corporate travel and has won the Best Western Director's Award. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable, amenity-rich base for exploring the Fraser Valley.

notes.Nearby evening food: Ricky's Country Restaurant is listed as an onsite amenity in the site navigation

hotel.name: Tofino Resort + Marina
hotel.desc: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront hotel and adventure basecamp situated in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory, with harbour-view rooms and direct marina access. The property runs an on-site Adventure Centre offering kayaking, whale watching, bear watching, and guided fishing, making it a natural hub for cyclists who want to mix riding with West Coast wilderness experiences. Shelter Restaurant, the on-site dining room specialising in local wild-caught seafood, and a complimentary gym round out the amenities for a multi-day stay.

notes.Laundry: FAQ states: 'There is a laundry facility located in the Adventure Centre. Please call 778.841.0186 to inquire about access.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Shelter Restaurant offers dinner with local wild-caught seafood and harbour views; described on front page and multiple guest reviews

hotel.name: Sandman Inn Princeton
hotel.desc: Sandman Inn Princeton is a hotel located on Frontage Road in Princeton, British Columbia. As part of the Sandman Inn hotel chain, it provides accommodation for travelers. Contact the hotel directly for information about current services and amenities.

hotel.name: Recreation Inn and Suites
hotel.desc: Recreation Inn & Suites is a family-owned hotel situated beside Highway 97 on the edge of Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard queens to a three-bedroom apartment suite sleeping up to eight. The property features a seasonal outdoor pool, dry sauna, heritage gardens with BBQ and picnic areas, and a complimentary continental breakfast included with every stay. Its location adjacent to parks, an on-leash dog park, and walking-distance restaurants makes it a comfortable and convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website front page states 'a handful of restaurants are all within easy walking distance'

hotel.name: Grizz Hotel
hotel.desc: Grizz Hotel is a centrally located hotel in downtown Revelstoke, within walking distance of the Revelstoke Aquatic Centre, museums, and Grizzly Plaza. The hotel features an in-house pub, The Last Drop, with 14 beers on tap, live entertainment, and daily specials. A free shuttle runs to Revelstoke Mountain Resort during winter, and the property is undergoing room renovations.

notes.Nearby evening food: In-house pub 'The Last Drop' offers 14 beers on tap, wine, bottled drinks, non-alcoholic beverages, daily specials, and live entertainment

hotel.name: Best Western Tin Wis Resort
hotel.desc: Tin Wis Resort is an 85-room beachfront hotel perched on the secluded tinwis (MacKenzie) Beach in Tofino, owned and operated by the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation and situated within their traditional territories. It holds the distinction of housing the largest conference centre on the Pacific Rim and offers direct oceanfront access, making it one of the most culturally rooted lodging options in the region. Touring cyclists arriving via the Pacific Rim Highway find themselves steps from the ocean with surf and paddle equipment available and an on-site restaurant for refuelling.

detail.address: 1119 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Homepage lists 'Complimentary Breakfast' as a named resort feature
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant is Browns Social House; a dedicated restaurant phone (1.250.725.0614) and email (tofino@brownssocialhouse.com) are listed on the contact page

hotel.name: The Queens Hotel
hotel.desc: The Queens Hotel is a historic boutique property in Queensborough and the only hotel in this New Westminster neighbourhood, offering multiple room types from twin beds to a family suite. The hotel features a covered patio with BBQ, pet-friendly rooms, and multilingual staff (Cantonese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Mandarin, Spanish). Its central Lower Mainland location gives cyclists easy road access to Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, and Surrey.

detail.address: 130-1110 Ewen Avenue, New Westminster, BC V3M 5E4

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists multiple restaurants within 15 minutes walking distance: Boston Pizza, Pho Express, Naan Bites, Opa Souvlaki, Nando's Flame Grilled Chicken, Tora Sushi, Starbucks, Tim Hortons, Subway, A&W

hotel.name: Blu Hotel
hotel.desc: Hotel BLU is a 4-diamond boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver on Robson Street, noted for personalized service and a stated commitment to sustainability. The property features an indoor pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, fitness centre, and an onsite breakfast lounge, and offers loaner electric and traditional bicycles for exploring the city. Its central location is steps from dozens of restaurants and grocery options, and less than a kilometre from the Canada Line SkyTrain.

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states 'you'll find dozens of options just steps from our hotel (we're in the heart of downtown)'
notes.Nearby grocery: TripAdvisor review quoted on website: 'Lots of places to eat, or get groceries right on same street as hotel'

hotel.name: Deer Lodge
hotel.desc: Deer Lodge is a self-catering vacation rental by owner tucked in the heart of Whistler Town Plaza, offering a one-bedroom suite sleeping four and a studio suite sleeping two. Both units feature full kitchens, gas fireplaces, in-suite laundry, and access to a shared hot tub, making them well suited for self-sufficient travellers. Restaurants, shops, golf courses, and ski lifts are all within easy walking distance.

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry listed as an amenity for both the One Bedroom Suite and Studio Suite
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'Restaurants, shops, golf courses and ski-lifts are all a short walk away.'

hotel.name: James Bay Inn
hotel.desc: James Bay Inn is Victoria's second-oldest continuously operating hotel, opened in 1911 in Edwardian style and located in the quiet James Bay district a short walk from the Inner Harbour, Beacon Hill Park, and Fisherman's Wharf. The property carries a Green Key Global Eco rating of 3 and is explicitly marketed as bicycle-friendly. An on-site Art Deco cafe, restaurant, and pub round out the experience for touring cyclists seeking a historic, characterful base.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Art Deco Cafe & Restaurant and a pub with pool table and dart boards listed on front page and /rooms page
notes.Vending machines: /rooms amenities list includes 'Drink & Snack vending machines' and 'Vending Machines'
notes.Luggage storage: /rooms amenities list includes 'Baggage Storage'

hotel.name: Sandman Signature Vancouver Airport Hotel & Resort
hotel.desc: The Sandman Signature Vancouver Airport Hotel & Resort is an upscale full-service hotel located near YVR in Richmond, BC, operated under Northland Properties' premium Signature tier. It offers standard resort-class amenities including free parking, room service, and free Wi-Fi. Its airport-adjacent location makes it a potential stopover point for cyclists using YVR, though no cycling-specific services have been confirmed.

detail.address: 10251 Saint Edwards Drive, Richmond, BC V6X 2M9

hotel.name: Rocky Inn
hotel.desc: Rocky Inn is a motel-style property in Valemount situated just off Yellowhead Highway 5 and surrounded by three mountain ranges. George Hicks Regional Park is a short walk away, and the Valemount Bike Park is listed among nearby attractions. The property offers free WiFi, on-site parking, and laundry service, making it a functional base for cyclists passing through the Robson Valley corridor.

notes.Laundry: Listed as 'Loundry Srvice' under Main Facilities on the front page
notes.Nearby evening food: The Moose Pub listed as 0.2 mi from the property
notes.Wi-Fi: Policies page: 'WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge.'

hotel.name: The Oswego Hotel
hotel.desc: The Oswego is a boutique all-suite hotel in downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour and BC Parliament Buildings, with every room featuring a full kitchen and most offering a private balcony. It explicitly markets itself to active travellers and offers secure bike storage alongside an on-site restaurant, fitness facilities, and a quiet outdoor zen garden. The hotel is both dog- and child-friendly, and its central location on a quiet residential street makes it a practical and comfortable overnight base for touring cyclists arriving in or departing from Victoria.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Aegir is open Monday to Sunday and serves into the evening
notes.Device charging: Studio Suite room listing mentions a 'clock radio with wireless charging pad and bluetooth connectivity' in-suite

hotel.name: Turf Hotel
hotel.desc: A Surrey landmark since 1967, Turf Hotel on King George Boulevard has grown from a modest roadside inn into a lively community hub combining budget-friendly guest rooms with an entertainment complex that includes Mojito's Pub (Latin nights, 200-person capacity), the intimate Turf Lounge (live bands, karaoke), and Kanin + Ulam, an on-site Filipino kitchen. An on-site Beer & Wine Store stocked with beer, wine, spirits, and convenience snacks rounds out the self-contained offering. The hotel was recently refreshed with updated rooms while retaining its retro, neighbourhood-gathering-place character.

detail.address: 12411 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: Kanin + Ulam Filipino kitchen is located on-site inside the hotel, offering dishes such as Pork Sisig, Beef Caldereta, and Garlic Rice

hotel.name: Sheraton Guildford Hotel
hotel.desc: A 4-star Sheraton hotel with 279 rooms serving the Surrey area. Standard mid-range chain accommodation typical of the Sheraton brand. A substantial property offering reliable lodging for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Buffalo Inn
hotel.desc: Buffalo Inn is a motel situated at Mile 143 of the iconic Alaska Highway in northern British Columbia, placing it squarely on one of the world's great long-distance cycling routes. The Alaska Highway corridor sees steady traffic from touring cyclists making multi-week journeys between Dawson Creek and Alaska, making roadside lodging at this milepost a meaningful stopping point. The commercial building and highway-side location suggest a classic roadhouse-style motel serving travellers in a remote stretch of BC.

hotel.name: Westview Centre Motel
hotel.desc: Westview Centre Motel is a recently refurbished 20-room hillside motel on Marine Avenue in Powell River, with panoramic views of Malaspina and Georgia Straits and the Salish Sea. It sits half a block from the ferry terminal serving Comox and Texada Island, and is walking distance from Willingdon Beach and the trailhead network that connects to the 180-km Sunshine Coast Trail. The motel proactively arranges discounted cycling and kayak rentals from local businesses for guests who book direct.

detail.address: 4534 Marine Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 2K4

notes.Nearby evening food: Booking.com review quoted on site: 'many restaurants just across the road'; Family Room page notes popular local restaurants near Willingdon Beach steps away
notes.Nearby grocery: Family Room page lists Safeway and Walmart as a 2-minute drive from the motel

hotel.name: Black Rooster Guesthouse
hotel.desc: Black Rooster Inn & Apartments is a multi-room lodging in Prince Rupert offering hotel-style rooms, kitchenettes, and fully furnished 1–4 bedroom apartments with a maximum occupancy of 99 guests. Sitting about 400m from downtown and 5 minutes from the ferry and train terminal, it is well-positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries on the North Coast. The property has ample parking for RVs and boats, a BBQ patio, entertainment room with pool table, and locker rentals.

detail.address: 501 6th Ave West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1Z7

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry listed under Property Information; also described as 'en-suite or shared laundry' in amenities list
notes.Nearby grocery: Contact page states 'Groceries, the golf course, the hospital & civic-center are all within 5-10 min walking distance.'

hotel.name: Hotel 19
hotel.desc: Hotel 19 is a recently restored oceanfront hotel in Port Hardy operated by two local women who transformed a long-vacant historic building into a modern boutique property. All rooms include private decks with ocean views and a coffee bar, and an attached sushi restaurant serves guests on-site. The property is still undergoing phased renovations, with a basement pub planned as a future addition.

detail.address: 7370 Market Street, Port Hardy, BC, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states: 'we have a great sushi restaurant attached to the lobby'

hotel.name: Eagle's Nest Resort
hotel.desc: Eagle's Nest Resort sits on a secluded 10-acre peninsula along the shores of Anahim Lake in the remote West Chilcotin, just 1 km off Highway 20 between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. Guests choose between log cabins with wood stoves and elegant suites with satellite TV and wireless internet, and can dine in a licensed lakefront dining room with views over the lake. The resort is noted as a birding hotspot on a major inland migration route and offers canoe rentals, day-hike access to volcanic canyons, and arrangements for floatplane tours into Tweedsmuir Park.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site licensed lakefront dining room serves dinner (and breakfast) to resort guests; website notes 'the dining room is serving resort guests only'

hotel.name: Ainsworth Hot Springs Resort
hotel.desc: Ainsworth Hot Springs Resort is a historic hotel on the shores of Kootenay Lake in the Selkirk Mountains, centered on natural mineral hot spring pools including a remarkable 150-foot horseshoe cave that has been used for healing by the Ktunaxa people since time immemorial. The resort combines indigenous cultural heritage with modern accommodation across a four-story main building and the newer Yaqan Nukiy Suites, all overlooking the lake and Purcell Mountains. For a touring cyclist, the therapeutic soaking pools offer genuine muscle recovery after a long day on Highway 31.

detail.address: 3609 Balfour-Kaslo-Galena Bay Hwy, Ainsworth Hot Springs, BC V0G 1A0, Canada

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Continental Breakfast available to hotel guests
notes.Nearby evening food: Ktunaxa Grill is an on-site restaurant serving dinner, located on the 3rd/4th floor of the Main Building

hotel.name: Imperial Motel
hotel.desc: Imperial Motel is a motel in the Okanagan region offering overnight accommodation for travelers. Located on Riverside Drive, it represents a potential overnight stop for touring cyclists in the area.

hotel.name: Hecate Inn
hotel.desc: The Hecate Inn is a motel and local landmark in Daajing Giids on Haida Gwaii, BC's remote island archipelago, where it has been operating for over 30 years. Rooms come with handmade furniture, full kitchens or kitchenettes, private bathrooms, and WiFi — practical features for touring cyclists who need to resupply and recover after arriving by ferry. Its location on Oceanview Drive puts it within the small community centre of Daajing Giids.

detail.address: 321 Oceanview Drive, Daajing Giids, British Columbia

hotel.name: Aurora Park Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Aurora Park Inn & Suites is a highway-side hotel in Dawson Creek, BC, located off Highway 2 about 2.8 km from the airport and near the Encarna Event Center. Rooms and suites include microwaves, minifridges, and TVs, with some featuring kitchenettes or whirlpool tubs, and the property offers a business lounge and a game room with gaming consoles. Free continental breakfast, 24-hour front desk service, coin laundry, and free parking with car plug-ins make it a practical base for travelers passing through northern BC.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on-site; dry cleaning service also listed as available
notes.Vending machines: Vending machine listed explicitly in the amenities

hotel.name: Spanish Fiesta Resort
hotel.desc: The Spanish Fiesta Resort is a lakefront resort in the heart of Osoyoos, BC, situated on Main Street steps away from a private sandy beach on Osoyoos Lake, widely cited as Canada's warmest lake. The property offers a variety of room types—many with full kitchens—alongside two outdoor heated pools and an indoor jacuzzi. Restaurants are within walking distance and the resort sits at a natural waypoint for cyclists touring the South Okanagan.

notes.Laundry: Laundry Room explicitly listed in General Information on the reviews page
notes.Nearby evening food: Restaurants Within Walking Distance listed in General Information on the reviews page

hotel.name: Totem Lodge Motel
hotel.desc: Totem Lodge Motel is a smoke-free motel in Prince Rupert on BC's North Coast, situated just minutes from the BC and Alaska ferry terminals and the VIA Rail station — making it a practical base for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The lodge is surrounded by coastal rainforest and most rooms include fully equipped kitchenettes, offering self-sufficient stay options. Prince Rupert itself sits on Tsimshian traditional territory and is a gateway to wilderness adventure including kayaking, bear-watching, and whale-watching charters.

detail.address: 1335 Park Avenue, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1K3

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry facilities with washers and dryers located on the lower floor; laundry detergent and fabric softener available for purchase at the front desk
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary continental breakfast included with all rooms; self-served with coffee, tea, juice, bagels, scones, muffins, cereal, yogurt, and fresh fruit

hotel.name: Comfort Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A mid-range hotel chain location in Campbell River on Vancouver Island. Offers standard accommodation in a commercial area, accessible to touring cyclists passing through the island.

hotel.name: Microtel Inn and Suites by Wyndham Kitimat
hotel.desc: The Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Kitimat is a modern budget-oriented chain hotel situated in Kitimat, a remote industrial town on the Douglas Channel in BC's North Coast region. As part of the Wyndham family, it offers standardized amenities in an area with limited accommodation options, making it one of the more reliable lodging choices for cyclists traveling through this part of the province. Kitimat sits at the end of a long fjord with limited onward cycling routes, so the hotel serves primarily as a destination rest point rather than a through-touring waypoint.

hotel.name: Grand Forks Inn
hotel.desc: The Grand Forks Inn is a highway-side hotel on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) in Grand Forks, BC, offering air-conditioned rooms with in-room fridge and microwave, a seasonal outdoor pool, and 24/7 front desk service. An on-site Japanese restaurant (Sushi Ocean Dream) provides evening dining options within steps of the door. The inn is a practical base for exploring the Boundary region, with Christina Lake about 20 minutes away by road.

detail.address: 2729 Central Avenue, Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H2

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Daily buffet breakfast available starting at 6 AM, including cereal, baked goods, fresh fruit, yogurt, coffee, and juice
notes.Nearby evening food: Sushi Ocean Dream Japanese Restaurant is listed as an on-site amenity, open Monday–Saturday

hotel.name: Naturally Pacific Resort
hotel.desc: Naturally Pacific Resort is an award-winning boutique hotel in Campbell River recognized on Travel + Leisure's 2025 It List, as a Michelin Guide PLUS hotel, and holding an AAA Four Diamond designation. It sits at the edge of Vancouver Island's wilderness corridors and offers on-site dining, a luxury spa, golf, and an indoor pool — positioning it as a full-service base for exploring the region's cycling, fishing, and wildlife routes. Dog-friendly rooms and a dedicated dog-washing station add a practical touch for touring cyclists traveling with pets.

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site restaurants: Carve Kitchen + Meatery, Velocity Lounge, and Sunset Terrace Patio + Grill

hotel.name: Hillview Motel
hotel.desc: Hillview Guest Rooms is a small, family-run motel on the eastern edge of Vanderhoof along the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16), a major transcontinental cycling route. The property has operated for over a decade and earned a 2024/25 Travel & Hospitality Award, positioning itself as the best-value lodging in town. Rooms include microwaves, refrigerators, and optional kitchenettes, and select units are pet-friendly — practical features for self-sufficient touring cyclists on a long-haul trip.

detail.address: 1533 Highway 16 East, Vanderhoof, BC, Canada V0J 3A0

notes.Laundry: Laundry service is available; website promotes one free load for stays of 7+ consecutive nights, implying an on-site or managed laundry service

hotel.name: Lakeview Motel
hotel.desc: Lakeview Motel is a family-owned, year-round property on Highway 3 (Crowsnest Hwy) in Christina Lake, BC, in the Kootenay Boundary region. The 12 recently renovated rooms include seven fully equipped kitchen units, and the grounds feature a shared barbecue and fire pit under a log gazebo — good for swapping stories with fellow travelers. The motel sits five minutes on foot from one of Canada's warmest lakes and 1 km from the Trans Canada Trail, making it a convenient staging point for cyclists exploring the Boundary country.

detail.address: 1658 Hwy 3, Christina Lake, British Columbia V0H 1E3

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states coffee shops and restaurants are within one block; explore page lists several locally owned eating establishments in Christina Lake

hotel.name: Airport Inn Motel
hotel.desc: Airport Inn is a combined motel and year-round RV park located in Quesnel, BC, on the Cariboo Highway near the airport. With 20 ground-floor motel rooms and over 50 pull-through RV sites, it caters to a range of travellers. Amenities like on-site laundry, a playground, and a walking trail make it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through central BC.

notes.Laundry: Explicitly listed in the amenities overview: 'walking trail, laundry and more'

hotel.name: Regent Hotel
hotel.desc: The Regent Hotel is a family-owned boutique heritage hotel in downtown Revelstoke, operating continuously since 1945 and originally built in the 1920s as two separate hotels (the Windsor and the Selkirk). Its unique, character-filled rooms, on-site pub, restaurant, sauna, and outdoor hot tub make it a full-service base for exploring Revelstoke's world-class mountain biking, hiking, and outdoor adventures. Pets are welcome, and the downtown location puts guests within easy reach of the town's shops, cafés, and trailheads.

detail.address: 112 First Street East, Revelstoke, British Columbia V0E 2S0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining includes 112 Restaurant & Lounge and River City Pub + Patio, both described on the website as operating within the hotel

hotel.name: Johnny's Motel
hotel.desc: Johnny's Motel is an award-winning, family-run budget motel set on the banks of the Granby River at the crossing of two rivers in Grand Forks, BC — a location the property calls the best in the city. Rooms open directly onto the riverbank and the motel sits just minutes from downtown shops and restaurants, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) corridor. Grand Forks is noted on the website as a base for cycling the Kettle Valley Trail.

detail.address: 7291 Hwy 3 E., Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states motel is 'just a few minutes' walk from the shops and restaurants of downtown' Grand Forks

hotel.name: Bella Villa Motel & Resort
hotel.desc: Bella Villa is an off-highway, lakefront motel situated on the shores of Osoyoos Lake in the southern Okanagan. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, and guests can use a grass courtyard with outdoor dining and gas barbecues. The quiet, beach-adjacent setting would appeal to cyclists seeking a relaxed base for exploring the Okanagan's wine-country roads.

hotel.name: The Riviera Motel
hotel.desc: The Riviera Motel is a motel in the Okanagan region offering overnight accommodation. Specific details about amenities and bike storage cannot be confirmed due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Comfort Inn & Suites Salmon Arm
hotel.desc: A Comfort Inn & Suites hotel in Salmon Arm, part of the Choice Hotels chain. A standard mid-range hotel providing accommodation to touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.

hotel.name: Riverside Court RV & Cabins
hotel.desc: Riverside Court RV & Cabins is a small, family-owned property on the Granby River just outside downtown Grand Forks, operating on a site with roots going back to 1948. After severe 2018 flooding, the property was reinvented into two cabin units and ten RV sites, with a sandy beach and green space along the river. It is one block from downtown Grand Forks, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through on Highway 3.

notes.Laundry: Website states: 'Fully equipped with public washrooms and laundry.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'restaurants, pubs' as nearby amenities within walking distance
notes.Nearby grocery: Website mentions 'groceries' and 'market ave' as nearby amenities within walking distance

hotel.name: Ocean Sands Resort
hotel.desc: Ocean Sands Resort is a condominium-style resort set on 4 acres of oceanfront property overlooking Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville, offering one- and two-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and ocean or pool-view balconies. The resort sits above one of Vancouver Island's most celebrated beaches, reachable on foot in about five minutes. Nearby activities listed on the resort's website include mountain biking, kayaking, hiking, and wildlife viewing tours, making it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the east coast of Vancouver Island.

detail.address: Unit 21 1165 Resort Drive, Parksville, BC V9P 2E2

notes.Laundry: About page states: 'The amenities include a heated outdoor pool, playground, indoor hot tub, sauna and laundry facilities.'

hotel.name: Meziadin Junction
hotel.desc: Meziadin Junction is a full-service rest stop on Highway 37N in remote northern BC, operated as an Indigenous-owned business on Gitanyow territory and recipient of the 2014 BC Aboriginal Business Outstanding Achievement Award. It combines motel rooms, a restaurant, a general store, and industrial camp services in one complex, making it a rare oasis for travelers — including cyclists — heading toward Alaska or exploring the Cassiar Highway corridor. The surrounding area offers access to Meziadin Lake Provincial Park, Bear Glacier, and salmon-spawning creeks.

notes.Laundry: Website accommodations page explicitly lists 'laundry services' among room conveniences
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website states 'be sure to stop by for some convenient breakfast before you head out' and lists breakfast availability beginning at 5:00 am
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant is situated 'conveniently alongside our accommodations' and serves lunch and dinner
notes.Nearby grocery: Meziadin Junction General Store is described as located 'just steps away' from the motel rooms

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Fort St. John BC
hotel.desc: A Super 8 by Wyndham franchise motel located on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, a major service centre near the start of the Alaska Highway. For northbound touring cyclists, Fort St. John represents one of the last substantial urban stops before the more remote stretches of the highway corridor. The property participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.

detail.address: 9500 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, BC

hotel.name: Glenwood Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Glenwood Inn & Suites is a 38-room motel in Trail, BC, sitting close to the Columbia River, local parks, and downtown Trail in the heart of the Kootenays. The property offers indoor and outdoor pools, a whirlpool spa, a fitness centre, and BBQ common areas, making it a well-equipped base after a long day on the road. It is fully disability-accessible and offers free on-site parking.

detail.address: 2769 Glenwood Drive, Trail, British Columbia, Canada V1R 2S6

notes.Luggage storage: Website amenities page explicitly lists 'Luggage Storage' under Guest Services

hotel.name: Crown Mansion Boutique Hotel & Villas
hotel.desc: Crown Mansion is a fully renovated heritage boutique hotel in Qualicum Beach, dating to 1914, with an elegant past that once saw celebrity guests including Bing Crosby, John Wayne, and the King of Siam. The property retains its original grandeur through rare wood panelling, crystal chandeliers, heritage fireplaces, and sweeping staircases. Accommodation options span boutique hotel rooms and separate villas, with an on-site restaurant rounding out the experience.

detail.address: 292 East Crescent Road, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 0A5

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant confirmed by website navigation menu ('Restaurant' listed as a section of the property)

hotel.name: Pioneer Inn
hotel.desc: Pioneer Inn is a long-established motel situated on the Quatse River bank in Port Hardy, North Vancouver Island, with over 40 years in business and a setting where forest and river meet the edge of town. It is the closest motel to the BC Ferry terminal (about 5 minutes' drive), making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing via the Inside Passage route. The property offers 36 rooms including kitchenette suites, 25 RV sites, a coin laundry, a dedicated drying room, and an on-site sushi restaurant, along with the Quatse River Loop Trail running directly in front.

detail.address: 8405 Byng Road, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry room for guests listed on About Us page
notes.Drying area: About Us page lists 'Special dry room for wet boots, coates, clothes for worker and loggers'; would serve the same function for cyclists
notes.Nearby evening food: Toudai sushi restaurant is on-site, described on the website with dinner service Tuesday–Sunday

hotel.name: Vista del Mar
hotel.desc: Vista del Mar is a motel on South Island Highway in the Vancouver Island area, providing lodging to passing travelers. The motel offers Wi-Fi access to guests.

hotel.name: Glacier Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: A European-style mountain lodge in Blue River, BC, situated in a natural valley between the Monashee and Cariboo Mountains on the border of Wells Gray Provincial Park — roughly equidistant (about 590 km) between Vancouver and Edmonton, making it a natural overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists on that corridor. The lodge offers 35 rooms with in-room fridges, microwaves, and a complimentary continental breakfast, plus an indoor hot tub and an on-site food shack (Grizzly Food Shack) serving burgers, wraps, and breakfast. Mountain biking, hiking, and canoeing are among the listed local activities.

notes.Laundry: Website front page and amenities page state 'free laundry service' is included
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Grizzly Food Shack serves breakfast, burgers, and wraps (take-out or picnic tables); website also notes 'walking distance to other restaurants.'

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Salmon Arm
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Salmon Arm is a nationally branded budget hotel situated on the northeast side of Salmon Arm in the Shuswap region of British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar, consistent lodging option for travellers passing through a community that sits along the Trans-Canada Highway corridor. Touring cyclists riding through the Thompson-Okanagan region will find it a straightforward overnight stop near the commercial centre of town.

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham 100 Mile House
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham 100 Mile House is a mid-range chain hotel situated in 100 Mile House, a service hub in BC's Cariboo region along Highway 97. It sits at a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling the Interior plateau between Cache Creek and Williams Lake. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, it offers the typical Days Inn suite of standard room amenities.

hotel.name: Spirit Bear Lodge
hotel.desc: Spirit Bear Lodge is British Columbia's most remote wildlife viewing lodge, owned and operated by the Kitasoo Xai'xais First Nation in the heart of the Great Bear Rainforest near Klemtu. Named a World's Best Adventure by National Geographic in 2025, the lodge offers all-inclusive multi-day packages focused on spirit bear and grizzly bear viewing, cultural immersion, and wilderness exploration within Kitasoo Xai'xais Traditional Territory. It was founded in 2001 and has become a widely cited model for Indigenous-led, conservation-based ecotourism.

detail.address: 300 Spirit Bear Dr, Klemtu, BC V0T 1L0, Canada

hotel.name: King Edward Motel
hotel.desc: King Edward Hotel & Motel is a full-service small-town accommodation in Stewart, BC, a remote border community at the end of the Portland Canal across from Alaska's Misty Fjords National Park. The property offers multiple room types from standard queens to kitchenette suites, and operates an onsite pub and café, making it a practical overnight base in one of northwestern BC's most dramatically scenic corners. The surrounding area offers glacier access, bear viewing at Fish Creek, and estuary boardwalk walks within minutes of the front door.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry machines listed as an onsite amenity: 'Guest Laundry Facility'
notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite Prospectors Pub / Casey's Pub and King Ed Cafe with licensed outdoor patio

hotel.name: Stagecoach Inn
hotel.desc: The Stagecoach Inn is a 52-room motel in Chetwynd, BC, offering fully renovated rooms with drive-up access, fridges, microwaves, and kitchenette options — a practical setup for cyclists hauling loaded bikes. An on-site restaurant and laundry facilities add to its appeal as an overnight stop. Chetwynd sits along the Hart Highway corridor, positioning this motel as a natural resupply and rest point for touring cyclists moving through northern BC.

detail.address: 5413 South Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0

notes.Laundry: Laundry facilities on premises
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant listed on website
notes.Vending machines: Ice and Pop machine on site

hotel.name: Walnut Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Walnut Beach Resort is a full-service lakefront suite resort on Osoyoos Lake, set against Canada's only desert landscape with vineyard and mountain vistas. Suites feature fully equipped kitchens and kitchenettes, and the property includes a private beach, heated outdoor pool, hot tubs, and on-site dining at Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar. It is a prominent destination resort in one of BC's sunniest regions, close to wine tours, cycling routes, and the US border.

detail.address: 4200 Lakeshore Drive, Osoyoos, British Columbia, Canada V0H 1V6

notes.Laundry: "Guest Laundry Facilities" explicitly listed on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar with indoor and patio dining is on-site at the resort
notes.Nearby grocery: On-site 'Walnut Beach Marketplace' listed in amenities
notes.E-bike charging: Amenities page lists 'EV Charging Station'; note this is vehicle-scale charging, not confirmed for e-bikes

hotel.name: White Crystal Inn
hotel.desc: The White Crystal Inn is a ski-resort hotel located within the Big White Ski Resort controlled recreational area, roughly 56 km southeast of Kelowna in BC's Okanagan highlands. As part of a major destination ski resort, it sits at high elevation in a village-style mountain setting that also offers summer eBike tours and trail activities. The resort operates on a seasonal model, closing in spring and reopening for summer and winter seasons.

hotel.name: Esta Villa Motel
hotel.desc: A motel on Vancouver Island offering overnight accommodation. The status of facilities and amenities for touring cyclists is unverified.

hotel.name: Jade City Motel
hotel.desc: Jade City is a world-famous jade mining destination on the Cassiar-Stewart Highway (Hwy-37) in the Cassiar Mountain Range, founded in 1985 and featured on Discovery Channel's Jade Fever. The motel offers 4 rooms with an open veranda, shared shower facilities, and a dining area, all set amid jade boulders and mining equipment with mountain views. It is one of very few accommodation options on this remote northern highway, making it a key stop for touring cyclists traversing the Cassiar corridor.

detail.address: Box B8, Jade City, BC V0C 1E0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Breakfast (Eggs, Bagels) explicitly listed as included with all accommodation types; served in Room 3 of the motel

hotel.name: Travelodge
hotel.desc: The Campbell River Travelodge is a mid-range chain hotel situated on the South Island Highway, offering a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring Vancouver Island. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it provides a familiar, predictable lodging option in a town that serves as a hub for northern Vancouver Island exploration. Touring cyclists will find it well-placed relative to the Island's main cycling corridor.

hotel.name: Bella Coola Grizzly Tours Resort
hotel.desc: Bella Coola Grizzly Tours & Adventure Resort is a family-operated wilderness destination in the Great Bear Rainforest offering guided grizzly bear and marine wildlife tours out of Bella Coola. Guests stay in private post-and-beam chalet log cabins set into the timber, or aboard the 42-foot vessel MV Nekhani during multi-day fjord expeditions. The resort sits at the end of the famously steep Highway 20 descent into the Bella Coola Valley, making it a dramatic destination for cyclists tackling one of BC's most remote routes.

detail.address: 1953 Mackenzie Highway 20, Bella Coola, BC V0T 1C0

hotel.name: Nimpo Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Nimpo Lake Resort is a small, historic lakefront cabin resort on Nimpo Lake in BC's West Chilcotin, sitting directly on Highway 20 roughly midway between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. The property dates to the late 1960s and offers a mix of year-round and seasonal cabins ranging from a two-bedroom unit to a five-bedroom lodge. For cyclists riding the Highway 20 corridor, it is a natural overnight stop with lake access for paddling and fishing, and notably has invested in dedicated fiber-optic internet infrastructure.

detail.address: 1595 Nimpo Creek Rd, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

hotel.name: Sunnycrest Motel
hotel.desc: Sunnycrest Motel offers overnight accommodation on Gibsons Way with WiFi access. Further amenities and services require verification due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Ramada Limited Merritt
hotel.desc: Ramada Limited Merritt is a mid-scale Wyndham-branded hotel located on Voght Street in Merritt, a highway town at the junction of the Coquihalla and the Okanagan connector routes. As part of the Ramada Limited tier, it is a straightforward lodging option for travellers passing through the Thompson-Nicola region. Touring cyclists riding the interior plateau routes will find it a conveniently situated overnight stop in an otherwise spread-out town.

hotel.name: Stoke Hotel SureStay Collection by Best Western
hotel.desc: The Stoke Hotel is a SureStay Collection property by Best Western situated in Revelstoke in the Selkirk Mountains, directly across from the Revelstoke Suspension Bridge with mountain views. Rooms feature décor celebrating Canadian heritage, and the property offers pet-friendly accommodations with kitchenettes and jetted tubs. It sits a short distance from downtown Revelstoke, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area.

detail.address: 1911 Fraser Drive, Revelstoke, British Columbia V0E 2S0

hotel.name: Pomeroy Inn and Suites Prince George
hotel.desc: Pomeroy Inn and Suites Prince George is a hotel providing standard accommodation in the city, part of a chain operating across British Columbia. As a mid-sized chain hotel, it represents a conventional lodging option for touring cyclists passing through the region.

hotel.name: Clydesdale Inn
hotel.desc: The Clydesdale Inn is a three-storey hotel located in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region of British Columbia. Its website is currently in maintenance mode, so details about rooms, services, and facilities are not publicly available. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor may find it a useful overnight stop, pending confirmation of amenities.

hotel.name: Shiraz Villa
hotel.desc: Shiraz Villa is a family-owned boutique hotel nestled within a 25-acre vineyard on the outskirts of Osoyoos, offering ten private villas and a two-bedroom guest house with panoramic views of Osoyoos Lake and the surrounding mountains. Each villa features a private patio, Jacuzzi tub, and rain shower, while the guest house includes a fully equipped kitchen with washer and dryer. Located roughly five minutes from Osoyoos town centre, it sits in the heart of the Okanagan wine country along Highway 3, a popular cycling corridor.

notes.Laundry: Two Bedroom Guest House amenities list explicitly includes 'Washer & Dryer'

hotel.name: Chateau Big White
hotel.desc: Chateau Big White is a hotel offering studios and suites slope-side at Big White Ski Resort, located in BC's Okanagan highlands southeast of Kelowna. The resort operates year-round, with a ski season in winter and a summer season featuring eBike tours, fat biking trails, and mountain activities. Guests are within walking distance of on-mountain restaurants, a market, and the full range of resort services.

notes.Nearby evening food: Resort website lists on-mountain restaurants, food trucks, and a market under Food & Dining, all within the controlled resort area adjacent to the accommodation

hotel.name: Nimpkish Hotel
hotel.desc: The Nimpkish Hotel is a historic waterfront property in Alert Bay on Cormorant Island, reached by ferry from Port McNeill on Vancouver Island. Its nine rooms overlook the Broughton Strait, and the deck is a well-known spot for watching whales, eagles, and seals. The hotel is surrounded by First Nations cultural sites, 15 km of woodland trails, and activities like kayaking and salmon fishing.

detail.address: 318 Fir Street, Alert Bay, British Columbia V0N 1A0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site full-service waterfront restaurant open for Breakfast and Dinner, located on the sun deck

hotel.name: North Country Inn
hotel.desc: North Country Inn & Suites is a family-run motel established in 1984, situated in the heart of downtown Vanderhoof — the geographical centre of British Columbia — along Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert. The 40-room property spans four buildings and includes an on-site restaurant locally known as the 'Log House,' serving Canadian-European cuisine from breakfast through dinner. Its central location puts guests within walking distance of shopping and parks, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 16 corridor.

detail.address: 2625 Burrard Ave, Vanderhoof, British Columbia V0J 3A0

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Laundry Service' as a property amenity on both the front page and accommodations page
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant ('Log House') serves lunch and dinner, including daily specials and a salad bar during dinner service

hotel.name: Kaslo Hotel & Brew Pub
hotel.desc: A renovated heritage boutique hotel originally built in 1896, perched on the shores of Kootenay Lake between the Purcell and Selkirk Mountains in the village of Kaslo. The elegantly updated property features spacious rooms with walk-out balconies, penthouse suites with full kitchens, and the on-site Waypoint Restaurant and Bar. Kaslo holds BC Green Business certification at the 'Green' level — the highest available — reflecting a genuine sustainability commitment.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Waypoint Restaurant and Bar, described as open daily

hotel.name: Beach Gardens Resort and Marina
hotel.desc: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina is a full-service oceanfront resort situated on Malaspina Strait in Powell River, on BC's Sunshine Coast. Each guest room features a private ocean-view patio, and the property includes a 55-slip marina, the award-winning Seasider Bistro, an on-site craft distillery, and a cold beer and wine store. A shuttle service to the Town Centre Mall is available upon request, making the resort a self-contained base for exploring the region.

detail.address: 7074 Westminster Street, Powell River, British Columbia, Canada, V8A 1C5

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry available; listed under marina amenities: 'Fresh water, ice, coin laundry, showers & washrooms.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Seasider Bistro + Wine Bar + Patio serves contemporary West Coast dinner cuisine on the waterfront, steps from guest rooms

hotel.name: The Pacific Inn
hotel.desc: The Pacific Inn is a locally owned and operated 3-star hotel in the heart of downtown Prince Rupert, BC — a key terminus for touring cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries. Ferry, train, and airline terminals are only minutes away, making it a natural first or last stop on a North Coast tour. The hotel offers complimentary continental breakfast, secured underground parking, and elevator access across three floors.

detail.address: 909 3rd Avenue West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1M9

notes.Wi-Fi: Complimentary high-speed wireless internet access in all guest rooms and public areas

hotel.name: Best Western Maple Ridge Hotel
hotel.desc: The Best Western Maple Ridge Hotel is a full-service chain hotel on the Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, sitting minutes from Golden Ears Provincial Park and Whonnock Lake — two major outdoor destinations in the Fraser Valley. The property is pet-friendly and offers rooms with kitchenette options, making it a practical base for cyclists on multi-day touring routes through the Lower Mainland. Its position along the Lougheed corridor puts it close to the mountain gateways northeast of Vancouver.

detail.address: 21650 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge, British Columbia V2X 2S1

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Page metadata slug includes 'free-breakfast', indicating this property offers complimentary breakfast

hotel.name: Avalon Inn
hotel.desc: Avalon Inn is a motel located on Main Street in the Okanagan region. It offers overnight lodging for touring cyclists and other travelers.

hotel.name: Park Place Lodge
hotel.desc: Park Place Lodge is a locally-owned, independent hotel that has been operating in Fernie, British Columbia since 1981 under the Sombrowski family. The 64-room property includes an indoor pool and hot tub, a fitness centre, a cold beer and wine shop, and two on-site dining venues — a Bistro Restaurant and a Pub Bar & Grill. Situated on Highway 3 in the centre of Fernie, the hotel positions itself as an alternative to chain properties, with a stated commitment to environmental practices and support for local arts and culture.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Pub Bar & Grill and Bistro Restaurant both

hotel.name: Road Runner Motel
hotel.desc: Road Runner Motel is a motel situated on Nicola Avenue in the Nicola Valley / Thompson region of British Columbia, a corridor used by touring cyclists travelling between the Interior and the Lower Mainland. As a roadside motel it offers basic overnight accommodation along this route. No further details about the property could be verified at this time.

hotel.name: Gold Pan Motel
hotel.desc: Gold Pan Motel is a budget-friendly 20-room motel on Front Street in Quesnel, a town at the heart of BC's historic Gold Rush country along the Fraser River. The property is open 24 hours, is pet-friendly, and sits within walking distance of several riverside parks including Fraser River Park and LeBourdais Park. It offers free parking and free WiFi, making it a straightforward overnight stop for travellers moving through the Cariboo region.

notes.Nearby evening food: Begbie's Bar & Bistro listed at 700 metres from the motel on the front page

hotel.name: Tatla Lake Manor / Motel
hotel.desc: Tatla Lake Manor / Motel is a family-run motel sitting approximately halfway along the remote Highway 20 corridor in BC's Chilcotin region, 220 km west of Williams Lake — a natural stopping point for cyclists riding toward Bella Coola or back east. The property offers a range of accommodation from basic motel rooms to multi-bedroom fully-equipped kitchen suites, all with private bathrooms. It sits within walking distance of fuel, a post office, health centre, and local shopping, which is a meaningful convenience in this sparsely serviced stretch of the Chilcotin.

hotel.name: The Chalet Motel
hotel.desc: The Chalet is a long-established motel in the heart of Kitimat, BC, serving the community through generations of celebrations and special occasions — describing itself as a 'home away from home.' The property includes an attached restaurant, offering an on-site dining option for touring cyclists passing through the North Coast region. An amenities page exists on the website but its full content was not captured in the fetch.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant confirmed by website; a dedicated 'Restaurant Home' section with menu and reservations appears alongside the accommodation section under the same Chalet brand

hotel.name: Econo Lodge
hotel.desc: Econo Lodge is a budget motel chain providing basic room-based accommodation in Prince George. Specific amenities and bike storage arrangements could not be verified due to website access restrictions.

hotel.name: Timberlane Beach Resort
