hotel.desc: Timberlane Beach Resort sits directly on sandy Saratoga Beach on Vancouver Island, offering six oceanview suites and four cabins tucked among old-growth Douglas firs, plus an RV park. Guests walk a tree-lined laneway to reach the Pacific shoreline, and the resort is open year-round. The property offers bike rentals and can arrange local activities including trail riding, fishing, and golf.

detail.address: 8896 Clarkson Drive, Black Creek, BC V9J 1B1

hotel.name: Ashcroft Apartments and Motel
hotel.desc: A small motel with 17 rooms in Ashcroft, BC, providing accommodation for travelers in the Interior. Situated in a regional location useful for touring cyclists needing overnight stops.

hotel.name: Tyee Village Motel
hotel.desc: Tyee Village Motel is a full-service motel in Port Alberni offering a range of units from standard rooms to full kitchen apartments sleeping up to six, making it a practical base for cyclists tackling the Pacific Rim Highway. The property features an outdoor pool (summer), an independently operated family restaurant open year-round, and free wireless internet. Its central location puts a 7-Eleven one block away and easy highway access within reach.

detail.address: 4151 Redford Street, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 3R6

notes.Nearby evening food: Independently operated family restaurant on-site, described as 'operational year round.'
notes.Nearby grocery: 7-Eleven convenience store one block from the motel, confirmed on local services page

hotel.name: Echo Landing 29-32
hotel.desc: Echo Landing is a collection of contemporary ski-in, ski-out townhomes and condos located in the quieter east village of Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort. Units range from 2 to 4 bedrooms and include full kitchens, with select units offering private hot tubs. The property sits adjacent to the Orient chairlift and Sun Peaks' extensive bike park and trail network, making it a convenient base for mountain biking in summer.

detail.address: 5025 Valley Drive, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Revelstoke
hotel.desc: Best Western Plus Revelstoke sits on Laforme Boulevard and positions itself as an adventure basecamp for visitors to the region, with direct access to the TransCanada Highway corridor and proximity to Revelstoke Mountain Resort and the Revelstoke Highline suspension bridge. The lobby is anchored by a hand-carved grizzly bear, and the property offers complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet. It is a well-situated overnight stop for TransCanada touring cyclists passing through Revelstoke.

detail.address: 1925 Laforme Boulevard, Revelstoke, British Columbia V0E 2S0 Canada

hotel.name: The Cache Hotel and Lodgings
hotel.desc: The Cache Hotel and Lodgings is a hotel in the Kootenays region. As overnight lodging, it provides accommodation to travelers including touring cyclists exploring the area.

hotel.name: Island Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Island Lake Lodge is a world-class backcountry mountain resort near Fernie, B.C., comprising three timber-frame lodges — Tamarack, Cedar, and Red Eagle — with 26 guest rooms set within 7,000 acres of wilderness in the Lizard Range. Famous for legendary catskiing in winter, the property opens for summer stays from mid-June to mid-September, offering a spa, gourmet dining, guided hikes, and foraging experiences. The lodge operates off-grid with no TVs or fridges in guestrooms, though WiFi and cell service are available throughout.

detail.address: Box 1229, 602A 2nd Avenue, Fernie, B.C. Canada V0B 1M0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Tamarack Dining Room serves gourmet dinners; hotel accommodations include breakfast

hotel.name: New Horizon Motel
hotel.desc: New Horizon Motel is a family-run, 25-room property in Christina Lake, BC, situated directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest) and the Trans Canada Trail. The motel offers a range of room types from standard sleeping units to two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, and serves a complimentary continental breakfast to guests. It sits at a natural crossroads for cyclists exploring the Kettle Valley Railroad Trail, Grand Forks Community Trail, and Paulson Pass routes, with Christina Lake—one of the warmest lakes in Canada—just minutes away.

detail.address: 2037 Hunter Frontage Road, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

hotel.name: Handsome Dan's Port Renfrew
hotel.desc: Handsome Dan's is a vacation rental management company offering over 30 unique cottages and homes in Port Renfrew and beyond, ranging from oceanfront properties to modern inland retreats. Originally founded by 'Handsome Dan and The French Girl' and taken over by Ken and Joy in 2020, the company manages self-catering properties with fully-equipped kitchens and coastal character. Port Renfrew sits at the trailhead of the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail and is a popular endpoint on the West Coast cycling route, making a self-catering cottage a practical base for touring cyclists in the area.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists The Renfrew Pub, Coastal Kitchen Cafe, and Tomi's Home Cooking as nearby places to eat in Port Renfrew

hotel.name: Fortune's Landing Motel
hotel.desc: Fortune's Landing Motel is a 30-room courtyard-style property in Enderby with an on-site restaurant, pub, and liquor store — an unusual all-in-one stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap/Okanagan corridor. Guests walk through the restaurant and lounge to reach rooms that overlook a central courtyard with a swimming pool. The property regularly hosts large adventure groups (hikers, skiers) and has received consistent praise for friendly staff and clean rooms.

detail.address: 1510 George St, Enderby, BC V0E 1V1, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub and restaurant confirmed; multiple reviews reference dinner and breakfast at the property's own pub
notes.Device charging: Accommodations page lists 'Many charging ports to plug in the devices' as a standard room amenity in all room types

hotel.name: Lizard Creek Lodge
hotel.desc: Lizard Creek Lodge is a full-service luxury mountain lodge sited slopeside at Fernie Alpine Resort, offering ski-in/ski-out and bike-in/bike-out access directly from the property. The lodge comprises 14 suites in the main building plus 85 residential-style condominiums with full kitchens, gas fireplaces, and private balconies, making it well suited to multi-night touring stays. On-site amenities include the Cirque Restaurant & Bar, the Névé Day Spa, an outdoor heated pool, and hot tubs with mountain views.

detail.address: Box 6032, 5346 Highline Drive, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6

notes.Nearby evening food: Cirque Restaurant & Bar is on-site at the lodge, serving breakfast, lunch, après, and dinner daily

hotel.name: Noralee Resort
hotel.desc: Noralee Resort is a waterfront resort on Francois Lake, 70km from Burns Lake in BC's Lakes District, offering year-round cabin rentals, RV sites with full or partial hookups, and tent camping on one of BC's purest lakes. The resort is a destination for sport fishing — rainbow trout, kokanee, Dolly Varden, char, and burbot — with annual fishing derbies all summer and boat rentals available on site. An on-site store stocks forgotten supplies, and the remote lakeside setting puts guests amid eagles, osprey, bears, moose, and deer in the Cariboo Chilcotin backcountry.

hotel.name: Moutcha Bay Resort
hotel.desc: Moutcha Bay Resort is a remote oceanfront fishing resort on the shores of Nootka Sound, roughly two hours by road from Campbell River through Strathcona Park and the village of Gold River. It offers a range of accommodation from two-storey lodge suites and luxury cedar yurts to waterfront chalets and 24-site RV and tent camping with full hook-ups. An on-site licensed restaurant (Conuma Grill), a full-service marina with boat rentals, kayak and paddleboard hire, and guided fishing round out the experience on Vancouver Island's wild west coast.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Conuma Grill restaurant serves afternoon shared plates and dinner; family-friendly, locally sourced menu

hotel.name: West Coast Trail Lodge
hotel.desc: West Coast Trail Lodge is a 20-suite, fully renovated motel in Port Renfrew, sitting just two kilometres from the Juan De Fuca Marine Trail and operated under the Wild Renfrew brand. Room options range from standard king rooms with balcony to a two-bedroom suite with a full kitchen, and all rooms are pet-friendly. On-site food and drink are available at the Renfrew Pub and Coastal Kitchen, making it a convenient base for multi-day coastal wilderness trips.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Renfrew Pub and Coastal Kitchen listed as amenities on the website

hotel.name: White Cap Motel
hotel.desc: White Cap Motel is a retro-themed motel in the historic town of Wells, BC, offering rooms ranging from single-occupancy doubles to two-bedroom kitchenette suites, including a step-free accessible room. Owners live on-site enabling 24/7 check-in, a practical feature for touring cyclists with unpredictable arrival times. The property is associated with Diggy's Diner and is situated near Bowron Lake and Barkerville, making it a convenient base for multi-day Cariboo touring.

detail.address: 3885 Ski Hill Road, Wells, British Columbia V0K 2R0, Canada

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Diggy's Diner is listed in the motel's navigation and its hours are shown on the motel's contact page, confirming on-site morning breakfast service is available most days of the week

hotel.name: Crown Isle Resort Clubhouse
hotel.desc: Crown Isle is an 871-acre Canadian-owned full-service resort and residential golf community situated in the Comox Valley near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, centred on an award-winning Platinum-rated 18-hole championship golf course with views of the Beaufort range and Comox Glacier. The resort complex includes 114 suites, villas, and cottages, plus the Timber Room Bar & Grill overlooking the 18th green and a fitness centre within the clubhouse. Touring cyclists exploring the Comox Valley will find a polished, amenity-rich base with on-site dining in an accessible location.

notes.Nearby evening food: The Timber Room Bar & Grill is on-site at the clubhouse, described as serving west coast cuisine with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the 18th green

hotel.name: Kitimat Lodge
hotel.desc: Kitimat Lodge is a full-service fishing and adventure lodge in Kitimat, BC, offering guided fly fishing, saltwater, and freshwater fishing trips on the Skeena, Kitimat, Nass, and Kalum rivers. Accommodation ranges from single and double suites to deluxe cabins with well-equipped kitchens, with all-inclusive fishing packages available. Beyond fishing, the lodge arranges helicopter tours, hot springs visits, whale watching, and kayak transport into remote coastal Northwest BC.

hotel.name: Corbett Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Corbett Lake Lodge is a historic fly-fishing resort built in 1942, sitting on 300 acres of sub-alpine grassland near Merritt, BC, with an international reputation for trophy catch-and-release trout fishing. The property offers rustic cedar cabins and lodge rooms with self-catering kitchen facilities, surrounded by working cattle ranches, wildlife habitat, and recreational lakes. Cycling is explicitly listed among the outdoor activities available at or near the property, making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists on Highway 5A.

hotel.name: Timberline Lodge
hotel.desc: Timberline Lodges is a sprawling 168-suite condo complex at Fernie Alpine Resort, developed across six buildings between 1989 and 2008 and managed by Fernie Lodging Company. Located on Timberline Crescent at the ski resort base, it places guests within easy reach of Fernie's celebrated mountain bike trail network and the lively historic downtown. The property offers shared resort-style facilities including a heated outdoor pool, six hot tubs, sauna, games room, and fitness room spread across the buildings.

hotel.name: Kye Bay Cottages
hotel.desc: Kye Bay Cottages is a historic beachfront cottage resort on the east coast of Vancouver Island that has hosted families since 1923, offering cedar-built 1- and 2-bedroom cottages with direct access to miles of sandy shoreline on the Georgia Strait. The property sits in the Comox Valley, a region known for cycling, including proximity to Cumberland's 80+ km of legendary mountain bike singletrack. Cottages are fully self-catering and the property operates year-round, including winter off-season retreats.

notes.Nearby evening food: Winter Experience page notes 'Charming pubs, cafes and restaurants dotted throughout Comox'; Activities page references Downtown Comox's 'wide array of shopping, food + beverage options'
notes.Nearby grocery: Activities page highlights Sieffert's Farm Market at 720 Knight Rd on the Comox peninsula as a nearby farm market selling vegetables, corn, potatoes, and more

hotel.name: Winston Lodge
hotel.desc: Winston Lodge is an intimate 11-room boutique lodge situated steps from Kicking Horse Mountain Resort and 13 km from Golden, BC, making it a natural base for mountain bikers, hikers, and ski tourers exploring the Canadian Rockies. The property features a dedicated equipment room for bikes, ski storage, and a boot dryer, alongside a barrel sauna and hot tub for post-ride recovery. Guests describe attentive, knowledgeable hosts and a cozy common area with a floor-to-ceiling fireplace — the kind of place a touring cyclist remembers.

notes.Drying area: Equipment room includes a boot dryer; website states 'Never have wet boots or gloves again.' Directly useful for cycling footwear and gloves
notes.Nearby evening food: Lodge is 'just steps from the renowned Kicking Horse Mountain Resort'; guest review notes 'So close to Kicking Horse for coffee, breakfast and dinner.' Lodge also maintains an F&B recommendations page for restaurants in and around Golden

hotel.name: 28 Inn Hotel
hotel.desc: The 28 Inn Hotel is a small, independently operated hotel in New Hazelton, BC, situated at a strategic junction for travellers heading toward the Yukon, BC's Pacific Coast, or the Rocky Mountains. The property offers standard, kitchenette, and family rooms with refrigerators, microwaves, and air conditioning. Grocery stores, restaurants, a gas station, a bank, and a post office are all described as within walking distance of the hotel.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states restaurants are within 2-3 minute walking distance; External Services page lists restaurants as a nearby service
notes.Nearby grocery: External Services page lists 'Grocery/Convenience Stores' as a nearby external service within walking distance
notes.Wi-Fi: FAQ confirms free wireless internet; password provided at front desk; no fees charged

hotel.name: Royal Reach Motel & Marina
hotel.desc: Formerly the Royal Reach Motel & Marina, this recently renovated property now operates as The Spot at Porpoise Bay Hotel & Marina, situated directly on Porpoise Bay in Sechelt on BC's Sunshine Coast. The hotel features contemporary oceanview and garden-view rooms with a working marina offering daily and annual moorage in calm bay waters. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient base for Sechelt Inlet exploration, with the village, dining, and a farmers market within easy walking or short cycling distance.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Walking distance to the village and farmers & artisans market' and promotes 'charming seaside towns & enticing dining options'; a Google review featured on the site notes 'about a 5 min bike ride from food and drinks.'

hotel.name: Barnabas Landing
hotel.desc: Barnabas Landing is a Christian retreat centre founded in 1986, situated on the north side of Keats Island off BC's Sunshine Coast and operated by Barnabas Family Ministries. The property hosts curated year-round retreats for families and leaders, as well as group bookings for non-profit, ministry, and corporate organizations ranging from 20 to 80 guests. Reaching the centre requires a boat or ferry crossing from the Gibsons/Langdale area, making it an unusual but scenic island destination.

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Courtenay
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Courtenay is a budget motel situated on Cliffe Avenue, the main commercial arterial through Courtenay on Vancouver Island. It operates under the Wyndham Hotels group's nationally consistent Super 8 brand, positioned in the heart of the Comox Valley — a well-travelled cycling region. Touring cyclists will find it a straightforward urban overnight stop with easy access to Courtenay's commercial services.

hotel.name: Northwinds Lodge
hotel.desc: Northwinds Lodge is a 20-unit motel in Dawson Creek, British Columbia, operated as part of The Lodge Motor Inn group serving the Peace Country region. Rooms are fully modernized and include kitchenettes, individual climate control, and in-room fridges, making it practical for both short stopovers and extended stays. The property caters to a wide range of travellers including tourists and long-haul truckers, with large-vehicle parking and winter engine plug-ins available on site.

notes.Device charging: Website states '20 fully modernized units with plenty of outlets for charging phones and other technology'

hotel.name: Airport Inn
hotel.desc: Airport Inn is a renovated motel situated just minutes from the Port Hardy Airport and the BC Ferries terminal — a critical gateway for cyclists completing a Vancouver Island tour or connecting to Prince Rupert. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette units suited for extended stays, along with an on-site restaurant, liquor store, and meeting rooms. Its location near the northern terminus of Island cycling routes makes it a strategically important stop in an area with limited accommodation options.

detail.address: 4030 Byng Road, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant noted on the website: 'on-site restaurant and liquor store'

hotel.name: Inntowne Motel
hotel.desc: Inn Towne Motel is a mountain-setting motel in Hope, BC, situated along the Trans-Canada Highway close to Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park and the Othello Tunnels. Rooms are individually furnished and range from standard kings to pet-friendly double queens and kitchenette suites — practical options for cyclists who need to do laundry or cook after a long day. The property also features a Jacuzzi and swimming pool, and guest reviews consistently praise the cleanliness and hospitality of the hands-on management.

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Laundry & Ironing' under Motel Facilities
notes.Nearby evening food: About Us page states 'a selection of restaurants situated nearby' for guests wishing to dine out

hotel.name: Twin Valley Inn
hotel.desc: Twin Valley Inn is a hotel on Yellowhead Highway in the Smithers area. It provides overnight accommodation for traveling cyclists and others. Specific amenities and services require direct contact with the business for verification.

hotel.name: Gracie's Place
hotel.desc: Gracie's Place is an accommodation in the North Coast region of British Columbia. The business also provides car rental services, making it a multi-service facility for travelers in this remote area. It serves as a potential stop for cyclists exploring the northern coast and Haida Gwaii regions.

hotel.name: 94 Mile Hotel
hotel.desc: The 94 Mile Motel is a family-run property established in the early 1970s, situated on 15 private acres of Cariboo wilderness bordering crown land about 5 minutes south of 100 Mile House near the Highway 97 and Highway 24 junction. The motel offers 10 renovated suites averaging 340 sq ft, eight of which include full kitchens, plus seasonal RV sites with full water, electricity, and sewer hookups. Trails accessible directly from the property and proximity to some of North America's best sport fishing lakes make this a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cariboo region.

detail.address: 6937 - 94 Mile Frontage Road, 100 Mile House, British Columbia V0K 2E2

hotel.name: Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge and Restaurant
hotel.desc: Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge is a hilltop motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, marketed for its panoramic Rocky Mountain panorama—the 'Million Dollar View' that names its website—with a licensed patio and private balconies on upper-floor rooms. The property operates Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea as its on-site restaurant, offering guests an evening dining option without leaving the premises. It sits close to Kootenay National Park and the Columbia Valley cycling corridor, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists travelling the region.

detail.address: 5067 Madsen Rd., PO Box 243, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant: Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea, confirmed as operating on the property

hotel.name: Wild Bear Lodge
hotel.desc: Wild Bear Lodge is a small, intimate luxury wilderness retreat set among six private log cabins along the Lardeau River in BC's Central Selkirk Mountains, within the world's largest inland temperate rainforest. The lodge specializes in guided grizzly and black bear viewing holidays, leading small groups into remote valleys with experienced naturalist guides. Cycling travellers on the remote Highway 31 corridor near Poplar Creek would find modern cabin comfort — hot showers, comfortable beds, and high-speed internet — in an exceptionally wild setting.

hotel.name: The Outpost Motel
hotel.desc: A 20-unit roadside motel in New Hazelton, northern BC, sitting just off the Yellowhead Highway corridor on the route toward Alaska and serving a mix of seasonal workers, fishing tourists, and long-distance road travelers. The property positions itself as a quiet, practical alternative to hotel chains, emphasizing convenience for those recharging between legs of a long journey through Skeena Country. The email domain stay@robbersroost.ca still carries the legacy brand name, suggesting a rebrand rather than a complete ownership change.

hotel.name: Passage View Motel
hotel.desc: Passage View Motel is a 30-room oceanfront property in Campbell River, BC, positioned directly on the ocean side of the Island Highway with unobstructed views of Discovery Passage, Quadra Island, and the Coastal Mountains from every room. Guests have private access to the rocky shoreline below, where seals, Orcas, dolphins, and a variety of seabirds are regularly spotted. The motel offers pet-friendly rooms and serves as a convenient base for salmon fishing, Strathcona Provincial Park hiking, and ferry day trips to Quadra and Cortes Islands.

detail.address: 517 Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9W 2B9

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website states 'complimentary light take-away breakfast' is available to guests (seasonal, summer months)

hotel.name: Mile Zero Motel
hotel.desc: Mile Zero Motel is a small, owner-operated motel in Midway, BC, sitting just metres from the Kettle Valley Railway Trail — one of BC's premier long-distance cycling routes. Hosts Vickie and Tracy have welcomed touring cyclists, hikers, and outdoor enthusiasts for over 16 years, with immaculate rooms and a quiet Kettle Valley setting that makes it a natural overnight stop on a KVR tour. The motel provides free on-site parking for guests leaving bikes while they ride the trail and enforces a clear, cyclist-oriented bike-storage policy.

notes.Nearby evening food: Rooms page lists 'historical hotel and pub' within walking distance of the motel
notes.Nearby grocery: Rooms page lists 'grocery store' within walking distance of the motel

hotel.name: Inn at Big White
hotel.desc: The Inn at Big White is a hotel accommodation option situated within Big White Ski Resort, one of BC's largest mountain resorts located in the Okanagan highlands east of Kelowna. The resort operates in both winter and summer seasons, with summer offerings including eBike tours, fat biking trails, Nordic activities, and on-mountain dining. A touring cyclist staying here would be at a full-service mountain resort with shuttle transport, wellness services, and a range of dining options on site.

hotel.name: Taseko Adventures
hotel.desc: Taseko Adventures is a remote wilderness lodge and resort on Taseko Lake in British Columbia's Chilcotin region, reachable by 3+ hours of off-road travel or floatplane transfer from Whistler. Guests stay in deluxe log cabins and can choose between fully guided all-inclusive wilderness packages or self-contained cabin rentals, with activities ranging from jet boat excursions to guided hunting. The lodge emphasizes rustic authenticity, organic cuisine, and a wood-fired sauna and hot tub in an untouched backcountry setting.

detail.address: PO Box 4232 Williams Lake, BC V2G 2V3

hotel.name: Reid
hotel.desc: The Reid Hotel is a 9-room boutique hotel in Vanderhoof, BC, occupying a landmark 1916 building that was famously relocated to its current site by a team of horses in the 1930s — originally known as the Egan, then the Mayo. The interior has been substantially reimagined with premium finishes including heated bathroom floors, Frette Italian linens, Nespresso machines, and Victoria & Albert freestanding bathtubs in select rooms. For touring cyclists on the long central-interior corridor of BC, it offers an unusually upscale overnight stop in a small northern community.

hotel.name: Premier Creek Lodging
hotel.desc: Premier Creek Lodging is the oldest hotel in Haida Gwaii, established in 1910 and situated in the heart of Daajing Giids (Queen Charlotte). It offers a range of rooms from large oceanview suites to a private cottage and quieter garden rooms, all with private bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. The hotel is a short walk from the marina, a laundromat, an ATM, and several village restaurants — making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the islands.

detail.address: 3101 Oceanview Drive, Daajing Giids, British Columbia V0T 1S0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'There are several small restaurants in the village, also within easy reach.'

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Chetwynd
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Chetwynd is a branded mid-range hotel situated in Chetwynd, a small northeastern BC town at the junction of Highways 97 and 29 in the Peace River region. It is part of the Wyndham Hotels network and participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty programme. For cycle tourists riding through the remote northern interior, it represents one of the few branded accommodation options in the area.

hotel.name: Motel Bavaria
hotel.desc: Motel Bavaria is a motel in the Kootenays region located on McKay Street. The business maintains contact information for guest inquiries and reservations.

hotel.name: Bluebird Motel
hotel.desc: A 24-hour motel on 3rd Avenue serving travelers and cyclists throughout the Vancouver Island region. The round-the-clock operation provides flexibility for cycling tours with variable arrival times.

hotel.name: Prestige Mountain Resort
hotel.desc: Prestige Mountain Resort is a full-service hotel in the mountain town of Rossland, tucked between the Monashee and Selkirk ranges and five minutes from some of BC's best ski and mountain bike terrain. The resort offers on-site dining in a restaurant, lounge, and cafe with a patio overlooking the valley, plus indoor hot tub and sauna for recovery after a hard day in the saddle. As part of the family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain, it provides a professionally managed, amenity-rich base for touring cyclists exploring the Kootenays.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant, lounge, and cafe listed under hotel amenities, with patio and valley views

hotel.name: Lakeview Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Lakeview Inn & Suites is a full-service hotel in Chetwynd, part of the western Canada Lakeview Hotels and Resorts chain, positioned along the North Access Road in this small Northern BC resource town. It holds a 2-key Green Key Eco-Rating, suggesting a baseline commitment to environmental practices. Touring cyclists passing through Chetwynd — a common stop on routes through the Peace River country — will find a professionally run property with standard hotel amenities.

detail.address: 4820 North Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0

hotel.name: The Griz Inn
hotel.desc: The Griz Inn is a ski-in/ski-out hotel and condominium complex situated at the base of Fernie Alpine Resort, originally built in 1983 and a fixture of the resort for over 30 years. It offers a range of fully-equipped accommodations from hotel rooms to 3-bedroom loft suites, all with full kitchens and mountain views. The on-site Rusty Edge Restaurant and All In Skier Services boot-fitting and ski shop are located within the building.

detail.address: 5369 Fernie Ski Hill Road, Fernie, BC

notes.Laundry: Laundry Facilities listed as a building amenity on the hotel rooms page
notes.Nearby evening food: Rusty Edge Restaurant is located on-site at the Griz Inn

hotel.name: Misty Harbour Inn
hotel.desc: A motel serving travelers to Haida Gwaii, a remote island archipelago off the British Columbia coast. The property provides accommodation to visitors exploring this scenic destination.

hotel.name: Skylite Motel
hotel.desc: Skylite Motel is a family-run motel centrally located in Parksville on Vancouver Island, offering standard queen rooms, deluxe kitchenette suites, and private cottages. It sits minutes from Parksville's sandy beaches and within walking distance of restaurants and shops, making it a convenient stopover point on the Island. The property features an outdoor BBQ and picnic area, a large backyard, and pet-friendly cottages.

detail.address: 459 East Island Highway, Parksville, BC V9P 2G5

notes.Nearby evening food: Website mentions Boston Pizza as a nearby dining option

hotel.name: Comfort Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A Comfort Inn & Suites location in Merritt offering standard mid-range hotel accommodation with wireless internet access. Specific bike storage arrangements are unconfirmed due to website access issues.

hotel.name: The Great Divide Lodge
hotel.desc: The Great Divide Lodge is a hotel located in the Kootenays, a popular cycling region in British Columbia. Website access issues prevent verification of what facilities and amenities it offers to cyclists.

hotel.name: Parklane Resort & Motel
hotel.desc: Parklane Resort & Motel is a motel-class lodging in the Okanagan region. Specific amenities and cyclist facilities could not be verified as the business website was unavailable during assessment. The property appears open and publicly accessible as overnight accommodation.

hotel.name: Monte Carlo Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned, 25-room motel on Highway 5 in Barriere, BC, operated by the Blanke family since 1995 and positioned roughly halfway between Vancouver and Jasper—making it a natural overnight stop on a long-distance touring route. The property offers entry-level, wheelchair-accessible rooms, an on-site laundromat, and BBQ and picnic tables outdoors. It sits adjacent to the Station House Restaurant and close to a Petro-Canada with A&W take-out.

detail.address: 4830 Yellowhead South Highway (British Columbia Highway 5), Barriere, BC V0E 1E0

notes.Laundry: On-site laundromat confirmed: 'We have an on-site laundromat so you can wash your clothes' (guest-services page); also listed as 'Guest laundromat' on the rooms page
notes.Nearby evening food: Station House Restaurant is adjacent to the motel: 'Guests may also enjoy a delicious meal in the adjacent licensed family restaurant – the Station House Restaurant.'

hotel.name: King Pacific Lodge
hotel.desc: King Pacific Lodge is a luxury floating sport fishing resort moored at Milbanke Sound on BC's remote Central Coast, reachable only by floatplane or boat. Family-owned and operated by George and Lisa Cuthbert for over 25 years, it offers guided Chinook and Coho salmon fishing packages alongside spa facilities (hot tub, steam room, sauna), fine dining, and multiple lounge areas. Guests have included Kevin Costner and other celebrities, and the lodge prides itself on a highly personalized, all-inclusive wilderness experience.

hotel.name: Riverhaven RV Park
hotel.desc: Riverhaven RV Park and Motel sits on the banks of the Similkameen River at Hedley along Highway 3 (Crowsnest Pass), offering 22 full-service RV sites plus four motel rooms for those wanting an indoor stay. The park features a sandy beach, fishing, swimming, and fully shaded and grassed sites in a setting that repeat visitors from Canada, the US, and Europe describe as a tranquil hidden gem. It occupies a strategically useful position on a major BC interior touring corridor through the scenic Similkameen Valley.

detail.address: 6165 Crowsnest Hwy, Okanagan-Similkameen G, BC V0X 1K0

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry facilities explicitly listed: 'Coin Laundry facilities' on home page and 'Coin operated Laundry Facilities' on amenities page

hotel.name: Genellehouse Apartments
hotel.desc: Genellehouse Apartments is a small accommodation in Genelle, British Columbia, in the Kootenay region, offering at least two rental units including a Queen Room with garden and mountain views, hardwood floors, and luxury bedding. The property is listed exclusively on Airbtc, a Bitcoin-only booking platform that accepts payment via Lightning Network or on-chain Bitcoin transactions. The host greets guests personally and offers a backyard with BBQ grill, making it a distinctive stop in a quiet rural Kootenay community.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Queen Room listing explicitly states 'Breakfast included' under room features and dining facilities

hotel.name: Best Western Terrace Inn
hotel.desc: Best Western Terrace Inn is a fully renovated, 100% non-smoking hotel on Greig Avenue in Terrace, BC, described by the property as the town's finest hotel with personalized service. Guest rooms feature 42-inch LED TVs, new bed linens, an upgraded A/C system, and both wireless and wired internet access. The hotel also includes over 4,500 square feet of meeting and event space accommodating up to 240 people, making it a full-service option in the Skeena River region of BC's North Coast.

detail.address: 4553 Greig Avenue, Terrace, British Columbia V8G 1M7

hotel.name: Motel 6 Fort Nelson
hotel.desc: Motel 6 Fort Nelson is a budget motel franchise in northern British Columbia. It serves as a lodging option for touring cyclists passing through the Fort Nelson area.

hotel.name: Saddle Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Saddle Mountain Lodge is mapped in OSM as a motel in the Blue River area of BC's Cariboo/Central Interior region. The phone number on the OSM record matches the international reservation line for Mike Wiegele Heli-Skiing Resort, a luxury heli-ski village offering package-based stays in log chalets and estate houses with on-site dining. The resort caters primarily to backcountry skiing guests rather than self-supported touring cyclists.

detail.address: 965 W Blue River Frontage Road, Blue River, BC V0E 1J0

hotel.name: Sunshine Inn
hotel.desc: Sunshine Inn is a Northern BC motel chain with four locations along Highway 16, positioned as a popular stop for travellers between Prince George and Prince Rupert or heading to Alaska. The Burns Lake property offers a variety of room types and includes complimentary continental breakfast and free parking with space accommodating RVs and trailers. The front desk operates 24 hours and staff will store luggage for guests who arrive early or need extra time after checkout.

detail.address: 920 Hwy 16 West, Burns Lake, BC V0J 1E0

notes.Luggage storage: FAQ states: 'Yes, we can look after your luggage free of charge. If you arrive early or are not ready to take your bags after checking out, we will store your goods for the day.'

hotel.name: Three Valley Lake Chateau
hotel.desc: Three Valley Lake Chateau is a large 200-room lakeside hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway near Revelstoke, set against rugged mountain scenery on the shores of Three Valley Lake. The property features an indoor pool and hot tub, kayak rentals, and on-site restaurant and cafeteria, offering a comfortable full-service stop for cyclists on a long highway stretch. Room types range from standard guest rooms to multi-level specialty suites, most with private balconies or patios overlooking the gardens and lake.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and cafeteria

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham McBride
hotel.desc: The Travelodge by Wyndham McBride is a branded chain hotel situated on the North West Frontage Road in McBride, a small community in BC's Robson Valley along Highway 16. As one of the few commercial accommodations in this remote stretch of the Interior, it serves as a key overnight stop for cyclists touring the region between Prince George and Jasper. The property operates under the Travelodge/Wyndham brand with Wyndham Rewards loyalty program integration.

detail.address: 868 North West Frontage Road, McBride, BC

hotel.name: Carmel Inn
hotel.desc: The Carmel Inn is a renovated motel in the heart of central Prince George offering a range of room types from standard queens and kings to family suites and jacuzzi suites, all with kitchenette facilities. The property includes an adjoining full-service restaurant — the Carmel Restaurant — making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through or based in Prince George. The inn has a long history of hosting travellers on Highway 97, a major north-south touring route through British Columbia's interior.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Carmel Restaurant offers daily service and a Prime Rib buffet Friday and Saturday evenings; fully licensed

hotel.name: Arbutus Grove Motel
hotel.desc: Arbutus Grove Motel provides overnight accommodation on East Island Highway on Vancouver Island. Positioned on a main island transportation corridor, it is accessible to touring cyclists exploring the region.

hotel.name: Malei Island Resort
hotel.desc: Malei Island Resort is a remote, off-grid, 45-acre wilderness lodge on Malei Island, reachable only by water taxi from Port Hardy. Guests experience old-growth rainforest hiking on a 2,800-foot boardwalk, whale watching, sea otter tours, and a salt-water wood-heated hot tub built into the rocks. The surrounding area was featured in the Netflix documentary 'Island of the Sea Wolves.'

hotel.name: Old House Village Hotel & Suites
hotel.desc: The Old House Hotel & Spa is an all-suite hotel set along the Courtenay River Estuary in the Comox Valley, comprising two West Coast-inspired buildings named Maple and Cedar. It offers a full-service spa, outdoor heated pool and hot tub, gym, kitchenette-equipped suites, and a 24-hour refreshment centre. Centrally located a few blocks from downtown Courtenay, it is well-positioned for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's east coast and the broader Comox Valley.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'central location for shopping and dining' and 'just a few blocks from downtown Courtenay'; includes a dedicated 'Local Outstanding Dining Choices in Courtenay' section

hotel.name: Glacier Mountaineer Lodge
hotel.desc: Glacier Mountaineer Lodge is listed as a hotel on Kicking Horse Trail within the Kicking Horse Mountain Resort area of Golden, British Columbia. Golden sits at the gateway to Yoho, Glacier, and Banff National Parks, offering year-round access to alpine terrain and road cycling in the Canadian Rockies. The associated Kicking Horse Lodging portfolio includes several on-mountain and in-town properties managed by Bellstar Resorts.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website dining page lists multiple on-mountain restaurants at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort including Eagle's Eye Restaurant, Peaks Grill, The Jeffrey Room, Winston Bar & Bistro, and Whitetooth Grill

hotel.name: Pender Harbour Hotel
hotel.desc: Pender Harbour Hotel is a family-owned coastal property in Madeira Park on the Sunshine Coast, offering west coast-style guest rooms alongside the Grasshopper Pub and Restaurant, a liquor store, and a marina dock. The pub features a generous patio overlooking Madeira Park harbour, making it a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling the Sunshine Coast Highway. The marina dock also accepts short and long-term moorage, reflecting the property's role as a hub for both land and water travellers.

detail.address: 12671 Sunshine Coast Highway, Madeira Park, BC

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Grasshopper Pub and Restaurant with full pub fare menu, located on the same property

hotel.name: Casa Grande Inn
hotel.desc: Casa Grande Inn is a three-storey oceanside inn in Qualicum Beach, situated on the Oceanside Highway midway between Victoria and Tofino on Vancouver Island. The inn offers 17 rooms and suites all facing the ocean, some with jacuzzi tubs, private decks, and kitchenettes. It is a short ride from downtown Qualicum Beach and 12km north of Parksville, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Vancouver Island corridor.

detail.address: 3080 W. Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C5

hotel.name: Causeway Bay Hotel & Conference Centre
hotel.desc: Causeway Bay Hotel & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in Sparwood at the heart of the Elk Valley, steps from the famous Titan Truck landmark. The property includes an on-site restaurant and lounge alongside three conference and event spaces ranging from an 18-person boardroom to a 130-person ballroom. It sits within 30 minutes of world-class skiing and close to hiking trails, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Kootenay region.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Rockies Lounge open 4pm–11pm with food service until 10pm; Gateway Restaurant also on premises

hotel.name: Days Inn Golden
hotel.desc: Days Inn Golden is a franchise hotel operated under the Days Inn by Wyndham brand, located in Golden, BC — a gateway community to Yoho and Glacier National Parks and a stop on several major cycling routes through the Rocky Mountains. As a full-service roadside hotel it offers standard room accommodation in a town with limited lodging options for touring cyclists. The Wyndham Rewards loyalty program is available for guests booking direct.

hotel.name: Wild Coast Wilderness Resort
hotel.desc: Wild Renfrew (OSM: Wild Coast Wilderness Resort) is a multi-unit wilderness resort in Port Renfrew at the western terminus of the West Coast Road, where forest, river, and sea converge roughly two hours from Victoria. The property spans seaside cottages, forest view domes and studios, and a West Coast Trail Lodge, catering to a range of budgets and party sizes. An on-site waterfront pub — the Renfrew Pub — offers draught beer and food year-round, making it a natural end-of-day stop for cyclists finishing a long coastal ride.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Renfrew Pub described as 'within walking distance' of the West Coast Trail Lodge, open year-round for lunch, dinner, and drinks

hotel.name: Deerview Lodge & Cabins
hotel.desc: Deerview Lodge & Cabins is a family-run property on the Crowsnest Highway in Princeton, BC, offering rooms, suites, and pet-friendly cabins with fully equipped kitchens in every unit. With over 10 years serving Princeton, the lodge primarily caters to industrial crews and contractors at nearby mine and mill projects. Touring cyclists passing through on the Crowsnest route would find a functional overnight stop with full kitchen access and Wi-Fi, though the property's services and marketing are firmly oriented toward workforce accommodation.

hotel.name: Ainsworth Motel
hotel.desc: A motel on Highway 31 in the Kootenays region of southeastern British Columbia, positioned along a major cycling touring corridor. Serves as overnight accommodation for travelers and cyclists passing through the area. The location provides a convenient rest stop for bicycle touring routes in the region.

hotel.name: Tumbler Ridge Inn
hotel.desc: A family-run motel nestled in the UNESCO Global Geopark in the remote community of Tumbler Ridge in Northern BC, offering a rare concentration of on-site amenities for such a remote location. The property includes a café and dining room, the Coal Bin Pub, an attached liquor store, pet-friendly rooms, kitchenettes, and an on-site hair salon. Touring cyclists riding through Northern BC will find it a well-equipped stop with access to world-class hiking, fishing, and wildlife viewing in the surrounding wilderness.

detail.address: 275 Southgate St, Tumbler Ridge, BC V0C 2W0

notes.Laundry: Website About page lists 'On-site Laundry Service' as an amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Coal Bin Pub is on-site at the same property, offering drinks and events on weekend evenings

hotel.name: Langara Island Lodge
hotel.desc: Langara Island Lodge is a remote, fly-in all-inclusive luxury fishing resort on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, reachable only by charter flight from Vancouver to Masset followed by a 15-minute helicopter transfer to the island. The lodge is widely regarded as one of BC's premier saltwater salmon fishing destinations, operating 17 fully equipped 25-foot guide boats with professional staff and offering packages for couples, families, and corporate groups. Three accommodation options — Chinook Lodge, Eagle Lodge, and Raven Cottage — provide guests with what the lodge describes as relaxed luxury in a strikingly isolated Pacific setting.

hotel.name: Safari Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Safari Beach Resort is a lakefront condominium resort on the shores of Lake Osoyoos — the warmest lake in Canada — in the sunny South Okanagan. The resort features over 400 feet of private sandy beach, two outdoor pools, and fully furnished condo units with private decks overlooking the lake, surrounding vineyards, and mountains. Shops, restaurants, golf courses, a water park, and wineries are all within walking distance or a short ride, making it a practical and scenic stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry listed on the amenities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Conveniently located shops and restaurants are within walking distance'
notes.Vending machines: Ice and snack vending machine listed on the amenities page

hotel.name: Gold Bridge Hotel
hotel.desc: The Gold Bridge Hotel is a historic hotel and pub in the remote gold-rush town of Gold Bridge, nestled in BC's Bridge River Valley — one of the few services in a region defined by rugged backcountry and mining heritage. The current building was originally the Legion hall from the nearby ghost town of Bralorne, relocated and reimagined; the current owner has renovated it since 2018 while preserving its small-town character. Guests can unwind in the hot tub or sauna after a long ride, and the on-site pub and restaurant make it a natural gathering point in an area with very limited alternatives.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site pub and restaurant: 'we offer a pub, restaurant and entertainment'

hotel.name: Bear Country Inn
hotel.desc: Bear Country Inn is a modern boutique hotel/motel in the heart of downtown Terrace, BC, offering 57 recently renovated rooms across six configurations including kitchenette suites and an executive jacuzzi suite. The property features a fully-licensed on-site restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, and cardlock electronic room keys. Its central downtown location is within walking distance of shopping centres, banks, and medical services — a practical base for cyclists needing resupply or rest.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site fully-licensed restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner

hotel.name: Big Rock Motel
hotel.desc: Big Rock Motel is a 22-room oceanfront motel on Campbell River's Seawalk, facing Discovery Passage in the self-described 'Salmon Capital of the World.' Set back from the highway for quiet, it markets itself as a fishing-friendly base with parking for boats and direct access to a free public boat ramp across the road. The motel is located just south of downtown Campbell River on the scenic Oceanside Route (Highway 19A), making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists travelling Vancouver Island's east coast.

detail.address: 1020 South Island Hwy., Campbell River, BC V9W1B3

hotel.name: Coach Light Motel
hotel.desc: The Coach Light Motel & RV Park sits on Highway 16 about one hour west of Prince George in Vanderhoof, serving travellers crossing through BC's Central Interior. It offers two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes and self check-in via passcode, making it well-suited for independent travellers arriving at odd hours. The property also has full RV hook-ups and spacious parking designed for large vehicles, giving touring cyclists ample room to maneuver with trailers.

The resort has operated for over 20 years and is known for its quiet, wildlife-rich setting and explicitly inclusive, everyone-friendly culture. Touring cyclists will find laundry, strong fiber-optic Wi-Fi across the whole property, and on-site kayak and canoe rentals.

hotel.name: Park Inn by Radisson

The property features a seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub, BBQ and picnic areas set against desert landscapes, and mountain and pool-view rooms. With 24-hour reception and free on-site parking (including accessible spaces), it is a practical overnight base for cyclists touring the Okanagan.

The property sits steps from a safe sandy beach with a campfire pit and sweeping ocean views, and is surrounded by provincial parks, a marina, and trails. Sparwood sits on a key Crowsnest Pass touring corridor, making this an accessible and convenient overnight stop for cyclists traversing the region.

Guests stay in individually owned, fully equipped suites ranging from garden-view units to oceanfront chalets, all with private patios and full kitchens. hotel.name: Sandy Beach Suites
hotel.desc: Sandy Beach Suites is a family-run lakefront resort on a quiet sandy bay of Osoyoos Lake, welcoming guests since opening as Sandy Beach Motel in 1962. The property sits within walking distance of Osoyoos town centre and is surrounded by the Okanagan's vineyards, orchards, and desert terrain, making it a natural base for cycling the southern wine country routes. Guests have access to a private beach, kayaks, paddle boards, and a sports court on a large smoke-free property.

hotel.name: Old Courthouse Inn

Eight individually themed rooms are furnished with antiques and collectables, while a complimentary full hot breakfast is served daily in the on-site Edie Rae's Cafe. The property sits within walking distance of Townsite Brewing, the Powell River Public Market, and the Patricia Theatre, making it a characterful base for exploring the Sunshine Coast by bike.

hotel.name: Sandman Inn Blue River

hotel.name: Richter Pass Motel

It sits within easy reach of several restaurants, wineries, and golf courses that define the Osoyoos region.

Sicamous sits at the junction of Mara and Shuswap lakes with over 700 hiking and biking trails in the surrounding area, making this a practical overnight stop for Highway 1 touring cyclists.

The property ranges from standard rooms to fully-equipped one- and two-bedroom kitchen suites, and features a sundeck, gazebo, and BBQs with mountain views. Trailheads, dining, and the world-famous Radium Hot Springs pools of Kootenay National Park are all within a short walk or two-kilometre ride.

hotel.name: Taseko Lake Lodge
