hotel.desc: Stewart's Lodge & Camps is a family-run wilderness resort on Nimpo Lake in BC's remote Chilcotin region, operating since 1953. Guests choose from 10 lakeside log cabins or fly-in-only outpost cabins on private backcountry lakes, with activities including fishing, flightseeing over Tweedsmuir Provincial Park and the Rainbow Mountains, hiking, and watercraft rentals. It serves as a basecamp for one of BC's most scenically dramatic and otherwise unreachable backcountry areas.

notes.Laundry: Cabins 01 and 02 explicitly list Laundry as an included amenity on the /log-cabins subpage

hotel.name: Above Tide Hotel
hotel.desc: Above Tide Motel is an oceanfront property in Campbell River, BC, offering rooms and suites with private balconies and direct views over Discovery Passage. It sits on the Island Highway, making it a natural stop on a Vancouver Island touring route, with Elk Falls Park and Strathcona Provincial Park both within 30 minutes. The motel operates 24/7 with a mix of budget rooms, standard doubles, and full kitchen suites sleeping up to four.

detail.address: 361 Island Highway, Campbell River, BC V9W 2B2

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Prince George
hotel.desc: The Travelodge by Wyndham Prince George is a chain hotel located on 7th Avenue in Prince George, a major service hub in BC's Central Interior and a common overnight stop on long-distance cycling routes. As part of the Wyndham portfolio it offers standard mid-range hotel amenities in a city with full resupply options. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George on routes such as the Yellowhead corridor would find this a convenient base.

hotel.name: Capri Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Capri Motor Inn is a small roadside motel on the Yellowhead Highway serving the Smithers area. It provides basic lodging for travelers in BC's North Coast region.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Williams Lake
hotel.desc: The Ramada by Wyndham Williams Lake is a mid-scale branded hotel situated on Lakeview Crescent in Williams Lake, a key hub city in BC's Cariboo region and a natural stop on long-distance cycling routes through the interior. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar, full-service hotel experience in a town with good supply access. Williams Lake sits at the crossroads of Highway 97 and routes toward the Chilcotin, making it a strategic overnight stop for touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Cedars Inn Hotel & Convention Center
hotel.desc: The Cedars Inn is a 45-room eco-friendly hotel and convention center in Gibsons on the Sunshine Coast, situated less than 10 minutes from the Langdale BC Ferry Terminal — a convenient stop for cyclists arriving or departing via ferry. The property features an outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and a fitness centre, plus an on-site Japanese-Korean restaurant. It is one of the few hotels in the area with full convention and banquet facilities, and is notably pet-friendly with ample parking for RVs and trailers.

detail.address: 895 Gibsons Way, Gibsons, British Columbia V0N 1V0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Won's Japanese Korean Restaurant serves lunch and dinner (sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, udon, tempura and more)
notes.Wi-Fi: Complimentary Wi-Fi 6 (6th generation equipment) included for all guests; described as 'super fast' and one of few or only hotels on the Sunshine Coast offering this technology

hotel.name: Pomeroy Hotel & Conference Centre Fort St. John
hotel.desc: The Pomeroy Hotel & Conference Centre is a large full-service hotel in Fort St. John, positioned along the Alaska Highway in Northern BC — a key waypoint for long-distance touring cyclists crossing into or out of the Peace Region. The property features an indoor pool, whirlpool, waterslide, 24-hour fitness centre, and a range of room types from standard doubles to full kitchen suites. It is connected directly to Chances Casino and offers complimentary parking with big-truck accommodation.

detail.address: 11308 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, BC V1J 5T5

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states: 'Dry cleaning services and on-site guest laundry available.'
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states on-site dining is available and the hotel is 'conveniently connected to Chances Casino,' which provides additional evening food and entertainment options

hotel.name: The Kanata Invermere
hotel.desc: The Kanata Invermere is a 100% Canadian-owned chain hotel nestled in the Columbia Valley, offering a wide range of room types from standard queens to full kitchen suites and family rooms. The on-site Rocky River Grill provides meals and beverages for guests after a day of exploring the valley. It is one of several Kanata Inns locations spread across western Canada.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Rocky River Grill: 'Enjoy the convenience of a great meal or a relaxing beverage after a long day of exploring the valley.'

hotel.name: The Lion Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: The Lion Inn & Suites is an all-suite property in Chetwynd, BC, offering 19 independently appointed suites with full kitchenettes, hardwood flooring, custom tile, and keyless entry doors. Situated at the junction of Highways 97 and 29 — BC's gateway to the Peace River Country — it is a natural overnight stop for cycle tourers traversing this corridor. The property features 24/7 staffed reception and a camera-monitored, well-lit parking area, with the town's amenities reachable entirely on foot.

notes.Laundry: Website About page: 'coin operated laundry machines' on site
notes.Nearby evening food: Website front page mentions multiple restaurants walkable from the property, including The Red Lion with a full dinner menu
notes.Nearby grocery: Website front page: 'you can walk from our establishment to anywhere in town including the 2 grocery stores.'

hotel.name: The Ram's Head Inn
hotel.desc: The Ram's Head Inn is a boutique lodge established in the 1970s, situated in its own private forest within the Red Mountain ski resort just outside Rossland — described on the website as the only boutique lodge in the world with its own forest at a ski resort. It offers a range of rooms and suites decorated by local BC artists, a common lounge with fireplace, wooden hot tub, sauna, and an included breakfast that guests consistently praise as exceptional. The lodge is dog-friendly and well-positioned for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region and the Powder Highway.

detail.address: 4465 Red Mountain Rd. Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0

hotel.name: Quality Inn
hotel.desc: Quality Inn is a mid-range hotel chain with a location in Quesnel. Part of the Choice Hotels family, it offers accommodations familiar to many travelers. For touring cyclists, it represents a known chain option for overnight lodging.

hotel.name: Fort Nelson Hotel
hotel.desc: Fort Nelson Hotel is a hotel in Fort Nelson, a remote community in northeastern BC situated along the Alaska Highway. It serves as a significant stop for long-distance travellers in one of BC's most isolated northern corridors. Touring cyclists tackling the Alaska Highway or routes through the Northern Rockies will find this a key overnight option in an area with limited services.

hotel.name: Oceanside Villas
hotel.desc: Oceanside Villas is a small oceanfront motel and villa complex in Sechelt, situated directly across from Davis Bay Beach and its boardwalk on the Sunshine Coast. The property offers individual villas with kitchenettes and a three-bedroom vacation home, making it well-suited for multi-night touring stays. Scenic hiking trails, water sports, and the restaurants of Downtown Sechelt are all within easy reach.

detail.address: 4726 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Sechelt, BC V0N 3A2

notes.Nearby evening food: Website highlights Downtown Sechelt offering 'local bars and restaurants' and Gibsons Landing with 'cafes, and restaurants'

hotel.name: Bayside Resort, Ascend Hotel Collection
hotel.desc: A Choice Hotels Ascend Collection property located in Parksville on Vancouver Island. This mid-range hotel provides standard accommodation but cyclist-specific amenities and staff procedures remain unverifiable.

hotel.name: April Point Resort
hotel.desc: A resort-style hotel located on April Point Road on Vancouver Island. Published contact details indicate an operational accommodation facility, though specific amenities and cyclist-specific services cannot be verified from available sources.

hotel.name: Orca Cottage
hotel.desc: The Orca Cottage is a private luxury annex of Langara Fishing Lodge, nestled among the trees of Henslung Cove on remote Langara Island at the northern tip of Haida Gwaii. It accommodates up to 14 guests across a king-bed master suite and six queen-bed double rooms, with cedar-lined ensuite bathrooms, a lounge with stone fireplace, and a wine cellar. Access is exclusively by charter jet from Vancouver and helicopter transfer — there are no roads to or on this part of the island.

hotel.name: Piccadilly Motel
hotel.desc: The Piccadilly Motel is a cheerful property in the heart of Radium Hot Springs, offering a mix of lodge rooms and private cottages with kitchenettes at the gateway to Kootenay National Park and the Columbia Valley's golf courses. It is best known for its complimentary premium breakfast served in a vintage red double-decker bus imported from Liverpool. The property also features a BBQ station, gazebos, picnic area, hot tub, and fire pit, making it a comfortable base for exploring the surrounding mountains and valleys.

detail.address: 4874 St Joseph Street, Radium Hot Springs, British Columbia V0A 1M0, Canada

hotel.name: Villager Inn
hotel.desc: A motel in Princeton offering standard overnight accommodation with air conditioning. Touring cyclists should contact directly to confirm bike storage options and handling procedures for loaded bikes.

hotel.name: Pender Harbour Resort & Marina
hotel.desc: Pender Harbour Resort sits on the waterfront of the Sechelt Peninsula (Sunshine Coast), reachable from Vancouver via a 40-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay followed by a scenic drive through Sechelt to Garden Bay. The property offers a range of accommodation styles — chalet, cabins, motel rooms, and yurts — alongside a 100-slip marina, kayak rentals, and proximity to some of BC's best cold-water scuba diving. An on-site store carries local artisan goods, and the surrounding area provides diverse dining options a short distance away.

detail.address: 4686 Sinclair Bay Rd, Garden Bay, BC V0N 1S1

notes.Nearby evening food: Contact page states: 'our area boasts a vibrant culinary scene with a wide range of dining options just a stone's throw away.'

hotel.name: Cariboo Hotel
hotel.desc: The Cariboo Hotel is a hotel on Front Street in Quesnel, BC, situated in the heart of the Cariboo region of central British Columbia. The area is part of the historic Cariboo Gold Rush corridor and a natural waypoint for touring cyclists travelling the interior of BC. No further details about the property could be retrieved from available sources.

hotel.name: Copper Mountain Inn
hotel.desc: Copper Mountain Inn is a motel in downtown Princeton, BC, situated in the Similkameen Valley with views of the surrounding mountains and river. It sits close to the China Creek Trail, the Bridge of Dreams, and the Similkameen River, making it a convenient rest stop for cyclists travelling the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) corridor. The property offers 24/7 guest services and markets itself as a comfortable base for exploring the Princeton area.

hotel.name: Skagit Motel
hotel.desc: A recently renovated motel in Hope, BC, just off Trans-Canada Highway 1 at the junction of Hwys 3 and 5 — a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing between the coast, the Okanagan, and the Coquihalla corridor. The old building has been replaced with a newly constructed suite wing offering updated rooms with fridge, microwave, and complimentary coffee. Downtown Hope restaurants and Memorial Park are a two-minute walk away.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'short 2 minute stroll to downtown restaurants'; area info page lists multiple nearby restaurants including Hope Pizza Place Ltd., Owl Street Cafe, and Rolly's Restaurant

hotel.name: Bighorn Meadows Resort
hotel.desc: Bighorn Meadows Resort is a luxury condo-suite resort managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, set on a 9-acre property surrounded on three sides by the Springs Golf Course in Radium Hot Springs. Located in the Columbia Valley between the Rocky and Purcell Mountain ranges, it sits within easy reach of Kootenay National Park and the famous Radium Hot Springs mineral pools. The resort offers a range of suite styles including loft and townhome configurations, along with hot tubs and a seasonal outdoor pool.

detail.address: #10 Bighorn Boulevard, Radium Hot Springs, BC, V0A 1M0

hotel.name: Northwood Plaza Hotel
hotel.desc: Northwood Plaza Hotel is a well-established Prince George hotel that has been operating for over thirty years, occupying a small commercial complex that includes Nelly's Pub (a neighbourhood favourite since 1984), a liquor store, a banquet hall, and several retail shops. The pub serves meals throughout the day and into the evening, making it a convenient stop for hungry travellers. Its location on John Hart Highway provides straightforward access to Prince George's central attractions and services.

detail.address: 2280 John Hart Hwy, Prince George, BC V2K 2X8

notes.Nearby evening food: Nelly's Pub is located on-site within the hotel complex, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with daily specials and a fully licensed bar

hotel.name: Park Inn Golden
hotel.desc: Park Inn Golden is a branded hotel (Park Inn by Radisson) situated on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, formerly known as the Selkirk Inn. Golden is a gateway to Yoho and Glacier National Parks and a popular overnight stop for cyclists traversing the Rockies or riding the TransCanada route. The hotel sits at the edge of town with easy highway access for loaded touring bikes.

hotel.name: Arrow Lakes Motel
hotel.desc: A small motel in the lakefront village of Fauquier, situated right off the Needles Ferry on Lower Arrow Lake. Originally built in 1968, it was fully renovated in 2016 by owners Ken and Liz Feiffer and now offers eleven air-conditioned rooms, five of which include kitchenettes. Its location on the ferry route makes it a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling through the Arrow Lakes corridor.

detail.address: 101 Oak Street, Fauquier, British Columbia V0G 1K0

hotel.name: Westerlea Resort Motel
hotel.desc: Westerlea Resort Motel is a roadside motel situated on West Island Highway on Vancouver Island, positioned along a popular cycling corridor between Parksville and Qualicum Beach. Its location on the Island Highway places it directly on a common touring route for cyclists travelling the length of Vancouver Island. Guests would find it a convenient overnight stop in a stretch of the island known for scenic coastal riding.

hotel.name: Ace Motel
hotel.desc: Ace Motel is a newly renovated motel located centrally in Princeton at the junction of BC-3, making it a natural stop for cyclists travelling the Similkameen corridor or the Kettle Valley Trail. Rooms and suites range from standard queens to 450 sq ft kitchenette suites, with pet-friendly options available. An on-site sushi restaurant (Mikado Sushi) and walking-distance access to downtown restaurants add convenience for touring cyclists ending a long day.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Mikado Sushi restaurant; website also notes walking distance to downtown restaurants and fast food places
notes.Nearby grocery: Save on Foods listed as a nearby attraction on the motel's events/attractions page

hotel.name: Econo Lodge Fort St. John
hotel.desc: Budget hotel chain location in Fort St. John, Northern BC. Econo Lodge offers economical accommodation suitable for touring cyclists seeking basic lodging in the region. Specific bike storage and handling procedures could not be verified from the hotel's website.

hotel.name: Snow Valley Lodging
hotel.desc: Snow Valley Lodging is a motel in the heart of downtown Fernie, B.C., offering a wide range of options from standard rooms and multi-bedroom suites to standalone tiny homes with full kitchens. It markets itself as a year-round adventure basecamp with a hot tub, complimentary laundry, and on-site bicycle borrowing for both summer and winter guests. The property is dog-friendly and positioned within walking distance of downtown restaurants and amenities.

notes.Laundry: Amenities page and homepage both list 'Complimentary Laundry Facilities'

hotel.name: Blue Bell Inn
hotel.desc: Blue Bell Inn is a roadside motel, Petro Canada gas station, and convenience store all under one roof on the Alaska Highway in Fort Nelson, BC — a strategically important resupply point for cyclists on one of North America's most remote touring routes. The on-site convenience store stocks snacks, cold drinks, fresh bakery items, and travel essentials, and non-guests can access a shower-only service. The RV park with full amenities makes this a flexible stop for a range of travellers.

hotel.name: V.I.P. Motel
hotel.desc: V.I.P. Motel is a motel on the West Island Highway on Vancouver Island, operating under the Evergreen Hotel Group alongside several other Vancouver Island Coast properties. Its location on this highway corridor places it along a well-travelled Vancouver Island cycling route. No further details about the property's facilities or character are available from the current website.

hotel.name: Lakeside Motel
hotel.desc: Lakeside Motel is a 32-room independent motel on Highway 97 (the Cariboo Highway) in Williams Lake, a significant waypoint on north-south cycling routes through BC's Cariboo region. Rooms include microwaves, refrigerators, and flat-screen TVs, and the property features a picnic area and BBQ grills — practical amenities for cyclists needing to cook or rest. Pets are welcome, free on-site parking is available, and the motel is within a short distance of Scout Island Nature Centre and other local attractions.

detail.address: 1505 Cariboo Highway, Williams Lake, BC V2G 2W3

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'laundry facilities' as an available on-site amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Website nearby-places section lists The Laughing Loon (bar, 0.8 mi) and Oliver Street Bar & Grill (bar, 1.5 mi)
notes.Vending machines: Website amenities page lists 'Vending Machine (Drinks)'; front page also lists 'Vending machines' as a facility
notes.Wi-Fi: Website states 'high-speed, unlimited Wi-Fi connection' free of charge in all rooms

hotel.name: Wanakena motel
hotel.desc: The Wanakena Motel is a family-owned property set on country acreage in Burns Lake, at the heart of the Lakes District in northern British Columbia along the Yellowhead Highway. It offers 17 ground-floor rooms with kitchenettes, a large parking lot, and outdoor electrical plugins. The surrounding region features over 300 lakes and is a hub for fishing, canoeing, hiking, and other outdoor recreation.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states motel is 'located minutes from shopping, restaurants, parks and recreation sites'

hotel.name: Best Western Westerly Hotel
hotel.desc: Best Western The Westerly Hotel & Convention Centre is a full-service branded hotel on Cliffe Avenue in Courtenay, the main commercial hub of the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. The property includes an on-site bar and lounge and a restaurant, giving it more infrastructure than a typical roadside motel. Courtenay sits at the intersection of cycling routes connecting the Comox Valley communities, making this a central overnight option for touring cyclists moving through the region.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site bar and lounge and restaurant confirmed by website: 'Unwind with a handcrafted cocktail in our cozy bar and lounge' and 'our restaurant area is the perfect place to relax and recharge.'

hotel.name: Ripley Creek Inn
hotel.desc: Ripley Creek Inn is a collection of more than ten restored heritage buildings spread across Stewart, BC — a remote northern community near the Alaskan border, surrounded by glaciers and dramatic mountain terrain. The property spans named structures ranging from the original Main Lodge (completed 2001, 11 rooms each with private bath, fridge, and microwave) to quirky historic houses like The Ritz (dating to 1910) and Peterson House, known as 'The Old Brothel.' An on-site Latin-inspired restaurant, El Tostador, provides full evening dining for guests.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant 'El Tostador' offers Latin-inspired cuisine including starters, mains, and cocktails

hotel.name: Alpine Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Alpine Inn & Suites is a newly renovated motel situated in the heart of Revelstoke, within easy walking distance of downtown shops, restaurants, pubs, and cafes, with mountain views visible from every room. The property offers a range of rooms and full kitchen suites, a free-use hot tub and BBQ grill, and a winter shuttle to Revelstoke Mountain Resort. Its central location near Mount Revelstoke National Park and the Columbia River makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring this mountain town.

notes.Nearby evening food: About page: 'Within short walking distance, you can find many shops, restaurants, pubs, cafes & lounges.'
notes.Nearby grocery: About page states 'there is a very big supermarket within walking distance'; amenities page confirms 'minutes walking to downtown commercial area with grocery store.'
notes.Device charging: Amenities page lists 'clock with USB charger' as standard in-room equipment in every room

hotel.name: Coast Prince George Hotel by APA
hotel.desc: Coast Prince George Hotel by APA is a full-service urban-style hotel in the heart of downtown Prince George, Northern BC's largest city. It incorporates APA Hotel elements from Japan — including TOTO Washlet bathrooms and origami crane décor — alongside on-site dining at Shogun Japanese Steakhouse and Winston's Resto-Bar. The hotel also offers an indoor pool, hot tub, and sauna, making it a comfortable base for cyclists tackling long routes through the Central Interior.

detail.address: 770 Brunswick Street, Prince George, BC V2L 2C2

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site dining includes Shogun Japanese Steakhouse and Winston's Resto-Bar, both described as 'signature dining destinations' on the hotel's own website

hotel.name: Pomeroy Inn and Suites Dawson Creek
hotel.desc: Pomeroy Inn and Suites operates a hotel on Highway 2 in Dawson Creek, serving as a convenient overnight stop for cyclists traveling in northern BC. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi to guests.

hotel.name: Anavada Inn and Suites Spruceland
hotel.desc: Anavada Inn & Suites is a recently renovated budget motel in Prince George, BC, offering straightforward rooms with kitchenettes, mini-fridges, and a community kitchen available to all guests. The property features an on-site Mexican restaurant, CHACO'S, making it convenient for a sit-down evening meal without leaving the premises. It is pet-friendly and centrally located with 24-hour front desk reception.

notes.Laundry: Guest Laundry listed in room amenities for Prince George location (charges apply)
notes.Nearby evening food: CHACO'S on-site restaurant at the Prince George location serves tacos, pizza, and margaritas

hotel.name: Radium Park Lodge
hotel.desc: Radium Park Lodge is a motel in Radium, a gateway community in the southeastern Kootenays. It provides overnight accommodation for touring cyclists traveling through the region.

hotel.name: Lasqueti Island Hotel, Pub & Restaurant
hotel.desc: The Lasqueti Island Hotel is located on Lasqueti Island, a small, off-grid island in the Strait of Georgia accessible only by a passenger-only ferry from French Creek near Parksville. For touring cyclists, reaching the hotel already requires a ferry crossing, making it a genuinely remote destination in the Gulf Islands region. The island is known for its rural, self-sufficient character, which shapes the experience of any accommodation there.

hotel.name: Swept Away Inn
hotel.desc: Swept Away Inn is a hotel accommodation. Without access to the business website, specific amenities and cyclist-specific details cannot be verified. Touring cyclists should contact the business directly to inquire about bike storage and related services.

hotel.name: Inakeep Resort
hotel.desc: Inkaneep Point Resort is a lakefront cabin resort on the southern shore of Osoyoos Lake, just 3km from the town of Osoyoos. The property offers self-catering cabins and a five-bedroom waterfront lodge, all within steps of a private pebble beach with a buoyed swimming area, swim rafts, and a large fishing pier extending into the lake. The surrounding Okanagan area is well known for cycling routes connecting numerous wineries and golf courses.

hotel.name: The Orchard at Oliver
hotel.desc: The Orchard at Oliver is a motel, cabin, and RV park set within a working fruit orchard in Oliver, BC, a short walk from town and surrounded by wineries and golf courses. The property explicitly calls out the area's wide, flat roads as ideal for cycle tours and positions itself as a base for Okanagan cycling adventures. Guests enjoy a communal outdoor lounge with fire pits, complementary BBQs, a clubhouse kitchen, and seasonal fruit from the orchard trees.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated guest laundry available to all guests, per the Facilities page
notes.Nearby evening food: Facilities page states 'From coffee and a croissant to fine dining meals Oliver has an abundance of great choices.'
notes.Vending machines: Snack vending station ('snack vending station') located in 'Big Room', offering cold drinks and snacks, per Facilities page

hotel.name: Steelhead Valhalla Lodge
hotel.desc: Steelhead Valhalla Lodge is a remote wilderness fishing lodge situated on the banks of the Sustut River in Northern BC, accessible only by floatplane from Smithers. The operation centers on guided steelhead fishing with jet boats on the lower 18 miles of the Sustut, with five hand-hewn log cabins (built in the 1950s, fully renovated in 2017-2018) each featuring a private bathroom, wood stove, and river views. The lodge runs a full from-scratch culinary program and maintains a repeat booking rate of nearly 95% among its fishing clientele.

hotel.name: Heron's Landing Hotel
hotel.desc: Heron's Landing is a boutique oceanfront hotel in Campbell River on Vancouver Island, offering rooms and apartment-style suites decorated with European antique décor and private balconies with ocean views. It holds the highest Green Key eco-rating in Campbell River and has 30 units ranging from standard king/twin rooms to two-bedroom penthouse suites with full kitchens. A hot breakfast is included with all room rates, making it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's gateway to adventure.

detail.address: 492 South Island Highway, Campbell River, BC V9W 1A5

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Coin laundry' on the front page and 'Onsite coin operated laundry' on the extended-stay page

hotel.name: Lighthouse Motel
hotel.desc: The Lighthouse Motel is an oceanfront motel in Qualicum Bay on Vancouver Island, with views across the Strait of Georgia to Hornby Island and the snow-capped Coastal Mountains. The property sits on the West Island Highway and promotes itself as a year-round base for exploring the area. Nearby cycling routes listed on the website include the Lighthouse Country Trail (15.8 km) and mountain bike trails, with ferry access to Denman and Hornby Islands about 8.7 km away.

detail.address: 6035 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Bay, BC V9K 2E1

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Quesnel
hotel.desc: The Ramada by Wyndham Quesnel is a branded chain hotel on St. Laurent Avenue in Quesnel, a significant service hub in BC's Cariboo region situated along Highway 97. Quesnel is a key resupply and overnight stop for cyclists traveling the interior of British Columbia, including those on the Gold Rush Trail corridor. The property is part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts network with loyalty program integration.

hotel.name: Sea Flame Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Sea Flame Beach Resort is a family-oriented beachfront property in Qualicum Bay offering rustic wood cabins and ocean-front RV sites, operated by the same family since 1988. The resort sits directly on the beach with fire pits, a central lawn with volleyball and badminton, and a playground, giving it a classic BC summer-camp character. Touring cyclists in the area will find the resort well-positioned for day trips to Mount Washington, old-growth forests, and local kayaking and paddleboarding.

detail.address: 6383 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2E5

notes.Laundry: Log house listing explicitly includes laundry; not mentioned for the three smaller cabins

hotel.name: Redford Motel & RV
hotel.desc: Redford Motel & RV has operated in Port Alberni for over 40 years, offering 34 rooms that range from single queen kitchenettes to full kitchen suites and extended-stay apartments, alongside RV grounds. The property sits in the Port Alberni Valley surrounded by mountains, lakes, and rivers, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring central Vancouver Island. An on-site restaurant, Dimitri's, has been serving pizza since 1980.

detail.address: 3723 Redford St, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 3S3

notes.Nearby evening food: Dimitri's Restaurant is on-site; website states 'Providing the Alberni Valley with the finest pizza since 1980' and lists it as part of the Redford Motel & RV complex

hotel.name: Snow Creek Lodge
hotel.desc: Snow Creek Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out luxury condo property at Fernie Alpine Resort, constructed in 1999 and situated directly beside the Elk Quad chairlift. It offers 61 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites with fireplaces, access to two hot tubs, an outdoor heated pool, a fitness room, and underground parking. Managed by Fernie Lodging Company, it is one of the operator's flagship 'Signature Properties' in the Elk Valley.

hotel.name: The Beach Club Resort
hotel.desc: The Beach Club Resort is an oceanfront luxury property in Parksville on Vancouver Island, situated steps from what has been voted Canada's favourite family-friendly beach. The resort features spacious accommodations, an acclaimed oceanfront dining patio, and a proprietary Stay® amenity program that includes complimentary rentals of kayaks, SUPs, and boogie boards. Cyclists arriving in Parksville will find the property well-positioned near walkable shops and the beach, with an on-site spa, heated indoor pool, and fitness centre rounding out the experience.

hotel.name: Sand Pebbles Inn
hotel.desc: Sand Pebbles Inn is an oceanfront hotel in Qualicum Beach situated along a miles-long stretch of beach widely regarded as among the finest on Vancouver Island, with all rooms offering ocean views across the Strait of Georgia toward Denman, Hornby, Lasqueti, and Texada Islands. The inn sits along the West Island Highway, placing cyclists within minutes of Little Qualicum Falls, Cathedral Grove, Englishman River, and Milner Gardens, with Tofino and Long Beach an easy day-trip away. Room options range from standard kings and doubles to full kitchen apartment-style suites suitable for longer stays.

detail.address: 2767 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C4

notes.Device charging: All rooms equipped with a clock with USB charger as standard
notes.Wi-Fi: Each room has its own dedicated fiber optic Wi-Fi included at no charge

hotel.name: Northern Rockies Lodge
hotel.desc: Northern Rockies Lodge is a full-service lakeside resort perched on Muncho Lake at Mile 462 of the Alaska Highway, roughly halfway between Fort St. John and Whitehorse—making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the Alcan. The property spans hotel rooms, motel units, cozy cabins, lakeshore chalets, and an RV park, all complemented by a licensed dining room, lounge, sauna, and on-site gas station. Its proximity to Liard Hot Springs and the Muskwa-Kechika backcountry gives tired touring cyclists both practical services and a genuinely spectacular setting in the northern Rockies.

detail.address: Mile 462 Alaska Highway, Muncho Lake, BC V0C 1Z0

notes.Laundry: RV park page lists 'coin shower, laundry facilities' as available for RV guests
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site fully licensed dining room and lounge confirmed on front page

hotel.name: Slumber Lodge
hotel.desc: Slumber Lodge is a motel situated in Hope, BC, at the junction of Highway 1 in the Fraser Canyon gateway, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists traversing southern BC. The property has a website listing rooms and amenities, though specific services are not detailed in available content. Its highway access location positions it conveniently for touring cyclists moving between the Lower Mainland and the Interior.

notes.Wi-Fi: Not contradicted by website content

hotel.name: Crystal Springs Motel
hotel.desc: Crystal Springs Motel is a motel in Radium, BC with WiFi access. Located in a mountain tourism area, it may serve touring cyclists, though specific bike amenities and storage arrangements require direct inquiry to confirm.

hotel.name: Elkford Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Elkford Motor Inn is a motel in Elkford, located in the East Kootenays region of British Columbia. It provides accommodation to travelers passing through the area.

hotel.name: Sigma Inn & Suites Hudson's Hope
hotel.desc: Sigma Inn & Suites is a 3-star hotel in Hudson's Hope, positioned off Highway 29 in British Columbia's remote northern Peace River region. The property ranges from standard rooms with microwaves and refrigerators to full-kitchen suites, and operates an on-site bar and restaurant serving both Western and Chinese cuisine. A fitness centre and hot tub make it a well-equipped rest stop in an area with limited accommodation options.

notes.Laundry: Guest launderette listed as a main facility on the front page
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Daily breakfast included in the rate; 'Breakfast takeaway containers' explicitly listed as a main facility
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site bar and restaurant serving Western and Chinese cuisine
notes.Wi-Fi: Policies page states 'WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge'

hotel.name: Merritt Lodge Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Merritt, BC offering standard overnight accommodation. For details about bike storage and other amenities, contact the business directly.

hotel.name: CMH Valemount Lodge
hotel.desc: CMH Valemount Lodge is Canadian Mountain Holidays' most exclusive heli-skiing destination — a private, 10-room luxury post-and-beam lodge deep in BC's remote Cariboo Range. Guests reach the property exclusively by private jet charter and personal helicopter, with access to over 400 runs across the largest CMH tenure. In addition to winter ski programs, the lodge offers guided heli-accessed hiking adventures in summer.

hotel.name: Cathedral mountain lodge
hotel.desc: Cathedral Mountain Lodge is a collection of handcrafted luxury log cabins set along the Kicking Horse River inside Yoho National Park, near Emerald Lake and Field, BC. Designed by Vancouver architect Brad Lamoureux and opened in 2006, the lodge uses native logs, timber framing, and local stone to blend into its forested riverside setting. Guests enjoy chef-driven fine dining in the on-site Riverside Dining Room and complimentary concierge services, making it a high-end staging point for exploring iconic Rockies destinations such as Lake Louise, Takakkaw Falls, and the Burgess Shale.

detail.address: 1 Yoho Valley Rd, Field BC V0A 1G0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Riverside Dining Room serves dinner for lodge guests (reservations required); menu includes full mains and desserts

hotel.name: Masset Oceanview Hotel
hotel.desc: Masset Oceanview Hotel is a small, independently run motel situated on the waterfront in downtown Masset on Haida Gwaii, offering spacious 525-square-foot rooms with harbour views and a complimentary made-to-order hot breakfast. Its central location puts guests within easy walking distance of shops and dining in one of the few service hubs on the islands. Reviewer comments highlight friendly, accommodating hosts and clean, well-maintained rooms — a notable asset for cyclists who have endured remote stretches of Haida Gwaii's limited road network.

hotel.name: Sportsman's Inn
hotel.desc: Sportsman's Inn is a hotel located in Northern BC along Beattie Drive, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a commercial tourism property. Its name and remote northern location suggest it likely caters to hunters, anglers, and outdoor travellers passing through this sparsely populated region. Touring cyclists riding routes through northeastern BC may find it a practical overnight stop in an area with limited accommodation options.

hotel.name: Sutton Place Hotel Revelstoke Mountain Resort
hotel.desc: The Sutton Place Hotel Revelstoke Mountain Resort is an upscale suite-style hotel situated at Revelstoke Mountain Resort, offering apartment-style suites ranging from studios to three-bedroom units, many with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and mountain-view balconies. It operates year-round in a premier ski and outdoor recreation destination in the Columbia Mountains, with on-site dining across multiple venues including Rockford Bar & Grill and La Petite Baguette. Touring cyclists arriving in Revelstoke would find comfortable, self-contained accommodation with easy access to the town's services.

notes.Laundry: In-suite washer/dryer included in all suite types as confirmed across room listings
notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site dining venues listed: Rockford Bar & Grill, Revelation Lodge, Mackenzie Common Tavern, La Petite Baguette, plus room service
notes.Device charging: USB Charging Ports listed as a suite feature in room amenity descriptions

hotel.name: DC Lodge
hotel.desc: DC Lodge is a motel in Northern BC offering wireless internet access. It provides overnight accommodation to travelers passing through the region.

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Sicamous
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham Sicamous is a budget hotel chain property situated in Sicamous, BC, a small lakeside town at the junction of the Trans-Canada Highway and Highway 97A often called the Houseboat Capital of Canada. It sits in the heart of the Shuswap region, which is traversed by several long-distance cycling routes including the Trans Canada Trail. As a nationally recognized brand property, it offers a predictable, accessible overnight option for touring cyclists passing through the interior of BC.

hotel.name: Ramada
hotel.desc: The Ramada by Wyndham Revelstoke is a four-storey chain hotel situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists travelling through the Columbia Mountains corridor. As a Wyndham-branded property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty programme and offers standard chain-hotel amenities. Its Trans-Canada location puts it close to Revelstoke's downtown core and the Rogers Pass route.

hotel.name: Grama's Inn
hotel.desc: Grama's Inn is a family-owned and operated motel in Prince George, BC that has been in continuous operation for over 50 years. With 60 recently renovated rooms and suites — including pet-friendly rooms, kitchen suites, and accessible rooms — it serves a wide range of travellers from solo visitors to large sports teams and bus tours. An on-site restaurant, guest laundry, and meeting and banquet facilities make it a self-contained base in the city.

detail.address: 901 Central Street West, Prince George, BC V2M 3C8

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Guest Laundry Self Service & Supplies' as an on-site amenity
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Grama's Kitchen is an on-site restaurant that serves breakfast and lunch daily
notes.Vending machines: Website lists 'Ice and Vending Machines' as an on-site amenity

hotel.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Osoyoos
hotel.desc: A Holiday Inn & Suites branded hotel in Osoyoos offering standard chain accommodation. The hotel has Wi-Fi and provides accessible lodging in the community.

hotel.name: Quality Inn Merritt
hotel.desc: A Quality Inn franchise motel located in Merritt on the TransCanada corridor. This mid-range chain accommodation provides standard motel services to touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Buena Vista by the Sea Motel
hotel.desc: Buena Vista by the Sea is an adults-only waterfront motel in Qualicum Beach on the east side of Vancouver Island, offering eight renovated suites—each with a full kitchen and ocean views. Upper suites feature private balconies with panoramic sea vistas, while lower suites open directly onto a manicured lawn at the water's edge. The motel sits amid biking routes, nature trails, golf courses, and wildlife sanctuaries, making it a convenient base for mid-island touring.

detail.address: 3285 Island Highway West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C6

hotel.name: Sunshine Coast Resort
hotel.desc: Sunshine Coast Resort is a waterfront hotel and marina in Madeira Park (Pender Harbour), offering oceanview suites, executive cottages, and self-contained rooms with kitchenettes and decks overlooking the ocean and mountains. The resort positions itself as a basecamp for Sunshine Coast recreation including mountain biking, kayaking, and hiking, and operates its own fleet of boat rentals. Its marina and pet-friendly policy add to its appeal as a multi-night destination stop for touring cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast.

detail.address: 12695 Sunshine Coast Highway, Madeira Park, BC V0N 2H0

hotel.name: Tsa-Kwa-Luten Lodge
hotel.desc: Cape Mudge RV Park is a secluded, First Nations-owned oceanfront facility on Quadra Island, reached by a 10-minute ferry crossing from Campbell River, sitting at the water's edge of a 1,100-acre forest along Discovery Passage. The property offers 30 fully serviced RV sites (many oceanside or beachfront) and the Wharfhouse, a two-bedroom beachfront cottage with full kitchen and panoramic ocean views. The former Tsa-Kwa-Luten Lodge building transitioned to a Wellness Centre in November 2024, so overnight accommodation is now limited to the RV park and cottage.

detail.address: #1 Lighthouse Road, Quathiaski Cove, BC V0P 1N0

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry machines available at the RV park service building

hotel.name: Reno Motel
hotel.desc: The Reno Motel is a characterful small motel in Salmo, BC, at the hub of the Kootenays where two main highways meet, placing Nelson, Trail, and Castlegar all roughly 40 km away. Each room is unique — several include a separate bedroom and some feature original claw foot tubs — and the property has communal outdoor BBQ and seating areas. Salmo Ski Hill, which offers mountain biking in summer, is practically at the doorstep, making this a practical base for active touring.

detail.address: 123 Railway Avenue, Box 49, Salmo, BC V0G 1Z0

notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page states 'Downtown, easy walking distance to restaurant and pub'

hotel.name: Destination Inn
hotel.desc: Destination Inn is a fully renovated 22-room motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, situated at the south entrance of Kootenay National Park and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, and shops in the village core. The property features a common room lounge with a full kitchen, a cedar gazebo, BBQ area, and fire pit, with continental breakfast included for all guests. Its central location in one of BC's most popular mountain-resort villages makes it a practical and comfortable base for cyclists touring the Columbia Valley.

detail.address: 4881 St. Mary's Street, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'walking distance to restaurants, fitness centre, bars, pubs, liquor store, candy store & various boutique shops.'
notes.Device charging: Website lists 'USB & Power Station' as a standard room amenity

hotel.name: Anchor Inn
hotel.desc: The Anchor Inn & Suites is Campbell River's only oceanfront hotel, a seven-story full-service property where all 77 guestrooms open onto private balconies facing the water, offering views of whales, dolphins, and cruise ships passing through Discovery Passage. Touring cyclists arriving in Campbell River will find a walkable location just steps from the downtown waterfront promenade, with an onsite restaurant, indoor pool, and Thai spa on site. The hotel sits directly off the Island Highway, making it an easy stop on a Vancouver Island tour.

detail.address: 261 Island Highway, Campbell River, BC V9W 2B3

notes.Laundry: Amenities page lists 'Laundry/valet services' as a hotel feature
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary breakfast available for all guests at the Waterfront Restaurant; a guest review specifically notes a takeout breakfast option from a menu of four choices
notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite Anchor Waterfront Restaurant & Lounge provides evening dining; amenities page also lists 'Bar & lounge'

hotel.name: Barney's Lakeside Resort
hotel.desc: Barney's Lakeside Resort is a 12-acre fishing and recreation resort on Puntzi Lake in the remote Chilcotin, positioned roughly midway along the Freedom Highway (Highway 20) between Williams Lake and Bella Coola—a corridor popular with long-distance touring cyclists. The resort offers cabins ranging from one to seven bedrooms with full kitchens and fire pits, plus a 16-site RV campground with lakeside camping. Mountain biking and trail hiking are listed among the recreational activities available in the surrounding area.

detail.address: 3556 Puntzi Lake Road, Chilanko Forks, BC V0L 1H0, Canada

notes.Wi-Fi: Wi-fi is only available in CABIN 5 per the amenities page notice

hotel.name: Ocean Marina Hotel
hotel.desc: The Ocean Marina Hotel is a 42-room, 100% non-smoking property in Port Alberni, BC, located just off Pacific Rim Highway 4 near Clutesi Haven Marina and Sproat Lake Provincial Park. The hotel features onsite dining at Bucksnort's Bar & Grill and Creekers Pub, plus an onsite Creekers Beer & Wine store, making it a self-contained stop after a long day on the road. Free large-vehicle parking and 24/7 coin-operated laundry add practical convenience for touring cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on the 2nd floor, open 24/7
notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite Bucksnort's Bar & Grill and Creekers Pub both offer lunch, dinner, and drinks on the hotel property

hotel.name: Atlin Mountain Inn
hotel.desc: Atlin Mountain Inn is a fully renovated 20-room hotel on Lake Street in the remote northern BC community of Atlin, featuring the famous Atlin lake view from guest rooms. The property includes a fine dining restaurant and the old-fashioned Discovery Saloon, making it a genuine hub in a small, isolated town. Amenities are notably broad for the region, including a guest kitchen, laundry machines, free continental breakfast, and new EV charging on-site.

notes.Laundry: Guest Laundry Machines available (Rooms page)
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site fine dining restaurant and Discovery Saloon; website also notes other restaurants in town are open
notes.Vending machines: Vending machine in the lobby with fresh meals and snacks to go

hotel.name: Northway Motor Inn
hotel.desc: The Northway Motor Inn is a 43-room motel in Dease Lake, BC, situated along the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37) — one of only two BC routes to the Yukon and Alaska — making it a critical overnight stop for anyone travelling this remote northern corridor. It serves as a base camp for exploring the Cassiar Mountains, historic Telegraph Creek, and the Stikine River wilderness. There is no cell service anywhere along Hwy 37 or in Dease Lake itself, making the inn's WiFi the sole connectivity lifeline for touring travellers in the area.

detail.address: 81 Boulder Avenue, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0

notes.Laundry: Guest laundry listed under hotel services (fees apply)
notes.Nearby grocery: Grocery store in Dease Lake listed under local services; website describes it as well-stocked
notes.Wi-Fi: High-speed WiFi listed as a standard room amenity; Info & Tips page notes it is the only connectivity option as there is no cell service in Dease Lake or along Hwy 37

hotel.name: Copper River Motel
hotel.desc: Copper River Motel is a roadside motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Terrace, BC, a key stop on a major cycling corridor through northern British Columbia. The property offers a variety of accommodation types including rooms with kitchenettes, trailer units with bunk beds and outdoor fire pits, and RV/camping sites. It is pet friendly and provides high-speed wireless internet.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Sunrise Inn
hotel.desc: A Best Western Plus branded hotel located on Main Street in Osoyoos, BC, at the heart of the Okanagan's wine and cycling country. The property features an indoor pool, complimentary breakfast, and suite-style rooms. Osoyoos sits at the southern end of the Okanagan Valley cycling corridor, making this hotel a natural stop for riders on multi-day tours.

detail.address: 5506 Main Street, Osoyoos, British Columbia V0H 1V0

hotel.name: Sunshine Inn Executive Suites
hotel.desc: A hotel located on Yellowhead Highway in Terrace providing overnight accommodation. Website content unavailable for verification of specific amenities or cycling facilities.

hotel.name: Wilderness Rim Resort
hotel.desc: Wilderness Rim Resort sits on the eastern shore of Nimpo Lake in BC's Chilcotin Plateau, roughly 185 miles west of Williams Lake on Highway 20 toward Bella Coola. The resort offers a range of cabin options from rustic units to the spacious lakefront Mt. Trumpeter cabin, plus RV and tent sites, making it a practical basecamp for the remote west-Chilcotin cycling corridor. Nimpo Lake is also BC's largest floatplane base, giving the resort an unusually wild and scenic setting near Tweedsmuir Provincial Park.

detail.address: P.O. Box 49 Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

notes.Laundry: Front page notes RV/tent sites include 'shower houses and laundry'; Mt. Monarch Cabin description notes 'washer and dryer conveniently located inside the cabin.'

hotel.name: Coldwater Hotel
hotel.desc: The Coldwater Hotel is a hotel located in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia, positioned along what is likely a significant touring corridor through the interior. Its name suggests a connection to the Coldwater River area near Merritt, a common stop for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Okanagan. No further detail about the property could be confirmed due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Kingfisher Oceanside Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Kingfisher Pacific Resort & Spa is an award-winning oceanside resort on Vancouver Island offering rooms, suites, and penthouses alongside an acclaimed spa featuring Healing Caves and Hydropath wellness circuits. The property has earned recognition from Condé Nast Traveler, Travel + Leisure, and the BC Hotel of the Year Award among many others. Touring cyclists arriving here would find a polished coastal retreat with multiple on-site dining venues serving daily breakfast through dinner.

detail.address: 4330 Island Highway South, Courtenay, BC V9N 9R9

notes.Nearby evening food: Multiple on-site restaurants: Ocean7 Restaurant, AQUA Bistro & Wine Bar, and Sky Domes Restaurant; website states daily breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner service

hotel.name: Casa Del Mila Oro Resort
hotel.desc: Casa Del Mila Oro Resort is a family-oriented lakefront resort on Osoyoos Lake, offering fully furnished 3-bedroom townhouses and 2-bedroom condos on 300 feet of private beachfront at the northern tip of the Sonoran Desert. Operating since 2006, it caters to guests drawn to Osoyoos's award-winning wine country, desert hiking, and five nearby golf courses—all popular with Okanagan touring cyclists. Units include full kitchens and private patios, making extended stays practical for self-catering travelers.

hotel.name: Alpen Motel
hotel.desc: Alpen Motel is a family-run roadside motel in Radium Hot Springs that has been welcoming guests since 1984, situated on the western slope of the Canadian Rockies just 3 km from the famous Radium Hot Springs pools. Rooms open directly to parking, and the motel is a short walk from Radium's main street dining and services. The surrounding Columbia Valley is a hub for cycling, hiking, whitewater rafting, and mountain biking, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through the region.

detail.address: 5022 Hwy 93, P.O. Box 27, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'We're a stones throw away from all of the local bars and restaurants, and would be happy to recommend a place that will suit your taste.'

hotel.name: Countryside Inn
hotel.desc: A motel on Crowsnest Highway in the Okanagan region offering overnight accommodation. Limited information available due to website inaccessibility.

hotel.name: Tranquility Bay Waterfront Inn
hotel.desc: Tranquility Bay Waterfront Inn is a small boutique inn on Sechelt Inlet on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering three oceanfront suites and a separate treehouse cottage, each with private entrances, ocean views, and access to a private beach and dock. Ranked #1 on TripAdvisor for the Sunshine Coast, it emphasizes relaxation and nature immersion with complimentary use of kayaks, paddleboards, and an oceanfront hot tub. Touring cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast would find it a scenic and comfortable base, though Sechelt's restaurants and shops are accessed primarily by road.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states: 'Sechelt Town: A coastal town with a variety of restaurants, cafés and shops and pubs are within 20 minutes' drive away.'

hotel.name: Stonebridge Hotel by Pomeroy
hotel.desc: The Stonebridge Hotel sits at the famous Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway in Dawson Creek, making it a natural stopping point for touring cyclists tackling one of North America's great adventure routes. The full-service property includes an on-site restaurant (Fixx Urban Grill), a pool with waterslide, hot tub, and 24-hour fitness centre. Pet-friendly rooms and suites ranging from standard queens to full kitchenette suites give cyclists flexibility for longer stays.

detail.address: 500 Highway 2, Dawson Creek, British Columbia V1G 0A4

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Fixx Urban Grill restaurant; website also notes the hotel is within minutes of multiple restaurants
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states the hotel is 'within minutes to... Walmart, grocery stores'

hotel.name: Barriere Motor Inn
hotel.desc: A motel located along the Southern Yellowhead Highway in Barriere, providing basic lodging for travelers passing through the Thompson-Okanagan region.

hotel.name: Alberni Inn
hotel.desc: Alberni Inn is a motel on Redford Street serving the Vancouver Island region. Touring cyclists passing through would find it as a basic accommodation option for overnight stays.

hotel.name: Heriot Bay Inn
hotel.desc: A historic inn operating since 1896 on the shores of Heriot Bay, Quadra Island, offering European-style hotel rooms, ocean-view cabins with full kitchens, a two-storey suite, an RV park and campground, and a full-service marina. The on-site HBI Pub and Herons Dining Room make it the social hub of Quadra Island, with live music, events, and west coast cuisine. Quadra Island is a short ferry hop from Campbell River and is noted for mountain biking, kayaking, and whale-watching.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site HBI Pub described as open year-round offering pub fare; Herons Dining Room also on-site offering elevated west coast menu
notes.Wi-Fi: Rooms page states 'Free, limited wifi is available'

hotel.name: Rossland Motel
hotel.desc: Rossland Motel is a small, independently-run motel sitting 1.5km from downtown Rossland and 4km from Red Mountain, operated by a hands-on manager who is visibly engaged with the local outdoor scene and willing to help arrange cyclist shuttles. The property explicitly caters to summer mountain bikers with a dedicated bike wash station and a bike maintenance room fitted with a repair stand. Rossland is one of BC's premier singletrack destinations, making this a practical multi-night base for cyclists exploring the Kootenays.

notes.Laundry: Coin-op laundry on site, explicitly mentioned on the front page
notes.Nearby evening food: Downtown Rossland, 1.5km away, described on the winter page as having restaurants that are 'gastronomical (in a good way)'
notes.Nearby grocery: Winter page references a family-run grocery store in Rossland carrying fresh organic produce, gluten-free, and specialty items, 1.5km away
notes.Bike wash / hose: Dedicated bike wash station explicitly listed on the front page alongside the bike maintenance room

hotel.name: Canadas Best Value Desert Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A modern two-story motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Cache Creek, operated under the Canada's Best Value Inn brand by Sonesta. Cache Creek sits at a historic crossroads in the Thompson-Okanagan interior, long used as a resupply point for travellers heading north, and the motel continues that tradition as a practical stop for long-distance road users. The property is pet-friendly, offers guest laundry, and advertises truck and bus parking, signalling familiarity with travellers arriving with large or heavy loads.

detail.address: 1069 South Trans-Canada Hwy, Cache Creek, BC V0K 1H0

notes.Laundry: Website lists 'Guest Laundry' as a hotel feature; description also references 'guest laundromat' on-site

hotel.name: Humpback Inn
hotel.desc: Humpback Inn is a newer, 24-room coastal motel situated in the heart of Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island, within walking distance of the protected harbour and views of Malcolm Island. Its central location puts guests close to the marina, BC Ferries terminals, whale watching, and a scenic drive to Telegraph Cove — making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the northern tip of Vancouver Island. The property is 100% non-smoking and does not accept pets.

detail.address: 1528 Broughton Blvd, Port McNeill, BC V0N 2R0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states hotel is close to 'local restaurants' in Port McNeill

hotel.name: Knights Inn Prince George
hotel.desc: Knights Inn Prince George is a budget economy motel on Dominion Street in Prince George, part of the Red Lion Hotels Knights Inn chain with over 150 locations across North America. Prince George sits at the crossroads of Highways 97 and 16, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring central BC. As an economy motel, it offers a no-frills base for riders moving through the Cariboo and Central Interior region.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Barclay Hotel
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Barclay Hotel is Port Alberni's largest full-facility hotel, with 84 eco-friendly rooms and suites on Vancouver Island's west coast. The property includes an on-site Pastimes Sports Bar and Grill, a year-round spa and sauna, and a hotel liquor store, making it a self-contained stop after a long day in the saddle. Its central Port Alberni location puts guests within minutes of the Log Train Trail, Sproat Lake, and other Alberni Valley attractions.

detail.address: 4277 Stamp Avenue, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 7X8

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Pastimes Sports Bar and Grill; website also notes an on-site restaurant serving breakfast and dinner per guest reviews

hotel.name: Hamilton Hotel
hotel.desc: Hamilton Hotel is a hotel accommodation in the Cariboo region of British Columbia. It offers standard hotel lodging to touring cyclists and other travelers in the area.

hotel.name: The Gateway
hotel.desc: The Gateway is a small, family-run motel in Radium Hot Springs, situated just minutes from the entrance to Kootenay National Park and the world-famous Radium Hot Springs mineral pools. Guests enjoy panoramic views of the Columbia Valley from sunny balconies, and the landscaped grounds include BBQ areas, fire pits, and a rustic barrel outdoor sauna. The surrounding area offers mountain biking, hiking, white-water rafting, and year-round wildlife watching — including a resident herd of over 200 bighorn sheep that roam the village.

detail.address: 4992 Hwy 93, Radium Hot Springs, British Columbia, V0A 1M0

notes.Luggage storage: Policies page states: 'If you arrive earlier then we will be pleased to store your luggage until your room is ready.'

hotel.name: Beach Acres Resort
hotel.desc: Beach Acres Resort is a family-friendly beachfront resort spread across 23 forested acres in Parksville, BC, bordered by the wide sandy shore of Rathtrevor Beach. Accommodation ranges from beachfront cottages to multi-bedroom oceanview townhouses, all with fully-equipped kitchens. On-site facilities include an indoor heated pool, hot tub, sauna, pickleball and tennis courts, and the historic Black Goose Inn pub-style restaurant.

detail.address: 1051 Resort Drive, Parksville, British Columbia, Canada V9P 2E4

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Black Goose Inn: a 60-seat British/Scottish pub-style restaurant offering cocktails, beer, light lunch, and hearty dinner, family-owned since December 2010

hotel.name: Fernie Fox
hotel.desc: The Fernie Fox Hotel is an eco-conscious property on the Crowsnest Highway in Fernie, BC, with a stated goal of becoming the most sustainable hotel in British Columbia, running much of its daily operations on solar energy and offering a free on-site EV charging station. It positions itself as a base for Fernie's world-class mountain biking and outdoor adventure, with pet-friendly rooms, a private balcony per room, and a secure on-site dog park. The hotel operates a dedicated e-bike section on its website, suggesting cyclist-specific services beyond the standard amenity set.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website describes Fernie as a 'foodies paradise' with diverse restaurants; hotel offers a hot breakfast discount at 'select local restaurants', confirming nearby dining establishments

hotel.name: Taylor Inn
hotel.desc: Taylor Inn is a full-service stopover in Taylor, BC, combining 10 hotel rooms (including 3 suites with full kitchens) with an on-site pub, restaurant, and liquor store that also stocks a small selection of groceries. The property has been under the same ownership since 2008 and caters to oilfield and contract workers as well as travellers needing stays from one night to several months. A touring cyclist arriving in this small northern BC community will find food, drink, and laundry all under one roof.

hotel.name: Painted Boat Resort Spa and Marina
hotel.desc: Painted Boat Resort Spa and Marina is a 31-villa waterfront resort set on five acres of prime marina frontage in Madeira Park on BC's Sunshine Coast, reachable by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay followed by a scenic coastal drive. The property is anchored by an award-winning spa and serenity garden, a seasonal infinity pool overlooking the harbour, and the Lagoon Restaurant serving regionally sourced coastal cuisine. Guests arriving by private seaplane can land directly at the resort's marina, making it a genuinely multi-modal destination.

detail.address: 12849 Lagoon Road, Madeira Park, BC V0N 2H0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Lagoon Restaurant serves dinner Tuesday–Saturday (no hours included per policy); located directly on the waterfront at the resort property

hotel.name: The Lodge At Skeena Landing
hotel.desc: The Lodge is a recently renovated hotel within the Skeena Landing commercial complex, situated at the junction of Highway 16 and Highway 37 just minutes from downtown Terrace. It occupies a 20+ acre mixed-use property that includes retail, restaurant, and office tenants, giving guests walkable access to shops and an on-site Indian restaurant. The property advertises a private, quiet setting alongside modern comforts including fireplaces and patios in select rooms.

notes.Nearby evening food: Chef Abhi's Classic Indian Cuisine is located on-site at 4055 Motz Road, Skeena Landing

hotel.name: The Poplars Motel

The property is open year-round and is well-positioned for exploring the southern Okanagan wine country, desert trails, and cross-border routes near the Washington state line. Staff are described as long-term Osoyoos residents knowledgeable about local attractions.

notes.Laundry: Services page lists 'Guest laundry' as an amenity
notes.Nearby evening food: Services page lists 'Pub -- across the street'

hotel.name: Ocean Crest Motel

It has 19 rooms ranging from standard doubles to deluxe kitchenette units equipped for self-catering. The location puts cyclists within easy reach of Qualicum Beach's waterfront and nearby restaurants.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'exceptional restaurants just steps away' and lists 'Local Restaurants Menu' as an available office amenity

hotel.name: Monashee Motel
hotel.desc: Monashee Motel is a motel situated on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sicamous, BC — a lakeside town known as the "Houseboat Capital of Canada" at the junction of Shuswap and Mara Lakes. The property offers modern rooms with Smart TVs, mini-fridges, microwaves, and Tempur-Pedic mattress options, along with free outdoor parking and a pet-friendly policy. Its Trans-Canada location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists traveling through the Thompson-Okanagan corridor.

detail.address: 1333 Trans-Canada Highway, Sicamous, British Columbia V0E 2V1, Canada

hotel.name: Cedar Motel
hotel.desc: Cedar Motel is a motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, centrally located in the village and within walking distance of dining, shopping, and the famed Radium Mineral Hot Springs. Now operated by Prestige Hotels and Resorts since May 2021, it offers room types ranging from standard queen rooms to fully-equipped kitchenette units, plus a BBQ sundeck and guest access to the Prestige resort's pool, hot tub, and fitness centre. There is no on-site staff; check-in and key pickup are handled at the Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort located a short drive away.

detail.address: 7593 Main St W, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website explicitly mentions Conrad's Kitchen and Grill and Don Agave Cantina, both at the Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort nearby; village dining also described as within walking distance

hotel.name: Holiday Motel & RV Resort
hotel.desc: Holiday Motel & RV Resort is a family-oriented property in Hope, BC offering 16 motel units, 4 cabins, 14 RV sites, and 4 tent sites on spacious resort grounds complete with a seasonal heated pool, campfire pits, and a children's playground. The property has a quirky distinction as a filming location for multiple movies and television shows over the years. Conveniently positioned near Kawkawa Lake and Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park, it serves as a practical overnight base for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

detail.address: 63950 Old Yale Road, Hope, BC V0X 1L2

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Restaurants' under 'Nearby' in the Service Amenities section
notes.Nearby grocery: Website lists 'grocery stores' under 'Nearby' in the Service Amenities section

hotel.name: Best Continental Motel
hotel.desc: Best Continental Motel is a family-run, 14-room motel in Hope, BC, offering retro-styled rooms centrally located near the town's restaurants, shops, and Recreation Complex. Hope sits at the confluence of the Fraser and Coquihalla rivers, surrounded by the Cascade Mountains, and is a natural stopping point for cyclists riding the Coquihalla corridor or exploring the Othello Tunnels. The property features free parking and exterior security cameras.

detail.address: 860 Fraser Ave., PO BOX 1396, Hope, BC, V0X 1L0

notes.Nearby evening food: Rolly's restaurant is described as 'right behind us around the corner' on the motel's front page

hotel.name: Qualicum Beach Inn
hotel.desc: Qualicum Beach Inn is a 32-room oceanside hotel situated directly beside Qualicum's longest sandy beach and a seawall park on Vancouver Island. Formerly the Old Dutch Inn, the property was fully renovated in 2015 into a boutique-style hotel with most rooms offering views of the Strait of Georgia and private patio or balcony access. A touring cyclist finishing a day on the Island Highway will find the hotel just steps from the beach with an on-site restaurant, lounge, heated indoor pool, hot tub, and sauna.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Restaurant and Lounge; website states 'Arrange a reservation with the front desk.'
notes.Nearby grocery: About page lists 'Qualicum Foods - Quality Foods' under a dedicated 'Groceries' heading as a nearby option

hotel.name: Northern Lights Inn
hotel.desc: The Northern Lights Inn is a motor inn in Fort St John. The property's website is currently inactive, making online amenity information unavailable. Touring cyclists should contact the property directly regarding bike storage policies and other amenities.

hotel.name: Elk Motel
hotel.desc: The Elk Motel is a small motel-style accommodation in British Columbia's Okanagan region. It offers basic overnight lodging with Wi-Fi internet access. Located on 7th Avenue, it provides a straightforward overnight option for cyclists passing through the area.

hotel.name: Arrow Lake Motel
hotel.desc: Arrow Lake Motel is a newly renovated, owner-operated motel situated in the small lakefront village of Fauquier, BC, right off the Needles Ferry on the eastern shore of Lower Arrow Lake. Originally built in 1968 and taken over by Ken and Liz Feiffer in 2016, it offers eleven air-conditioned rooms including five with kitchenettes. Its ferry-adjacent location makes it a natural stopover for touring cyclists crossing between the Arrow Lakes on the Needles-Fauquier route.

detail.address: 101 Oak Street, Fauquier, British Columbia V0G 1K0

hotel.name: Evening Star Motel
hotel.desc: The Evening Star Motel is a small independent motel situated on Highway 3, one kilometre east of Greenwood City Centre in BC's Boundary region — one of the smallest cities in Canada. It offers single, kitchen, and family units in a fully renovated facility and is open 365 days a year, making it a reliable stop on the Crowsnest Highway cycling corridor. Nearby attractions include the Trans Canada Trail (which runs parallel to Hwy 3 through Greenwood), heritage walking tours, and Jewel Lake.

hotel.name: Sage Hills Motel
hotel.desc: Sage Hills Motel is a single-storey roadside motel situated on the Cariboo Highway (Highway 97) in the V0K1H0 postal area, a stretch of road that forms a key artery for cyclists touring through BC's interior plateau. Its location along this remote corridor makes it a potentially important overnight stop for self-supported tourers covering long distances between services. The area is known for its high-desert sagebrush landscape and sparse amenity infrastructure.

hotel.name: Qualicum Beach House
hotel.desc: Qualicum Beach House is a family-run beachfront vacation property on Vancouver Island's premier walk-on waterfront, offering three self-contained suites (Brant, Heron, and Eagle) that can be rented individually or combined for up to 10 guests. The property sits along the Strait of Georgia and provides direct coastal access with kayaks and floaty toys available for guests. It is within walking distance of restaurants and trails, and is well-positioned as a base for exploring the Island.

detail.address: 3267 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C7

notes.Laundry: Laundry explicitly listed for Brant Suite ('fully equipped kitchen, laundry') and Heron Suite ('newly fully equipped kitchen, laundry')
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the property is 'within walking distance to popular restaurants.'

hotel.name: Courthouse Inn Revelstoke
hotel.desc: The Courthouse Inn is a boutique inn set in the historic core of Revelstoke, furnished with handcrafted local fir beds and Canadiana antiques, with a gourmet 3-course breakfast included in every stay. Situated in a mountain town celebrated for its cycling, skiing, and national park access, it offers a warm, lodge-style alternative to standard hotels. Touring cyclists will find dedicated bike storage and a boot/glove dryer on-site as standard inclusions.

notes.Drying area: King Suite amenities page lists 'Boot and glove dryer with ski storage available,' indicating a dedicated drying facility for gear

hotel.name: Coast Courtenay Hotel
hotel.desc: The fully renovated Coast Courtenay Hotel is a mid-size chain property in the heart of Courtenay on Vancouver Island, two blocks from the Strait of Georgia and steps from downtown shops and the Courtenay Riverway Heritage Park trail. It features an on-site restaurant (Plates Eatery, known for all-day breakfast), a seasonal outdoor pool, and pet-friendly rooms with kitchenette options suited to longer stays. The central location puts cyclists within walking distance of groceries, parks, and the broader Comox Valley trail network.

notes.Nearby evening food: Plates Eatery is the on-site restaurant, described as an automotive-themed dining venue and community-favourite all-day breakfast spot
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'groceries... all within walking distance' of the hotel

hotel.name: Avola Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Avola Mountain Lodge is a newly renovated motel on Highway 5 in the North Thompson Valley, positioned roughly midway between Kamloops and Jasper as a natural overnight stop for travellers moving through the mountains. Rooms range from standard doubles to kitchenette suites sleeping up to four, and the property includes a barbecue area and mountain views. The surrounding area offers mountain biking, hiking, fishing, and quick access to Wells Grey Provincial Park.

detail.address: 3845 West Frontage Road Rd, Avola, BC V0E 1C0, Canada

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Amenities page lists 'Complimentary morning snack bag' as an offered amenity alongside the continental breakfast
notes.Nearby evening food: Guest review on website states: 'Funky pub with great burgers and jerky just down the road.'

hotel.name: Maple Leaf Motel Inn Towne
hotel.desc: Maple Leaf Motel Inn Towne is a motel on Okanagan Highway offering overnight lodging with Wi-Fi access. Located in the Okanagan region, it serves as a potential stopover for cycling tourists traveling through the area.

hotel.name: The Explorers Society Hotel
hotel.desc: A The Explorers Society Hotel in Revelstoke.

hotel.name: Bearpaw Heli-Skiing
hotel.desc: Bearpaw Heli-Skiing is a boutique, owner-operated heli-ski operation based out of the handbuilt Binchi Lodge near Sinclair Mills, accepting just eight guests per week across 1.2 million acres of exclusive terrain spanning four mountain ranges. Named by Outside Magazine as one of the Coolest Backcountry Lodges, it is guided exclusively by ACMG- and CSGA-certified professionals flying AStar B3 helicopters. The operation is entirely winter-season and package-based, with no walk-in or drop-in access.

detail.address: 37763 Upper Fraser Road, Sinclair Mills BC, Canada, V0J 3M0

hotel.name: Palliser Lodge
hotel.desc: Palliser Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out condo-hotel nestled in the glades at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, steps from the mountain village in Golden, BC. It offers guest rooms and one- or two-bedroom condo suites with full kitchens, electric fireplaces, private balconies, and private hot tubs in select units. Golden sits at the intersection of several major cycling routes and is a gateway to Yoho, Glacier, and Banff national parks, making this a potential base for touring cyclists.

detail.address: 1420 Palliser Lodge Trail, Golden, BC V0A 1H0

notes.Laundry: Condo suite amenities list includes 'Washing machine, dryer, iron and ironing board'; in-suite only, not mentioned for guest rooms
notes.Nearby evening food: Dining page lists multiple on-mountain restaurants including Peaks Grill, The Jeffrey Room, and Winston Bar & Bistro, as well as dining options in Golden townsite

hotel.name: Sundance Resort
hotel.desc: Sundance Resort is a condo-style accommodation property within Big White Ski Resort, a large four-season mountain resort located in the Okanagan highlands east of Kelowna. The resort operates as a self-contained mountain village with on-site dining, retail, and activities including summer eBike tours, making it a destination stay rather than a simple overnight stop. Guests book through Big White's central reservation system alongside lift tickets and other resort services.

notes.Nearby evening food: Big White village has on-mountain restaurants, food trucks, and a market listed under Food & Dining on the resort website
notes.Nearby grocery: Website lists 'Order Groceries Online' as a resort service, indicating grocery provisioning is available on-mountain

hotel.name: Bella Coola Cumbrian Inn
hotel.desc: Bella Coola Cumbrian Inn is a hotel in Bella Coola, BC, located on Cliff Street and providing accommodation for travelers visiting the area.

hotel.name: Painter's Lodge
hotel.desc: Painter's Lodge is a historic waterfront fishing and nature lodge on the shores of Campbell River, with a legacy of hosting Hollywood icons and legendary anglers since its early days. The property offers standard rooms, lofts, suites, private cabins, and a full house, all with Pacific Northwest ocean or garden views. On-site amenities include a restaurant, bar, heated outdoor pool, tennis court, mobile sauna, and a marine center offering whale watching, grizzly bear tours, fishing charters, and scuba diving.

detail.address: 1625 McDonald Rd, Campbell River, BC V9W 4S5

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and bar listed under lodge amenities on the homepage and amenities page

hotel.name: Bella Coola Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Bella Coola providing overnight accommodation. Website status unknown; direct phone contact recommended to verify amenities and services.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Merritt Hotel is an 83-room property billed as Merritt's largest and most contemporary hotel, situated just off the Coquihalla Highway at the gateway to the Nicola Valley. It offers a complimentary full breakfast and modern amenities in a location well-positioned for cyclists travelling the interior BC corridor. The surrounding Nicola Valley provides access to outdoor recreation and the town's services.

detail.address: 3969 Crawford Avenue, Merritt, British Columbia V1K 1C4

hotel.name: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park
hotel.desc: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park is a year-round, pet-friendly property on the shores of Christina Lake in BC's Boundary region, offering newly renovated motel rooms with kitchenettes and air conditioning alongside 48 RV sites and 7 tent sites. The property is steps from the lake and within reach of local biking trails, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring the area. A food truck (The Fork In The Road Food Bus) appears in their on-site gallery, suggesting casual dining options close at hand.

detail.address: 19 West Lake Drive, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

hotel.name: Birken Lakeside Resort
hotel.desc: Birken Lakeside Resort is a rustic lakeside retreat on Gates Lake in BC's coastal mountains, about 45 minutes from Whistler. Built during the gold rush era, the historic property features themed cabins, a lakeside grille, a general store, and private waterfront docks. It serves as a base for hiking, water sports, and nature activities, and is also a popular venue for weddings and private events.
