detail.address: PO Box 369, 9179 Portage Road, Birken, British Columbia Canada V0N 2L0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Birken Lakeside Grille serving gourmet food overlooking Gates Lake

hotel.name: Riverside Cabins
hotel.desc: Riverside Cabins is a motel-style accommodation in Princeton, BC, established in 1934. With nearly 90 years of operation, it serves touring cyclists and other travelers. Current amenities and services cannot be verified due to website inaccessibility.

hotel.name: Ponderosa Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Ponderosa Motor Inn is an 85-unit motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, nestled between the Rocky and Selkirk mountain ranges and within reach of six national parks. Golden is a well-known hub for outdoor adventure, and the inn sits at a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists crossing the Rockies or riding the Columbia Valley. A restaurant is located directly adjacent to the property, and Kicking Horse Mountain Resort is a short distance away.

detail.address: 1206 Trans Canada Hwy, Golden, BC V0A 1H0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website /location.htm states: 'There is a restaurant adjacent to the property and many others within walking distance.'

hotel.name: Hilltop Inn Salmon Arm
hotel.desc: The Hilltop Inn is a full-service hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, offering rooms with views of Shuswap Lake, the surrounding forest, and a seasonal outdoor pool. Room categories range from Queen Executive to a 660 sq ft Junior Suite, all with in-room appliances and pillow-top mattresses. Situated along a major touring corridor in the Okanagan/Thompson region, it provides a comfortable basecamp for cyclists riding the TransCanada route.

hotel.name: Coast Osoyoos Beach Hotel
hotel.desc: Coast Osoyoos Beach Hotel is a family-friendly waterfront property sitting directly on Osoyoos Lake, in BC's warmest and sunniest corner of the Okanagan Valley. The hotel features a Spanish-inspired façade, indoor pool with waterslide, private beach with free beach chairs, and a putting green, making it one of the more distinctive full-amenity hotels in town. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient hub for the area's wine routes, lake paddling, and Okanagan hiking trails, with restaurants and cafes reachable on foot.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Stroll from our hotel to one of the many restaurants and cafes within walking distance.'

hotel.name: The Beach Retreat at Saratoga
hotel.desc: The Beach Retreat at Saratoga is a beach resort accommodation located on Clarkson Avenue near Saratoga on Vancouver Island's coast. It provides seaside lodging for travelers visiting the area.

hotel.name: Coast Discovery Inn
hotel.desc: Coast Discovery Inn, affectionately known locally as 'the D.I.', is a full-service downtown Campbell River hotel situated directly across the street from the ocean. Part of the Coast Hotels chain, it has earned a TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence and serves as a landmark within the downtown cityscape. Touring cyclists will find a convenient urban base with laundry services, free hot buffet breakfast, and on-site dining at D.I. Restaurant & Lounge, though no cycling-specific facilities are advertised.

detail.address: 975 Shoppers Row, Campbell River, BC V9W 2C4

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states 'laundry and dry-cleaning services are available'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site D.I. Restaurant & Lounge

hotel.name: Inn on the Harbour
hotel.desc: Inn on the Harbour is a boutique hotel perched on a bluff overlooking the busy Prince Rupert harbour, with recently renovated rooms and a patio lounge facing the water. It sits at a major transportation crossroads for BC Ferries, Alaska Ferries, VIA Rail, and air connections, making it a natural base for touring cyclists arriving or departing by ferry or train. Rotary Waterfront Park is on the doorstep and downtown shopping and services are within walking distance.

detail.address: 720 1st Avenue West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 3V6

hotel.name: Aspen Inn and Suites
hotel.desc: Aspen Inn and Suites is a motel situated on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Smithers, BC, a strategic overnight stop roughly midway between Prince George and Prince Rupert on a popular touring corridor. The property includes an on-site full-service restaurant and lounge (Aspen Riverhouse) capable of hosting large groups. Rooms feature microwaves and fridges, and the property offers pool and hot tub access.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Aspen Riverhouse Restaurant & Lounge serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner; accommodates parties up to 150

hotel.name: Golden Village Lodge
hotel.desc: Golden Village Lodge is a 76-unit property situated at the east entrance of Golden, BC, on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kicking Horse Canyon, tucked between the Rocky and Purcell Mountain ranges. It markets itself as a comfortable, scenic base for Canadian Rockies travel — a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Trans-Canada corridor or approaching Yoho National Park. The lodge emphasizes spacious units and a home-away-from-home atmosphere.

hotel.name: Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort, BW Premier Collection
hotel.desc: The Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort sits in the village of Radium Hot Springs, minutes from the world-famous Hot Springs Pools and nestled in the Columbia River valley between the Rocky Mountain and Purcell ranges. It is a full-service resort under the BWH Hotels umbrella, offering mountain views, kitchenette-equipped rooms, and pet-friendly accommodations. The location makes it a natural base for cyclists riding Kootenay National Park or the Columbia Valley route.

detail.address: 7493 Main Street W, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

hotel.name: Roam Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Roam Beach Resort is a beachfront property on Qualicum Bay offering newly renovated one- and two-bedroom cabins, twelve numbered RV sites that accommodate vehicles up to 32 feet, and a barrel sauna perched at the ocean's edge for cold-plunge recovery. Situated on the historic Old Island Highway 19 Oceanside Route in central Vancouver Island, it positions touring cyclists within 45 minutes of the Departure Bay ferry and a day-trip radius of Tofino, Cumberland, and Hornby Island. The resort caters to travellers and locals alike with waterfront beach access, a social deck with fire bowl, and on-site laundry.

detail.address: 6115 Island Highway West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2E2

notes.Laundry: On-site laundromat listed in site navigation and confirmed in RV-sites page: 'Facilities include an on-site laundromat.'

hotel.name: Comfort Inn
hotel.desc: Comfort Inn is a mid-range branded hotel chain. Located on the Alaska Highway in Dawson Creek, it provides standard hotel accommodation for travelers and touring cyclists in Northern BC.

hotel.name: Rainbow Lake Castle Resort
hotel.desc: Rainbow Lake Castle Resort is a rustic lakeside retreat tucked into the Cascade Mountains five minutes outside Princeton, BC, offering a mix of lodge rooms and deluxe log chalets overlooking a creek. Guests can enjoy Jacuzzi tubs, lakeside picnic areas, barbecue facilities, and abundant outdoor recreation in a scenic, lesser-known valley. The property also operates an RV park and offers weekly and monthly rentals, making it a flexible base for extended stays in the southern BC interior.

detail.address: 375 Rainbow Lake Road, Princeton, British Columbia Canada, V0X 1W0

hotel.name: Dalewood Inn
hotel.desc: Dalewood Inn is a locally owned and operated motel in Port McNeill on Northern Vancouver Island, offering renovated rooms with queen beds and optional kitchenettes. The property sits across from the marina and is close to the ferry terminal, with an on-site restaurant and cold beer and wine store. Its central location provides convenient access to whale watching, local tours, and other Northern Vancouver Island attractions.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant mentioned: 'A restaurant and liquor store are also on site so you'll have everything you need for your short or long stay.'

hotel.name: Wild Renfrew Seaside Cottages
hotel.desc: Wild Renfrew is a multi-unit coastal resort in Port Renfrew at the southern terminus of the West Coast Trail, where forest, river, and sea converge roughly two hours from Victoria. The property spans seaside cottages, forest-view domes, studios with hot tubs, and a hostel-style lodge, making it one of the more complete accommodation options at the remote western end of Vancouver Island. An on-site pub serves food and drinks year-round, which is notable given how few services exist in this area.

notes.Nearby evening food: Renfrew Pub is on the property and described as open year-round for lunch, dinner, and drinks; the West Coast Trail Lodge is stated to be within walking distance of the pub

hotel.name: Free Spirit Spheres
hotel.desc: Free Spirit Spheres is a world-renowned treehouse resort on Vancouver Island featuring three handcrafted spherical treehouses suspended among coastal rainforest trees near Qualicum Bay. The adult-only property sits on a 5-acre forested lot with a central pond, shared bathhouse with sauna, and a galley kitchen — a glamping experience marketed as among the most unique accommodations in the world. It could serve as an exotic overnight base for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's interior and nearby Horne Lake area.

detail.address: 420 Horne Lake Rd, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1Z7, Canada

hotel.name: Jade City Jade Store
hotel.desc: Jade City is a world-renowned stop on the Cassiar-Stewart Highway (Hwy-37) in Northern BC, offering seven accommodation units — cabins, a bungalow, and a four-room motel — set among jade boulders and mining equipment on a working jade mining property founded in 1985. During the summer season, guests can watch live jade cutting and polishing demonstrations steps from their door, and the on-site jade store is less than 100 feet from any room. The property gained international recognition as the setting for the Discovery Channel series Jade Fever.

detail.address: Box B8, Jade City, BC V0C 1E0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: All accommodation units (Cabina, Bungalow, Doghouse, Motel) include breakfast of eggs and bagels; Motel breakfast is served in Room 3. Timing and packed/to-go option not specified

hotel.name: Arctic Divide Lodge
hotel.desc: Arctic Divide Lodge is a boutique indigenous-family-owned property on the remote Stewart-Cassiar Highway in Dease Lake, Northern BC, housed in a handcrafted log building whose hallways double as an art gallery. The lodge offers private rooms, kitchen apartments, and full chalets with self-check-in by keycode, a communal kitchen, and Starlink WiFi — designed for self-sufficient travellers making the long drive up the Cassiar corridor. It holds a 2023 accreditation from the Indigenous Tourism Association of Canada.

detail.address: PO Box 234, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0

hotel.name: Anahim Lake Resort & RV Park
hotel.desc: Anahim Lake Resort sits on the eastern slope of the Coastal Mountains along BC's Chilcotin Highway (Hwy 20), roughly halfway between Williams Lake and Bella Coola — a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the Freedom Highway. The resort offers tent sites along the lakeshore, RV hookups with 15 & 30 amp electric and water, and rustic cabins equipped with a wood stove, hot plate, and fridge. Free hot showers and Wi-Fi are included, making it a comfortable base in an otherwise very remote stretch of interior BC.

detail.address: 2799 Reed Road, Anahim Lake, BC V0L 1C0

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Prince George
hotel.desc: Best Western Plus Prince George sits at the junction of Highways 16 (Yellowhead) and 97, making it one of the most strategically placed hotels for touring cyclists crossing northern British Columbia. The property markets itself as the gateway to BC's Northern Capital, with the hotel overview highlighting its role as a launchpad for exploring Prince George's natural and cultural attractions. As a Plus-tier franchise, it offers a higher amenity standard than base Best Western properties.

detail.address: 3387 Highway 16 W, Prince George, BC V2N 5P8

hotel.name: Adriatic Motel
hotel.desc: The Adriatic Motel is a roadside motel situated on Main Street in Osoyoos, a cycling hub at the southern end of the Okanagan Valley near the US border and popular wine country touring routes. Osoyoos sits at the junction of several regional cycling corridors including the Kettle Valley Rail Trail network. No further details about the property's facilities or character could be confirmed from available sources.

hotel.name: Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel
hotel.desc: The Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel is an award-winning boutique hotel in Trail's business district overlooking the Columbia River. The property offers premium rooms and is positioned as a refined, full-service stay in one of the Kootenays' most industrial yet scenically striking small cities. Trail serves as a gateway to mountain biking, skiing, and rail-trail cycling in the surrounding region.

detail.address: 1001 Rossland Avenue, Trail, British Columbia V1R 3N7

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website amenity tags prominently list 'free-breakfast' as a property feature

hotel.name: Western Traveller Motel
hotel.desc: The Western Traveller Motel is a 35-room property in central Grand Forks, BC, offering mountain view rooms with optional kitchenettes and a practical range of amenities. Located in the Boundary region, it sits near Seasons — a local bike, run, and ski shop — making it a convenient stopover for cyclists passing through the Kootenay-Boundary corridor. The property includes a BBQ facility, picnic area, and coin laundry.

detail.address: 1591 Central Ave, Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H0

notes.Laundry: Coin Laundry and Laundry Services Available both listed in the amenities section
notes.Vending machines: Ice machine / Pop machine listed in amenities section

hotel.name: Riverside Motel
hotel.desc: A family-owned and operated motel in Port Alberni's Alberni Valley, offering a range of room types from standard kitchenette rooms to two-bedroom cottages. The property sits near a riverside walkway where bears can be spotted fishing in late summer and fall, giving it an unmistakably wild Vancouver Island character. It is centrally located within minutes of the Clutesi Haven Marina and several local restaurants.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website names several nearby restaurants: The Clam Bucket, Bucksnorts Bar and Grill, Boomerangs Cafe, and Little Bavaria Restaurant (5-minute drive)

hotel.name: EasyStay Inn & Suites Fernie
hotel.desc: Canada's Best Value Inn and Suites Fernie is a budget motel on the Crowsnest Highway in Fernie, part of the Sonesta/Red Lion hotel brand. Fernie sits in the Elk Valley and is a well-known destination for mountain biking and cycle touring on routes including the Crowsnest Pass corridor. The brand participates in a pet-friendly program (PAWS) and a loyalty scheme across its Canadian properties.

hotel.name: Fireside Lodge
hotel.desc: Fireside Lodge is a condo vacation rental complex at Sun Peaks Resort, managed by Bear Country Property Management. Units feature gas fireplaces, full kitchens, and access to a community hot tub, giving it a self-catering feel rather than a traditional hotel experience. An onsite coffee shop and restaurant means touring cyclists arriving in the village have food options without venturing further.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'onsite coffee shop and restaurant' and references 'ordering a takeout meal from our restaurant.'

hotel.name: Revelstoke Lodge
hotel.desc: Revelstoke Lodge is a centrally located motel in Revelstoke, BC, offering standard and deluxe rooms steps from downtown amenities. It markets itself as the best-value motel in Revelstoke and provides free parking and fiber-optic Wi-Fi as standard inclusions. The property offers four room configurations with in-room microwaves and refrigerators, making it a practical base for touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Mountains corridor.

notes.Device charging: All room types listed on the website include 'Work desk with multiple USB charging ports'

hotel.name: MStar Hotel
hotel.desc: MStar Hotel is a contemporary boutique hotel embedded within the Kitimat City Centre Mall, offering 42 mountain-view rooms in a temperate rainforest setting at the base of Douglas Channel. The hotel emphasizes eco-friendly practices including a linen-reuse program and a goal of being 90% paperless. It is ADA-accessible, pet-friendly, and positions itself as the primary full-service accommodation option in Kitimat's city core.

detail.address: 150 City Center Mall, Kitimat, BC V8C 1T6

notes.Laundry: Amenities page states 'guest laundry services' listed among complimentary hotel features
notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page states 'plenty of fantastic restaurant options within easy walking distance to our hotel.'

hotel.name: Sahara Courtyard Inn
hotel.desc: Sahara Courtyard Inn is a motel in Osoyoos, BC, situated near Haynes Point Provincial Park and Rattlesnake Canyon. The property offers a seasonal outdoor pool, BBQ facilities, a game room, and a children's playground, catering to families and leisure travellers in BC's southern Okanagan. Select rooms include kitchenette facilities, and free on-site parking is available.

notes.Laundry: Third-party site amenities page lists 'Laundry services' as an on-site facility
notes.Nearby evening food: The Sage Pub & Liquor Store listed at 409 ft from the property; Tim Hortons listed at 1.0 mi
notes.Vending machines: Third-party site amenities page explicitly lists 'vending machine'

hotel.name: Hillside Lodge and Chalet
hotel.desc: Hillside Lodge & Chalets is a family-run property along the Blaeberry River outside Golden, BC, comprising multiple self-contained one- and two-bedroom cabins each with a kitchenette, wood stove, and private porch. Originally founded as a bed and breakfast in the 1990s, it now operates primarily as a wedding venue on summer weekends and a winter ski getaway near Kicking Horse Mountain Resort. Cabins are explicitly positioned as a place to unplug, with limited WiFi and no TV.

detail.address: 1740 Seward Frontage Road, Golden, B.C., V0A1H1

notes.Wi-Fi: Explicitly described as limited: 'Our cabins don't include TV & only limited WIFI - you're welcome!'

hotel.name: Clearwater Country Inn Motel & RV Park
hotel.desc: Clearwater Country Inn & RV Resort is a motel and campground property nestled minutes from the North Thompson River and the waterfalls of Wells Gray Provincial Park, offering cozy guest rooms alongside tent sites and 30-amp RV hookups. The inn provides plush rooms with free Wi-Fi and complimentary coffee, while the campground includes clean washrooms and hot showers. The property's 24/7 staff offers local insider tips, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Wells Gray region.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website has a dedicated 'Local Restaurants' navigation section and references 'local eateries' in the welcome text

hotel.name: Lido Motel
hotel.desc: The Lido Motel is a classic 1950s-inspired motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, thoughtfully refreshed with modern comforts while retaining its retro road-trip character. The property comprises four detached single-storey buildings where every room has ground-floor access with dedicated parking directly outside the door—a layout that is naturally convenient for cyclists arriving loaded. Rooms include fully equipped kitchenettes, and the motel accommodates groups of up to 32 guests across 10 rooms, with shared outdoor spaces featuring BBQs and firepits.

detail.address: 4876 McKay St, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

hotel.name: Lodge + Lantern
hotel.desc: Lodge + Lantern is a locally owned boutique hotel in downtown Golden, BC, positioned as a reimagined mountain classic at the gateway to the Canadian Rockies. Room types range from ground-floor queen and king mountain-view rooms to premium king lofts, all finished with modern amenities in a warm lodge atmosphere. Its central downtown location puts guests within walking distance of Golden's restaurants, cafés, and pubs.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: FAQ states breakfast delivery from Golden Bakery can be arranged
notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ states many restaurants, cafés, and pubs are just a short walk away, and several offer takeout and delivery directly to the lodge

hotel.name: Escott Bay Resort
hotel.desc: Escott Bay Resort is a wilderness retreat on the shores of Anahim Lake in BC's remote West Chilcotin, sitting roughly 320 km west of Williams Lake along Highway 20. The resort offers a range of accommodations from bunk bed cabins to a full chalet, plus a full hook-up campsite with barbecue facilities, making it a rare oasis of comfort in an otherwise very isolated stretch of road. Fishing, hiking, and wildlife viewing are the main draws, with the Chilcotin Plateau's dramatic landscapes surrounding the property.

detail.address: 7097 Christensen Rd, Anahim Lake, BC V0L 1C0, Canada

notes.Laundry: Campsite page states the campsite provides 'laundry facilities' among its essential amenities
notes.Nearby evening food: Amenities page describes Donna's Place in Anahim Lake as offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with hearty home-style cooking and takeout options
notes.Nearby grocery: Amenities page lists McLean Trading (general store with groceries, outdoor gear, and hardware) and Anahim Lake Trading General Store (primary grocery in the area), both located in Anahim Lake
notes.E-bike charging: Campsite page states the campsite includes 'an EV charging station for electric vehicles'; likely oriented toward cars/RVs — compatibility with e-bike chargers should be confirmed directly with the resort

hotel.name: Spruce Hill Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Spruce Hill Resort & Spa is a full-service wilderness retreat on a working cattle ranch in the BC Cariboo, offering hotel rooms and 3-bedroom chalets set within 20,000 acres of wilderness with 100 kilometres of trails for biking, hiking, and more. The property includes a spa, indoor pool, hot tubs, infrared saunas, gym, and on-site dining, making it a higher-comfort destination stay rather than a simple overnight stop. It also accommodates corporate retreats and riding groups, suggesting staff familiarity with active-travel guests.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant listed in amenities: 'Dining — Feel at home with a range of familiar dishes prepared to satisfy'; note health closure affecting restaurant flagged for Dec 2025, current status

hotel.name: Seine Boat Inn
hotel.desc: The Seine Boat Inn is a historic waterfront inn built on pilings directly over the beach and ocean in Alert Bay on Cormorant Island, a 40-minute BC Ferry ride from Port McNeill. Just a three-minute walk from the ferry terminal, the inn sits at the heart of a vibrant community steeped in 'Na̱mg̱is First Nation culture, with the U'mista Cultural Centre and coastal trails nearby. Its name honours the purse seiners, gill netters, and long liners that shaped this authentic fishing village.

detail.address: 60 Fir Street, Alert Bay, BC V0N 1A0

notes.Nearby evening food: FAQ lists The Orca Restaurant & Pub (Wed–Sat evenings), Pemba's Kitchen at The Nimpkish (Wed–Mon from 11:30 AM), Alert Bay Pizza Delivery (7 days/week evenings), and Bayside Grill, all within the village
notes.Nearby grocery: FAQ lists Shoprite Grocery Store in Alert Bay

hotel.name: Chateau Riverside Boutique Hotel
hotel.desc: Chateau Riverside Boutique Hotel is a boutique vacation rental situated beside the Campbell River in Campbell River, BC, with north-facing suites offering views of the water and local wildlife including seals. The property offers fully self-contained apartment-style suites from one to two bedrooms, each featuring a full kitchen, heat pump, in-suite sauna, and 50" flat-screen TV — designed for extended, self-catered stays with a home-away-from-home atmosphere. Its riverside location on northern Vancouver Island provides a tranquil base for touring cyclists exploring the region.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'two units equipped with laundry machines'; Comfort room listing confirms 'In Suite Washer & Dryer'
notes.Nearby evening food: Dining page lists extensive nearby pubs, restaurants, and fine dining with walking/driving times, including Riptide Marine Pub (5 min drive), Beach Fire Brewing and Nosh House (6 min), and multiple other dinner options

hotel.name: Kwa'lilas Hotel
hotel.desc: Kwa'lilas Hotel is the only Indigenous-owned 4-star hotel on northern Vancouver Island, located in Port Hardy at the northern tip of the island. Named from the Kwak̓wala word for 'a place to sleep,' it was curated by Gwa'sala-'Nakwaxda'xw Elders and features original Indigenous artwork, masks, and cultural displays throughout. Touring cyclists finishing or beginning the full island route will find on-site dining at Nax'id' Pub and Ha'me' Restaurant, plus modern room amenities in a culturally immersive setting.

detail.address: 9040 Granville St, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

notes.Nearby evening food: Two on-site venues: Nax'id' Pub (cocktails, local brews, freshly made dishes) and Ha'me' Restaurant (Indigenous-inspired West Coast cuisine), both described as serving daily

hotel.name: Spirit Ridge Vineyard Resort & Spa
hotel.desc: Spirit Ridge Vineyard Resort & Spa is a resort property in the South Okanagan region of British Columbia, operating under the Hyatt Unbound Collection brand based on its website domain. The name suggests vineyard-integrated accommodations in one of Canada's warmest and driest wine-producing regions. Touring cyclists routing through the Okanagan would find this a high-end destination-stop option in an area known for its scenic cycling through wine country and desert landscape.

hotel.name: King Edward Hotel
hotel.desc: The King Edward Hotel & Motel is the primary full-service accommodation in remote Stewart, BC — a small border town at the end of the Portland Canal opposite Alaska's Misty Fiords National Park. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette suites with outside entrances, an on-site pub, café, and licensed outdoor patio. Stewart sits at the end of the Glacier Highway and serves as a key resupply and rest point for cyclists riding the remote Stewart-Cassiar corridor.

notes.Laundry: Coin operated laundry machines listed as on-site amenity ('Guest Laundry Facility')
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site: Prospectors Pub, Casey's Pub, King Ed Cafe, and Licensed Outdoor Patio

hotel.name: Sonora Resort
hotel.desc: Sonora Resort is a five-star luxury wilderness resort on a remote BC island, part of the Relais & Châteaux collection, offering eco-adventure travel amid old-growth rainforest with abundant wildlife including eagles, whales, and bears. The resort combines elegant accommodation with world-class outdoor experiences including fishing, helicopter adventures, ocean excursions, and a full spa. It is positioned as a remote sanctuary most easily reached from Vancouver, making it an unusual but distinctive destination.

hotel.name: Rondo Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in the Kootenays region of British Columbia. No additional information available due to website connectivity issues.

hotel.name: Silvertip Lodge and Heli-Skiing
hotel.desc: Silvertip Lodge is an exclusive, off-grid heli-skiing lodge set on a 14-acre lakefront property at the remote eastern end of Quesnel Lake in BC's Cariboo Mountains, reachable only by a 45-minute helicopter flight from Williams Lake. The 7,250 sq. ft. triple A-frame lodge accommodates a small number of guests in eight en-suite rooms plus a separate lakefront cabin, with world-class dining, a spa chalet featuring sauna, steam room, and outdoor hot tub, and guided access to a 1,440 sq. km. ski tenure. It operates completely off-grid with satellite Wi-Fi throughout.

hotel.name: Somass Motel & RV
hotel.desc: A motel and RV park in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island's central coast. Offers overnight accommodation for touring cyclists and other travelers.

hotel.name: Hotel Viewmont
hotel.desc: Hotel Viewmont is a hotel and restaurant in Logan Lake, BC, operating since 1995 with 24/7 front-desk reception. It offers standard rooms with in-room microwaves and refrigerators alongside an on-site restaurant. A complimentary shuttle to Kamloops Airport is available, making it a serviceable base for cyclists passing through the Thompson-Okanagan region.

detail.address: 19 Apex Dr, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant operated by the hotel, branded throughout site as 'Hotel & Restaurant'

hotel.name: Great Northern SnowCat Skiing
hotel.desc: Great Northern SnowCat Skiing is a boutique backcountry ski lodge operating since 1979 in the Bad Shot Range of the Selkirk Mountains, offering guided snowcat powder skiing across 75 sq km of terrain with over 15 m of annual snowfall. Guests drive directly to the remote lodge, which emphasizes a family-like atmosphere, small groups, and on-site meals. It is a seasonal winter operation; cyclists visiting outside ski season should confirm availability in advance.

hotel.name: CMH Gothics Lodge
hotel.desc: CMH Gothics Lodge is a remote backcountry heli-skiing lodge operated by Canadian Mountain Holidays, internationally regarded as the epicenter of deep tree skiing in the Selkirks and Monashees. Described as a cozy, laid-back destination famous for its sociable atmosphere, the lodge attracts everyone from families to seasoned CMH veterans. Access is primarily by helicopter, placing it deep in wilderness terrain far from conventional road networks.

hotel.name: Rest Inn
hotel.desc: Rest Inn is a renovated independent motel on Lakelse Avenue in a quiet corner of Terrace, BC, offering standard queen, double, and kitchenette room types. The property sits within walking distance of the Skeena River and is a short drive from downtown, making it a practical overnight base for cyclists exploring the Skeena region. Rooms are fully equipped with kitchen appliances, and the motel provides a complimentary continental breakfast and on-site laundry.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'Laundry facilities are available.'
notes.Early or packed breakfast: Website lists 'Complimentary continental breakfast' as an included service
notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'there are many restaurants near to our hotel. Some of them are within walking distance.'

hotel.name: Airport Inn
hotel.desc: Airport Inn is a motel in Northern BC. Without access to website content, specific details about bike storage, amenities, and services for touring cyclists remain unverified.

hotel.name: Super 8 by Wyndham Williams Lake BC
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national budget motel chain with a location on Broadway Avenue South in Williams Lake, a hub city for the Cariboo region of central British Columbia. Williams Lake sits along Highway 97 and serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the interior plateau. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, guests can earn loyalty points on stays.

detail.address: 1712 Broadway Avenue South, Williams Lake, BC

hotel.name: Glen Lyon Inn
hotel.desc: Glen Lyon Inn sits on the waterfront of Hardy Bay in Port Hardy, the northern terminus of the Island Highway and departure point for BC Ferries' Inside Passage and Discover Coast routes. All 44 rooms face the ocean with balcony views, and the property sits immediately adjacent to the marina and seaplane base. Touring cyclists finishing or starting the Island Highway will find it a strategically located base, with a full-service restaurant, lounge, 24/7 front desk, and ferry terminal just 8 km away.

detail.address: 6435 Hardy Bay Road, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and bar open daily; website states 'the bar and restaurant are open daily and offer a relaxed atmosphere.'
notes.Vending machines: Website states 'Vending machines featuring snacks and drinks are located on-site.'
notes.Wi-Fi: Website states 'Free WiFi Available in all rooms and some public areas'

hotel.name: City Center Motel
hotel.desc: A motel in Hope with wireless internet access. Cycling-specific amenities and bike storage arrangements could not be verified due to website unavailability.

hotel.name: Gables Motel
hotel.desc: Gables Motel is a family-owned motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, sitting on Highway 93 (the Banff-Windermere Parkway) at the entrance to Kootenay National Park. Under new ownership since 2020, the property has been updated with new flooring and mattresses and offers a range of room types including pet-friendly rooms, a king suite with soaker tub, and a kitchen suite. Its location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Columbia Valley, the Radium Hot Springs pools, and the broader Kootenay Rockies network.

detail.address: 5028 Highway 93, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0

hotel.name: Northern Shores Lodging and Catering
hotel.desc: Northern Shores Lodging and Catering is a hotel and catering operation situated at 455 Beach Road in the North Coast & Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia. Operating in one of the most remote and sparsely serviced stretches of the BC coast, it represents a rare accommodation option for touring cyclists making their way through this area. The combined lodging and catering offering suggests on-site food service may be available.

hotel.name: Overlander Motel
hotel.desc: The Overlander Motel is a small, owner-operated 12-room motel in Chase, BC, sitting on the Trans-Canada Highway halfway between Kamloops and Salmon Arm — a natural stopping point for cyclists crossing the Shuswap. All rooms are ground-level with parking right at the door, and the property is steps from Little Shuswap Lake with mountains rising behind it. Contactless check-in via lockbox is available for late arrivals.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Walking distance to restaurants, grocery, and shops.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'Walking distance to restaurants, grocery, and shops.'

hotel.name: Chilko River Lodge
hotel.desc: Chilko River Lodge & Guest Ranch is a family-run wilderness retreat on the banks of the Chilko River in the Chilcotin, surrounded by Ts'ylos Provincial Park and the eastern foothills of the Coast Mountains. The property offers five log cabins with kitchenettes plus a main house, all accessed via gravel road from Tatla Lake, making it a genuinely remote destination. A licensed bar/restaurant serves home cooking on-site, and guests may encounter spawning salmon, grizzly bears, and bald eagles nearby.

detail.address: P.O. Box 43, Tatla Lake, BC V0L 1V0

notes.Nearby evening food: Lodge operates a licensed bar/restaurant serving home cooking on-site

hotel.name: Qualicum Beach Ocean Suites
hotel.desc: Qualicum Beach Ocean Suites is a small complex of eight self-contained, fully equipped oceanfront suites situated directly on the beach on the east coast of Vancouver Island, next to a seawall park. Each suite includes a full kitchen, private outdoor seating, and sweeping views of the Georgia Strait. Guests also receive complimentary access to the neighbouring Qualicum Beach Inn's indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and fitness room.

detail.address: 2795 Island HWY W, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C4

notes.Nearby evening food: Website recommends the Qualicum Beach Cafe at the neighbouring Qualicum Beach Inn: 'QBOS guests are encouraged to try the casual elegant atmosphere and cuisine of the Qualicum Beach Cafe during their stay.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Amenities page states: 'Just a quick trip to the grocery store to fill your fridge is all you'll need,' implying a grocery store is within easy reach

hotel.name: Sorrento Inn Motel
hotel.desc: The Sorrento Lakeview Inn is a 22-room lakeside motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sorrento, BC, operated as part of the Shuswap Resorts complex on the shores of Shuswap Lake. Room options range from standard queen/double units with lake-view balconies to kitchenette suites with private patios, and guests have access to the resort's beach and water-sports rentals. A coin-operated laundromat and showers are available at the adjacent RV park area, and the Copper Island Pub is a short walk away.

detail.address: 1277 Trans-Canada Highway, Sorrento, British Columbia V0E2W0

notes.Nearby evening food: Copper Island Pub and Pool Hall described as a short walk from the inn, with karaoke and live bands

hotel.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Dawson Creek
hotel.desc: This Holiday Inn Express & Suites in Dawson Creek is a mid-range chain hotel offering standardized accommodations. It provides reliable overnight lodging typical of the brand. A straightforward stopping point for cycle tourists in Northern BC.

hotel.name: Fernie Stanford Resort
hotel.desc: A full-service riverside resort hotel in Fernie, BC, set directly on the Elk River and just minutes from Fernie Alpine Resort. The property offers hotel rooms, suites, condos, and townhouses, anchored by an indoor aquatic centre with a 166-foot waterslide and the award-winning Tandoor & Grill restaurant serving East Indian cuisine. It is one of the higher-profile year-round accommodation options in Fernie, catering to both winter ski and summer adventure travellers.

notes.Nearby evening food: Onsite Tandoor & Grill Restaurant serves East Indian-inspired dinner menus; also offers a Pizza & Burger Menu

hotel.name: Silvertip Lodge
hotel.desc: Silvertip Lodge is an ultra-remote, all-inclusive heli-skiing lodge perched on the east end of Quesnel Lake deep in BC's Cariboo Mountains, accessible only by charter aircraft and helicopter — there are no roads to the property. The 14-acre lakefront property sits within 1,440 sq km of exclusive ski tenure and offers fine dining, a spa chalet with hot tub, steam room, sauna, and full-time massage therapist. It caters to a small, exclusive clientele seeking a wilderness heli-skiing experience far from conventional resort infrastructure.

hotel.name: Island View Lodge
hotel.desc: Island View Lodge is a modern 30-room motel in Powell River, BC, offering air-conditioned rooms with private balconies and complimentary Wi-Fi. The property sits steps from Townsite Brewing and is a short drive from Willingdon Beach Park and Second Beach, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast. It is pet-friendly in designated rooms and accepts major credit and debit cards.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states property is 'steps from Townsite Brewing'

hotel.name: Courtyard Prince George
hotel.desc: Courtyard by Marriott hotel in Prince George located on Brunswick Street. A chain hotel offering accommodations for touring cyclists passing through the Central Interior region of British Columbia.

hotel.name: Qualicum Breeze Beach Resort
hotel.desc: A beachfront resort on the Strait of Georgia between Qualicum Beach and Parksville, offering a range of oceanfront suites, cottages, and a private vacation home with direct beach access. The setting is a secluded beachfront where guests can beachcomb, dig clams, fish for salmon, and observe marine wildlife including bald eagles and seals. The resort is also well-placed as a base for exploring Vancouver Island cycling and outdoor destinations, including mountain biking at Mt. Washington and trails near Cathedral Grove.

detail.address: 6695 Island Highway West, Bowser, BC V0R 1G0

hotel.name: Red Shutter Inn
hotel.desc: The Red Shutter Inn is a small, historic six-room inn at Red Mountain Resort in Rossland, BC, built in the 1960s and now owned by Big Red Cats cat skiing company. It has a casual 'ski club' atmosphere centered on a wood stove lounge and a large outdoor hot tub, and also offers a self-contained A-Frame Cabin next door for groups wanting a basic kitchen. Summer guests can use the BBQ on site, and the inn is a short walk from the resort lifts and close to local restaurants.

detail.address: 4420 Red Mountain Road, Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'We are also conveniently located to nearby restaurants.'

hotel.name: Robbie's Motel
hotel.desc: Robbie's Motel is a small, renovated motel in Cache Creek, BC, situated at the junction of Highways 1 and 97 — a classic overnight stop for cyclists traveling between Kamloops and Vancouver. The property offers clean, recently renovated rooms with a complimentary continental breakfast included. Pets are permitted with prior approval, which may be useful for touring cyclists traveling with animals.

detail.address: 1067 Todd Rd, Cache Creek, BC V0K 1H0

hotel.name: Canadas Best Value Inn - Prince George
hotel.desc: Canada's Best Value Inn Prince George is a budget motel situated along Highway 97, now operating under the Sonesta hotel umbrella following the Red Lion brand transition. It positions itself as a base for outdoor pursuits including mountain biking, hiking, skiing at nearby Tabor Mountain, and fishing in the Northern Capital of BC. An on-site restaurant, Daddyo's Pizza and Ribs, provides breakfast through dinner for guests who need a solid meal after a long day on the road.

detail.address: 1630 Central Street East, Prince George, BC V2M 3C2

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant Daddyo's Pizza and Ribs serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner on the premises
notes.Vending machines: Website lists 'Vending/Ice Machines' as a confirmed hotel feature
notes.Wi-Fi: Website confirms 'WiFi Internet' available in all guest rooms and public areas

hotel.name: Sechelt Inn
hotel.desc: A beachfront hotel in the heart of Sechelt on BC's Sunshine Coast, formerly known as the Driftwood Motor Inn and now operating as Sechelt Inn under Catalog Hospitality. The property offers simple rooms with ocean views and a fully renovated penthouse suite with rooftop patio overlooking the water. An in-house restaurant, Fred's, serves handmade pasta, hearth-fired pizzas, and coastal mains just off the lobby.

notes.Nearby evening food: Fred's restaurant is 'just off the lobby' serving handmade pasta, hearth-fired pizzas, coastal mains, and a lounge menu with smash burgers and local beer

hotel.name: River Heights Motel
hotel.desc: River Heights Motel is a 16-unit budget motel in Courtenay on Vancouver Island, recently renovated with laminated floors and offering units with full kitchens, including a two-bedroom suite. It sits within walking distance of the Air Park and the Courtenay riverway trail, making it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the Comox Valley. The motel emphasizes value and personal service, and its kitchen-equipped rooms are practical for self-catering touring cyclists.

hotel.name: Best Western Williams Lake
hotel.desc: Built in 2012, the Best Western Williams Lake Hotel is a modern full-service hotel situated on Broadway Avenue South in the heart of BC's Cariboo Region. It is a branded franchise property offering consistent amenities and a complimentary continental breakfast, making it a reliable overnight stop for cyclists passing through Williams Lake. The Cariboo Region is a major hub on central BC touring routes connecting the Interior to the coast.

detail.address: 1850 Broadway Avenue South, Williams Lake, BC V2G 5G8

hotel.name: Newton Cove Resort
hotel.desc: Newton Cove Resort is a remote, all-inclusive floating fishing lodge in Esperanza Inlet, operated by Nootka Marine Adventures and reachable only by boat or floatplane. The lodge offers luxury suites, gourmet multi-course meals, guided salmon and halibut fishing, and moorage for guests arriving by private boat. It caters primarily to sport fishing groups, families, and corporate retreats.

hotel.name: Brookside Inn Boutique Hotel
hotel.desc: Brookside Inn is a six-suite boutique hotel nestled beside Pepin Brook Vineyard Estates in West Abbotsford, with each suite individually themed after a classic romantic film. The property is five minutes from Abbotsford International Airport and positioned near hiking, birding, and the Fraser Valley's Circle Farm Tour routes. Owners Chris and Sandi Buis prepare a complimentary continental breakfast each morning using locally sourced ingredients.

hotel.name: Prestige Treasure Cove Resort Prince George
hotel.desc: The Prestige Treasure Cove Resort is a full-service hotel and resort on Highway 97 in Prince George, BC, offering standard rooms, suites, and designer rooms alongside an on-site casino, pool with waterslide and hot tub, and athletic centre. Prince George is a major waypoint for cyclists traveling the Highway 97 corridor through central BC. The property is dog-friendly and part of the Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain with 19 locations across British Columbia.

detail.address: 2005 Hwy 97 S, Prince George, BC V2N 7A3

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and cafe listed explicitly as hotel amenities on the overview page

hotel.name: Valhalla Inn
hotel.desc: A Norse-mythology-themed inn in the village of New Denver in the Slocan Valley, within reach of the 49,000-hectare Valhalla Provincial Park and surrounded by Selkirk Mountain scenery. The property includes an on-site restaurant and Odin's Pub, and sits along a corridor the inn itself describes as 'Paradise for Cyclists and Motorcyclists.' It offers a range of standard and deluxe rooms, some pet-friendly, with a direct-booking form on its website.

detail.address: 509 Slocan Avenue, New Denver, BC V0G 1S0

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and Odin's Pub both listed on the website

hotel.name: Town Centre Inn
hotel.desc: Town Centre Inn is a motel on Vancouver Island offering overnight accommodation for travelers. The motel provides Wi-Fi access to guests.

hotel.name: Bella Coola Valley Inn
hotel.desc: The Bella Coola Valley Inn is a 20-room hotel in the remote Bella Coola valley, sitting at the western terminus of Highway 20 — the legendary Chilcotin route that draws touring cyclists across BC's interior plateau. Each room comes equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a mini fridge, and satellite TV. The inn includes an on-site restaurant and pub offering Western, Korean, and Japanese cuisine alongside a summer patio and a lively pub with pool tables.

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site restaurant and pub open for lunch and dinner, serving Western, Korean, and Japanese/sushi cuisine

hotel.name: Cathedral Lakes Lodge
hotel.desc: Cathedral Lakes Lodge is one of Canada's highest full-service wilderness lodges, situated at 2000 metres elevation on Quiniscoe Lake in Cathedral Provincial Park. The lodge offers all-inclusive accommodations across lodge rooms, bungalows, and private cabins, with access to over 60 km of alpine hiking trails. It also provides transport services for backcountry campers, making it a rare full-service basecamp deep in the southern BC wilderness.

hotel.name: Fireweed Motel
hotel.desc: The Fireweed Motel is a recently renovated motel situated in the heart of Smithers, BC, offering clean and comfortable rooms for travelers on the move. It positions itself as a convenient stopover along the Highway 16 corridor, with grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance. The property also offers a Ski & Stay package and is pet-friendly, reflecting the outdoor-oriented character of the Bulkley Valley region.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'restaurants just a short walk away.'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'grocery stores... just a short walk away.'

hotel.name: Marine Inn
hotel.desc: Marine Inn is a hotel on Marine Avenue offering wireless internet access. Located in the Vancouver Island and Gulf Islands area, it provides overnight accommodation for travelers including cycling tourists exploring the region.

hotel.name: Nootka Sound Resort
hotel.desc: Nootka Sound Resort is a luxury all-inclusive floating fishing lodge moored at Galiano Bay in Nootka Sound, reachable only by boat or floatplane. Operated by Nootka Marine Adventures, it offers private suites, gourmet meals, guided salmon and halibut fishing, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding in sheltered waters. The resort is open June through August and caters primarily to fishing groups and corporate retreats.

hotel.name: Crown Columbia Hotel, BW Premier Collection
hotel.desc: Crown Columbia Hotel BW Premier Collection is a newly designed all-suite boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Trail, situated along the Columbia River. Every suite comes with a full kitchen and deluxe amenities, well-suited for touring cyclists needing a comfortable multi-night base. The central downtown location puts guests within easy walking distance of restaurants, coffee shops, the Cominco Arena, and the riverfront.

detail.address: 1399 Bay Avenue, Trail, British Columbia V1R 4A7

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states hotel is walkable to 'popular coffee shops and restaurants' in downtown Trail

hotel.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Dawson Creek
hotel.desc: The Travelodge by Wyndham Dawson Creek is a mid-range chain hotel located in Dawson Creek, BC — famously the Mile 0 marker of the Alaska Highway, making it a symbolic and practical overnight stop for northbound cycle tourers. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a recognizable, bookable lodging option in a small northern city with limited accommodation density. Cyclists completing or beginning a long-distance Alaska Highway journey would find this a convenient base in the centre of Dawson Creek.

hotel.name: Riverside Resort
hotel.desc: Riverside Resort is a 7-acre resort on the Little Qualicum River near Parksville/Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, offering accommodations ranging from studio suites and standalone cabins to two-story condos and full hook-up RV sites with 30 and 50 amp service. The property features private riverfront access, a seasonal waterpark with pools and waterslides, an 18-hole mini-golf course, and an on-site R&R convenience store, all within a 5-minute walk of the ocean. RV sites are available year-round with extended stay options, making it a potential base for longer touring visits to the Oceanside region.

detail.address: 3506 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2H4

notes.Laundry: Coin laundry facilities on-site for guests, open during regular office hours (/rv-sites.html)

hotel.name: Travelodge Golden Sportsman Lodge
hotel.desc: The Travelodge Golden Sportsman Lodge is a branded Travelodge by Wyndham property in Golden, BC, a hub town for cyclists tackling the Rocky Mountains or connecting between Banff and the Kootenays. As a mid-scale chain hotel it offers a familiar, reliable overnight stop on one of BC's most demanding touring corridors. The 'Sportsman Lodge' name suggests an outdoor-recreation orientation, though specific cyclist services are not confirmed from available sources.

hotel.name: Rivers Edge Cabins
hotel.desc: Rivers Edge Cabins offers two private riverfront cabins on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar, BC, situated 1 km from Nahatlatch Provincial Park with access to hiking, fishing, rafting, and wildlife viewing. The property reopened after a wildfire and now also offers one RV/camping spot, with eco-friendly shared washroom facilities including flush toilets, on-demand hot water, and solar-powered lighting. It is a deliberately quiet, off-the-grid-style retreat well-positioned for cyclists exploring the Fraser Canyon corridor.

hotel.name: The Canterbury Inn of Downtown Invermere
hotel.desc: The Canterbury Inn is a motel in downtown Invermere, a town on the western shore of Lake Windermere at the foot of the Rocky Mountains in southeastern British Columbia. It offers single, double, and family room configurations and sits close to regional draws including Panorama Mountain Resort, Radium Hot Springs, and Kootenay National Park trails. The inn's central location in Invermere puts touring cyclists within easy reach of local dining, shops, and the Columbia Valley Trail corridor.

hotel.name: Baymont By Wyndham Gold River
hotel.desc: Baymont By Wyndham Gold River is a branded motel in Gold River on Vancouver Island, situated in one of the more remote communities accessible to touring cyclists on the island's western interior. As part of the Wyndham chain it offers a standardised mid-range stay with loyalty programme integration. Gold River is a small resource town with limited accommodation options, making this property a notable overnight option for cyclists riding the interior routes.

hotel.name: Homestead Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: A motel in the Cariboo-Chilcotin region of northern BC. Situated on West 1st Street, it serves as a convenient rest stop for touring cyclists traversing this remote region.

hotel.name: The Tuwanek Hotel and Spa
hotel.desc: The Tuwanek is a small, adult-oriented luxury waterfront B&B on the Sunshine Coast just north of Sechelt, offering two themed king-suite rooms (African Queen and Casablanca) with ocean views, wood-burning fireplaces, and private decks. The property sits directly on the water and includes a spa, hot tub, steam cave, sandy beach, kayaks, canoe, and stand-up paddleboards. It is accessible via the Horseshoe Bay–Langdale ferry followed by a 40-minute drive up the coast.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'Lighthouse Pub So Good Anytime!' and 'Saffron They Deliver!' as local recommendations

hotel.name: Chase Country Inn Motel
hotel.desc: A family-operated, pet-friendly motel in Chase on the Trans-Canada Highway 1 corridor, situated in the Shuswap region between Kamloops and Salmon Arm. The property includes an on-site Chinese restaurant for evening meals and offers guests a complimentary seasonal breakfast during the warmer months. Its location on a busy touring route makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling the Thompson-Shuswap corridor.

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Complimentary breakfast offered to guests for bookings from Victoria Day to Thanksgiving (approx. May 1 – Oct 17); described as 'quick refreshment in the morning and ready on the road.'
notes.Nearby evening food: On-site Chase Country Inn Restaurant serves Chinese food (dine-in and take-out) Wednesday–Monday from 3:00pm–7:30pm

hotel.name: Chilko Lake Lodge
hotel.desc: Chilko Lake Lodge is a remote wilderness retreat on the shores of Chilko Lake in BC's Chilcotin, offering privately appointed lakeside and riverside cabins, guided activities such as horseback riding, kayaking, fly fishing, and ATV tours, plus on-site dining featuring locally inspired cuisine. The lodge caters to exclusive-use holidays, corporate retreats, and family gatherings, set against towering mountains and turquoise glacial waters. Its River's Edge cabin alone sleeps up to eight guests, giving it capacity for larger cycling groups venturing deep into the Chilcotin.

hotel.name: The Lodge at Arrow Lakes
hotel.desc: The Lodge at Arrow Lakes is a 47-room motel tucked into the small town of Nakusp in BC's Arrow Lakes region, a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the quieter Kootenay back roads. The property includes the Arrow Lake Tavern with an indoor dining room and outdoor patio serving food seven days a week. The surrounding area offers road cycling, lakeside walkways, and access to Valhalla Provincial Park in the Selkirk Mountains.

detail.address: 515 Broadway Street W, Nakusp, BC, V0G 1R0

notes.Nearby evening food: Arrow Lake Tavern is on-site with a dining room and outdoor patio; website states 'Open 7 days a week' with patio and takeout available

hotel.name: Langara Fishing Lodge
hotel.desc: Langara Fishing Lodge is a remote floating fishing resort on Langara Island at the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, operated by Langara Fishing Adventures. Guests arrive by charter jet from Vancouver and helicopter transfer, with all meals, beverages, and guided Pacific salmon and halibut fishing included in packages. The lodge bills itself as North America's premier destination for ocean-run Chinook, Coho, and Halibut fishing across a May–September season.

hotel.name: Nitinaht Lake Motel
hotel.desc: The Nitinaht Lake Motel is a year-round, nine-room motel operated by the Ditidaht First Nation on the remote west coast of Vancouver Island, reachable via roughly 62 km of active logging road from Lake Cowichan. It sits at the gateway to the West Coast Trail's third entrance and the famed windsurfing fjord of Nitinaht Lake, making it the sole covered accommodation in this otherwise roadless stretch of coastline. Rooms range from simple queen-bed units to two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes, offering a functional base for cyclists tackling this wild corner of the island.

notes.Nearby grocery: Nitinaht Visitor Centre and General Store (250-745-3999) is explicitly listed on the contact and things-to-do pages as a village facility; the getting-here page instructs visitors to stop there for gas and supplies before continuing past the motel

hotel.name: Echo Landing 33-38
hotel.desc: Echo Landing is the newest ski-in, ski-out property at Sun Peaks Resort, a major four-season mountain destination in the Thompson-Okanagan region. The contemporary townhomes and condos range from 2 to 4 bedrooms, each with a full kitchen, and sit in the quieter east village near the Orient chairlift and BC's highest-elevation golf course. Sun Peaks also operates a full bike park with rentals, lessons, and a pedal-access trail network directly accessible from the resort village.

detail.address: 5025 Valley Drive, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

hotel.name: Quilchena Hotel
hotel.desc: The Quilchena Hotel is a historic boutique property built in 1908, set in the Nicola Valley as part of the Douglas Lake Cattle Company's ranch operations. Originally established by the Guichon brothers, the heritage building features period antiques and rooms with pedestal wash-sinks, evoking turn-of-the-century ranching history. A touring cyclist arriving here will find a working ranch landscape, an on-site general store with gas, and a bar and grill, all in a remote and scenic Thompson-Nicola setting.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'The one eleven Bar & Grill' as a resort amenity on the same property
notes.Nearby grocery: Website confirms the on-site 'Quilchena General Store' (since 1912) carries groceries, gifts, and has gas pumps

hotel.name: Bear's Claw Lodge
hotel.desc: Bear's Claw Lodge is a 2-level motel on Cariboo Highway in the Okanagan region of British Columbia.

hotel.name: Red Tree Lodge
hotel.desc: Red Tree Lodge is a 43-room hotel in Fernie, BC, situated on Highway 3 near downtown and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort in the Canadian Rockies. The lodge explicitly caters to cyclists with a dedicated bike amenities program, bike storage, and tuning tools alongside a heated boot room, indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and fully equipped guest kitchen. Staff are described as outdoor enthusiasts with strong local knowledge of activities in the area.

notes.Nearby grocery: Directions page states 'We are located opposite the Red Apple Store on Highway #3' — Red Apple is a BC grocery/convenience chain
notes.Basic tools: Website front page amenity list includes 'Bike Storage & Tuning Tools'

hotel.name: Klahoose Wilderness Resort
hotel.desc: Klahoose Wilderness Resort is an award-winning, all-inclusive Indigenous-owned luxury retreat set in BC's Desolation Sound, operated by the Klahoose First Nation in their traditional territory. Guests stay in one of seven accommodations — four lodge rooms and three private oceanfront cedar cabins — and join guided wildlife and cultural experiences including grizzly bear viewing, whale watching, and kayaking. The resort is described as off-grid and is situated on Homfray Channel, making it a remote fly-in or boat-access destination rather than a road-accessible stop.

detail.address: Homfray Channel, Desolation Sound, Powell River Area, British Columbia, Canada

hotel.name: Super 8 Dawson Creek
hotel.desc: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national budget motel chain located on Alaska Avenue in Dawson Creek, the southern terminus of the Alaska Highway and Mile Zero of one of cycling's most iconic long-distance routes. For touring cyclists completing or beginning the Alaska Highway journey, this motel offers a recognizable, consistent lodging option at a significant milestone destination. As a Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.

hotel.name: Ramada Limited Golden
hotel.desc: Ramada Limited Golden is a motel-style property in Golden, BC, operating under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella in the heart of the Kootenays. Golden sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers and serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park and the Trans-Canada cycling corridor. As a nationally recognized mid-range brand with a fixed address in a small mountain town, it is a predictable overnight option for long-distance touring cyclists passing through.

hotel.name: Shearwater Resort & Marina, Fishing Lodge
hotel.desc: Shearwater Resort is an Indigenous Wilderness Resort and fishing lodge located at Shearwater Marina on Haida Gwaii. The resort provides accommodation for visitors exploring the remote North Coast region of British Columbia.

hotel.name: Crooked Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Crooked Lake Resort is a remote, off-grid wilderness resort in the Cariboo Mountains that has operated since the early 1960s, offering rustic cabins, RV sites, and campsites accessed via Forest Service roads from 100 Mile House or Horsefly. The resort runs on solar and generator power with limited satellite communication and explicitly lists mountain biking among its surrounding recreational activities. It appeals to self-sufficient travellers seeking solitude, with a central wash-house featuring showers and a dishwashing station serving all accommodation types.

detail.address: 2225 6700 Forest Service Rd, PO Box 358, Horsefly, BC, Canada V0L 1L0

notes.Device charging: Website states 'solar and generator for lights and power outlets in the cabins, RV sites and wash-house'; power outlets available across all accommodation types

hotel.name: Coast Sundance Lodge
hotel.desc: Coast Sundance Lodge is a full-service hotel belonging to the Coast Hotels chain, a network of properties spanning Canada and the United States. Located in BC's Thompson-Okanagan region, it serves as a base for visitors to the surrounding mountain and resort terrain. Touring cyclists passing through will find a branded hotel experience with the consistency of a managed chain property.

hotel.name: Apple Tree Inn
hotel.desc: Apple Tree Inn is a family-owned, ground-level motel in Radium Hot Springs at the edge of the Rocky Mountains, offering 1- and 2-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchenettes. It is pet-friendly and positioned within walking distance of the town's restaurants and shops, with the Radium Hot Pools just two minutes away. Guest reviews highlight attentive ownership and clean, affordable rooms that suit both solo travellers and family groups.

detail.address: 4999 BC-93, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0, Canada

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the inn is 'very close to... restaurants'

hotel.name: Truffle Pigs Lodge
hotel.desc: Truffle Pigs Bistro & Lodge is a 12-room mountain lodge in Field, British Columbia, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park just 20 minutes west of Lake Louise. Founded in 2000 as a café and general store, it expanded into its current lodge-and-bistro format in 2008 and has built a reputation for passionate, creative cooking alongside warm Rocky Mountain hospitality. Touring cyclists will find hearty on-site meals and rooms with sweeping views of the surrounding peaks.

notes.Nearby evening food: Truffle Pigs Bistro is on-site in the same building, serving dinner daily from 5 pm until 8:45 pm with bar open until 10 pm

hotel.name: Port Augusta Inn
hotel.desc: Port Augusta Inn is a hotel located on Comox Avenue in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. The business offers wireless internet access according to OSM records. Further details about bike facilities and amenities could not be confirmed due to website access failure.

hotel.name: Sandman Hotel Revelstoke
hotel.desc: The Sandman Hotel Revelstoke is a two-building chain property (Selkirk and Monashee buildings) with an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant. It holds Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions for sustainability and offers a seasonal shuttle to Revelstoke Mountain Resort. Free overnight parking and pet-friendly rooms make it a practical base for travellers arriving by various means.

notes.Nearby evening food: Denny's Restaurant listed as an on-site amenity on the hotel's own amenities page

hotel.name: Bamfield Inn (Flora's Stays)
hotel.desc: A Bamfield Inn (Flora's Stays) in Port Desire.

hotel.name: Duncanby Fishing Lodge
hotel.desc: Duncanby Lodge is a remote, all-inclusive salmon and halibut fishing destination in Rivers Inlet on BC's breathtaking Central Coast, family-owned by the Keay family since 2003. Guests arrive by chartered floatplane from Vancouver and can choose between self-guided and guided fishing in a fleet ranging from 18.5-foot centre consoles to 23–26-foot Grady Whites. The surrounding wilderness offers wildlife encounters with humpback whales, bears, and eagles across 40 kilometres of ocean and mountain scenery.

hotel.name: Alpine Lodge
hotel.desc: Alpine Lodge Fernie is an award-winning, purpose-built inn-style lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort — the largest lodge at the resort, accommodating groups of up to 18 guests across eight ensuite rooms on two floors. The lodge blends private-lodge warmth with resort amenities including a steam room, jacuzzi, drying room, laundry, and a great room with a large log fireplace. Summer activities highlighted include mountain biking, river rafting, fly-fishing, and hiking, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the Fernie area.

detail.address: 5291 Highline Drive, Fernie, British Columbia, V0B 1M6

notes.Laundry: About page lists 'laundry' explicitly among guest facilities: 'a steam room, jacuzzi, drying room, laundry, large fireplace, great room and media room are just some of the services and facilities available to guests.'
notes.Drying area: About page lists 'drying room' explicitly among guest facilities alongside laundry and steam room

hotel.name: Rockwater Secret Cove Resort
hotel.desc: Rockwater Secret Cove Resort is a luxury coastal retreat perched above the Pacific near Halfmoon Bay on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering iconic suspended Tenthouse Suites, renovated Oceanview Cabins, and lodge rooms — all with uninterrupted ocean views. The resort features an on-site oceanfront restaurant (TuBird), a spa, and complimentary kayak rentals exclusively for resort guests. It is a distinctive destination property for cyclists seeking upscale accommodation while touring the Sunshine Coast.

detail.address: 5356 Oles Cove Rd, Halfmoon Bay, BC V7Z 1B8

notes.Nearby evening food: TuBird, an on-site oceanfront restaurant described as offering West Coast-inspired cuisine with ocean views, is available to resort guests

hotel.name: Mansion on Main
hotel.desc: Mansion on Main is a hotel accommodation on Main Street in the Cariboo region. The property's specific amenities and facilities for touring cyclists require verification through direct contact, as the website is currently unavailable.

hotel.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Terrace
hotel.desc: Days Inn by Wyndham Terrace is a branded chain hotel on Lakelse Avenue in Terrace, BC, a regional hub in the Skeena River corridor of northwestern British Columbia. It is one of the more recognizable lodging options in a community that serves as a gateway to the Coast Mountains and Nisga'a territory. Cyclists touring Highway 16 or the Nisga'a Highway would find Terrace a natural overnight stop.

hotel.name: Prince Motel
hotel.desc: Prince Motel is a 45-room independently operated motel in central downtown Prince George, offering newly renovated rooms ranging from standard queens to kitchenette suites. The property is pet-friendly and provides cold-weather electrical plug-ins in the parking lot—a practical feature for travellers in northern BC. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of multiple restaurants and grocery stores.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states 'Close to numerous ethnic and western restaurants'
notes.Nearby grocery: Website states 'Near major shopping malls and grocery stores'

hotel.name: Knights Inn Merritt
hotel.desc: Knights Inn Merritt is a budget economy motel operated under the Knights Inn/Red Lion brand, located on Nicola Avenue in Merritt, BC, a common stopping point for cyclists travelling the Coquihalla or Nicola Valley corridors. As a branded chain property, it offers predictable economy lodging in a town with limited accommodation options. Touring cyclists passing through the Thompson-Okanagan region would find it a practical overnight base.

hotel.name: Pomeroy Inn & Suites
hotel.desc: Pomeroy Inn & Suites is a hotel in Chetwynd, Northern BC, providing accommodation along North Access Road. Part of the Pomeroy Inn & Suites chain, it serves as a commercial lodging option for travelers in the northern region. Contact the hotel directly for information about bike storage and services for cycling tourists.

hotel.name: Powder Mountain Lodge
hotel.desc: Powder Mountain Lodge is a motel in Fernie, BC that has been operating since 1970, offering six room types from economy queens to five-bedroom kitchen suites with full kitchens. It sits centrally in town off Highway 3 at 9th Street, placing guests within a short walk of downtown pubs, restaurants, and shops, and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort and mountain biking trails. The lodge has an outdoor courtyard pool, indoor hot tub, guest kitchen, BBQ area, common room with pool and snooker tables, and a fireplace lounge.

notes.Nearby evening food: Lodge is 'just few blocks from historic downtown where you can enjoy pubs and restaurants' per front page and extended-stays page

hotel.name: Cactus Tree Inn
hotel.desc: Cactus Tree Inn is a privately-owned motel on Highway 97 in Oliver, BC, situated in Canada's only desert and surrounded by over 40 wineries, making it a natural base for cycling the South Okanagan wine trails. Under new management since 2021, it offers a range of room types from standard queens to family suites with kitchenettes. The outdoor pool and BBQ patio provide a comfortable place to recover after a day in the saddle.

notes.Laundry: Laundry Facilities listed as a property amenity on the front page and About Us page
notes.Nearby evening food: Guest testimonial states the motel is 'within walking distance to restaurants'
notes.Nearby grocery: Guest testimonial states the motel is 'within walking distance to restaurants, grocery stores'

hotel.name: Falcon Resort
hotel.desc: Falcon Resort is a lakefront motel in Osoyoos, BC, situated directly on over 300 feet of private sandy beach on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake. Units range from single rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens, and the property features two outdoor heated pools and an indoor spa. It operates alongside the adjacent Spanish Fiesta Resort under shared management, together forming a well-established family-friendly beach destination in the South Okanagan.

notes.Laundry: Listed explicitly as 'Laundry Room' in General Information on /reviews.html
notes.Nearby evening food: 'Restaurants Within Walking Distance' listed in General Information on /reviews.html

hotel.name: Wakepilot
hotel.desc: Wakepilot is a watersports rental and charter company operating from three locations on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake — with over 20 years serving the South Okanagan. They offer Sea-Doo, pontoon, deck boat, SUP, kayak, and e-foil rentals as well as fully guided wakeboard and surf charters aboard Supra SA wake boats. A cycling tourist passing through Osoyoos could use Wakepilot for a half-day water activity before continuing on the route.

hotel.name: Madrona Beach Resort
hotel.desc: Madrona Beach Resort is a waterfront self-catering resort set directly on Rathtrevor Beach near Parksville, offering fully furnished condos ranging from ocean view studios to two-bedroom beach-level suites with full kitchens and private balconies or patios facing Georgia Strait and the north shore mountains. Units are well-equipped for extended stays and the property includes a tennis court, basketball hoops, children's adventure playground, propane barbecues, and coin-operated laundry. The famously long sandy beach at Rathtrevor is steps away from beach-level units, making this a comfortable base for exploring the Oceanside region by bike.

notes.Laundry: Coin-operated laundry on site, explicitly listed among facilities available to all units
notes.Nearby evening food: Guest review on website states 'Quite close to a good selection of restaurants.'

hotel.name: Ray Lyn Motel
hotel.desc: Ray Lyn Motel is a small motel on the outskirts of Trail, BC, offering standard queen-bed rooms and kitchenette units suited to multi-night stays. It sits a short drive from downtown Trail and is roughly 15 minutes from Red Mountain Ski Resort, placing it in the heart of the Kootenay region. Rooms include in-room fridge and microwave, and the property has a seasonal outdoor BBQ area and gazebo.

hotel.name: Lakeview Motel and Suites
hotel.desc: A family-owned motel in Osoyoos situated directly across the street from a public beach on Canada's warmest freshwater lake, in the heart of BC's only desert region. The property offers standard motel rooms, suites, and a separate 3-bedroom vacation cottage, with a seasonal heated saltwater pool and complimentary BBQ facilities on-site. It sits walking distance from downtown Osoyoos restaurants and pubs, close to wineries, the Haynes Point campground, and the US border crossing.

notes.Nearby evening food: Website states the motel is 'walking distance to... restaurants, and pubs'

hotel.name: Manning Park Eastgate Lodging
hotel.desc: Manning Park Eastgate Lodging is a motel situated near the eastern entrance to E.C. Manning Provincial Park along Highway 3, a key route for touring cyclists riding the Crowsnest corridor between the Fraser Valley and the Okanagan. Its location in one of BC's most scenic mountain passes makes it a logical overnight stop for cyclists tackling this demanding route. The motel sits in a remote area where accommodation options are sparse, which adds to its value for self-supported touring.

hotel.name: Kookaburra Lodge
hotel.desc: Kookaburra Lodge is a condo-suite property centrally located in the Sun Peaks village, offering 1- to 4-bedroom units with fully equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry overlooking McGillivray Creek. Situated directly across from the Sports Centre and steps from the resort's trail network and bike park, it caters to both weekend visitors and extended-stay guests. On-site restaurants, retail shops, and underground parking make it a convenient base for cycling the Sun Peaks network.

detail.address: 3270 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

notes.Laundry: In-suite laundry included in all suites per website
notes.Nearby evening food: Website lists 'a variety of on-site restaurants' as a guest facility

hotel.name: Sal-Crest Motel
hotel.desc: Sal-Crest Motel sits in Salmo, BC on Highway 3, making it a natural overnight stop on the Selkirk Loop and a base for exploring the southern Kootenays. The owners explicitly welcome cyclist groups and offer a large backyard with barbecues and picnic tables for socializing. Room options range from single queens to two-bedroom units with full kitchens, all with a microwave, fridge, and coffee maker.

hotel.name: Royal Oak Inn and Suites & RV Park
hotel.desc: A hotel and RV park offering accommodation in Northern British Columbia. The property provides lodging alongside RV parking facilities for touring cyclists and other travellers.

hotel.name: Swiss Chalet Motel
hotel.desc: Swiss Chalet Motel is a locally owned, non-chain motel in the heart of Revelstoke, BC, a mountain town celebrated for deep-snow skiing, hiking, and year-round outdoor adventure. The property has 22 recently renovated rooms ranging from cozy standard queens to deluxe kings with jetted tubs and balconies, and takes genuine pride in its connection to the town's Swiss alpine-guide and CPR railway heritage. Its active-traveller focus is evident in dedicated ski and bike lockers, a resort shuttle, and exclusive Tourism Revelstoke deals available to direct-booking guests.

detail.address: 1101 West Victoria Road, Revelstoke, BC V0E 2S0

notes.Early or packed breakfast: Rooms page states 'Complimentary bagged breakfast included'; amenities page confirms snack breakfast available with access to a guest kitchen/microwave room
notes.Device charging: Amenities page lists 'Cell phone chargers' and 'Europe plug-in adapters' among available tools and electrical items

hotel.name: West Coast Fishing Club
hotel.desc: West Coast Fishing Club is a luxury all-inclusive fishing resort on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, operating since 1988 and offering guided salmon and halibut fishing from two lodges (The Clubhouse and The Outpost). Guests reach the property exclusively via a charter jet from Vancouver's South Terminal to Masset, followed by a helicopter transfer to the lodge. The resort is renowned for its conservation programs and high-end wilderness hospitality in one of BC's most remote corners.

hotel.name: Summit Lake Resort
hotel.desc: Summit Lake Resort is a seasonal lakeside resort on the continental divide between the Pacific and Arctic watersheds, set 50 km north of Prince George just off the Alaska Highway. The resort offers RV and tent sites, rental cabins (double occupancy, no washrooms), a boat launch, and picnic facilities on a lake with over 40 km of undeveloped shoreline. Nearby attractions include Teapot Mountain hiking trails and the historic Giscome Portage Trail, making it a scenic stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 97 corridor.

detail.address: 815 Adams Road, Summit Lake, British Columbia

hotel.name: Town Centre Hotel
hotel.desc: The Powell River Town Centre Hotel bills itself as Powell River's only full-service hotel, with 71 air-conditioned guest rooms and suites ranging from standard courtyard-view rooms to executive suites with Jacuzzi tubs. Centrally located in the city hub on BC's Sunshine Coast, it sits near shopping, transit, and recreation areas. On-site amenities include a licensed restaurant, a pub serving dinner, and banquet facilities for up to 300 guests.

detail.address: 4660 Joyce Avenue, Powell River, BC V8A 3B6

notes.Nearby evening food: On-site TC's Pub explicitly described as 'serving dinner'; Garden Court Restaurant also on-site

hotel.name: Northern Motor Inn
hotel.desc: Northern Motor Inn is a full-service, rustic-style hotel situated on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Thornhill, just outside Terrace, BC, with an onsite restaurant, pub (George's Pub), and liquor store all under one roof. The property has a long local history and caters to a wide range of travelers, offering room types from basic queens to suites with kitchenettes, plus pet-friendly and accessible rooms. The hotel explicitly highlights cycling as one of the outdoor adventures available from its doorstep in northwestern BC.

notes.Laundry: Website states 'shower and laundry services' are offered; free laundry also listed as a perk for corporate/VIP and extended-stay guests
