restaurant.name: Red Umbrella Cafe
restaurant.desc: Red Umbrella Cafe is a locally-owned breakfast and lunch spot in Vancouver's West End, serving the neighbourhood since 2007 and rebranded under current owner Mitra Ameri in 2014. The cafe is known for homemade and handcrafted food — including all-day breakfast, creative lunch sandwiches, specialty coffee, and slow-roasted meats — using fresh, premium ingredients. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and takeout is offered for those who prefer to eat on the move.

notes.Takeout: Website states 'Take Out Not sitting in? No problem. Drop by to pick up a meal to enjoy at home' and lists 'Take Out & Dine In' as a feature

restaurant.name: Maple Palace
restaurant.desc: Maple Palace Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant in Sidney, BC, run under new management and helmed by a chef born and raised in China with over 20 years of experience. The dining room is decorated with hand-painted murals and offers a unique view of aircraft taking off from nearby Victoria International Airport. The menu spans classic Cantonese staples through Szechuan and Mongolian dishes, with both dine-in and takeout available.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website states 'We also offer a variety of delicious vegetarian options.' No vegan or GF claims made

restaurant.name: Superbaba
restaurant.desc: Superbaba is an award-winning Middle Eastern restaurant located in the Atrium building in downtown Victoria, serving made-from-scratch wraps and bowls with pita baked in-house daily. It is a second outpost of the celebrated Vancouver original, recognized multiple times as Best Casual Restaurant by Vancouver Magazine and featured on Food Network's Big Food Bucket List for its falafel sandwich and eggplant bowl. Dine-in, takeout, and DoorDash delivery are all available.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes falafel (chickpea-based, vegan) and eggplant bowl; Food Network segment specifically highlights these two items. No explicit GF claim found on the website

restaurant.name: Koon Bo Seafood Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Koon Bo Seafood Restaurant is a long-established Cantonese eatery tucked into a strip mall near Fraser and 41st Avenue in Vancouver, serving traditional Guangdong-style cuisine since 1998. Known locally as a quiet 'hidden gem,' it draws a loyal following with standout dishes like house special shredded chicken, roast squab, Peking duck (advance order required), and a broad dim sum selection. Online ordering is available directly through the restaurant's site as well as through Uber Eats and DoorDash.

restaurant.name: Troll's
restaurant.desc: Troll's is a long-standing fish and chip restaurant in North Vancouver that bills itself as 'World Famous.' It offers dine-in seating and online ordering for pick-up, making it a practical stop for cyclists seeking a classic BC coastal meal. The restaurant hosts events and accepts reservations, suggesting a community-rooted operation rather than a simple fast-food outlet.

detail.address: 6408 Bay St, West Vancouver, BC V7W 2H1

restaurant.name: Cardero's
restaurant.desc: Cardero's is a full-service waterfront restaurant operated by the Sequoia Company of Restaurants (est. 1978), perched at Coal Harbour Marina on the east side of the Westin Bayshore Hotel. It offers an eclectic Pacific Northwest menu heavy on local seafood, with live music daily and panoramic marina views that make it a landmark dining stop on Vancouver's scenic Coal Harbour seawall. The heated enclosed patio and spacious main dining room can accommodate large groups, and the marina-side setting is a natural reward for cyclists finishing a loop around the seawall.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu page explicitly labels dietary categories: Oceanwise, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, and Organic. Menu includes Korean Style Tofu, Szechuan Beans, and salads among vegetarian options

restaurant.name: Nat's New York Pizzeria
restaurant.desc: Nat's New York Pizzeria is a Vancouver institution over 30 years in operation, serving hand-tossed thin-crust New York-style pizza rooted in 100-year-old Calabrian family recipes. The West End location on Denman Street opened in January 2000 and sits close to the Stanley Park seawall — one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors. The restaurant is celebrated for deep community ties, a warm neighbourhood atmosphere, and a loyal following that has included celebrities Ryan Reynolds and Joshua Jackson.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu page lists numerous pizzas explicitly labelled 'Vegetarian' and at least one vegan option: 'The Vegan (no cheese) — Mushrooms, sweet onions, artichoke, black olives and fresh garlic.' No gluten-free option mentioned

restaurant.name: Lee's Donuts
restaurant.desc: Lee's Donuts is a beloved BC institution founded in 1979, famous for handmade classic donuts crafted fresh daily from scratch using original recipes. The Steveston location is one of a growing network of shops carrying on the legacy started at Vancouver's Granville Island Public Market. A fast, friendly stop for a cycling snack in the historic Steveston village area of Richmond.

restaurant.name: Pearl House Richmond
restaurant.desc: Pearl House Richmond is a Chinese restaurant located in Richmond, BC, serving dine-in customers in a shopping plaza setting on Number 6 Road. It provides a dining stop for cyclists on touring routes through Richmond. Specific menu details and facility amenities could not be verified due to website connectivity issues.

restaurant.name: The Bimini
restaurant.desc: Bimini's Since 1975 is a Kitsilano institution recognized as British Columbia's first neighbourhood pub, operating since 1974 at 2010 West 4th Avenue. Recently renovated under new ownership, the three-floor, 294-capacity venue blends heritage elements — reclaimed wood from a historic Vancouver mill, imported tiles — with a modern sports bar boasting 16 screens and 24 craft beers on tap. It serves as the official pub partner of Vancouver Whitecaps FC and hosts live music, DJ nights, trivia, and special events, making it a lively stop on the West 4th corridor.

restaurant.name: Macau Cafe
restaurant.desc: Macau Cafe (澳門街) is a Chinese fast food cafe situated in the busy Number 3 Road retail corridor of Richmond, BC. It serves the large local Cantonese community and is a convenient stop for cyclists navigating Richmond's flat, bike-friendly grid streets through the city's commercial heart.

restaurant.name: Bubble Waffle Cafe
restaurant.desc: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street food cafe specializing in egg waffles (雞蛋仔), fish soup noodle combos, curry fish balls, and a broad selection of Taiwanese-style bubble teas. Operating across multiple Lower Mainland locations including Aberdeen Centre, a Public Market, and Park Royal, it brings authentic Hong Kong street snack culture to the Vancouver area. Cyclists will find a wide range of quick, customizable snacks and noodle bowls served in a casual takeout format.

restaurant.name: Rivers Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Rivers Restaurant is a sit-down dining spot located in Yarrow, a small rural community southwest of Chilliwack in the Fraser Valley. The Yarrow area sits along quiet agricultural back-roads that attract recreational and touring cyclists, making a local restaurant a welcome find. Its Facebook presence suggests active community engagement, though details about the menu and atmosphere are not publicly accessible without a Facebook account.

restaurant.name: Lee Gar Nei
restaurant.desc: Lee Gar Nei (이가네) is a Korean restaurant located in a Surrey strip-mall plaza, formerly operating as BJS Korean Restaurant. The menu spans Korean appetizers, soups, hot pots, and set meals, with a student lunch option that suggests it serves a local residential and campus crowd. Online ordering is available, making it a practical stop for a cyclist wanting to pre-order a hot Korean meal.

restaurant.name: Mongolie Gril
restaurant.desc: Mongolie Grill is an independently owned stir-fry restaurant that has operated in the heart of Whistler Village since 1996. Diners select their own combination of meats, seafood, vegetables, and sauces, then watch the chefs cook the meal theatrically on a large open grill. The restaurant caters to a wide range of dietary needs and is consistently cited as one of Whistler's top dining experiences.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website states 'variety of Whistler vegan options, as well as vegetarian and gluten-free choices available'; also offers a 20% vegetarian discount; gluten-free allergen protocol described in detail in customer reviews

restaurant.name: Bouchons Bistro
restaurant.desc: Bouchons Bistro is an authentic French bistro operating in Kelowna's cultural district since 2004, helmed by Parisian chef Stephane Facon and offering classic regional dishes from escargots de Bourgogne and duck confit to bouillabaisse. The restaurant maintains a temperature-controlled Burgundy-style cellar stocked with over 750 bottles spanning Okanagan Valley producers and French appellations. Situated within walking distance of the Delta Grand Hotel, Kelowna Community Theatre, and Prospera Place, it serves as a polished evening dining destination for cyclists exploring the central Okanagan.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Dinner menu labels individual dishes with 'V' (vegetarian), 'GF' (gluten-free), and 'DF' (dairy-free) codes; e.g. Salade Verte is marked V GF DF and multiple mains carry GF or GFO designations

restaurant.name: Homeland Café Restaurant Bar
restaurant.desc: Homeland Cafe & Bar sits on Marine Drive in White Rock, a popular waterfront cycling corridor, and blends South Asian and Western cuisine — from VADA PAV and paneer bhurji paratha to Cajun chicken sandwiches and ceremonial-grade matcha drinks. The cafe operates with a full bar and outdoor seating, making it a potential stop for cyclists riding the White Rock promenade route. The menu spans breakfast, brunch, and evening service with a notable range of plant-based and vegetarian options.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes explicitly vegan items (VEGAN CLUB SANDWICH with plant-based mayo, VADA PAV) and vegetarian South Asian dishes (aanda/paneer bhurji paratha, SPINACH MUSHROOM OMELETTE). No GF mention found

restaurant.name: Miso Sushi
restaurant.desc: Formerly known as Arigato Sushi, this Japanese restaurant rebranded as Miso Sushi in March 2026, while retaining the same menu and staff. It sits directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Valleyview area of Kamloops, making it a convenient stop for cyclists traveling that corridor. Online ordering is available.

restaurant.name: Zorba's Bakery & Foods
restaurant.desc: Zorba's Bakery & Foods is a family-operated Greek and Mediterranean food manufacturer that has been producing pita bread, phyllo pies, dips, and falafel for the North American market since 1985, with roots tracing back to a village bakery on the Greek island of Evia. Products use locally sourced BC ingredients including Okanagan yogurt and Fraser Valley vegetables, and include vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free options. OSM tags the location as a takeaway-only bakery shop, though the business also distributes wholesale to grocery retailers across the region.

restaurant.name: Seh-mi Sushi Japanese Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Seh-mi Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Port Alberni offering casual dining along the main highway. A convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking Asian cuisine in the region.

restaurant.name: Pumpjack
restaurant.desc: PumpJack Pub has anchored Vancouver's Davie Village as a queer community bar since December 2000, serving as both a daytime sports bar with two large projection screens and nine TVs and a weekend nightclub with live entertainment. It operates as an explicitly inclusive safe space under the BarWatch program and welcomes all queer lifestyles, hosting themed weekly and monthly events. A touring cyclist passing through the West End would find a lively neighbourhood pub atmosphere in one of Vancouver's most walkable and bikeable urban corridors.

restaurant.name: Adam's Crepes
restaurant.desc: Adam's Crepes is a small French-style crêpe café established in 2017 on Rumble Street in south Burnaby, with seating for around 24 guests. It offers outdoor seating, giving cyclists a comfortable place to rest along this residential corridor. The café also offers delivery, suggesting a takeout-friendly model.

restaurant.name: The Canadian Brewhouse
restaurant.desc: The Canadian Brewhouse is a large western-Canadian chain sports bar and restaurant with dozens of locations, known for a broad food menu, extensive beer selection, and wall-to-wall screens for live sports. The Prince George location features a licensed patio, table reservations, a kids menu, and online ordering, making it a full-service dine-in destination near the Recplace recreation complex. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George will find a reliable, high-capacity food stop with takeout available.

restaurant.name: Nine Bar Coffee
restaurant.desc: Nine Bar Coffee is a specialty café in Yaletown, Vancouver, built around carefully sourced local beans and skilled preparation, with a strong emphasis on community gathering in a relaxed neighbourhood setting. The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating and also operates a mobile battery-powered espresso bar for weddings, corporate events, and private gatherings across Metro Vancouver.

restaurant.name: Adriana's
restaurant.desc: Adriana's is a compact sandwich and pizza shop in Tofino serving Italian-inspired subs, focaccia sandwiches, and wood-style artisan pizzas. The shop runs rotating specials — including a Friday meatball sub and a weekly feature pizza announced via Instagram — and supports online pre-ordering with in-store pickup. Its varied menu and quick-service format make it a practical mid-ride refuel stop in the heart of Tofino.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes Vegetarian Sandwich, Caprese Sandwich, Broccoli Rob Sandwich (broccolini-based), Vegetarian Pizza, and Vegan Pizza (tomato sauce, olive oil, olive, caper, basil)

restaurant.name: Humpty's Big Plate Diner
restaurant.desc: Humpty's Big Plate Diner is the Fort St. John franchise of a Western Canadian family restaurant chain founded in 1977 and best known for its all-day breakfast and 'Famous Pan Scrambler.' Located on Alaska Road North, the full-service diner offers breakfast, burgers, and comfort-food classics with cash and card payment. It is one of only a handful of Humpty's locations in British Columbia, making it a notable sit-down option for cyclists travelling the Alaska Highway corridor.

detail.address: 11724 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 4H9

restaurant.name: Big Star Sandwich Co.
restaurant.desc: Big Star Sandwich Co. is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013, known for hearty, made-from-scratch sandwiches built on a fresh rustic Filone loaf with slow-roasted meats, house-made sauces, and vintage cane-sugar sodas. The Maple Ridge location is one of six across the region, offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery with vegetarian and vegan options confirmed. The About page notes the chain pays living wages and offers staff benefits — a community-minded operation that's been a local fixture for over a decade.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Gluten-free not mentioned anywhere on the website

restaurant.name: Via Tevere Pizzeria
restaurant.desc: Via Tevere is an award-winning Vera Pizza Napoletana-certified restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, recognized by Vancouver Magazine and Georgia Straight for best pizza on the East Side. Authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas are the centrepiece, alongside antipasti, pasta, and house-made gnocchi. The restaurant also operates a second brick-and-mortar location on Victoria Drive and a food truck, making it a well-established local institution on a popular urban cycling corridor.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu notes 'plant based version available' for Radicchio Caesar; GF items explicitly labelled (e.g. 'MELANZANE ALLA PARMIGIANA (GF)', 'Gluten free GNOCCHI AI QUATTRO FORMAGGI'); numerous meatless pizza options available

restaurant.name: Shagun Sweets
restaurant.desc: Shagun Sweets is an Indian restaurant located in Surrey, BC. The establishment features vegetarian options, making it accessible to plant-based touring cyclists. It operates as a dine-in restaurant serving the local community.

restaurant.name: Ignite Pizzeria Express
restaurant.desc: Ignite Pizzeria Express is the Gastown outpost of a Vancouver stone-fired pizza chain founded in 2017, and the only Express-format location in the group where pizza by the slice is sold. Hand-tossed pies are fired at 800° with a low-sodium dough rested for three days, and the menu spans carnivore, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options. It sits on West Cordova Street in the heart of historic Gastown, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists cutting through downtown Vancouver.

detail.address: 508 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 0G8

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu has a dedicated 'Herbivore + Vegan' section; gluten-friendly housemade crust available for medium pizzas; catering page lists 'gluten-friendly, vegetarian, and vegan selections.'

restaurant.name: Ga Hyang Ru
restaurant.desc: Ga Hyang Ru is a Korean and Chinese restaurant located on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, providing both indoor and outdoor seating. The establishment maintains a non-smoking dining environment. It is positioned on a main commercial corridor in North Vancouver's local business district.

restaurant.name: Dragon Bowl
restaurant.desc: Dragon Bowl is a modern Chinese restaurant chain founded in 2022, with a Burnaby outpost on Kingsway specializing in rice bowls, noodle dishes, and bento-style meals made with natural, seasonal ingredients. The restaurant blends traditional Chinese flavours with a health-focused approach, including vegetarian choices and customizable meal combinations. Online ordering and corporate catering round out an offering aimed at quick, satisfying meals.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: About page explicitly lists 'refreshing vegetarian options' among menu offerings

restaurant.name: Lionsgate Pizza
restaurant.desc: Lionsgate Pizza is a North Vancouver institution that has been serving gourmet pizza since 1989, evolving from the original Raven Pizza tradition dating back to 1979. The kitchen makes dough and slow-simmered sauce from scratch daily, using local BC cheese, fresh vegetables, and artisan meats sourced from a North Shore supplier. Specialty pizzas, Italian pastas, and gluten-free crusts are all on the menu.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: About page explicitly states 'We also make gluten free pizza.' Fresh vegetables featured prominently; vegan not mentioned

restaurant.name: Naruto Sushi
restaurant.desc: Naruto Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Commercial Drive in Vancouver offering dine-in and takeout service with online ordering. A straightforward meal option for cycling tourists passing through the area.

restaurant.name: Alcatraz Chicken
restaurant.desc: Alcatraz Chicken is a fried chicken restaurant established in 2023 in Kelowna's Rutland Centre, built around a proprietary 13-spice blend and 24-hour marination process applied to every piece of chicken. The menu spans whole pieces, tenders, wings, family combos, sandwiches, and kids meals, making it a practical high-calorie refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Rutland corridor. Orders can be placed online for pickup or through UberEats, DoorDash, and SkipTheDishes for delivery.

restaurant.name: Provisions
restaurant.desc: Provisions is an all-day neighbourhood café in the heart of Whistler Village, backed by the Toptable Group and open since 2023. It offers a full espresso bar with custom-roasted coffee, daily fresh-baked pastries, made-to-order breakfast and lunch dishes, and slow-roasted rotisserie chicken — serving both dine-in and takeout. A natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the village, with online ordering available for both its Whistler and Kitsilano locations.

restaurant.name: Papa John's
restaurant.desc: Papa John's is a pizza fast-food restaurant, part of the national franchise. It is notable to touring cyclists for its brand familiarity and quick-service model. The Kingsway location provides accessible meal service without requiring reservation or seated time.

restaurant.name: Steel & Oak Tasting Room
restaurant.desc: Steel & Oak Brewing Co. is a New Westminster craft brewery that blends North American and German brewing traditions to produce unfiltered, unpasteurized beers — from a crisp Cold Lager to an Imperial Hefeweizen — all poured in their own tasting room. The venue has both indoor and outdoor seating, and an on-site food truck rounds out the experience with a full menu of burgers, sandwiches, and sides. Community events, live music, and private keg sales make it a genuine neighbourhood destination rather than just a stop for a pint.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: S&O Veggie Burger explicitly listed as vegan (beyond meat patty, brioche or pretzel bun); Caesar Salad is vegetarian. No GF options mentioned

restaurant.name: Ricky's All Day Grill
restaurant.desc: Ricky's All Day Grill is a Canadian family restaurant chain with over 60 years of history, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner all day from a sit-down dining room. The Nanaimo location sits along Island Highway North, a primary cycling corridor on Vancouver Island. The menu spans all-day breakfast classics and Eggs Benedict through to Alberta Angus beef burgers, comfort mains, and Fish & Chips.

restaurant.name: Marble House Eatery
restaurant.desc: Marble House Eatery is a Chinese restaurant on the second floor of Crystal Mall in Burnaby, described on its own site as one of the city's most iconic Chinese restaurants. It offers three distinct culinary formats under one roof: traditional dim sum at lunch, all-you-can-eat mini hotpot at dinner, and BBQ available throughout the day. A touring cyclist looking for a hearty, varied Chinese meal along the Kingsway corridor will find a full-service restaurant with a lively neighbourhood atmosphere.

restaurant.name: Turtle Bay Pub
restaurant.desc: Turtle Bay Pub is a family-friendly waterfront pub on Wood Lake in Lake Country, open year-round and welcoming dogs on its lakeside patio. The menu spans classic pub fare and kids' meals through Pacific Rim-inspired dishes like tuna tataki, Korean fusion tacos, and coconut prawns, paired with a broad selection of BC craft beer and Okanagan VQA wines. The waterfront location and all-season operation make it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists touring the Wine Country Cycling routes through the central Okanagan.

detail.address: 2850 Woodsdale Rd, Lake Country, BC V4V 1Y1

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website FAQ explicitly states: 'Yes, we have a selection of gluten-free dishes on our menu, including salads, grilled meats, and seafood.' Menu also includes vegetarian-suitable items (grilled cheese, tomato linguini, nachos) though not explicitly labeled vegetarian

restaurant.name: Published on Main
restaurant.desc: Published on Main is a Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, led by Executive Chef Gus Stieffenhofer-Brandson, whose cooking draws on British Columbia's landscape and seasonal regional ingredients. Since opening six years ago it has held a MICHELIN Star every year from 2022 through 2025, claimed the top spot on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants, and placed among North America's 50 Best. A touring cyclist looking for a special-occasion dinner on the Main Street corridor would find polished service and a thoughtfully crafted contemporary Canadian menu here.

restaurant.name: Route 97 Diner
restaurant.desc: A roadside diner located on Highway 97 in Westwold, BC, serving the local community and travelers. The diner offers classic dining in a rural setting along a major provincial highway corridor.

restaurant.name: Mundy Park Bakery
restaurant.desc: Mundy Park Bakery is a family-owned artisan bakery that has operated in Coquitlam since 1988, situated on Como Lake Avenue near Mundy Park. The production team collectively holds over a century of professional baking trade experience, with roots tracing back to a Richmond shop and a second Heritage Bakery and Deli location on Barnet Highway. Touring cyclists would find it a welcoming stop for freshly baked goods in a well-established community bakery.

restaurant.name: Salt Spring Wild Cider House Kitchen
restaurant.desc: Salt Spring Wild Cider House Kitchen is a farm-based cidery and restaurant on Salt Spring Island, serving scratch-made food designed to pair with their diverse lineup of artisanal ciders pressed from heritage apples and pears grown across the island. The setting overlooks an orchard and valley with all-day sun, and both indoor seating and an outdoor picnic area are available, with walk-ins welcome. Families and pets are welcome, making it a relaxed stop for touring cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island's rural roads.

detail.address: 151 Sharp Rd, Salt Spring Island BC

restaurant.name: Belle's
restaurant.desc: Belle's Café is a long-established neighbourhood café in South Surrey's Elgin Park area, proudly scratch-cooking almost everything — from soups and meatballs to baked goods free of chemicals and preservatives — since 1999. The café is well known for its handcrafted coffee, seasonal baked treats, and an unusually broad range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options across both its eat-in and take-away menus. Touring cyclists will find a cozy, community-minded stop with house-made frozen dinners available to grab on the way out.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website states 'We have many vegetarian, gluten-free, and even vegan options'; menu items are labelled V, GF, and DF throughout both eat-in and frozen food sections

restaurant.name: Hot Delivery
restaurant.desc: Hot Delivery is a Cantonese-style Chinese restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver offering an extensive menu of chow mein, fried rice, chop suey, seafood, and dim sum. The restaurant operates primarily as a pickup and dine-in spot with an active online ordering system, making it straightforward for cyclists to order ahead. Indoor seating is available according to OSM tags.

restaurant.name: Popina Cantina
restaurant.desc: Popina Cantina is a restaurant located in Vancouver. The website is not currently accessible and no phone number is available for verification. Without these contacts, the business's current status and amenities cannot be confirmed.

restaurant.name: Samz Neighbourhood Pub
restaurant.desc: Samz Neighbourhood Pub is a full-service neighbourhood pub and adjacent liquor store with locations in Port Coquitlam and Surrey, positioning itself as a go-to spot for casual dining, drinks, and watching live sports in the Lower Mainland. The Port Coquitlam location on Elgin Avenue offers dine-in service alongside a separately operated liquor store. Touring cyclists passing through PoCo could use it as a meal stop, with takeout also available via Skip the Dishes.

detail.address: 2342 Elgin Avenue, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 2B5

restaurant.name: Mo-Ment Crispy Burger
restaurant.desc: Mo-Ment Crispy Burger is a Chinese-style crispy burger fast food restaurant on Granville Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver. It offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment and operates without a drive-through, making it a sit-down-or-grab-and-go stop. Granville Street is a busy urban corridor, putting this spot within easy reach of cyclists navigating the city centre.

restaurant.name: Coast Mountain Brewing
restaurant.desc: Coast Mountain Brewing is a craft brewery and tap house established in 2016, situated in Whistler's Function Junction neighbourhood just south of the main village. The venue offers house-brewed mountain beers served from a tap house with a covered outdoor patio. It sits on the Unceded Territories of the Skwxwú7mesh (Squamish) First Nation and is accessible via local transit from the Function Junction bus stop.

detail.address: 2-1212 Alpha Lake Rd, Function Junction, Whistler, BC V8E 0R5

restaurant.name: Green Leaf Sushi Cafe
restaurant.desc: Green Leaf Sushi is a Japanese-focused restaurant chain with four Lower Mainland locations; the North Vancouver branch is situated in the Lonsdale neighbourhood. The menu spans what the restaurant describes as traditional favourites and innovative creations. Indoor seating is available and phone-in takeout orders are accepted.

restaurant.name: White Spot
restaurant.desc: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and known for locally sourced ingredients including Canadian beef, BC chicken, and BC-grown Kennebec potato fries. The Richmond (Ackroyd) location is a full-service family restaurant offering dine-in with a patio, takeout, and delivery. It is a reliable sit-down meal option for cyclists passing through central Richmond along the Number 3 Road corridor.

restaurant.name: Green Timbers Pub
restaurant.desc: Green Timbers Pub is a well-established neighbourhood sports bar and full-service restaurant in Surrey, anchored by big-screen TVs for Canucks, Lions, and NFL/NHL viewing. The venue is also home to one of the largest BC Lottery Centres in the province and an attached full-service liquor store. A touring cyclist seeking a casual sit-down meal or cold drink in the Green Timbers area would find this a lively, familiar local stop.

restaurant.name: Beaucoup Bakery and Cafe
restaurant.desc: Beaucoup Bakery & Café is an award-winning French pastry destination founded in Vancouver in 2012, celebrated for blending classical viennoiseries with Asian-inspired creations such as Peking Duck Croissants and Golden Mochi Croissants. The Britannia Beach outpost—on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor between Vancouver and Squamish—draws its design inspiration from the 15th-century tapestry À Mon Seul Désir. Cyclists stopping in can expect specialty pastries, 49th Parallel espresso drinks, and Bellocq teas in a thoughtfully crafted setting.

detail.address: 161 Copper Dr #101, Britannia Beach, BC V8B 1E7

restaurant.name: Red Light Ramen
restaurant.desc: Red Light Ramen is a small, locally owned restaurant and natural wine bar tucked into historic Herridge Alley just off Baker Street in Nelson. The kitchen prepares everything from scratch using local BC ingredients — miso from Amano Foods, tofu made five blocks away, and produce from nearby Kootenay-region farms. A lush patio and a menu rooted in Japanese ramen traditions make it a compelling stop for cyclists wanting a nourishing, sit-down meal.

restaurant.name: Oma's Bakery & Market
restaurant.desc: Oma's Bakery & Market is a combined bakery and market serving the Duncan area of Vancouver Island. The 'Oma's' name (Dutch/German for grandmother) suggests a homestyle or artisan baking tradition. As a market-bakery hybrid it could offer touring cyclists a convenient stop for baked goods and general provisions.

detail.address: 1761 Shawnigan-Mill Bay Rd, Shawnigan Lake, BC V0R 2W5

restaurant.name: Grelhados
restaurant.desc: Grelhados is a restaurant located in North Vancouver. No additional information is available due to website unavailability.

restaurant.name: Fleetwood Sushi
restaurant.desc: Fleetwood Sushi is a sushi restaurant located in unit 304 of a commercial building on Fraser Highway in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood. It is tagged in OpenStreetMap as a sit-down restaurant serving Japanese sushi cuisine. Its Instagram presence has no posts, so little additional detail about the business is publicly available.

restaurant.name: Demitasse Cafe
restaurant.desc: Demitasse is a family-run café, kitchen, and garden centre nestled in Oak Bay, combining carefully sourced organic fair-trade espresso with handcrafted daily food — burgers, house-made pizzas, inspired salads, and fresh baked goods. The quaint property doubles as a specialty garden centre featuring rare and unusual plants, giving it a distinct charm among Victoria's coffee stops. Locals and visitors alike are drawn to its cheerful outdoor garden seating and constantly rotating seasonal menu.

notes.Takeout: Website explicitly states 'We are open Monday through Saturday 8am to 6pm for take out.' Kitchen page notes food is available 'to enjoy at home.'
notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Customer review on the kitchen/café pages states 'non-dairy, gluten-free… and all the above!' Website also notes locally sourced organic ingredients and plant-based menu items (salads, kale caesar, Chana Masala, lemongrass coconut tofu)

restaurant.name: Friends of Dorothy
restaurant.desc: Friends of Dorothy is Victoria's premier 2SLGBTQIA+ restaurant and cocktail lounge, voted Tasting Victoria's Best New Restaurant in 2022. This queer-owned establishment serves gourmet plates and craft cocktails in a bold, inclusive downtown setting with live entertainment. The lounge also hosts 'Somewhere* A Restaurant at Dorothy's,' a culinary collaboration with acclaimed local restaurant Hanks.

restaurant.name: Himalaya Indian Cuisine
restaurant.desc: Himalaya Indian Cuisine is a sit-down Indian restaurant located on Ware Street in Chilliwack. The restaurant provides a place for touring cyclists to pause and enjoy a meal while passing through the community.

restaurant.name: Tatos Kitchen
restaurant.desc: Tatos Kitchen is a Chinese restaurant on Keefer Street in Vancouver. It offers dining service to customers.

restaurant.name: The Old Spaghetti Factory
restaurant.desc: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a 100% Canadian-owned Italian chain restaurant with a Kelowna location in the Capri area. They are known for their full 3-course pasta meals served with bread, salad, and Spumoni ice cream, and the menu is adaptable for gluten-free, vegan, and allergy-conscious diners. The Kelowna location accepts reservations and supports both pickup and delivery ordering.

restaurant.name: Mr. Sushi
restaurant.desc: Mr. Sushi Lonsdale is a family-owned sushi restaurant that has operated in North Vancouver since 2016, part of a brand with roots going back to the early 1990s. Spanning 2,000 square feet in the Lower Lonsdale waterfront neighbourhood, it offers a modern interior, a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, and noodle dishes, and has earned a North Shore News Readers' Choice Award. Cyclists finishing a ride along the North Shore waterfront will find both dine-in and convenient takeout options a short ride from the SeaBus terminal.

detail.address: 105 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2E7

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Lonsdale menu lists 'Chicken, beef, or veggie yakisoba' and 'Chicken, beef, or veggie udon', confirming vegetarian options

restaurant.name: Deville Coffee
restaurant.desc: Deville Coffee is a locally owned specialty coffee chain founded in 2008 and now operating across Alberta and BC, including Vancouver. The café brews small-batch, direct-trade beans — sourced from farms in Guatemala and Brazil — crafted into espresso drinks with house-made ingredients like chocolate ganache and organic vanilla. A rotating menu of daily pastries and creative breakfast wraps and sandwiches rounds out the offering.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website menu explicitly lists a 'VEGETARIAN BKFST WRAP' (2 scrambled eggs, black beans, cheddar, salsa, spicy aioli)

restaurant.name: King's Choice Indian Cuisine
restaurant.desc: King's Choice Indian Cuisine is an Indian restaurant located in Surrey's Whalley neighbourhood on 152 Street. The business was present in OSM as an active restaurant, though current operational status is unclear. A touring cyclist passing through this part of Surrey would find it a potential stop for Indian food on a busy commercial corridor.

restaurant.name: Fieldstone Bread
restaurant.desc: Fieldstone Artisan Breads is a South Surrey bakery specializing in naturally leavened, hand-shaped loaves baked in a French stone-hearth oven using certified organic flours, filtered water, and sea salt — no additives, preservatives, or dough enhancers. Beyond bread, the shop offers a range of sweets including fruit tarts, quiches, cakes, and scones. A touring cyclist could resupply with dense, high-quality baked goods here on routes through the South Surrey/White Rock area.

restaurant.name: Non-Stop Pizza
restaurant.desc: Non-Stop Pizza is a multi-location Indian-fusion pizza restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey, offering a broad menu spanning classic and specialty pizzas alongside tandoori items, biryani, wraps, and wings. The Fraser Highway location is one of at least three Lower Mainland outlets and serves both dine-in and delivery customers. Cyclists on this busy arterial corridor would find a wide range of vegetarian and meat options available for a sit-down or takeaway meal.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website menu includes dedicated 'VEG SPECIALITIES' and 'VEGGIE PIZZAS' product categories, plus a 'Veggie Wrap' item

restaurant.name: L'Abattoir
restaurant.desc: L'Abattoir is a Michelin-recommended French-West Coast restaurant housed in a 19th-century brick-and-beam building in historic Gastown, on the site of Vancouver's first jail and former meat-packing district. Chef Jasper Cruickshank blends classical French technique with West Coast ingredients, backed by a Platinum Award-winning wine list and a serious cocktail program. With over 15 years in operation and options to dine at the bar, mezzanine, or atrium, it is one of Vancouver's most celebrated dinner destinations.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Chef's Tasting Menu page states the menu 'can be crafted for pescatarians or vegetarians'; Le Petit Menu includes vegetarian dishes (Spinach farfalle with stracciatella/fava beans, Crispy avocado with tamale cake)

restaurant.name: Comma
restaurant.desc: Comma Cafe is a UBC Okanagan Food Services outlet tucked inside The Commons building on the UBCO campus, serving Doi Chaang specialty coffee alongside hand-crafted sandwiches, seasonal salads made with locally sourced ingredients, and house-made pastries. It operates as a self-funded ancillary of the university, with profits supporting student programs and the academic mission. A touring cyclist passing through the UBC Okanagan campus will find a relaxed spot to refuel with fresh, scratch-made food in a campus commons environment.

restaurant.name: Nohra Thai Kitchen
restaurant.desc: Nohra Thai Kitchen is a family-run Thai restaurant in Victoria's Estevan neighbourhood, owned and operated by Phen Bryan, who brings multiple generations of Thai culinary heritage to each dish. The kitchen emphasizes authenticity rooted in family recipes refined over decades, and the restaurant also hosts private functions and special chef's table events. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available.

restaurant.name: Keating Pizza
restaurant.desc: Keating Pizza has been a fixture near the Keating Industrial Park since 1989, serving generous 'Heavy Duty' pizza slices — up to nine varieties daily — alongside 33 specialty pizzas, chicken wings, poutine, and house-made desserts like Nanaimo Bars. It is a no-frills, locally rooted pizza shop with a loyal following and online ordering available. Cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula on Keating Cross Road would find it a filling and convenient meal stop.

restaurant.name: Princeton Pub
restaurant.desc: Princeton Pub is a neighbourhood pub located in East Vancouver at 1901 Dundas Street. It operates as a traditional pub-style venue in a mixed residential and commercial area of the city. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver may find it a convenient stop for a meal or drink.

restaurant.name: Steveston Pizza Co.
restaurant.desc: Steveston Pizza Co. is an award-winning gourmet pizza restaurant in the heart of Steveston Village, just steps from the Richmond waterfront. Named 2025 Best Pizza in Richmond by Richmond News, it serves handcrafted pizzas built on organic flour, house-made sauces, and locally sourced ingredients drawn from Steveston's coastal fishing heritage and Richmond's multicultural community. Owner and Head Chef Nader personally handcrafts every pizza, and the shop offers menus in English, Chinese, and Korean reflecting its diverse local clientele.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website explicitly states 'Whether you're a vegetarian, a seafood enthusiast, or an adventurous eater, there's something to discover.' Multiple menu items (e.g., Marguerite Three: spinach, roasted garlic, tomatoes; Mediterranean: feta, olives, oven-dried tomatoes) are vegetarian. No explicit vegan or GF claims found

restaurant.name: Taste of Pho
restaurant.desc: Taste of Pho is a Vietnamese restaurant in Surrey, BC, serving the style of noodle soups and accompanying dishes typical of Vietnamese cuisine. It is located at 13979 140 Street in Surrey. No additional detail about the dining experience, menu, or cyclist-relevant features can be confirmed due to website domain compromise.

restaurant.name: Fireside Café
restaurant.desc: Fireside Café sits at the main entrance of Menno Hospital on the Menno Place seniors' care campus, one of BC's largest with 700 residents across 11 acres. It offers cozy indoor tables and an outdoor patio, serving hot bento boxes and soft serve ice cream. The café is operated by the Mennonite Benevolent Society and is open to residents, families, and visitors to the campus.

restaurant.name: Hamada Fusion
restaurant.desc: Hamada Fusion is a multi-cuisine cafe and restaurant on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, blending Filipino, Japanese, Korean, and Western culinary traditions under one roof. The extensive menu spans sushi rolls and nigiri, Korean tteokbokki, gyoza, tempura, and Western-style salads, offering a wide variety of flavours for groups with different tastes. The fusion concept was built around the idea of bringing people with different food preferences together at a single table.

detail.address: #200-22529 Lougheed Hwy, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 0L4

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes multiple explicitly labelled vegetarian options: Pink Lady Roll (Vegetarian), SCV Roll (Vegetarian), Veggie Gyoza, Veggie Spring Roll, Edamame, Yam Roll, Avo Cucumber Roll, and Mango Avo Roll

restaurant.name: Young's Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Young's Restaurant is a restaurant located on Quadra Street in Victoria.

restaurant.name: Hello Nori
restaurant.desc: Hello Nori is a Japanese hand roll bar specializing in Temaki-style sushi, built around the philosophy of crispy premium nori, warm seasoned rice, and sustainable Ocean Wise seafood sourced locally and from select imports. Each hand roll is individually prepared to order at an open chef's bar, creating a quick yet considered dining experience. The brand has several BC locations and draws both local regulars and travelling guests.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu page labels options as 'Gluten-Free - Vegan - Oceanwise'; vegan hand rolls include Avocado, Pickled Vegetables, and Cucumber

restaurant.name: La Maison Da Nang
restaurant.desc: La Maison Da Nang is a family-owned casual Vietnamese restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver's southeast, specializing in the regional cuisine of Da Nang in Central Vietnam. The restaurant features both indoor seating and a street-facing outdoor patio in a residential neighbourhood, offering a relaxed atmosphere with natural daylight. The menu focuses on authentic Central Vietnamese cooking, spanning side dishes, rice mains, soups, and desserts.

restaurant.name: Pure Bread
restaurant.desc: Purebread is a well-regarded BC artisan bakery chain with locations across Whistler, Vancouver, and Squamish, known for freshly baked breads, pastries, pies, and cakes. The Squamish location sits in Garibaldi Village and offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop for cyclists passing through. The bakery has received media coverage from outlets including the New York Times, Lonely Planet, and Vogue, underscoring its reputation as a destination-worthy stop.

restaurant.name: Cafe Ciel
restaurant.desc: Cafe Ciel is a cafe situated in The High Street mixed-use development in Coquitlam. OSM confirms outdoor seating, making it a potentially pleasant stop for cyclists passing through the area. The business was verified in OSM as recently as December 2024.

detail.address: 1153 The High Street, Unit 136, Coquitlam, BC V3B 0B7

restaurant.name: FARO
restaurant.desc: FARO is a café and coastal Italian restaurant within Victoria's Oak Bay Beach Hotel, named after the Italian word for 'beacon' or 'lighthouse.' By morning it serves handcrafted barista coffee and fresh-baked pastries; by afternoon and evening it shifts to Neapolitan-style pizzas from a Wood Stone oven, seasonal share plates, and a curated wine list. Cyclists can dine indoors or relax on the outdoor patio beside signature fire features, with dogs welcome outside.

restaurant.name: Plain Jane Ice Cream
restaurant.desc: Plain Jane is a New Zealand-style ice cream shop that opened in the summer of 2024 in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood. They blend real frozen fruit to order into organic French vanilla ice cream base using a New Zealand technique, with a short, rotating seasonal menu. A dairy-free coconut ice cream (Nora's) is available for those avoiding dairy.

detail.address: 2295 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V5L 1V3

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: About page explicitly names Nora's coconut ice cream as a dairy-free alternative base; fruit-based menu is inherently vegetarian

restaurant.name: Heritage Restaurant & Bar
restaurant.desc: Heritage Restaurant & Bar is the Mount Pleasant flagship of the Heritage Asian Eatery group, offering a contemporary sit-down take on classic Chinese cuisine — think handcrafted dumplings, Peking duck, and Chinese BBQ alongside handcrafted cocktails, beer, and wine. The space is described as a contemporary setting where casual meals and celebrations share the same menu. Reservations are available and recommended, as the Pender Street sister location is walk-in only.

restaurant.name: Their There
restaurant.desc: Their There is a breakfast and lunch café in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on West 4th Avenue, opened in 2018 by the team behind the Michelin Star-awarded AnnaLena restaurant. It offers a full-service brunch alongside a grab-and-go program of freshly made mochi donuts, coffee sourced from small independent roasters, and sandwiches. The combination of dine-in and takeout options makes it a practical and distinctive mid-morning or midday stop on a busy urban cycling corridor.

notes.Takeout: Dedicated takeout program explicitly listed: coffee, mochi donuts, and sandwiches; 'Take Out [9am - 3pm]' prominently shown in site navigation and FAQ

restaurant.name: Wasabi Modern Kitchen
restaurant.desc: Wasabi Modern Kitchen is a Japanese fine dining restaurant in Kamloops's Sun Rivers community, beside Big Horn Golf Course, led by a chef with over 21 years of experience across more than 10 Japanese restaurants. The menu blends traditional Japanese staples with modern Pacific Northwest influences, spanning a chef-driven sushi program, ramen, miso cod, kabayaki, and premium seafood. The 55-seat licensed space features a dedicated sushi bar and full drink bar in warm, modern surroundings.

restaurant.name: Milltown Bar & Grill
restaurant.desc: Opened in 2014 on Richmond Island, Milltown Bar & Grill is the only restaurant in the Lower Mainland with three distinct waterfront patios — one facing the marina and mountains, one overlooking the Fraser River, and one with views of the main YVR runway. The kitchen emphasises house-made and locally sourced Pacific Northwest ingredients that go well beyond standard pub fare. Despite its Richmond address, the venue is only accessible from the Marpole neighbourhood in Vancouver, so cyclists should factor in their approach route.

restaurant.name: Esquimalt Roasting Company
restaurant.desc: A small-batch specialty coffee roastery with an on-site cafe nestled in the heart of Esquimalt on Vancouver Island. Coffee is roasted locally with a focus on single-origin and blended beans sourced from Rwanda, Guatemala, Colombia, and Ethiopia. They recently opened a second location called ERC Gateway on Esquimalt Road.

restaurant.name: Elvis Pizza
restaurant.desc: Elvis Pizza is a family-owned Surrey institution operating since 1977, serving pizza, pasta, wings, and salads for pickup and delivery from its North Surrey–Guildford location. Known for making dough, pizza sauce, and meat sauce entirely on-premise with 100% real mozzarella, it has built a loyal local following over nearly five decades. Late-night availability makes it a potential stop for cyclists finishing a long day on the road.

restaurant.name: Yonni's Doughnuts
restaurant.desc: Yonni's Doughnuts is a scratch-made specialty doughnut bakery on Discovery Street in Victoria, operating as part of the Discovery Coffee family. Every morning the team hand-crafts doughnuts from original recipes using quality ingredients — no mixes, no artificial flavours — producing classics like old-fashioneds, crullers, and fritters alongside seasonal specials and a growing vegan lineup. Cyclists can place online pickup orders or stop by the bakery door directly to collect a fresh box.

restaurant.name: The Beer Shack
restaurant.desc: The Beer Shack is a bar and microbrewery located on Johnston Road in White Rock, BC. OSM tags suggest it may operate as a multi-use venue, with nightclub and theatre designations alongside its craft brewery function. Touring cyclists passing through the White Rock area would find it a potential stop for locally brewed beer.

restaurant.name: Alloz Grill
restaurant.desc: Alloz Grill is a Filipino restaurant in North Vancouver. Specific details about offerings and cyclist amenities could not be verified due to website unavailability.

restaurant.name: Pizza Garden
restaurant.desc: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain operated by Neapolitan Pizza Ltd., with over 25 years in the industry and locations stretching from Victoria to Fort St. John. The Downtown Vancouver location serves wood-fired pizzas with authentic charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and creamy mozzarella, with both indoor and outdoor seating available. Cyclists will find it a convenient, filling stop in the heart of Vancouver's downtown core, with takeout and delivery also on offer.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website events page references 'classic Margherita' as a menu staple, a standard vegetarian pizza

restaurant.name: Donair Drive
restaurant.desc: Donair Drive is a fast-casual donair restaurant on Nelson Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, serving fresh-made donairs, wraps, poutines, and wings with halal meats and falafel options. Positioned steps from Granville Street and the West End, it is a well-known late-night option for locals and visitors in a dense cycling corridor. Cyclists can order pickup online or by phone, with third-party delivery also available through DoorDash, Uber Eats, and SkipTheDishes.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu offers Veggie Spicy Falafel and falafel as a protein choice across donairs, rice plates, salad boxes, and meat-and-fries boxes

restaurant.name: Sushi High
restaurant.desc: Sushi High is a casual Japanese restaurant on East Broadway at the border of Vancouver and Burnaby, recently under new management and specializing in fresh, innovative sushi. It offers indoor dine-in seating in a relaxed neighbourhood setting. Online ordering for takeout is available via its website, making it a potential quick stop for cyclists moving through the area.

notes.Takeout: Website prominently features an 'Online Order-Desktop Only' link, confirming takeout/online ordering is offered

restaurant.name: Nelson Brewing Company
restaurant.desc: Nelson Brewing Company is one of BC's original craft breweries, founded in 1991 in a historic building that has housed brewing since the 1800s — its beer cellar sits 20 feet underground above a natural creek called Ward Street Creek. The taproom pours a rotating selection of small-batch and classic craft beers alongside ciders, wine, and cocktails, with flights, snacks, and growler fills available. As the first craft brewery east of the Okanagan, it is a landmark stop in Nelson for touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays.

restaurant.name: Nightingale
restaurant.desc: Nightingale is a fine dining restaurant in downtown Vancouver specializing in shared plates and group dining experiences. Part of the Hawksworth Group, it offers both dine-in and takeout service with a focus on chef-curated menus. The restaurant provides a refined dining environment in the heart of the city suitable for gathering with cycling companions.

restaurant.name: Quesada
restaurant.desc: Quesada is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain that has been serving burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and bowls since 2004, with this location situated in the Willoughby Town Centre shopping area of Langley Township. The restaurant is part of the Foodtastic franchise network and is known for daily hand-mashed guacamole and a customizable menu inspired by regional Mexican flavours. It is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Willoughby corridor, with takeout readily available.

detail.address: 20727 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley, V2Y1X1

restaurant.name: Naked Cafe
restaurant.desc: Naked Cafe is a fully plant-based restaurant and coffee bar established in 2015 by three sisters, now a fixture in downtown Kelowna on Lawrence Avenue between Safeway and The District mall. The cafe is licensed to serve local beer, wine, and spirits alongside its vegan comfort food — PETA named their Market Poutine best in the country. It hosts a lively events calendar including monthly brunch buffets, jazz nights, and a weekly Vegan Meet Up, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Fully plant-based menu ('Always plant-based'); gluten-friendly options available throughout including kids menu and catering

restaurant.name: La Petite Cuillère
restaurant.desc: La Petite Cuillère is a well-established English-style tea house anchored in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, featuring a dramatically decorated interior with vaulted ceilings, custom chandeliers, and velvet couches. The kitchen blends teas in-house and builds its daily menu around tea-infused dishes prepared by a chef de pâtissier, with strong accommodation for vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free diets. Takeaway pastries and loose-leaf teas sold by the bag make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website explicitly states 'offering vegan, gluten free, and nut free options'; menu page lists specific vegan and gluten-free items including cashew-feta tartlets and a raw carrot-and-chai cheesecake

restaurant.name: Pita Pit
restaurant.desc: Pita Pit is a healthy fast-food chain located inside Orchard Park Mall on Harvey Avenue in Kelowna, offering build-your-own pitas, salads, rice bowls, and smoothies. It operates as a takeout and delivery location with no drive-through. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna's main commercial corridor will find it a quick, customizable stop for a filling meal.

restaurant.name: Ba Le Deli & Bakery
restaurant.desc: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese delicatessen operating since 1987, known for authentic bánh mì sandwiches built on French baguettes baked fresh in-house daily using locally sourced meats. The Richmond location is one of five Ba Le outposts across Metro Vancouver and Victoria. Cyclists passing through Richmond can fuel up quickly on Vietnamese subs, rice bowls, and vermicelli bowls, with a solid range of vegan and vegetarian choices on the menu.

detail.address: Unit 140, 12560 Bridgeport Road, Richmond, BC V6V 2N5

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes Vegan Steak Banh Mi, Vegan Bologna Banh Mi, Vegetarian Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi, Classic Vietnamese Veggie Sandwich, and Vermicelli Bowl with Tofu and Spring Rolls

restaurant.name: McDonald's
restaurant.desc: A McDonald's fast food location in Vancouver serving burgers, fries, sandwiches, wraps, McCafé beverages, and desserts with takeout available. It is part of the McDonald's Canada chain, which participates in a rewards program and supports Ronald McDonald House charities. No drive-through is present at this location per OSM data.

restaurant.name: Fab Burgers Inc.
restaurant.desc: Fab Burgers is a gourmet burger restaurant in Surrey's King George Boulevard corridor, billing itself as the 'Home of the Monster Burger' with handmade burgers including their signature oversized creations. It operates out of a unit in a strip-mall-style commercial building and offers online ordering. A cycling tourist on the King George corridor would find this a convenient stop for a sit-down or takeout burger meal.

detail.address: #108-7320 King George Boulevard, Surrey, BC V3W 5A5

restaurant.name: HellCrust Pizza
restaurant.desc: HellCrust Pizza is a BC-born pizza franchise that sets itself apart through 'Biga' preferment dough — an Italian technique requiring a day or two of advance preparation — aimed at richer flavour and improved digestibility without chemical stabilizers. The brand has grown from 2 locations in 2021 to 18+ across British Columbia and Alberta, all franchised. The menu spans signature and vegan pizzas, pasta, wings, and appetizers, with online ordering and indoor seating available.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegan Pizzas (Made with Daiya cheese)' section; cauliflower bites and other vegetarian-compatible items also listed. No GF mention found

restaurant.name: Trees Organic Coffee
restaurant.desc: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1996, now operating 13–14 locations across the city under the Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee brand. The King Edward Village branch on Kingsway serves the chain's signature small-batch roasted organic coffee alongside its award-winning homemade cheesecakes, sandwiches, and baked goods. A combination of corporately run and franchised cafes, Trees also hosts live music nights at select locations, making it a lively neighbourhood stop.

restaurant.name: Tiramisu Republic
restaurant.desc: Tiramisu Republic is a dessert cafe located at 4611 Kingsway in Burnaby's Metrotown neighbourhood, operating out of a space previously occupied by Ricey Yogurt. Specializing in dessert cuisine, it sits along a major arterial corridor with good transit and cycling access through Burnaby. Touring cyclists passing through Metrotown will find it a convenient stop for a sweet break.

restaurant.name: Bon Bon Bakery
restaurant.desc: Bon Bon Bakery is a family-run Italian bakery with roots going back to 1959, when Armando and Teresa Burtini opened on Victoria Drive after immigrating from Italy. Now on Hastings Street in Burnaby and in its second generation of family ownership, the shop offers specialty cakes, pastries, cookies, and authentic Italian bread made from recipes passed down through generations. Cyclists passing through the Hastings corridor would find a well-established neighbourhood bakery with over six decades of history.

restaurant.name: Cassette Cafe and Dive Bar
restaurant.desc: Cassette Cafe and Dive Bar is a combined cafe and dive bar on Lower Ganges Road in Ganges, the main village on Salt Spring Island — one of BC's most beloved cycling destinations. It offers a cafe menu alongside a full dive bar menu, with outdoor seating available. For cyclists riding the island's hilly roads, it serves as a convenient stop for food and drinks in the heart of town.

detail.address: 106 Lower Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, V8K-2S7

restaurant.name: Rice and Noodle
restaurant.desc: Rice and Noodle is a fast-casual Asian kitchen on Vancouver's West Broadway, specializing in made-to-order Pad Thai and a broad menu of Thai curries, noodle dishes, and soups. Customers customize their bowl by choosing a base, protein, and spice level up to 'extreme.' The brand operates as a franchise chain with multiple Lower Mainland locations and a rewards program.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu explicitly offers Tofu and Mixed Veggies protein options across all bases, plus 'deep fried vegetarian spring roll' as a side item

restaurant.name: Unique Bakery
restaurant.desc: Unique Bakery is a Richmond artisan bakery specializing in handcrafted, naturally fermented breads, bagels, pretzels, and toast made from locally sourced ingredients. The shop emphasizes traditional slow-fermentation techniques and low-sugar, low-fat recipes, producing fresh loaves daily from scratch. Online ordering with in-store pickup is available, and the bread is also stocked at several nearby Richmond and Burnaby retail partners.

restaurant.name: Yama Cafe
restaurant.desc: Yama Cafe is a homestyle Japanese cafe in East Vancouver opened in 2017 by Tokyo-born chef Mitsuhiro Yamamura, whose cooking philosophy centres on Washoku — a UNESCO-recognized approach to Japanese food that prizes seasonal ingredients and respectful technique. The cafe serves rice bowls, Japanese baked goods (called 'moffins'), custom cakes, and an Omakase bento and dinner course under the Special menu. A touring cyclist will find a calm, neighbourhood atmosphere with several gluten-free and vegan menu options alongside alternative milks.

detail.address: 2007 East Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5T 1T9

notes.Packed lunches: Special menu lists 'Omakase bento' — a chef's-choice bento box that constitutes a packaged, portable meal
notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu explicitly labels Vegan Bowl as 'Gluten Free / Vegan', Tuna Tataki Bowl and Pork Bowl as 'Gluten Free'; custom cakes available gluten-free on request; soy, almond, and oat milk offered as dairy alternatives

restaurant.name: Prinkle Chicken
restaurant.desc: Prinkle Chicken is a Korean-style fried chicken chain with multiple BC locations, specializing in hand-battered, deep-fried chicken hand-brushed with Korean sauces such as yangyeom, honey hot, and their signature 'prinkle snow.' The menu also features Korean street-food sides like tteokbokki and cheese balls. The Granville Street location is one of several Vancouver outposts of this growing BC franchise.

restaurant.name: Kind Brewing Tasting Room
restaurant.desc: Kind Brewing is a craft brewery tasting room located in Kelowna, BC, tagged in OSM as both a pub and an alcohol retail shop. As a tasting room, it likely pours house-made beers on-site and sells packaged product to go — a natural stop for a cyclist looking to sample local BC craft beer. The Kelowna area is a popular cycling destination, and a neighbourhood brewery tasting room can offer a relaxed post-ride atmosphere.

restaurant.name: Euspiria Cafe Madeira Park
restaurant.desc: A cafe located in Madeira Park on the Sunshine Coast of Vancouver Island. It serves the local community and visiting travelers.

detail.address: 12904 Madeira Park Road, Madeira Park, V0N 2H0

restaurant.name: Twenty Two Taphouse
restaurant.desc: Twenty Two Taphouse is a restaurant in Sechelt with vegan and vegetarian menu options and wheelchair accessibility. It serves as a notable dining and refreshment stop for cycling tourists on the Sunshine Coast.

restaurant.name: Jones BBQ
restaurant.desc: Jones Bar-B-Que is an independent Texas-style barbecue restaurant that built its own stick-burner smoker and uses 100% southern smoking techniques, substituting local Vancouver Island woods like oak and maple for traditional Texas post oak and pecan. Founded in 2016 by Chris Jones, the restaurant cooks fresh daily and serves sliced meats until sold out — a deliberate commitment to never serving leftovers. The Langford location on Goldstream Avenue is their newer outpost, complementing the original Cook Street spot in Victoria.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu page states 'the entire menu is gluten free except the waffles, tacos, mini buns and the sandwich buns.' Vegetarian options include Portobello Taco, Portobello Sandwich, and smoked Portobello Mushrooms explicitly noted as 'Provided For Vegetarians' in catering menus

restaurant.name: Cafe Dilli
restaurant.desc: Cafe Dilli is a Canadian-Indian fusion café planted in the heart of Yaletown, serving chai, rice bowls, samosas, gelato, and grilled sandwiches alongside familiar Canadian staples. The space is designed for both quick grabs and relaxed breaks, making it a practical mid-ride refuelling stop in one of Vancouver's most bike-accessible neighbourhoods. Vegetarian and vegan options are part of the regular menu.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: About Us page states 'vegetarian/vegan options, everything here is made fresh'; specific items include samosas, soya chaap sandwich, guac & chips, and grilled paneer pesto sandwich

restaurant.name: King George Donair
restaurant.desc: King George Donair is an authentic Middle Eastern fast-food restaurant in Surrey serving house-made donairs, slow-cooked lamb shank, crispy falafel, and grilled kebabs using traditional recipes. The Surrey location on 100 Avenue is one of two Metro Vancouver outposts, the other being in New Westminster. Online ordering for pickup or delivery is available, making it a practical calorie stop for cyclists passing through Surrey's commercial strip.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Falafel Plate (falafel, rice, salad, hummus, tahini) is a confirmed vegetarian option listed on the menu

restaurant.name: Anecdote
restaurant.desc: Anecdote is a cozy neighborhood café on West Broadway in Vancouver, serving specialty espresso drinks alongside freshly baked pastries made in-house. The space is designed as a community gathering spot — equally suited to solo work, catching up with friends, or lingering over a matcha latte. The menu leans into plant-friendly options, with vegan and vegetarian items prominently featured.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu explicitly lists 'Veg Veg Sandwich' and 'Vegan Breakfast Cookie' as named menu items

restaurant.name: Willow Street Cafe
restaurant.desc: Willow Street Cafe occupies a striking 1927 heritage building in the heart of Chemainus — originally a Masonic Lodge, later a bank — that now serves made-to-order breakfasts, homemade soups, sandwiches, wraps, and their locally famous fresh-baked scones. A spacious outdoor deck makes it a natural warm-weather stop, and the cafe also offers cold beer, private event rental, and catering services.

restaurant.name: Cinnzeo
restaurant.desc: Cinnzeo is a Canadian franchise bakery café best known for freshly baked cinnamon rolls in classic and specialty flavours, all topped with cream cheese frosting and prepared throughout the day. The menu also includes savoury options like Cheesy Garlic Dippers, Lavazza espresso and coffee drinks, smoothies, and frappes — a reasonable pit stop for a quick energy boost. The North Vancouver location sits on the first floor of a shopping mall.

restaurant.name: Surrey Indian Bite
restaurant.desc: Surrey Indian Bites is a family-run Indian fast-food restaurant operating in the Central City Mall Food Court in Surrey, offering a rotating daily buffet alongside an à la carte menu of street food, curries, biryanis, and traditional breakfast dishes. The restaurant was founded by a family with deep roots in India's regional cuisines, emphasizing fresh ingredients and authentic spices passed down through generations. Touring cyclists stopping in Surrey will find a wide range of hearty options, including an extensive selection of vegetarian dishes.

detail.address: Central City Mall Food Court, Surrey, BC

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Paneer Pakora, Veg Sandwich with Fries, Veg Noodles, Dhahi Bhalle, Chaat Papri, Samosa Cholle, Bun Samosa, stuffed Aloo/Gobi Prantha, Kulche Chole, Puri Cholle, and Bhature Cholle

restaurant.name: Onggi
restaurant.desc: Onggi is a bright and energetic Korean eatery located in Burnaby serving an extensive menu of traditional Korean comfort food, from cold buckwheat noodles and seafood pancakes to bulgogi, galbi, and rich stews like Gamja Tang. The restaurant takes its name from the traditional earthenware pottery used to ferment Korean condiments such as gochujang and doenjang. Delivery is available for cyclists who want to order ahead, and the menu offers generous, calorie-dense dishes well suited to hungry riders.

restaurant.name: Fraternal Order of Eagles Aerie 2638
restaurant.desc: A pub operated by the Fraternal Order of Eagles, a North American civic and social organization. Located in North Vancouver, it serves as a community gathering space with a non-smoking policy.

restaurant.name: HiFive Chicken
restaurant.desc: HiFive Chicken is a Canadian fast food chain founded in Vancouver in 2016, now operating over 11 locations across British Columbia. The Burnaby Kingsway location serves freshly marinated fried and roasted chicken in various preparations — whole pieces, sandwiches, tenders, wings, and boxed meals — made with in-house sauces and special ingredients. The chain's loyalty app and e-gift cards add a modern convenience layer for regulars and travelers alike.

notes.Packed lunches: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Boxed Lunch' category alongside a 'School Lunch Program', indicating pre-packaged boxed meal options are a standard offering
notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu lists a 'Veggie Sandwich' (toasted bun, mayo, lettuce, veggie patty, tomato, onion rings). No vegan or gluten-free claims confirmed

restaurant.name: Bennett Craft Kitchen
restaurant.desc: The Bennett Craft Kitchen is a community-oriented pub in South Surrey blending traditional English pub warmth with modern culinary creativity. The menu features locally sourced ingredients across classic pub fare including burgers, fish and chips, beef dip, and tacos, alongside craft cocktails and beer. The venue hosts weekly live events and offers private event booking including fundraiser pub nights for local organizations.

restaurant.name: The Crab Shop
restaurant.desc: The Crab Shop is a North Vancouver landmark seafood shop with roots on Dollarton Highway going back to 1961, family-owned by Marcel Gregori since 1993. It specializes in wild, locally-caught BC seafood — including live Dungeness crab harvested on the owner's own fishing vessel — alongside a popular takeaway menu of fish and chips, crab sandwiches, and house-made clam chowder. A seven-time North Shore News Readers' Choice Award winner, it operates out of Dollarton Landing Plaza and draws a loyal following for both its fresh seafood counter and ready-to-eat cooked items.

detail.address: 2455 Dollarton Hwy #121, North Vancouver, BC V7H 0A2

restaurant.name: Bravo Restaurant & Lounge
restaurant.desc: Bravo Restaurant and Lounge is a casually elegant fine-dining spot in downtown Chilliwack specializing in Pacific Northwest cuisine, offering an innovative dinner menu alongside an extensive martini and wine list. The intimate yet social atmosphere makes it a standout evening destination on the Fraser Valley cycling corridor. A private lounge is available for group events, and Wi-Fi is available throughout.

restaurant.name: The Bread Company
restaurant.desc: The Bread Company is a fifth-generation family bakery café whose baking heritage stretches back to 1851 in the Netherlands, now running three locations across Kelowna. The Bernard Avenue flagship sits in downtown Kelowna and serves a full breakfast and lunch menu built around house-baked artisan breads, pastries, specialty espresso drinks, and seasonal offerings like sorbets and gelato. Touring cyclists will find a substantial, made-from-scratch food stop with catering available for groups.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website explicitly lists 'Vegan Artisan Breads' as a menu category

restaurant.name: Don Mee Seafood Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Don Mee Seafood Restaurant is a landmark Cantonese and seafood institution that has anchored Victoria's Historic Chinatown for over 80 years. The restaurant serves daily dim sum from trolleys alongside a full dinner menu of Cantonese, Szechuan, and Western-style dishes, and can host banquets for up to 260 guests. Located a short walk from the Inner Harbour, the Empress Hotel, and the Royal BC Museum, it is a well-known destination for both locals and visitors.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website menu page explicitly lists a 'Gluten Free & Vegan Menu' as a named menu section

restaurant.name: Rice & Noodle
restaurant.desc: Rice & Noodle is a casual fast-casual Thai and Asian kitchen on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, best known for its pad thai and fully customizable dishes — diners pick a base, protein, and spice level from none to extreme. The kitchen cooks fresh in front of customers, with a menu spanning curries, noodle dishes, stir-fries, and soups. Online ordering is available alongside dine-in, making it a convenient fuel stop on a city cycling route.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website lists tofu as a protein option and explicitly describes spring rolls as 'deep fried vegetarian spring roll'

restaurant.name: Café 8
restaurant.desc: Café 8 is a restaurant in White Rock. Detailed information about amenities and services could not be verified as the website was unavailable during prefetch.

restaurant.name: Kurry Wala
restaurant.desc: Kurry Wala is an Indian restaurant in Burnaby offering a regionally-inspired menu of traditional dishes built around aromatic herbs and vivid spices, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. The restaurant occupies a space formerly known as Aria Kabab House & Grill and aims for an immersive dining atmosphere blending modern elegance with Indian aesthetics. Online ordering with pickup is available for cyclists wanting a quick meal to go.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu includes dedicated vegetarian options: Paneer Tikka, Paneer Lababdar, Malai Kofta, Mushroom Do Pyaza. No vegan or GF claims found

restaurant.name: Sizzling Tandoor
restaurant.desc: Sizzling Tandoor has anchored Victoria's Indian dining scene for over 15 years, offering tandoor-cooked breads, regionally inspired curries, and a full cocktail and wine program. The Uptown location now operates under the KINU by Sizzling Tandoor brand, a contemporary tapas concept blending Indian flavours with globally inspired dishes in the Uptown shopping district. A second Downtown location on Johnson Street continues the original Sizzling Tandoor brand.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu items are tagged [V] (vegetarian) and [GF] (gluten-free) throughout, e.g. Vegetable Samosas [V], Chicken Pakora [GF], Hummus and Naan [GF V], Aloo Tikki [V GF]

restaurant.name: Habit Coffee
restaurant.desc: Habit Coffee is a community-centred coffee shop in Victoria with two locations, distinguished by over a decade of certified carbon-neutral operations and a commitment to local sourcing. All coffee and supplies are transported between shops by Dutch cargo bike, reflecting a genuine cycling-aligned ethos rare in the cafe world. Beans are ethically sourced and roasted exclusively by local partner BowsxArrows, and the shop works with a wide network of Victoria food and beverage producers.

restaurant.name: Pasta Lupino
restaurant.desc: Pasta Lupino is an Italian-inspired restaurant and deli in Whistler Village, open since May 2000 and run by husband-and-wife team Kevin Holland and Kendra Mazzei. The kitchen turns out freshly-made pastas, sauces, and breads for both dine-in and takeout, and the attached deli sells fresh pasta, housemade sauces, and specialty Italian groceries to take home. Its casual, cozy dining room and simple, hearty food make it a reliable refuelling stop after a day on the trails or roads.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu lists a dedicated Veggie Lasagna (roasted garlic, zucchini, eggplant, peppers, spinach, ricotta) and a Garden Mista Salad; roasted veggies available as a pasta add-on. No vegan or GF options explicitly mentioned

restaurant.name: Guildford Sushi House
restaurant.desc: Guildford Sushi House is a Japanese and Asian restaurant tucked into a Surrey strip mall, serving sushi, sashimi, specialty rolls, and traditional appetizers with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. The kitchen emphasizes consistency in its Japanese staples, and the menu spans everything from miso soup and edamame to nigiri sets and house special combos. Online ordering for pickup and delivery is available, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Guildford area.

notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Edamame, Gomae (spinach salad with sesame paste), Tuna Gomae, spring roll (vegetable-filled), Miso soup, Agedashi Tofu. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found

restaurant.name: Cafe C'est si bon
restaurant.desc: Cafe C'est si bon is a French-inspired patisserie in West Vancouver specializing in elegant cakes and tarts, including a Basque cheesecake, Black Swan black-sesame cake, and a gluten-free Ispahan macaron dessert. Located in a unit at 1425 Marine Drive, the cafe operates a pre-order pickup model requiring orders three days in advance. A cyclist riding the Marine Drive corridor could swing by for a celebratory pastry, though advance planning is required.

notes.Takeout: Website shows 'Order now' and 'Pickup from 1425 Marine Drive Unit 240'; FAQ confirms all orders are pre-order pickup only (3 days in advance)
notes.Vegetarian / vegan / GF: Website lists a 'Gluten Free' Ispahan dessert (macaron shells, rose buttercream, raspberries, lychee)

restaurant.name: The Wicklow
restaurant.desc: The Wicklow is a cozy waterfront tavern at Stamps Landing overlooking False Creek, serving food made fresh in house daily alongside a full drinks menu and happy hour specials. Situated along a popular cycling corridor near the False Creek seawall, the pub offers a patio with stunning water views. It operates as a neighbourhood pub with table reservations available for larger parties.

restaurant.name: Beach House Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Beach House Restaurant occupies a heritage-designated 1912 building in West Vancouver's Dundarave neighbourhood, overlooking Burrard Inlet with an oceanview patio now open for summer. The seafood-centric menu blends West Coast ingredients with Southern California influences, featuring a sushi and raw bar, rotating seasonal dishes, and an extensive martini and wine list. The second-floor Landing event space offers unobstructed water views, and the building has served the waterfront community continuously — under various names — for over a century.

restaurant.name: Sunflower Lodge
restaurant.desc: Sunflower Lodge is a farm-to-table restaurant housed in a hand-built log cabin within Fraser River Heritage Park, offering sweeping Fraser River and mountain views from both a 44-seat interior and a 48-seat patio. The kitchen draws from the owners' Maple Ridge farm, where over 200 varieties of certified organic fruits, vegetables, and herbs are grown using regenerative no-till methods, resulting in a hyper-seasonal menu that changes with what is freshest. BC beers, ciders, and wines round out the drinks list, with all beer and cider selections rotating seasonally.

restaurant.name: Doon Express
restaurant.desc: Doon Express is a long-established Indian restaurant in Tsawwassen known for authentic tandoori cuisine, house-blended spices, and a lunch buffet.
